text.title: 拉斯安
text.objectives: 在宠物战斗中击败拉斯安。
text.description: 你想再打一场？我觉得我比上次进步了！
text.completion: Nice work!
text.completed: Speak to Ras'an.

english.title: Ras'an
english.objectives: Defeat Ras'an in a pet battle.
english.description: You want to fight again? I think I've gotten better!
english.completion: Nice work!
english.completed: Speak to Ras'an.

text.title: 纳洛克
text.objectives: 在一场宠物战斗中击败纳洛克。
text.description: 我希望能再战一场。这些小家伙还需要磨练。
text.completion: It would seem that these younglings still have a lot of work to do before they are at full strength. Thank you.
text.completed: Speak to Narrok.

english.title: Narrok
english.objectives: Defeat Narrok in a pet battle.
english.description: I wish to do battle once more. These young ones need to grow stronger.
english.completion: It would seem that these younglings still have a lot of work to do before they are at full strength. Thank you.
english.completed: Speak to Narrok.

text.title: 莫勒鲁长老
text.objectives: 在一场宠物战斗中击败莫勒鲁长老。
text.description: 自从我们上一次交手之后，我又精进了不少。你想再检验下自己的技能吗？
text.completion: Even I continue to learn from each passing day.
text.completed: Speak to Morulu The Elder.

english.title: Morulu The Elder
english.objectives: Defeat Morulu The Elder in a pet battle.
english.description: I have learned much since our last encounter. Do you wish to test your skills once more?
english.completion: Even I continue to learn from each passing day.
english.completed: Speak to Morulu The Elder.

text.title: 驯宠宗师安塔里
text.objectives: 在宠物战斗中击败血骑士安塔里。
text.description: 上次交锋你把握住了我的失误，击败了我。这次你不会这么走运了，$r。
text.completion: You are a fool for thinking yourself better than me. I will crush you, I swear it!
text.completed: Speak to Bloodknight Antari.

english.title: Grand Master Antari
english.objectives: Defeat Bloodknight Antari in a pet battle.
english.description: You capitalized on my mistake last time and emerged victorious. This time, you will not be so fortunate, $r.
english.completion: You are a fool for thinking yourself better than me. I will crush you, I swear it!
english.completed: Speak to Bloodknight Antari.

text.title: 战斗宠物训练师：诺森德
text.objectives: 在宠物战斗中击败毕格·爆索、差点没头的雅各布、奥克鲁特·荒龙和格特瑞奇。
text.description: 尽管你已经打遍外域无敌手，可还有诺森德在等着你呢！$B$B你现在必须击败四位驯宠师：嚎风峡湾的毕格·爆索、晶歌森林的差点没头的雅各布、龙骨荒野的奥克鲁特·荒龙和祖达克的格特瑞奇。$B$B要是你能将他们悉数打败，那么诺森德的驯宠宗师一定会对你发出挑战！
text.giverWindow: 全力应战！

english.title: Battle Pet Tamers: Northrend
english.objectives: Defeat Beegle Blastfuse, Nearly Headless Jacob, Okrut Dragonwaste, and Gutretch in pet battles.
english.description: Outland's finest have fallen to your skill, but Northrend now awaits you!$B$BThere are four tamers that you must now defeat: Beegle Blastfuse in Howling Fjord, Nearly Headless Jacob in Crystalsong Forest, Okrut Dragonwaste in Dragonblight, and Gutretch in Zul'drak.$B$BIf you are able to best all of them, then Northrend's Grand Master will surely challenge you!
english.giverWindow: Show them your best!

objectiveDetails.description: 击败差点没头的雅各布

text.title: 驯宠宗师派恩
text.objectives: 在宠物战斗中击败派恩少校。
text.description: 依我看，我的驯宠师同行们在对你进行训练时都太过宽厚了。$B$B真正的驯宠要讲求军事化训练。我会给你这个机会，让你亲眼见识下纪律能为我们带来何种收获。$B$B到冰冠冰川的银色比武场来，让自己迸发出真正的实力吧！
text.completion: I was wrong about you, $n. You've earned my respect as one of the finest adversaries I've ever faced. Don't go and think that I'll let you defeat me again next time, though!
text.completed: Speak to Major Payne.
text.giverWindow: 为了联盟！

english.title: Grand Master Payne
english.objectives: Defeat Major Payne in a pet battle.
english.description: In my opinion, my fellow tamers have been far too lenient on your training.$B$BTrue pet taming requires militaristic discipline. I shall honor you with the pleasure of seeing firsthand what that discipline can produce.$B$BCome to the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown and see firsthand what you could become!
english.completion: I was wrong about you, $n. You've earned my respect as one of the finest adversaries I've ever faced. Don't go and think that I'll let you defeat me again next time, though!
english.completed: Speak to Major Payne.
english.giverWindow: For the Alliance!

text.title: 战斗宠物训练师：诺森德
text.objectives: 在宠物战斗中击败毕格·爆索、差点没头的雅各布、奥克鲁特·荒龙和格特瑞奇。
text.description: 尽管你已经打遍外域无敌手，可还有诺森德在等着你呢！$B$B你现在必须击败四位驯宠师：嚎风峡湾的毕格·爆索、晶歌森林的差点没头的雅各布、龙骨荒野的奥克鲁特·荒龙和祖达克的格特瑞奇。$B$B要是你能将他们悉数打败，那么诺森德的驯宠宗师一定会对你发出挑战！
text.giverWindow: 决不容许失败。
text.turninWindow: 最艰巨的挑战在等着你呢。

english.title: Battle Pet Tamers: Northrend
english.objectives: Defeat Beegle Blastfuse, Nearly Headless Jacob, Okrut Dragonwaste, and Gutretch in pet battles.
english.description: Outland's finest have fallen to your skill, but Northrend now awaits you!$B$BThere are four tamers that you must now defeat: Beegle Blastfuse in Howling Fjord, Nearly Headless Jacob in Crystalsong Forest, Okrut Dragonwaste in Dragonblight, and Gutretch in Zul'drak.$B$BIf you are able to best all of them, then Northrend's Grand Master will surely challenge you!
english.giverWindow: Failure is not an option.
english.turninWindow: Your most difficult challenge yet now awaits you.

objectiveDetails.description: 击败差点没头的雅各布

text.title: 战斗宠物训练师：潘达利亚
text.objectives: 在宠物战斗中击败圣地的俞娜、农夫倪石、莫鲁克、勇敢的尹勇、探索者祖什和废土行者苏游。
text.description: 你现在必须要面对艾泽拉斯最难对付的驯宠师了，$n。他们住在潘达利亚，那里是宗师们的训练场。$B$B你还需要击败六位宗师：翡翠林的圣地的俞娜、四风谷的农夫倪石、卡桑琅丛林的莫鲁克、昆莱山的勇敢的尹勇、螳螂高原的探索者祖什和恐惧废土的废土行者苏游。$B$B要是你认为自己已经准备好了，就去寻找这些高手，证明你自己吧！

english.title: Battle Pet Tamers: Pandaria
english.objectives: Defeat Hyuna of the Shrines, Farmer Nishi, Mo'ruk, Courageous Yon, Seeker Zusshi, and Wastewalker Shu in pet battles.
english.description: You must now face the toughest tamers in all of Azeroth, $n. They make their home in Pandaria, training ground of the grand masters.$B$BThere are six grand masters left to defeat: Hyuna of the Shrines in The Jade Forest, Farmer Nishi in Valley of the Four Winds, Mo'ruk in Krasarang Wilds, Courageous Yon in Kun-Lai Summit, Seeker Zusshi in Townlong Steppes, and Wastewalker Shu in Dread Wastes.$B$BIf you think yourself ready, seek out these champions of the trade and prove yourself!

text.title: 毕格·爆索
text.objectives: 在宠物战斗中击败毕格·爆索。
text.description: 我发誓，我的一只小鸡昨天竟然飞了一会儿。我们终于要大获成功了！$B$B噢，你想再打一场？
text.completion: One day, when we're flying high above you, you'll be the loser!
text.completed: Speak to Beegle Blastfuse.

english.title: Beegle Blastfuse
english.objectives: Defeat Beegle Blastfuse in a pet battle.
english.description: One of my chickens flew for just a moment yesterday, I swear. We're finally hitting the big time!$B$BOh, you'd like to battle again?
english.completion: One day, when we're flying high above you, you'll be the loser!
english.completed: Speak to Beegle Blastfuse.

text.title: 差点没头的雅各布
text.objectives: 在宠物战斗中击败差点没头的雅各布。
text.description: 你一次又一次地藐视我的智慧。究竟为什么要回到这片树林里来？$B$B啊，你希望再战一场。那好吧。
text.completion: Your risk has paid its due reward. Now begone!
text.completed: Speak to Nearly Headless Jacob.

english.title: Nearly Headless Jacob
english.objectives: Defeat Nearly Headless Jacob in a pet battle.
english.description: Time and time again you defy my wisdom. What is it that brings you back to these woods?$B$BAh, you wish to do battle once more. Very well then.
english.completion: Your risk has paid its due reward. Now begone!
english.completed: Speak to Nearly Headless Jacob.

objectiveDetails.description: 击败差点没头的雅各布

text.title: 奥克鲁特·荒龙
text.objectives: 在宠物战斗中击败奥克鲁特·荒龙。
text.description: 你竟敢打扰我们的工作？那就必须再跟我打一场！亮出你的宠物，我会让你尝尝地狱咆哮的怒火！
text.completion: I dare you to continue to fight the inevitable. Dragons will once again serve our purposes, and you will fall to my hand in a pet battle. I swear on the Warchief's mantle that it will be so!
text.completed: Speak to Okrut Dragonwaste.

english.title: Okrut Dragonwaste
english.objectives: Defeat Okrut Dragonwaste in a pet battle.
english.description: You dare interrupt our work? Then you must battle me again! Take out your pets, and I'll give you a taste of Hellscream's wrath!
english.completion: I dare you to continue to fight the inevitable. Dragons will once again serve our purposes, and you will fall to my hand in a pet battle. I swear on the Warchief's mantle that it will be so!
english.completed: Speak to Okrut Dragonwaste.

text.title: 格特瑞奇
text.objectives: 在宠物战斗中击败格特瑞奇。
text.description: 我喜欢跟你交手。你不像其他人那么好对付。再打一场吗？
text.completion: Me like fighting you, even if me lose.
text.completed: Speak to Gutretch.

english.title: Gutretch
english.objectives: Defeat Gutretch in a pet battle.
english.description: Me like fighting you. You not so easy like the others. We fight again?
english.completion: Me like fighting you, even if me lose.
english.completed: Speak to Gutretch.

text.title: 驯宠宗师派恩
text.objectives: 在宠物战斗中击败派恩少校。
text.description: 叛逆的$c又来挑战大师，以检验$g他:她;自己的力量了。这一次，你的勇气会为你招致毁灭！
text.completion: I applaud your tactics, but despise your victory. Well done, $n.
text.completed: Speak to Major Payne.

english.title: Grand Master Payne
english.objectives: Defeat Major Payne in a pet battle.
english.description: The rebel $c comes once again to test $g his:her; might again that of a Grand Master. Your bravery will be your undoing this time!
english.completion: I applaud your tactics, but despise your victory. Well done, $n.
english.completed: Speak to Major Payne.

text.title: “锦鱼公主”灌溉系统
text.objectives: 把“锦鱼公主”灌溉系统带到日歌农场或半山市集，交给农夫老愚。
text.description: <箱子背后产品功能那一面贴了张漫画，画的是一位锦鱼少女被宣传单给包围了。>$B$B“嘿，老兄，你还在为焦渴的南瓜犯愁吗？你还在为干瘪的卷心菜哭泣吗？你的韭菜和甜瓜还是那么蔫儿吗？$B$B那么是时候把锦鱼公主请回家了！她会像春雨一样滋润你的农田，让干旱消失得无影无踪……”$B$B<同样的内容又重复了六段。>
text.completion: A sprinkler system? For the farm? Thank you, $n! We can use this instead of that old watering can.$B$BThe "Jinyu Princess" eh? What's up with that?$B$B$B$BAlright, I don't even want to know. I'll get this installed right away!
text.completed: 将“锦鱼小姐”灌溉系统带到日歌农场或半山市集，交给农夫老愚。

english.title: The "Jinyu Princess" Irrigation System
english.objectives: Bring the "Jinyu Princess" Irrigation System to Farmer Yoon at Sunsong Ranch or Halfhill market.
english.description: <The back of the box features a caricature of a jinyu maiden surrounded by marketing copy.>$B$B"Hey there, greenthumb. Are you pouting over parched pumpkins? Crying over crusty cabbage? Are your leeks lame and your melons melancholy?$B$BThen it's time you brought home the Jinyu Princess! She'll wash over your garden like a sweet spring rain, dousing that drought with a deep draught of..."$B$B<It goes on like this for six paragraphs.>
english.completion: A sprinkler system? For the farm? Thank you, $n! We can use this instead of that old watering can.$B$BThe "Jinyu Princess" eh? What's up with that?$B$B$B$BAlright, I don't even want to know. I'll get this installed right away!
english.completed: Bring the "Jinyu Princess" Irrigation System to Farmer Yoon at Sunsong Ranch or Halfhill Market.

text.title: “雷电之王”驱虫器
text.objectives: 把“雷电之王”驱虫器带到日歌农场或半山市集，交给农夫老愚。
text.description: <一个威风凛凛的魔古肖像占据了整个箱子，双眼凝视着下方刚劲有力的黑体字。>$B$B“别让那些怯弱、讨厌的虫子侵蚀你上好的庄稼。用雷电之王的力量去消灭它们，保护你的财产。”$B$B<下面的行间用卡通画描绘出各种各样的虫子痛哭流涕、落荒而逃的样子。>
text.completion: Pest repellers! You're a genius, $n! We can finally stop using that ancient bug sprayer.$B$B$B$BAw yeah, Thunder King! That's what I'm talking about!$B$BI'll get this installed right away - those bugs won't know what hit 'em!
text.completed: 将“雷电之王”驱虫器带到日歌农场或半山市集，交给农夫老愚。

english.title: "Thunder King" Pest Repellers
english.objectives: Bring the "Thunder King" Pest Repellers to Farmer Yoon at Sunsong Ranch or Halfhill Market.
english.description: <An imposing image of a mogu face dominates this box, casting its gaze downward at neatly ordered rows of bold text.>$B$B"DO NOT LET WEAK, DISGUSTING INSECTS INFEST YOUR GLORIOUS CROPS. CONQUER THEM WITH THE MIGHT OF THE THUNDER KING AND PROTECT YOUR LEGACY."$B$B<The rest of the space is dedicated to cartoon depictions of various insects crying out in lament or fleeing in terror.>
english.completion: Pest repellers! You're a genius, $n! We can finally stop using that ancient bug sprayer.$B$B$B$BAw yeah, Thunder King! That's what I'm talking about!$B$BI'll get this installed right away - those bugs won't know what hit 'em!
english.completed: Bring the "Thunder King" Pest Repellers to Farmer Yoon at Sunsong Ranch or Halfhill Market.

text.title: “翻地者”万能犁
text.objectives: 把“翻地者”万能犁带到日歌农场或半山市集，交给农夫老愚。
text.description: <箱子上画了一幅画，一位体格异常健壮的熊猫人农夫得意洋洋地跨在宽广的裂隙上，手里抓着一把强劲的犁。幼崽们在他宽阔的肩膀上嬉戏，在他壮硕的胳膊上摇曳。$B$B在他身旁，一位端庄的女士——也是近乎异常的体格——头上顶着一只装得满满的大篮子，姿态优雅地一脚踩在兔妖脸上。>$B$B“翻地者，农用犁中的战斗犁。居家旅行，务农必备。”
text.completion: An Earth-Slasher master plow! I... I never thought I'd get to use one of these. Do you have any idea how much time this will save us?!$B$BI heard if you push the Earth-Slasher through twenty yards of solid rock, you end up with a sandbox and a citation from the Shado-Pan for causing an earthquake scare!$B$BThis is going to be AWESOME.
text.completed: 将“翻地者”万能犁带到日歌农场或半山市集，交给农夫老愚。

english.title: The "Earth-Slasher" Master Plow
english.objectives: Bring the "Earth-Slasher" Master Plow to Farmer Yoon at Sunsong Ranch or Halfhill Market.
english.description: <The box art depicts a pandaren farmer of impossible physique standing proudly astride a widening rift in the earth, a mighty plow in his grasp. Cubs wrestle playfully on his shoulders and dangle from his muscular arms.$B$BAt his side, a stoic female - of equally impossible physique - balances a massive, overflowing cornucopia gracefully on her head while kicking a virmen in the face.>$B$B"The Earth-Slasher. Master the land. Master your life."
english.completion: An Earth-Slasher master plow! I... I never thought I'd get to use one of these. Do you have any idea how much time this will save us?!$B$BI heard if you push the Earth-Slasher through twenty yards of solid rock, you end up with a sandbox and a citation from the Shado-Pan for causing an earthquake scare!$B$BThis is going to be AWESOME.
english.completed: Bring the "Earth-Slasher" Master Plow to Farmer Yoon at Sunsong Ranch or Halfhill Market.

text.title: [TEMP]
text.objectives: 种植并收获4份爽脆胡萝卜。爽脆胡萝卜种子可以在半山市集的商人绿野处买到。在开垦土地并照料植株之后，你必须等到第二天才能收获成熟的爽脆胡萝卜。
text.description: 好了，朋友，之前的农活不过是热身而已！$B$B现在，要动真格的了！你准备好了吗？$B$B市集的美美·铁掌需要一些胡萝卜来做炖菜。你知道这些胡萝卜要由谁来种吗？我们！$B$B现在，你就来种植、催生并收获四畦爽脆胡萝卜，让我看看你学到了点什么吧！
text.completed: Speak to Farmer Yoon at Sunsong Ranch in the Valley of the Four Winds.

english.title: [TEMP]
english.objectives: Plant and harvest 4 Juicycrunch Carrots. Juicycrunch Carrot Seeds can be purchased from Merchant Greenfield at Halfhill Market. After tilling and caring for your planting, you must wait until the next day to harvest grown Juicycrunch Carrots.
english.description: All right friend, all of that farming was just for practice!$B$BAre you ready to try the real thing?$B$BMei Mei Ironpaw over at the market is in need of some carrots for her stew. And you know who can grow those carrots? Us!$B$BHow about you show me what you've learned by planting, growing, and harvesting four beds of Juicycrunch Carrots?
english.completed: Speak to Farmer Yoon at Sunsong Ranch in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: Battle Pet Trainers: Pandaria
text.objectives: Defeat Ziggy the Flightless, Nearly Headless Jacob, Okrut Dragonwaste, and Gutretch in pet battles.
text.description: Outland's finest have fallen to your skill, but Northrend now awaits you!$B$BThere are four trainers that you must now defeat: Ziggy the Flightless in Howling Fjord, Nearly Headless Jacob in Crystalsong Forest, Okrut Dragonwaste in Dragonblight, and Gutretch in Zul'drak.$B$BIf you are able to best all of them, then Northrend's Grand Master will surely challenge you!
text.giverWindow: Show them your best!

english.title: Battle Pet Trainers: Pandaria
english.objectives: Defeat Ziggy the Flightless, Nearly Headless Jacob, Okrut Dragonwaste, and Gutretch in pet battles.
english.description: Outland's finest have fallen to your skill, but Northrend now awaits you!$B$BThere are four trainers that you must now defeat: Ziggy the Flightless in Howling Fjord, Nearly Headless Jacob in Crystalsong Forest, Okrut Dragonwaste in Dragonblight, and Gutretch in Zul'drak.$B$BIf you are able to best all of them, then Northrend's Grand Master will surely challenge you!
english.giverWindow: Show them your best!

text.title: 除臭碧玉瓜
text.objectives: 在日歌农场种植一棵碧玉瓜。你可以从半山市集的商人绿野那里购买种子。
text.description: 爷爷常说：“每周一只碧玉瓜，可以让臭气远离你的尾巴。”$b$b<老愚敏锐地闻了闻空气。>$b$b没错。我想一周快到了。你能帮我种一个碧玉瓜吗？
text.completion: Well planted, $n.$B$BNow we play the waiting game...
text.completed: Return to Farmer Yoon at Sunsong Ranch in the Valley of the Four Winds.

english.title: Squash Those Foul Odors
english.objectives: Plant a Jade Squash in Sunsong Ranch. You can purchase seeds from Merchant Greenfield in the Halfhill Market.
english.description: Grandpa always said, "A squash a week, and your tail won't reek."$b$b<Yoon subtly sniffs the air.>$b$bYup. I think it's been about a week. Could you help me plant a Jade Squash?
english.completion: Well planted, $n.$B$BNow we play the waiting game...
english.completed: Return to Farmer Yoon at Sunsong Ranch in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 种瓜时间
text.objectives: 在日歌农场种植一棵菜瓜。你可以从半山市集的商人绿野那里购买种子。
text.description: <农夫老愚抬头看看了天，又闻闻了空气中的气味。>$b$b嗯……$b$b<他舔了舔爪子，然后把它竖在空中，又加一根脚趾甲刺进土里，测量着自己影子的长度。>$b$b没错。种瓜的时间到了。$b$b你能去弄点种子来，帮我种一个菜瓜吗？
text.completion: That was close. We almost missed melon time.
text.completed: Return to Farmer Yoon at Sunsong Ranch in the Valley of the Four Winds.

english.title: It's Melon Time
english.objectives: Plant a Striped Melon in Sunsong Ranch. You can purchase seeds from Merchant Greenfield in the Halfhill Market.
english.description: <Farmer Yoon looks up at the sky and sniffs the air.>$b$bHmm...$b$b<He licks his paw and holds it up in the air, sticks a toenail into the soil, and then inspects the length of his shadow.>$b$bYup. It's melon time.$b$bCould you grab some seeds and help me plant a Striped Melon?
english.completion: That was close. We almost missed melon time.
english.completed: Return to Farmer Yoon at Sunsong Ranch in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 什么浆果？女巫浆果。
text.objectives: 在日歌农场种植一棵女巫浆果。你可以从半山市集的商人绿野那里购买种子。
text.description: 那个小家伙，安蒂，将来一定会长成一个了不起的农夫。只要看他一眼，我就能看出来了。$b$b我想我得为他种些女巫浆果。小孩子都喜欢浆果——那将会是一个惊喜。
text.completion: Alright, witchberries! I can't wait!$B$BBut I'm gonna have to.
text.completed: Return to Farmer Yoon at Sunsong Ranch in the Valley of the Four Winds.

english.title: Which Berries? Witchberries.
english.objectives: Plant Witchberries in Sunsong Ranch. You can purchase seeds from Merchant Greenfield in the Halfhill Market.
english.description: That young'un over there, Andi, is going to grow up to be a heck of a farmer some day. I can tell just by lookin' at him.$b$bI think I'll plant him some witchberries. Kids love witchberries - it'll be a nice surprise.
english.completion: Alright, witchberries! I can't wait!$B$BBut I'm gonna have to.
english.completed: Return to Farmer Yoon at Sunsong Ranch in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 完成训练：终极试炼
text.objectives: 去晴日峰的训练场里完成最后的试炼。
text.description: 欢迎回来，$n。你该完成最后的训练了。去我们下方的训练场接受最终的试炼吧。
text.completion: Well done, $n.  Your training is now complete.  Feel free to return in the future to spar with the masters here to practice what you have learned.
text.completed: Speak to Master Hight in the Shrine of the Ox.

english.title: Complete Your Training: The Final Test
english.objectives: Go the the Training Grounds at the Peak of Serenity and complete your final test.
english.description: Welcome back, $n.  The time has come for you to complete the last step of your training.  Head to the Training Grounds for your final test.
english.completion: Well done, $n.  Your training is now complete.  Feel free to return in the future to spar with the masters here to practice what you have learned.
english.completed: Speak to Master Hight in the Shrine of the Ox.

text.title: 学习务农（六）：吉娜的选票
text.objectives: 种植并收获一棵葱，然后将5棵葱送给吉娜·泥爪。$B$B你可以从半山市集的商人绿野那里买到小葱种子。耕种并灌溉后，你必须等到次日才能收获成熟的葱。
text.description: 我的生意算是毁了！你看到那些大排档里的铁掌家了吗？$B$B他们美味的菜肴吸引了市集上的大部分顾客，但他们的葱快用完了！$B$B葱看上去没什么，但却是一种重要的烹饪材料。要是没了葱，食物就没那么香了，没那么可口了，也没那么诱人了。$B$B这问题很严重。我这边的葱已经断了一周的货了！$B$B等等，你不是农夫吗？你能不能帮帮我？
text.progress: Don't overlook the scallion. It may be small and innocuous, but it creates truly marvelous flavors.
text.completion: Well, I'll be! I've certainly seen larger scallions, but this will do quite nicely. You've just saved our hides, $n!
text.completed: Speak to Gina Mudclaw at Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

english.title: Learn and Grow VI: Gina's Vote
english.objectives: Plant and harvest 1 Scallion, then deliver 5 Scallions to Gina Mudclaw.$B$BScallion Seeds can be purchased from Merchant Greenfield at Halfhill Market. After tilling and tending your plant, you must wait until the next day to harvest ripe Scallions.
english.description: My business is doomed! You see all of the Ironpaws at their cooking stations?$B$BTheir tasty dishes draw many of the customers to this market, but they're all out of scallions!$B$BIt may not look like much, but the scallion is an essential cooking ingredient. Without it, foods are less savory, less flavorful, and less aromatic.$B$BThis is terrible. I'm not getting another scallion shipment for a week!$B$BWait a second. You're a farmer, aren't you? You think you could help me?
english.progress: Don't overlook the scallion. It may be small and innocuous, but it creates truly marvelous flavors.
english.completion: Well, I'll be! I've certainly seen larger scallions, but this will do quite nicely. You've just saved our hides, $n!
english.completed: Speak to Gina Mudclaw at Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 蒙蒙的选票（三）：狸猫换太子
text.objectives: 种植并收获2根爽脆胡萝卜，然后将10根爽脆胡萝卜送给蒙蒙。$B$B你可以从半山市集的商人绿野那里买到爽脆胡萝卜种子。耕种并灌溉后，你必须等到次日才能收获成熟的爽脆胡萝卜。
text.description: 蒙蒙才不在乎是谁偷了胡萝卜。蒙蒙只在乎当泥爪先生发现他的庄稼被毁后，会如何惩罚可怜的蒙蒙！$B$B<蒙蒙撑着下巴，陷入沉思。>$B$B等等！蒙蒙有个好主意。你去种些爽脆胡萝卜，然后我们就把你的胡萝卜当成是泥爪先生的。$B$B就这么干！
text.progress: Virmens love carrots, but they hate turnips. I hate turnips, too.
text.completion: Whoa, these carrots look crunchy and juicy, $n! Mung-Mung did not know you had such a green thumb.
text.completed: Return to Mung-Mung at Haohan Mudclaw's House in the Valley of the Four Winds.

english.title: Mung-Mung's Vote III: The Great Carrot Caper
english.objectives: Plant and harvest 2 Juicycrunch Carrots, then deliver 10 Juicycrunch Carrots to Mung-Mung.$B$BJuicycrunch Carrot Seeds can be purchased from Merchant Greenfield at Halfhill Market. After tilling and tending your plant, you must wait until the next day to harvest ripe Juicycrunch Carrots.
english.description: Mung-Mung don't care who steals carrots. Only care what Mr. Mudclaw does to poor Mung-Mung when he finds his crop is ruined!$B$B<Mung-Mung rubs his chin thoughtfully.>$B$BWait! Mung-Mung have bright idea. You go and grow some juicycrunch carrots. Then, we take your carrots and pretend they are Mr. Mudclaw's.$B$BYes!
english.progress: Virmens love carrots, but they hate turnips. I hate turnips, too.
english.completion: Whoa, these carrots look crunchy and juicy, $n! Mung-Mung did not know you had such a green thumb.
english.completed: Return to Mung-Mung at Haohan Mudclaw's House in the Valley of the Four Winds.

objectiveDetails.description: 收获成熟的爽脆胡萝卜

text.title: 农夫老方的选票（三）：美味卷心菜
text.objectives: 种植并收获3颗绿色卷心菜，然后将15颗绿色卷心菜送给农夫老方。$B$B你可以从半山市集的商人绿野那里买到绿色卷心菜种子。耕种并灌溉后，你必须等到次日才能收获成熟的绿色卷心菜。
text.description: <农夫老方喜笑颜开。>$B$B多亏了你，我终于找回我的金牌牦牛了！但不幸的是，我发现它们这些天在外面流浪，把自己搞得面黄肌瘦。$B$B它们肯定是饿坏了，但我从不给我们家的金牌牦牛吃廉价货。$B$B它们只吃谷里品质最好的卷心菜。$B$B我的库存不多了。如果你能帮我的牦牛带些卷心菜回来，我会给你丰厚的报酬。
text.progress: I have pet nicknames for all of my yaks. There's Hairy, and Shaggy, and Fluffy, and Woolly, and...
text.completion: I was expecting cabbages, but not cabbages of this quality! Oh my!$B$BA perfectly round head, large waxy leaves, a perfect gradient of emerald color...$B$B<Farmer Fung takes a bite out of the cabbage.>$B$BMmm, and sweet, crisp flavor! These is a beautiful cabbage, $n. My yaks will certainly be spoiled by this tasty treat.
text.completed: Return to Farmer Fung at The Heartland or at Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

english.title: Farmer Fung's Vote III: Crazy For Cabbage
english.objectives: Plant and harvest 3 Green Cabbages, then deliver 15 Green Cabbages to Farmer Fung.$B$BGreen Cabbage Seeds can be purchased from Merchant Greenfield at Halfhill Market. After tilling and tending your plant, you must wait until the next day to harvest ripe Green Cabbages.
english.description: <Farmer Fung is beaming with a radiant smile.>$B$BThanks to you, I got my precious yaks back! Unfortunately, I noticed that their time out in the wild left them rather gaunt.$B$BThey must be starving, but I don't feed my prize yaks just any regular old grass.$B$BNo sir, they eat only the leafiest green cabbages you can find here in the Valley.$B$BMy stores are a bit low. If you bring me some cabbages for my yaks, I will reward you handsomely.
english.progress: I have pet nicknames for all of my yaks. There's Hairy, and Shaggy, and Fluffy, and Woolly, and...
english.completion: I was expecting cabbages, but not cabbages of this quality! Oh my!$B$BA perfectly round head, large waxy leaves, a perfect gradient of emerald color...$B$B<Farmer Fung takes a bite out of the cabbage.>$B$BMmm, and sweet, crisp flavor! These is a beautiful cabbage, $n. My yaks will certainly be spoiled by this tasty treat.
english.completed: Return to Farmer Fung at The Heartland or at Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

objectiveDetails.description: 收获成熟的绿色卷心菜

text.title: 娜娜的选票（二）：活泉圣水
text.objectives: 用空水罐在流金瀑收集千年沉水。
text.description: 你来的正是时候，$n。我正想做批新鲜的浆果冰柠酒呢。$B$B你有没有听说过这种神奇的饮料？$B$B喝上一小口，你的容貌就能年轻10岁！不然你以为我怎么看上去还这么容光焕发呢？$B$B总之，我需要一种特殊的材料——千年沉水——你可以在北边瀑布的源头找到这种水。$B$B我恐怕取水之路对我这个老太婆来讲有点苛刻了。不过你要是愿意帮把手的话，我会很乐意把我的酒与你分享的。
text.progress: The water in this valley flows from the Vale of Eternal Blossoms to the north. It is said that these waters have wondrous, magical properties.
text.completion: Found the falls, did you? Oh yes, I see you found the water. Wonderful!
text.completed: Return to Nana Mudclaw at Halfhill in the Valley of Four Winds.

english.title: Nana's Vote II: The Sacred Springs
english.objectives: Use the Empty Pitcher at the Golden Falls to collect Thousand-Year Water.
english.description: You caught me at a good time, $n. I was just hankering to make a fresh batch of Witchberry Julep.$B$BHave you ever heard of this wondrous brew?$B$BEach sip takes ten years off your face! How do you think I still look so good?$B$BAnyway, I need a special ingredient - thousand-year water - which can be collected from the mouth of the waterfall to the north.$B$BI'm afraid the journey is too treacherous for an old matron like me, but if you can get your hands on a pitcher, I'll let you share my brew.
english.progress: The water in this valley flows from the Vale of Eternal Blossoms to the north. It is said that these waters have wondrous, magical properties.
english.completion: Found the falls, did you? Oh yes, I see you found the water. Wonderful!
english.completed: Return to Nana Mudclaw at Halfhill in the Valley of Four Winds.

text.title: 娜娜的选票（三）：浆果冰柠酒
text.objectives: 种植并收获3颗女巫浆果，然后将15颗女巫浆果送给娜娜·泥爪。$B$B你可以从半山市集的商人绿野那里买到女巫浆果种子。耕种并灌溉后，你必须等到次日才能收获成熟的女巫浆果。
text.description: 现在千年沉水已经到手了，我几乎都能感觉到浆果冰柠酒的滋味了！$B$B现在，我们还需要找些女巫浆果。$B$B我外孙今年浆果的收成不是很好，所以我只能在别的地方想想办法了。$B$B对了，今年你的地里有没有种女巫浆果啊？不如你从你的农场里摘些给我？$B$B只要你种的浆果品质不是太差，我们就能帮自己酿上一批上好的冰柠酒了。
text.progress: Hurry it up, will ya? I'm an old woman. I don't have all the time in the world, and I want one more taste of the sauce before I croak!
text.completion: <Nana Mudclaw scrutinizes a dark witchberry, then pops it into her mouth. Her face lights up.>$B$BLands alive! I haven't tasted such a sweet, juicy witchberry in years! Why, the only person who could grow berries like these was... Old Yoon, yer friend's grandpa.$B$B<Nana Mudclaw blushes.>$B$BOh that man was such a scamp! I still remember the summer days when we were young, eating these berries by the bushel without a care in the world.$B$BThank you for reminding me of an old friend, $n.
text.completed: Return to Nana Mudclaw at Halfhill in the Valley of the Four Winds.

english.title: Nana's Vote III: Witchberry Julep
english.objectives: Plant and harvest 3 Witchberries, then deliver 15 Witchberries to Nana Mudclaw.$B$BWitchberry Seeds can be purchased from Merchant Greenfield at Halfhill Market. After tilling and tending your plant, you must wait until the next day to harvest ripe Witchberries.
english.description: Now that we have the water, I can almost taste the icy cold witchberry julep!$B$BNow, we just need to find ourselves some sweet witchberries.$B$BMy grandson's berries this season have been total slop, so I need to seek a decent harvest elsewhere.$B$BSay, do you have any witchberries in the ground this year? How about you bring me some from your farm?$B$BIf your berries are up to the standard, we'll make ourselves a grand old batch of the old juice!
english.progress: Hurry it up, will ya? I'm an old woman. I don't have all the time in the world, and I want one more taste of the sauce before I croak!
english.completion: <Nana Mudclaw scrutinizes a dark witchberry, then pops it into her mouth. Her face lights up.>$B$BLands alive! I haven't tasted such a sweet, juicy witchberry in years! Why, the only person who could grow berries like these was... Old Yoon, yer friend's grandpa.$B$B<Nana Mudclaw blushes.>$B$BOh that man was such a scamp! I still remember the summer days when we were young, eating these berries by the bushel without a care in the world.$B$BThank you for reminding me of an old friend, $n.
english.completed: Return to Nana Mudclaw at Halfhill in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: [TEMP]
text.objectives: Plant and harvest 4 Juicycrunch Carrots. Juicycrunch Carrot Seeds can be purchased from Merchant Greenfield at Halfhill Market. After tilling and caring for your planting, you must wait until the next day to harvest grown Juicycrunch Carrots.
text.description: All right friend, all of that farming was just for practice!$B$BAre you ready to try the real thing?$B$BMei Mei Ironpaw over at the market is in need of some carrots for her stew. And you know who can grow those carrots? Us!$B$BHow about you show me what you've learned by planting, growing, and harvesting four beds of Juicycrunch Carrots?
text.completed: Speak to Farmer Yoon at Sunsong Ranch in the Valley of the Four Winds.

english.title: [TEMP]
english.objectives: Plant and harvest 4 Juicycrunch Carrots. Juicycrunch Carrot Seeds can be purchased from Merchant Greenfield at Halfhill Market. After tilling and caring for your planting, you must wait until the next day to harvest grown Juicycrunch Carrots.
english.description: All right friend, all of that farming was just for practice!$B$BAre you ready to try the real thing?$B$BMei Mei Ironpaw over at the market is in need of some carrots for her stew. And you know who can grow those carrots? Us!$B$BHow about you show me what you've learned by planting, growing, and harvesting four beds of Juicycrunch Carrots?
english.completed: Speak to Farmer Yoon at Sunsong Ranch in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 驯宠宗师亚济
text.objectives: 在宠物战斗中击败天选者亚济。
text.description: 你已经勇敢高明地击败了艾泽拉斯的诸位驯宠师。就连那些大师级高手也纷纷倒在你狡诈的战术面前。$B$B我现在正在锦绣谷等你，你已经赢得了与我交手的资格。来吧，$n，让我们瞧瞧你是否有实力将我击败。
text.completion: You have emerged victorious. Continue your training and find challenges in other trainers like yourself. The journey is never truly complete.
text.completed: Speak to Aki the Chosen.
text.giverWindow: 是时候面对我了。

english.title: Grand Master Aki
english.objectives: Defeat Aki the Chosen in a pet battle.
english.description: You have fought hard and well against the trainers of Azeroth. Even the grand masters have fallen to your cunning tactics.$B$BI now await you in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms, for you have earned the privilege to face me in battle. Come, $n, and let us see if you have what it takes to defeat me.
english.completion: You have emerged victorious. Continue your training and find challenges in other trainers like yourself. The journey is never truly complete.
english.completed: Speak to Aki the Chosen.
english.giverWindow: It is time to face me.

text.title: 战斗宠物训练师：潘达利亚
text.objectives: 在宠物战斗中击败圣地的俞娜、农夫倪石、莫鲁克、勇敢的尹勇、探索者祖什和废土行者苏游。
text.description: 你现在必须要面对艾泽拉斯最难对付的驯宠师了，$n。他们住在潘达利亚，那里是大师们的训练场。$B$B你还要击败六位大师：翡翠林的圣地的俞娜、四风谷的农夫倪石、卡桑琅丛林的莫鲁克、昆莱山的勇敢的尹勇、螳螂高原的探索者祖什和恐惧废土的废土行者苏游。$B$B要是你认为自己已经准备好了，就去寻找这些高手，证明你自己吧！

english.title: Battle Pet Tamers: Pandaria
english.objectives: Defeat Hyuna of the Shrines, Farmer Nishi, Mo'ruk, Courageous Yon, Seeker Zusshi, and Wastewalker Shu in pet battles.
english.description: You must now face the toughest tamers in all of Azeroth, $n. They make their home in Pandaria, training ground of the grand masters.$B$BThere are six grand masters left to defeat: Hyuna of the Shrines in The Jade Forest, Farmer Nishi in Valley of the Four Winds, Mo'ruk in Krasarang Wilds, Courageous Yon in Kun-Lai Summit, Seeker Zusshi in Townlong Steppes, and Wastewalker Shu in Dread Wastes.$B$BIf you think yourself ready, seek out these champions of the trade and prove yourself!

text.title: 驯宠宗师俞娜
text.objectives: 在宠物战斗中击败圣地的俞娜。
text.description: 你还想再打一场？很好，那会让我变得越发强大，更好地保护我人民的圣地。
text.completion: You are very strong. Will you lend your skills to my efforts?
text.completed: Speak to Hyuna of the Shrines.

english.title: Grand Master Hyuna
english.objectives: Defeat Hyuna of the Shrines in a pet battle.
english.description: You seek to do battle once more? Very well, it will strengthen me to better protect the sacred sites of my people.
english.completion: You are very strong. Will you lend your skills to my efforts?
english.completed: Speak to Hyuna of the Shrines.

text.title: 驯宠宗师莫鲁克
text.objectives: 在宠物战斗中击败莫鲁克。
text.description: 这次我要狠狠攻击了！瞧好了！
text.completion: Next time you lose. I'm gonna beatcha!
text.completed: Speak to Mo'ruk.

english.title: Grand Master Mo'ruk
english.objectives: Defeat Mo'ruk in a pet battle.
english.description: This time I'm gonna do the beating! You watch!
english.completion: Next time you lose. I'm gonna beatcha!
english.completed: Speak to Mo'ruk.

text.title: 驯宠宗师倪石
text.objectives: 在宠物战斗中击败农夫倪石。
text.description: 多亏了这片肥沃的土地，我训练的宠物力量与日俱增。你赢不了我的！
text.completion: Wow! I'm not the only one that's been training!
text.completed: Speak to Farmer Nishi.

english.title: Grand Master Nishi
english.objectives: Defeat Farmer Nishi in a pet battle.
english.description: My pets continue to grow in strength thanks to the fertile land we train on. You don't stand a chance!
english.completion: Wow! I'm not the only one that's been training!
english.completed: Speak to Farmer Nishi.

text.title: 驯宠宗师尹勇
text.objectives: 在宠物战斗中击败勇敢的尹勇。
text.description: 要是你以为我会让你再次得胜离去，那可就大错特错了。这一次，我要以无敌驯宠师的身份，凌驾于你之上！
text.completion: Fine. Victory is yours once more. Begone, I have much preparation to do before we meet again.
text.completed: Speak to Grand Master Yon.

english.title: Grand Master Yon
english.objectives: Defeat Courageous Yon in a pet battle.
english.description: If you think I am going to let you walk away with another victory in hand, you are sorely mistaken. This time, I will stand over you as the superior trainer!
english.completion: Fine. Victory is yours once more. Begone, I have much preparation to do before we meet again.
english.completed: Speak to Grand Master Yon.

text.title: 驯宠宗师苏游
text.objectives: 在宠物战斗中击败废土行者苏游。
text.description: 你再次来到废土深处与我见面，只为再次被真正的驯宠宗师亲手击败。真是既高尚又愚蠢。
text.completion: In all my time as a grand master I've never faced one as determined as you. The others were right about you. You are a force to be reckoned with.
text.completed: Speak to Wastewalker Shu.

english.title: Grand Master Shu
english.objectives: Defeat Wastewalker Shu in a pet battle.
english.description: You venture into the heart of the wastes to face me again, only to suffer defeat at the hands of a true grand master. Noble, but foolish.
english.completion: In all my time as a grand master I've never faced one as determined as you. The others were right about you. You are a force to be reckoned with.
english.completed: Speak to Wastewalker Shu.

text.title: 驯宠宗师亚济
text.objectives: 在宠物战斗中击败天选者亚济。
text.description: 你想再次对我发起挑战？很好，那就打吧。
text.completion: You are stronger and your skills more refined. Your journey continues.
text.completed: Speak to Aki the Chosen.

english.title: Grand Master Aki
english.objectives: Defeat Aki the Chosen in a pet battle.
english.description: You wish to test yourself against me once more? Very well, let us fight.
english.completion: You are stronger and your skills more refined. Your journey continues.
english.completed: Speak to Aki the Chosen.

text.title: 女皇的开局
text.objectives: 向恐惧之心的无伤者玛里克报到。
text.description: 大女皇夏柯希尔终于对我们失去了耐心。我们刚刚了解到，一支大军已经在恐惧之心的阴影之下集结，并受命摧毁卡拉克西维斯。$B$B我们能够坚守这么久，已经非常幸运了，但我们无法抵挡这种规模的攻击。$B$B唤醒者，你对我们的帮助是无比珍贵的。去吧，和我们这些英杰一起奔赴战场。$b$b我们战场见。

english.title: The Empress' Gambit
english.objectives: Report to Malik the Unscathed outside the Heart of Fear.
english.description: Grand Empress Shek'zeer has finally lost her patience with us. We have learned of an enormous army, massing in the shadows of the Heart of Fear, with orders to crush Klaxxi'vess.$B$BWe have been fortunate to hold out this long, but we cannot survive a siege of this scale.$B$BWakener, you have been invaluable to our efforts. Come, take your place on the field among we paragons.$b$bI will see you on the battlefield!

text.title: 战斗宠物训练师：大地的裂变
text.objectives: 在宠物战斗中击败布洛克、鲍丁·固拳和高兹·怨怒。
text.description: 你已经击败了诺森德最杰出的驯宠师，可你需要做更多的准备，才能面对潘达利亚的驯宠宗师。你可以尝试击败下列精英驯宠师来让自己做好准备，磨练技能，他们是海加尔山的布洛克、深岩之洲的鲍丁·固拳和暮光高地的高兹·怨怒。$B$B等你战胜他们后，就可以去潘达利亚迎接最终的挑战了。
text.giverWindow: 全力应战！

english.title: Battle Pet Tamers: Cataclysm
english.objectives: Defeat Brok, Bordin Steadyfist, and Goz Banefury in pet battles.
english.description: You have defeated Northrend's finest tamers, but you need more preparation before you are ready to face the grand masters of Pandaria. Ready yourself and hone your skills by defeating these elite tamers: Brok in Mount Hyjal, Bordin Steadyfist in Deepholm, and Goz Banefury in Twilight Highlands.$B$BOnce you have triumphed over them, you will be ready to journey to Pandaria to face the ultimate challenge.
english.giverWindow: Show them your best!

text.title: 战斗宠物训练师：大地的裂变
text.objectives: 在宠物战斗中击败布洛克、鲍丁·固拳和高兹·怨怒。
text.description: 诺森德的驯宠师纷纷成了你的手下败将，可你还没做好面对潘达利亚宗师的准备。击败下列驯宠师，能让你的意志变得越发坚定，更好地应对未来的挑战：海加尔山的布洛克、深岩之洲的鲍丁·固拳和暮光高地的高兹·怨怒。$B$B只有击败他们，你才能前往潘达利亚。
text.giverWindow: 你已历经千辛万苦，决不能半途而废。
text.turninWindow: 准备好迎接下一场挑战了吗，驯宠师？

english.title: Battle Pet Tamers: Cataclysm
english.objectives: Defeat Brok, Bordin Steadyfist, and Goz Banefury in pet battles.
english.description: Northrend has fallen to your hand, but you are not yet ready to face the grand masters of Pandaria. Defeat these tamers to harden your will for the coming challenges: Brok in Mount Hyjal, Bordin Steadyfist in Deepholm, and Goz Banefury in Twilight Highlands.$B$BOnly by defeating them will you be ready to journey to Pandaria.
english.giverWindow: You have come too far to fail.
english.turninWindow: Think you're ready for the next challenge, tamer?

text.title: Doubt Begins To Surface
text.objectives: Snap Nazgrim out of it.
text.description: The Alliance... so many airships. How can we possibly fight them all? I... don't feel... well...
text.completed: Speak with Taran Tzu at Thunder Hold in the Jade Forest.

english.title: Doubt Begins To Surface

text.title: 驯宠宗师奥巴里斯
text.objectives: 在宠物战斗中击败奥巴里斯。
text.description: 你觉得自己已经准备好进军潘达利亚了？你真以为自己能击败全艾泽拉斯最强大的驯宠师？$B$B我会试试你的实力，$r。到奥丹姆的维尔纳尔水坝顶上来找我，让我们瞧瞧，你究竟准备好了没有。
text.completion: I have been proven wrong. You are prepared to face my greaters.
text.completed: Speak to Obalis.
text.giverWindow: 我等待着我们的对决。

english.title: Grand Master Obalis
english.objectives: Defeat Obalis in a pet battle.
english.description: You think yourself ready to challenge Pandaria? You truly believe that you can defeat the most powerful tamers in all of Azeroth?$B$BI shall be the judge of that notion, $r. Face me atop the Vir'naal Dam in Uldum, and we shall see if you are truly ready.
english.completion: I have been proven wrong. You are prepared to face my greaters.
english.completed: Speak to Obalis.
english.giverWindow: I await our battle.

text.title: 驯宠宗师奥巴里斯
text.objectives: 在宠物战斗中击败奥巴里斯。
text.description: 看来大获全胜的驯宠师又来找我检验$G他自己:她自己;的实力了。很好。我接受你的挑战。
text.completion: By defeating me, I grow stronger. I urge you to be wary during our next encounter.
text.completed: Speak to Obalis.

english.title: Grand Master Obalis
english.objectives: Defeat Obalis in a pet battle.
english.description: I see the triumphant tamer returns to again test $G himself:herself; against me. Very well. I accept your challenge.
english.completion: By defeating me, I grow stronger. I urge you to be wary during our next encounter.
english.completed: Speak to Obalis.

text.title: 布洛克
text.objectives: 在宠物战斗中击败布洛克。
text.description: 我还不是很理解这些生物所处的困境，所以无法充分帮助它们。也许再战一场能加强我们的联结？
text.completion: Even in defeat I feel closer to my pets. Thank you for a worthy skirmish.
text.completed: Speak to Brok.

english.title: Brok
english.objectives: Defeat Brok in a pet battle.
english.description: I do not yet understand the plight of these creatures well enough to help them sufficiently. Perhaps another battle would strengthen our bond?
english.completion: Even in defeat I feel closer to my pets. Thank you for a worthy skirmish.
english.completed: Speak to Brok.

text.title: 鲍丁·固拳
text.objectives: 在宠物战斗中击败鲍丁·固拳。
text.description: 当地人教我领会到了大地之力。我明白那是一种无尽的坚忍。让我们再战一场吧，你会发现，我变得比以前更难对付！
text.completion: No, no, I just messed up. How about another go?
text.completed: Speak to Bordin Steadyfist.

english.title: Bordin Steadyfist
english.objectives: Defeat Bordin Steadyfist in a pet battle.
english.description: The natives have taught me the strength of the earth. I know it's unending endurance. Let us battle once more, and you'll see that I'm tougher than ever!
english.completion: No, no, I just messed up. How about another go?
english.completed: Speak to Bordin Steadyfist.

text.description: 暮光之力在我体内涌动。我就是神！你没希望打败我！
text.completion: You fight with the wrath of my masters. Perhaps you and I aren't so different.
text.completed: Speak to Goz Banefury.

text.description: 在我看来，你跟其他那些高手一样，都属于外域。为什么不回暴风城找奥黛丽·伯恩赫普，看看作为新晋的驯宠师，下一步该做什么！
text.completion: Let's see...where to send you next...

text.title: 酒最珍贵！
text.objectives: 在蜜露林地里找回6桶蜜酒。
text.description: 瞧瞧这儿，真是一团糟！所有的酒都浪费了！$b$b祝踏岚警告我们说不要跟你们这些陌生人讲话，但眼下我也顾不了那么多了。$b$b当时我们正把酒送到晨芳园，结果半路上遇袭了。现在所有的酒都丢了！$b$b你想跟我们和解吗？那就帮我们找回一些还未破损的蜜酒酒桶吧，这样就能减少些损失了。
text.completion: Well, it's not as much as I would have hoped, but it will have to do. I guess there is no sense in cryin' over spilled brew.
text.completed: Return to Ellie Honeypaw in Honeydew Village.

english.title: Priorities!
english.objectives: Find 6 Barrels of Honeybrew in Honeydew Glade.
english.description: Just look at this mess! All that brew gone to waste!$b$bTaran Zhu warned us against speaking to you outsiders, but I'll take any help I can get.$b$bWe were on our way to Dawn's Blossom to deliver our brew when the fighting broke out. Now all of our brew has been lost!$b$bYou want to make it up to us? Maybe you can find some of our Honeybrew barrels that haven't been broken. Then it wouldn't be a complete loss.
english.completion: Well, it's not as much as I would have hoped, but it will have to do. I guess there is no sense in cryin' over spilled brew.
english.completed: Return to Ellie Honeypaw in Honeydew Village.

text.description: 干得好，真是好极了！要是你愿意的话，请回暴风城找奥黛丽·伯恩赫普小姐。$B$B噢，记得代我向她问好。她是位年轻漂亮的美女，理应有老成持重的斗士陪伴在侧，比如我自己。

text.title: 奥黛丽·伯恩赫普
text.objectives: 去暴风城向奥黛丽·伯恩赫普报到。
text.description: 你好，$n！我叫奥黛丽·伯恩赫普。近来我听说了不少关于你的消息。你正在成为一名出色的驯宠师！$B$B你应该到暴风城找我谈谈。我与艾泽拉斯各地的精英驯宠师都有所往来，我能帮你变得更强！
text.completion: Ah, you're $n. Splendid! Let's get to work then, shall we?
text.giverWindow: 我想马上与你见面！

english.title: Audrey Burnhep
english.objectives: Report to Audrey Burnhep in Stormwind.
english.description: Greetings, $n! My name is Audrey Burnhep. I've been hearing quite a lot about you recently. You're becoming quite the tamer!$B$BYou should come speak with me in Stormwind. I have connections with some of the finest tamers in all of Azeroth, and I can help you grow even more!
english.completion: Ah, you're $n. Splendid! Let's get to work then, shall we?
english.giverWindow: I can't wait to meet you!

text.title: 瓦佐克
text.objectives: 去奥格瑞玛向瓦佐克报到。
text.description: 力量与荣耀，$n。我叫瓦佐克。我近来听说了不少你作为驯宠师所取得的成就，我愿意把你引荐给艾泽拉斯的其他训练师，使你进一步磨练自己的技能。$B$B请到奥格瑞玛来找我聊聊，我们尽快开始。
text.completion: You must be $n. Well met. I am Varzok.$B$BI will serve as your contact from here on out.
text.giverWindow: 期待与你会面。

english.title: Varzok
english.objectives: Report to Varzok in Orgrimmar.
english.description: Lok'tar, $n. My name is Varzok. I have heard much your accomplishments as a tamer recently, and I would like to introduce you to trainers around Azeroth so that you may further hone your skills.$B$BPlease speak with me in Orgrimmar so that we may begin.
english.completion: You must be $n. Well met. I am Varzok.$B$BI will serve as your contact from here on out.
english.giverWindow: I look forward to meeting you.

text.title: 长者的好运护符
text.objectives: 收集90枚次级好运护符。
text.description: 欢迎你，$n。我有幸为你送上一个难得的好机会。经过几个世纪，我们找到了一种可以改变运势的方法。只要拥有长者的好运护符，就能让更多的珍贵神器落入你的手中。
text.progress: May these charms bring you great luck, $n.
text.completion: May the stars smile upon you, $N.
text.completed: Return to Elder Lin in the Shrine of Seven Stars in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

With an Elder Charm of Good Fortune, valuable artifacts will find their way into your hands more frequently.

text.title: 他姓……风暴烈酒
text.objectives: 去四风谷的雷脚农场和陈·风暴烈酒谈一谈。
text.description: 几天前，一个很特别的熊猫人路过镇上。他比小潘更会讲故事，酒量是李寻杯的两倍，然后还在吧台前揍了我一顿。而他那个小侄女就一直在边上打趣我们。$b$b那真是太了不起了。$b$b听说他们往四风谷去了。你一定得去见见他！只是……千万要小心他的右勾拳。
text.completion: Ha ha! You were sent by Bolo? The "Keg Mender," right? From the Drunken Hozen?$b$bHow is his eye healing? Is his friend still hung over?$b$bAhh... that was an enjoyable evening.

english.title: His Name Was... Stormstout
english.objectives: Speak with Chen Stormstout at the Thunderfoot Fields in the Valley of the Four Winds.
english.description: An unusual pandaren came through town a few days back. He told a better tale than Pan, drank twice as much as Lee, and then beat me up in front of the bar. All while his little niece made fun of us.$b$bIt was awesome.$b$bThey said they were headed to the Valley of the Four Winds. You should meet him! Just... watch out for that right hook.
english.completion: Ha ha! You were sent by Bolo? The "Keg Mender," right? From the Drunken Hozen?$b$bHow is his eye healing? Is his friend still hung over?$b$bAhh... that was an enjoyable evening.

text.title: 他们叫他……风暴烈酒
text.objectives: 去四风谷的雷脚农场和陈·风暴烈酒谈一谈。
text.description: 我们可不总是这么走运，$r。才不是呢，一般情况下可要糟得多了。大约三周前，我们遭到一群蜥蜴人强盗的围攻。他们偷走了我们的玉石，糟蹋了我们储藏的食物，还吓唬我们的孩子。$b$b总之在我们最需要英雄的时候，一个英雄出现了。$b$b他赶跑了蜥蜴人的部队，击败了他们的首领，还夺回了我们的玉石。而他只要求让他侄女骑一回翔龙作为回报。$b$b我难以表达对他的谢意。如果你要去四风谷，能帮我们转达一下感谢之情吗？
text.completion: You come from the Temple of the Jade Serpent? Rain-Zhu sends his thanks?$B$BAi yah... really, that was nothing. I could have defeated that saurok without spilling my beer.$B$BIn fact, I believe I did.

english.title: They Call Him... Stormstout
english.objectives: Speak with Chen Stormstout at the Thunderfoot Fields in the Valley of the Four Winds.
english.description: Things were not always like this, $r. Oh no, they were much, much worse. Not three weeks ago, we were under siege by saurok bandits. They stole our jade, befouled our food stores, and terrorized our cubs.$b$bWe needed a hero, and a hero arrived.$b$bHe drove back their forces, defeated their leader, and returned our stolen jade. All he asked in return was a serpent ride for his niece.$b$bI was never able to thank him. If you are headed to the Valley of the Four Winds, would you relay our thanks?
english.completion: You come from the Temple of the Jade Serpent? Rain-Zhu sends his thanks?$B$BAi yah... really, that was nothing. I could have defeated that saurok without spilling my beer.$B$BIn fact, I believe I did.

text.title: 千年一遇
text.objectives: 与卡拉克西维斯的卡拉克西瓦交谈。
text.description: 时候到了，唤醒者。$b$b议会将集中所有力量，解决这个堕落的女皇。$b$b以你们种族的寿命来衡量，这种仪式大概已经有一百个轮回未曾举行了——而且从未有外来者目睹过它。$b$b为了感谢你为我们所做的一切，我邀请你来见证我族历史的这一伟大时刻。
text.completion: Your arrival is timely, wakener.$B$BOur ritual is underway.
text.giverWindow: 返回卡拉克西维斯见证我族帝国的重生吧。

english.title: Once in a Hundred Lifetimes
english.objectives: Speak to Klaxxi'va Ik in Klaxxi'vess
english.description: The time has come, wakener.$b$bThe council's power will combine to bring an end to the corrupted empress.$b$bThis ritual has not been witnessed in one hundred of your kind's lifetimes - and never by an outsider.$b$bIn exchange for your deeds on our behalf, I invite you to behold this great moment in our history.
english.completion: Your arrival is timely, wakener.$B$BOur ritual is underway.
english.giverWindow: Return to Klaxxi'vess and witness the re-making of our empire.

text.title: 雄鹿大师
text.objectives: 杀死10只野地雄鹿。
text.description: 我一直都很喜欢猎雄鹿。雄鹿强壮、迅捷，而且有很强的领地观念。$b$b它们或许是食草动物，但却能让猎人们为了金钱而飞奔。$b$b这里的东边就有一大群野地雄鹿等着像你这样的猎人去追赶他们呢。$b$b狩猎愉快。
text.completion: I haven't seen stag hunting this good since Ashenvale.
text.completed: Speak with Matt "Lucky" Gotcher at Nesingwary's Safari in Valley of the Four Winds.

english.title: Stag Mastery
english.objectives: Kill 10 Wilderland Stags.
english.description: I always was a fan of a good stag hunt. Stags are tough, fast, and territorial.$b$bThey may be plant eaters but they can give any hunter a run for his money.$b$bEast of here is a whole mess of Wilderland Stags just waiting for a hunter like yourself to give 'em a good run.$b$bHappy hunting.
english.completion: I haven't seen stag hunting this good since Ashenvale.
english.completed: Speak with Matt "Lucky" Gotcher at Nesingwary's Safari in Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 水的孩子
text.objectives: 消灭卡兰可、雷鳃和苏库拉。
text.description: 我们都是四风谷的水流的孩子。它滋养着我们，浇灌着我们的蔬菜，赐予我们生命。$b$b可是，有些生物喝下了太多的水。他们长得太大了。我们必须在他们对周围的一切造成伤害前消灭他们。$b$b我只是一个石匠。可你就不同了……
text.completion: Let this be a lesson to you: don't drink too much of the water.$b$bWhy do you think we have such a big brewery?
text.completed: Return to Stonecarver Mac at Halfhill in the Valley of the Four Winds.

english.title: Children of the Water
english.objectives: Slay Kracor, Thundergill, and Succula.
english.description: We are all children of the water here in the Valley of the Four Winds. It nourishes us, it grows our vegetables, it brings us life.$b$bSome creatures, however, drink too deeply from the water. They grow too large, and must be eliminated before they cause havoc to those around them.$b$bI am but a simple stonecarver. You, on the other hand...
english.completion: Let this be a lesson to you: don't drink too much of the water.$b$bWhy do you think we have such a big brewery?

text.objectives: 将神器进行展览。
text.description: 这件神器的恢复状况极为良好。或许你该把它放在闻道之座进行展览，好让那些游学者和考古学家们进行研究。
text.completed: Put the artifact on display at the Seat of Knowledge.

english.title: Pristine Monument Ledger
english.objectives: Put the artifact on display.
english.description: This artifact has been restored to a remarkably excellent condition.  Perhaps you will put it on display at the Seat of Knowledge, so that lorewalkers and archaeologists can study it.
english.completed: Put the artifact on display at the Seat of Knowledge.

text.objectives: Bring the Flying Tiger Gourami to Nat Pagle at Anglers Wharf.
text.description: You've caught a unique fish... with wings.  Perhaps it deserves the expert opinion of Nat Pagle in Anglers Wharf.
text.completed: Bring the Flying Tiger Gourami to Nat Pagle at Anglers Wharf.

text.title: 统御岗哨
text.objectives: 点燃海滩上部落登陆点的烽火，给部落舰队发信号。
text.description: 现在，该向这片新大陆展现一下部落的力量了。$B$B快回海滩点燃剩余的烽火。我们的舰队正等着呢。
text.completion: <This fire will signal the full might of the Horde invasion fleet to land on this beach, beginning Garrosh's campaign in Pandaria.>
text.completed: 点燃海滩上部落登陆点的烽火，给部落舰队发信号。

english.title: Domination Point
english.objectives: Light the Signal Fire on the beach of the Horde Landing Site to signal the Horde fleet.
english.description: Now it is time to show this new land the true strength of the Horde.$B$BReturn to the beach and light the remaining signal fire. Our fleet is waiting.
english.completion: <This fire will signal the full might of the Horde invasion fleet to land on this beach, beginning Garrosh's campaign in Pandaria.>
english.completed: Light the Signal Fire on the beach of the Horde Landing Site to signal the Horde fleet.

text.title: 雄狮港
text.objectives: 在卡桑琅海湾使用信号弹发射器给联盟舰队发信号。
text.description: 部落已经在艾泽拉斯横行了太久。我绝不允许这片新大陆被某个野蛮的“酋长”征服。$B$B你做好将联盟的正义带上潘达利亚海岸的准备了吗？$B$B我们回登陆点去吧。用信号弹发射器召唤舰队，然后启动神盾行动。
text.completion: <Blue sails are barely visible on the horizon - the full might of the Alliance fleet, awaiting one final signal.>
text.completed: 在卡桑琅海湾使用信号弹发射器给联盟舰队发信号。

english.title: Lion's Landing
english.objectives: Use the Flare Launcher in Krasarang Cove to signal the Alliance fleet.
english.description: For too long the Horde has been allowed to run rampant across Azeroth. I will not see these new lands conquered by some barbaric "warchief."$B$BAre you ready to bring Alliance justice to the shores of Pandaria?$B$BLet us return to the landing site. Use the flare launcher to bring in the fleet proper, and begin Operation: Shieldwall.
english.completion: <Blue sails are barely visible on the horizon - the full might of the Alliance fleet, awaiting one final signal.>
english.completed: Use the Flare Launcher in Krasarang Cove to signal the Alliance fleet.

text.description: You wanna test dailies? Well alright then.
