text.title: 旧日的枷锁
text.objectives: 解救14个不安的灵奴。
text.description:
魔古族就是一群混蛋！

在洞中干活儿的熊猫人即便在死后都要受到他们的奴役。你要去解救他们的灵魂！因为那是不对的。

但你要小心点……那些饱经创伤的灵魂已经分不清敌友了。所以他们可能会反抗。
text.completion: Ye' did good work out there. It's not right seein' the dead unable to rest like that.
text.completed: Return to Hilda Hornswaggle at the Ruins of Ogudei in Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: Shackles of the Past
english.objectives: Free 14 Troubled Slave Spirits.
english.description:
The mogu are a bunch of right bastards!

They enslaved the pandaren who worked these caves even after their death. Ye' gotta go free their spirits! It's just not right.

Be careful though... so much trauma, they don't know what's a friend and what's an enemy. So they'll probably fight back.
english.completion: Ye' did good work out there. It's not right seein' the dead unable to rest like that.
english.completed: Return to Hilda Hornswaggle at the Ruins of Ogudei in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 救人要紧！
text.objectives: 去卡桑琅丛林的敖骨打废墟找希尔达·盘角。
text.description:
当我下令开挖西北部的矿道时，我以为我们能找到点有用的东西。比如黄金、铁矿……什么都行！

结果呢，我们却找到一堆魔古遗物，还有一票来自探险者协会的矮人要我照顾。

我听士兵们说矿脉里出了点麻烦。乌瑞恩已经下令让我务必协助探险者协会，可我实在抽调不出部队了。你能下去看看出了什么事吗？
text.completion: Oi! We got a right nasty problem here. Kicked the hornet's nest. Except these are mogu ghost hornets with a mean streak a bloody mile wide!

english.title: Priorities, People!
english.objectives: Meet with Hilda Hornswaggle at the Ruins of Ogudei in Krasarang Wilds.
english.description:
When I ordered the excavation of the tunnel to the northwest, I thought we'd find something useful. Gold, iron... anything!

Instead, we found mogu artifacts, and I get a bunch of dwarves from the Explorers' League to baby-sit.

I hear from the soldiers that there's trouble in the mines. I have orders from Wrynn that I have to support the Explorers' League, but I can't spare any troops. Can you get down there and find out what's going on?
english.completion: Oi! We got a right nasty problem here. Kicked the hornet's nest. Except these are mogu ghost hornets with a mean streak a bloody mile wide!

text.title: 伺机而动
text.objectives: 使用火箭岗哨的传送门去卡桑琅丛林的敖骨打废墟找凯利斯·舞阳。
text.description:
探险者协会的蠢货们在西北边挖出了一个古代魔古遗迹。而且，毫不意外的，这些笨手笨脚的家伙惊动了里面的魔古幽灵。

我们得好好利用他们干出的好事。使用这座传送门，去找我安排在废墟的联络人——凯利斯·舞阳。
text.completion: Ah, yes. Good. Help from Belloc. He never does like to get his hands dirty.

english.title: Taking Advantage
english.objectives: Use the portal at Sparkrocket Outpost to meet with Kaelis Sunsoar at the Ruins of Ogudei in Krasarang Wilds.
english.description:
The fools in the Explorers' League have excavated an ancient mogu ruin to the northeast. And - of course - in their bumbling, they've disturbed the mogu spirits within.

We are going to take advantage of their ineptitude. Take this portal and meet with Kaelis Sunsoar, my contact within the ruins.
english.completion: Ah, yes. Good. Help from Belloc. He never does like to get his hands dirty.

text.title: 这是个谜
text.objectives: 使用希尔达的异常跟踪器，找到并消灭异形体。
text.description:
那里面有什么东西一直把工人们吓得心神不宁。似乎是某种怪物……看起来就像是鬼魂，也许是什么魔法……反正我从来没见过。

我弄了一个可以侦测那玩意的仪表指示器，把这个设备一同带上就可以跟踪那东西。设备上会显示出你与那东西的大致距离。

一旦你靠近了，你就使用这设备把那鬼东西给揪出来，然后替大家解决掉它！
text.completion: Good work! Now maybe the workers can get through a day without fillin' their britches!
text.completed: Return to Hilda Hornswaggle at the Ruins of Ogudei in Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: It Is A Mystery
english.objectives: Use Hilda's Anomaly Tracker to find and disperse an anomaly.
english.description:
There's somethin' down there that was spookin' the workers. Some kind o' anomaly... looks like a ghost, or a magic spell... like nothing I've ever seen.

I did manage to get a reading on it and put together this device to try to track it down. The display on the device will let you know roughly how close you are. 

Once you get close enough, you can use it to draw out the anomaly and get rid of it for good!
english.completion: Good work! Now maybe the workers can get through a day without fillin' their britches!
english.completed: Return to Hilda Hornswaggle at the Ruins of Ogudei in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 敖骨打的遗产
text.objectives: 收集5份古代魔古精华。
text.description:
我们占领的这片废墟是由一个古代魔古族统治者——敖骨打建造的。尽管这一地区冒出来的幽灵说明此人或许和缚魂术有关，但我们对他的身份知之甚少。

在你消灭那些幽灵时，它们会留下少量精华。把它带给我——我们会对其进行分析，希望能通过它多了解一些敖骨打的历史——以及力量。
text.progress: You'll need to destroy the spirits to collect their essence. Go to it.
text.completion: Good, good. We'll begin our research post-haste.
text.completed: Return to Kaelis Sunsoar at the Ruins of Ogudei in Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: Legacy of Ogudei
english.objectives: Collect 5 Ancient Mogu Essence.
english.description:
The ruins which we are occupying were built by Ogudei - an ancient mogu ruler. We know little about who he was, though the rise of the spirits in this area seems to indicate that it was related to spirit binding.

When you destroy these spirits, a small amount of their essence will remain in this world. Bring it to us - we will analyze it and hopefully learn more about Ogudei's history - and his power.
english.progress: You'll need to destroy the spirits to collect their essence. Go to it.
english.completion: Good, good. We'll begin our research post-haste.
english.completed: Return to Kaelis Sunsoar at the Ruins of Ogudei in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 灵魂陷阱
text.objectives: 摧毁3个灵魂陷阱。
text.description:
废墟里有一大堆十分危险的蓝色水晶。检查它们时稍有不慎，就会有愤怒的鬼魂冲出来攻击你。

我需要你进去，除掉一些这些害人的东西，这样我们的人才能重返工作。
text.completion: Those things are nasty! Thanks for takin' care of 'em for us.
text.completed: Return to Hilda Hornswaggle at the Ruins of Ogudei in Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: The Spirit Trap
english.objectives: Destroy 3 Spirit Traps.
english.description:
In the ruins there are a bunch of right nasty blue crystals. Look at 'em the wrong way and bloody angry ghosts run out at ya.

I'm gonna be needing ye' to go in and clear some of them out so we can get our people back to work.
english.completion: Those things are nasty! Thanks for takin' care of 'em for us.
english.completed: Return to Hilda Hornswaggle at the Ruins of Ogudei in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 敖骨打的副官
text.objectives: 击败担山力士孟都和织谎者庚离。
text.description:
在我们发掘这片魔古废墟的一个区域时，那些恶心的东西突然就冒了出来，其中还有两只特别棘手的幽灵。

我们得干掉它们，朋友。
text.completion: You did it! Good work! Really saved our bacon!$B$BHere's to hoping those things don't come back...
text.completed: Return to Hilda Hornswaggle at the Ruins of Ogudei in Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: Ogudei's Lieutenants
english.objectives: Kill Meng-do, Strength of Mountains, and Gen-li, Twister of Words.
english.description:
When we dug through to an ancient section of the mogu ruins, that's when all this nasty business went down - and that's where the two worst o' these ghosties emerged.

We need them gone, friend.
english.completion: You did it! Good work! Really saved our bacon!$B$BHere's to hoping those things don't come back...
english.completed: Return to Hilda Hornswaggle at the Ruins of Ogudei in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 死战到底
text.objectives: 在统御岗哨击败10名联盟士兵。
text.description: 联盟已经登陆了。如果我们不能在这里击败他们，那么部落占据这片大陆的希望就破灭了。$b$b快去南边的战场上干掉你遇到的任何联盟。$b$b让联盟看看，部落是怎么以一当百的！
text.completion: Well done, $n. I see your time in this land has hardened your resolve and sharpened your skills.
text.completed: Speak with Shokia at Domination Point in Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: Death on Two Legs
english.objectives: Defeat 10 Alliance soldiers in Domination Point.
english.description: The Alliance has made landfall. If we do not defeat them here, any hope of a Horde presence on this continent is lost.$b$bGo to the battlefield south of here and slay Alliance you find.$b$bShow them how any Horde who still stands on two legs will be the death of ten Alliance!
english.completion: Well done, $n. I see your time in this land has hardened your resolve and sharpened your skills.
english.completed: Speak with Shokia at Domination Point in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: Don't Try So Hard - DEPRECATED
text.objectives: Kill 8 SI:7 Saboteurs.
text.description: Ah, a $c! I guess you'll do.$b$bMy spies tell me there are Alliance spies sneaking around outside the fortress. But they are just... so... bad at it! I mean come on! Show a little pride in your work or something.$b$bGo kill a bunch of 'em as a lesson to the others.$b$bHere, take this batch of my latest Spy Stinker formula. If you can't see the spies just start tossing these outside the walls of the fortress to the south and you should flush them out.
text.completed: Speak with the Image of Trade Prince Gallywix at Domination Point in Krasarang Wilds.
text.turninWindow: His voice is broadcasting from a nearby bush... you think.

english.title: Don't Try So Hard - DEPRECATED
english.objectives: Kill 8 SI:7 Saboteurs.
english.description: Ah, a $c! I guess you'll do.$b$bMy spies tell me there are Alliance spies sneaking around outside the fortress. But they are just... so... bad at it! I mean come on! Show a little pride in your work or something.$b$bGo kill a bunch of 'em as a lesson to the others.$b$bHere, take this batch of my latest Spy Stinker formula. If you can't see the spies just start tossing these outside the walls of the fortress to the south and you should flush them out.
english.completed: Speak with the Image of Trade Prince Gallywix at Domination Point in Krasarang Wilds.
english.turninWindow: His voice is broadcasting from a nearby bush... you think.

text.title: 破灭的希望
text.objectives: 摧毁8个联盟空投补给。
text.description: 联盟或许都是懦夫，可他们并不蠢。如果面对的是劣等种族，他们的攻击还是很有威胁性的。$b$b为了保持围攻的局面并对我们的部队施加压力，他们一直在向自己的地面部队空投补给。$b$b去南边的海滩和码头上搜一下，毁掉那些空投补给。$b$b就让联盟眼睁睁地看着自己的食品和弹药化为灰烬并陷入绝望吧！
text.completion: Just remember, the weapon of choice is not always the weapon with the longest range or heaviest amount of damage. In the end, the best weapon is the weapon that works every time.
text.completed: Speak with Brolic at Domination Point in Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: Tear It Up
english.objectives: Destroy 8 Alliance Supply Drops.
english.description: The Alliance may be cowardly, but they are not fools. Their assault would be formidable, if it were directed at lesser creatures.$b$bTo sustain a siege and put pressure on our troops they are air dropping in supplies to support their ground forces.$b$bSearch the beaches and docks to the south for any airdropped supplies and smash them.$b$bLet the Alliance see their food and ammunition destroyed before their eyes and despair.
english.completion: Just remember, the weapon of choice is not always the weapon with the longest range or heaviest amount of damage. In the end, the best weapon is the weapon that works every time.
english.completed: Speak with Brolic at Domination Point in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 统统干掉
text.objectives: 击败“黑炭”布伦特船长和马尔基船长。
text.description: 我们的酋长派我到这片海岸来解决那些联盟可怜虫的威胁。$b$b这些人类和他们的盟友显然非常依赖自己的领袖。他们本身毫无自主性。$b$b你今天上战场时，要注意一下我们南边海岸附近的联盟船只并找出他们的船长。$b$b去干掉他们。$b$b为了部落！
text.completion: It is not enough to rob the Alliance of their leaders. We must warn those who would aspire to leadership the cost of such ambition.
text.completed: Speak with Brolic at Domination Point in Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: All Dead, All Dead
english.objectives: Defeat Captain Brent the Black and Captain Mulkey.
english.description: Our Warchief has dispatched me to these shores to deal with this pitiful Alliance threat.$b$bThese humans and their allies have proven to be very dependent on their leaders. No initiative of their own.$b$bAs you walk the battlefield today look to the Alliance ships off our southern shores. Find their captains.$b$bSlay them.$b$bFor the Horde!
english.completion: It is not enough to rob the Alliance of their leaders. We must warn those who would aspire to leadership the cost of such ambition.
english.completed: Speak with Brolic at Domination Point in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 又干掉一个
text.objectives: 引爆挑战号和无畏界限号上的爆炸品。
text.description: 联盟已经牢牢占据了我们南边的海滩，并不断用炮火袭击我们的地面部队。我倒要看看，没有了火炮支援，他们的围攻还打不打得下去。$b$b我要你登上敌舰，摧毁他们储备的弹药。这一定能让他们变成没牙的老虎。
text.completion: Ah! Look at them burn. These new Alliance craft require more to destroy them permanently however. I am sure they will have those fires out in a day or two.
text.completed: Speak with Blood Guard Gro'tash at Domination Point in Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: Another One Bites the Dust
english.objectives: Detonate the explosive cargo of The Defiant and Valor's Edge.
english.description: The Alliance have planted themselves off our southern coast and continue to pepper our ground forces with cannon fire. Let us see how great their siege is without such support.$b$bBoard the enemy vessels and destroy their reserve ammunition. This will take the teeth out of their bite.
english.completion: Ah! Look at them burn. These new Alliance craft require more to destroy them permanently however. I am sure they will have those fires out in a day or two.
english.completed: Speak with Blood Guard Gro'tash at Domination Point in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 祝你好运，好好享受
text.objectives: 去卡桑琅丛林的雄狮港收集10个闪亮联盟耳环。
text.description:
我这边抢购联盟耳环的客人都排成长龙了。可他们不要旧耳环。他们只愿意为最闪亮的新耳环掏钱！

我猜他们是觉得那样比较幸运还是怎么着的。

总之，我要你去帮我弄点来。我不想为此赶制新货，所以你得从雄狮港的联盟那里下手。

玩得开心点——记住，我只要最闪亮的！
text.progress: Ears, $n, I wanna see some ears!
text.completion: Good and waxy, just like they asked for. Here's your share.
text.completed: Return to Zazzix "Toasty" Sparkrocket at Sparkrocket Outpost in Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: Good Luck, Have Fun
english.objectives: Collect 10 Extra-Waxy Alliance Ears at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds.
english.description:
I've got some customers lined up that wanna collect some good old fashioned ears. But not any old ears. They only want the absolute waxiest ears money can buy! 

Guess they think they're lucky or something'.

Anyways, I need you to go get 'em for me. I don't want to hurt any animals, so you'll need to get 'em from the Alliance over at Lion's Landing.

Have fun - and remember, only bring me the waxiest!
english.progress: Ears, $n, I wanna see some ears!
english.completion: Good and waxy, just like they asked for. Here's your share.
english.completed: Return to Zazzix "Toasty" Sparkrocket at Sparkrocket Outpost in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 我们要更多的矿石！
text.objectives: 收集20块松动的石头。石头可以在雄狮港工程师身上找到，或者摧毁石板附近的雄狮港挖掘者，把石板炸成便于携带的小块岩石。
text.description:
侏儒正在开采东北边的采石场。

他们把那些东西当成了建材！

<扎兹克斯翻了个白眼。>

他们真是太蠢了，完全没有意识到，那就是魔古族用来制造活动雕像的石材。

而我们可以用它们配合咱们地精的小戏法，从而制造出前所未有的大爆炸！

不过那些石头很重，所以他们用那些愚蠢的炸弹机器人来挖。去把石板附近的机器人给炸了，然后挑一些便于携带的小石块带回来。

或者，你也可以干掉他们，抢走他们手里的石头。随便你怎么做。
text.progress: You got some stone? I wanna blow stuff up!
text.completion: Ha! YES! You got me some! I'm gonna make the best bomb EVER!$B$BMan I love bombs! Love making them, love blowin' em up...$B$B... and yeah, that IS how I got this eyepatch. What's it to ya?
text.completed: Return to Zazzix "Toasty" Sparkrocket at Sparkrocket Outpost in Lion's Landing.

english.title: We Require More Minerals!
english.objectives: Collect 20 Animatable Stone chunks from the Lion's Landing quarry. Lion's Landing Engineers carry them, or you can destroy stone slabs with collateral damage to blow them into chunks you can carry.
english.description:
Gnomes are excavating a stone quarry to the northeast.

They're building stuff with it!

<Zazzix rolls his eyes.>

They're too stupid to realize it's special mogu stone for creating animated statues. 

WE can mix with a little Goblin magic juice to make some real big explosions!

But the stuff is heavy. They've got some of their stupid bomb-bots there for excavating the stone. Blow 'em up near slabs and you'll get chunks small enough to carry. 

Or, just kill 'em and take it. Whatever works.
english.progress: You got some stone? I wanna blow stuff up!
english.completion: Ha! YES! You got me some! I'm gonna make the best bomb EVER!$B$BMan I love bombs! Love making them, love blowin' em up...$B$B... and yeah, that IS how I got this eyepatch. What's it to ya?
english.completed: Return to Zazzix "Toasty" Sparkrocket at Sparkrocket Outpost in Lion's Landing.

text.title: 骚扰工人
text.objectives: 击败30名雄狮港农夫。
text.description:
我们的地精朋友恐怕无法理解赢得一场持久战所必须的战略。

摧毁永久性设施的关键在于打击他们补充兵力和重建的能力。

在现在这种情况下，就意味着消灭他们的农夫。快去干掉他们，你就能削弱联盟的根基，而他们的整座要塞也必将垮塌。
text.completion: Good work. That should slow them down by a few days, at least.$B$BYou don't win the war by playing the short game, friend. Trust me, this is the right strategy.
text.completed: Return to Shademaster Kiryn at Sparkrocket Outpost in Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: Worker Harassment
english.objectives: Kill 30 Lion's Landing Peasants.
english.description:
Our goblin friends do not have the grasp of strategy necessary to win a long term engagement, I'm afraid.

The key to eliminating any permanent establishment is to attack their ability to replenish their troops and to rebuild.

In this case, that means taking out their Peasants. Kill them, and you weaken the foundation. The rest of the keep is bound to crumble.
english.completion: Good work. That should slow them down by a few days, at least.$B$BYou don't win the war by playing the short game, friend. Trust me, this is the right strategy.
english.completed: Return to Shademaster Kiryn at Sparkrocket Outpost in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 真视之眼
text.objectives: 将真视之眼放置在雄狮港的码头、市政厅和兵营二层。
text.description:
我们在敌方基地上空发现了大量空中支援部队，主要是大群骑着狮鹫的矮人。也就是说，我们无法从空中侦察到的地面的任何情况。

我的一个巨魔……朋友给了我一套真视之眼。我们可以用它来探查对方基地并掌握那里的情况。

坏消息是，朋友——你就是那个将奉命前去侦察的人。
text.completion: Good work, $n. I've already been getting some useful information that should help make our next offensive even more devastating.
text.completed: Return to Shademaster Kiryn at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: Sentry Wards
english.objectives: Place Sentry Wards on the Docks, in the Town Hall, and on the Second Floor of the Barracks at Lion's Landing.
english.description:
We've spotted heavy air support over their base, in the form of way too many dwarves on way too many griffons. Means we can't get any vision of the area from above.

A troll... friend of mine gave us a set of Sentry Wards, which we can use to spy on their base and get a vantage point on what's going on in there.

Bad news, friend - you're going to be the one going in there.
english.completion: Good work, $n. I've already been getting some useful information that should help make our next offensive even more devastating.
english.completed: Return to Shademaster Kiryn at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds.

objectiveDetails.description: 将真视之眼放入市政厅
将真视之眼放入兵营二层

text.title: 棋逢对手
text.objectives: 击败8名雄狮港迫击炮小队工程师并摧毁2座雄狮港迫击炮。
text.description:
我们设法在海滩上架起了几台歼灭者，可那些白痴矮人同样在那里架设了他们那可笑的迫击炮，导致歼灭者无法抵近攻击要塞本身！

快出去干掉那些矮人，把他们的迫击炮都炸掉。
text.completion: Oh heck yeah! That'll show 'em that NOBODY blows stuff up like goblins blow stuff up!$B$BOh, and you did good work too.
text.completed: Return to Zazzix "Toasty" Sparkrocket at Sparkrocket Outpost in Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: Hard Counter
english.objectives: Kill 8 Lion's Landing Mortar Team Engineers and destroy 2 Lion's Landing Mortar Tubes.
english.description:
We've managed to get some Demolishers on the beach, but the stupid dwarves are also out there with their stupid mortar tubes, preventing the Demolishers from pushing forward and assaulting the keep itself!

Get out there, kill some dwarves, and blow up some mortar tubes.
english.completion: Oh heck yeah! That'll show 'em that NOBODY blows stuff up like goblins blow stuff up!$B$BOh, and you did good work too.
english.completed: Return to Zazzix "Toasty" Sparkrocket at Sparkrocket Outpost in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 英雄杀手
text.objectives: 去卡桑琅丛林的雄狮港击败一名联盟英雄。
text.description:
在某些情况下，干掉一个敌方士兵比消灭一百个还重要。

他们在战场上投入了一些英雄人物，以协助防御。干掉这些家伙不仅能削弱他们的防御，还能打击他们的士气。

快去吧，帮我干掉一个所谓的“英雄”。你有这个实力。
text.completion: Cut off the head, and the body will fall.$B$B... Unless you're forsaken, I guess. I realize I should probably stop using that saying now that I am.
text.completed: Return to Shademaster Kiryn at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: Hero Killer
english.objectives: Kill an Alliance Hero at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds.
english.description:
There are some situations in which taking out one of their soldiers is more important than killing hundreds.

They've deployed some of their heroes to the battlefield to help rally their defenders. Not only will killing them soften their defense, it will also leave their morale crippled.

So go, take one down for me. You can handle it.
english.completion: Cut off the head, and the body will fall.$B$B... Unless you're forsaken, I guess. I realize I should probably stop using that saying now that I am.
english.completed: Return to Shademaster Kiryn at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 作业订单：燃料
text.objectives: 去锈水海滩找格里兹尔·轮滑。
text.description: 我们的燃料补给已经不多了。没有燃料我们就无法操作机器进行建设。他们还指望我去动手帮他们造房子呢！$b$b我可不是来干苦力的！看见这些指甲了吗？我刚做的！$b$b快到冶炼厂去，让他们完成这张燃料订单！快点！他们今早还让我试穿了一条工具带。它和我的衣服根本就不搭！
text.completion: More fuel huh? Is her "loveliness" afraid she might have to do a little more than sit around lookin' pretty?

english.title: Work Order: Fuel
english.objectives: Find Grizzle Gearslip in Bilgewater Beach.
english.description: Our fuel supplies are running low. Without fuel we won't be able to operate the machinery that's building this place. They might even expect me to start helping them build!$b$bI was not built for manual labor! See these nails?! I just had them done!$b$bGet down to the refinery and get this fuel order filled! Hurry! They were fitting me for a tool-belt this morning. It didn't even match my outfit!
english.completion: More fuel huh? Is her "loveliness" afraid she might have to do a little more than sit around lookin' pretty?

text.title: 盲目冒进
text.objectives: 从黑沙河口找回9个“纯化”燃料桶。
text.description: 我从没见过这种品质的燃料！问题是，这些燃料还需要稍微精炼一下。$b$b我听说过使用海水加快精炼过程的做法。而我的时间又很紧迫，所以我就把燃料桶扔到海湾里去了。$b$b很棒的主意，对吧？我知道。问题是，我不知道怎么把他们从海湾里捞出来了……$b$b或许你的经验能够帮到我？
text.progress: So he found a use for the bay after all? Waste not, want not I guess!
text.completion: Oh, yuck! Why are these barrels wet?! Oh nevermind! At least you got here before they made me work. I can't think of anything more horrible!
text.completed: Return to Boss-Lady Trixel in Domination Point.

english.title: Runnin' On Empty
english.objectives: Retrieve 9 "Distilled" Fuel Barrels from the Blacksand Spillway.
english.description: I've never seen this quality of oil! Problem is the oil needed a little extra refinin'.$b$bI heard of this system where you use ocean water to speed up the process. I don't have time to waste down here, so I just threw the barrels into the bay.$b$bPretty good idea, I know. Problem is, I'm not sure how to pull it out of the bay...$b$bMaybe someone of your expertise could help me out.
english.progress: So he found a use for the bay after all? Waste not, want not I guess!
english.completion: Oh, yuck! Why are these barrels wet?! Oh nevermind! At least you got here before they made me work. I can't think of anything more horrible!
english.completed: Return to Boss-Lady Trixel in Domination Point.

text.title: 作业订单：木材
text.objectives: 去伐木场找“伐木机”兹诺·快锯。
text.description: 天天都是这样！“这个没了！”，“我们还要点儿那个！”，“你怎么老不干活？！”$b$b我在干活！我在做事！他们真是太伤人了！我已经在尽力而为了！$b$b噢，对了，我们需要更多木材！快到下面去告诉那个一无是处的兹诺，让他赶紧把他的伐木机开动起来！
text.completion: Good for nothin' huh?! I'm busting my rump down here!$B$BMaybe her "uselessness" would like to come down here and haul this lumber herself!

english.title: Work Order: Lumber
english.objectives: Find Zino "The Shredder" Quickchop in the Lumber Farm.
english.description: Everyday it's the same thing! "We're out of this!", "We need more of that!", "Why don't you ever do anything?!"$b$bI work! I do things! They can be so hurtful! I'm doin' my best down here!$b$bOh yeah, we need more lumber! Go down and tell that good for nothin' Zino to get his shredders in gear!
english.completion: Good for nothin' huh?! I'm busting my rump down here!$B$BMaybe her "uselessness" would like to come down here and haul this lumber herself!

text.title: 加班加点！
text.objectives: 在伐木场收集9堆统御岗哨木材。
text.description: 我们今早刚完成了一份订单。他们怎么又跑来要了？！$b$b我的团队已经在加班加点地砍伐加工树木了。问题是雄狮港的部队一直在干扰我们的工作。我今天已经冒过一次掉脑袋的风险了，我可不想再回去了！$b$b古布会跟你去，帮你完成订单的。他不是很聪明，但搬搬抗抗还是没问题的。
text.completion: It's about time you showed up with this lumber order! I was just about to come down there and get it myself.
text.completed: Return to Zino "The Shredder" Quickchop in Quickchop's Lumber Farm.

english.title: Stacked!
english.objectives: Gather 9 Pieces of Domination Point Lumber from the Lumber Farm.
english.description: We just filled an order this morning. How could they possibly need more already?!$b$bMy team has been workin' double-time to get these trees chopped and processed.$b$bProblem is we have an infestation of Lion's Landing troops down here. I already risked my neck once today, I'm not goin' back out there!$b$bGoob will go with you and help you fill this order. He's not the brightest, but he can do the heavy liftin'.
english.completion: It's about time you showed up with this lumber order! I was just about to come down there and get it myself.
english.completed: Return to Zino "The Shredder" Quickchop in Quickchop's Lumber Farm.

text.title: 作业订单：铁矿
text.objectives: 去奥格林德挖掘场附近找“宝石”达克希尔·研矿。
text.description: 当他们说自己在矿洞下发现了一些神奇的石头时，我还以为会是钻石。人人都知道，所有的矿洞都该产钻石，蠢货！至少也得有红宝石吧！$b$b结果呢，我得到的只有这些诡异的铁矿石！我要这种东西做什么？$b$b好吧，也没人保证过这个工作会很愉快。我只要尽力而为就行了。$b$b我们刚刚又收到一份铁矿的订单。快去下面的奥格林德挖掘场附近找达克希尔，让他尽快完成订单！
text.completion: Is she still complaining about diamonds and rubies? We found something better than diamonds down here!$B$BThis ore is special. It has power!

english.title: Work Order: Iron
english.objectives: Find Daxil "The Gem" Oregrind near Oregrind's Dig.
english.description: When they said they found some amazing rocks in that mine I envisioned diamonds. Everyone knows all mines have diamonds, silly! At the very least rubies!$b$bInstead, all I got was this strange iron! What am I supposed to do with this?$b$bOh well, no one said this job would be glamorous. I just do what I can to add a little class.$b$bWe just got another work order for iron. Go see Daxil down near Oregrind's Dig and get it filled pronto!
english.completion: Is she still complaining about diamonds and rubies? We found something better than diamonds down here!$B$BThis ore is special. It has power!

text.title: 能量金属
text.objectives: 在奥格林德挖掘场获得7块充能铁矿石。
text.description: <达克希尔眯起眼睛，压低声音道：>$b$b有时我们向下挖得太深了，$c。我们在下面发现了极其可怕的东西，令所有参与挖掘的人都后悔莫及……$b$b开玩笑的啦！我是说，别误会我的意思，我们真的发现了一些意想不到的东西。我们在那下面发现的东西可不是普通的矿石。$b$b但有一个问题，页岩蜘蛛！我们正在努力完成这些订单。$b$b或许你能帮帮我们？
text.progress: Did you happen to find anything sparkly while you were down there?
text.completion: Did they manage to find anything useful down there? Maybe an emerald or an opal? Is it too much to ask for a little bit of effort?!$B$BNevermind! I'll make sure this shipment gets where it's goin'.
text.completed: Return to Boss-Lady Trixel in Domination Point.

english.title: Power Metal
english.objectives: Obtain 7 chunks of Energized Ore from Oregrind's Dig.
english.description: <Daxil narrows her eyes and speaks in a hushed tone.>$b$bSometimes we dig too deep, $c. Sometimes, we uncover something so horrible we wish we hadn't started diggin'...$b$bJust kidding! I mean, don't get me wrong, we did find something unexpected. The ore we're finding down there is not your average run-of-the-mill iron.$b$bThere is just one problem; Shale Spiders! We're struggling to keep these orders filled.$b$bMaybe you can lend us a hand?
english.progress: Did you happen to find anything sparkly while you were down there?
english.completion: Did they manage to find anything useful down there? Maybe an emerald or an opal? Is it too much to ask for a little bit of effort?!$B$BNevermind! I'll make sure this shipment gets where it's goin'.
english.completed: Return to Boss-Lady Trixel in Domination Point.

text.title: 干掉他们！
text.objectives: 在统御岗哨击败10个兽人。
text.description: 我绝不允许兽人在这片土地上获得立锥之地。他们会污染这里，就如同他们在卡利姆多的所作所为。$b$b$p，我这儿正需要人手把部落送进坟墓。快到海岸上去，将联盟的怒火倾泻到他们的头上！$b$b干掉你见到的每一个兽人。让他们闻风丧胆！$b$b为了国王！
text.completion: Well done, soldier. That should help keep the horde in check.
text.completed: Speak with Sky Admiral Rogers aboard the Skyfire in Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: We Will Rock You
english.objectives: Slay 10 Orcs at Domination Point.
english.description: The orcs can NOT be allowed a foothold in this land. They will defile it just as they did Kalimdor.$b$b$p, I need boots on the ground and horde in their graves. Get down to the coastline and bring the full force of Alliance wrath down on their heads!$b$bSlay any orcs you find. Take the wind out of their sails.$b$bFor the King!
english.completion: Well done, soldier. That should help keep the horde in check.
english.completed: Speak with Sky Admiral Rogers aboard the Skyfire in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 神奇魔法
text.objectives: 在统御岗哨找到3个探查器。
text.description: 欢迎你，$p！我听说过不少有关你的英勇事迹。我想请你帮忙测试一下我最新的“自动攻城器”，这可是一件具有可怕力量的多功能装置。$b$b我保证，它对使用者是绝对无害的。$b$b当你去统御岗哨时，请注意搜寻我的探查器。我先前已经派它们出去搜集攻击目标的情报。当你找到探查器时，就激活它，而我会把自动攻城器投放到你的位置。$b$b老规矩，我们战场见。
text.completed: Speak with the Tinkmaster Overspark on the Skyfire in Krasarang Wilds.
text.turninWindow: 说话声从某个隐蔽装置中传出。

english.title: A Kind of Magic
english.objectives: Find the three Scout-o-Matics in Domination Point.
english.description: Greetings $p! I have heard a lot about your success in the field. I would like to use your services to test my latest "Siege-o-Matic", a device of terrible and varied abilities.$b$bI promise it is mostly harmless to its users.$b$bWhen you are around Domination Point be on the look out for my Scout-o-Meters. They have been dispatched to get info on good siege targets. When you find one, activate it and I will pilot a Siege-o-Matic to your location.$b$bSee you in the field... as it were.
english.completed: Speak with the Tinkmaster Overspark on the Skyfire in Krasarang Wilds.
english.turninWindow: Broadcasting to you from an assortment of hidden devices.

text.title: 重压之下
text.objectives: 摧毁8个部落补给箱。
text.description: 部落已经被骄傲冲昏了头脑，可以毫不犹豫地慷慨赴死。$b$b我们必须以最小的代价打垮他们的意志。$b$b快到海岸上去找部落的补给，就在他们的舰船附近。把你找到的补给都毁了。$b$b再也没有比眼看着期盼已久的补给化为一阵青烟更打击士气的了。$b$b完成任务后，就到敌人后方去找苏利。他会给你进一步的指示。
text.completion: Thanks to your actions, the Horde knows it cannot feed its troops.$B$BThe timeframe they can withstand a siege is greatly reduced and their morale is going to start suffering soon.$B$BWe just need to keep applying pressure.
text.completed: Speak with Mishka aboard the Skyfire in Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: Under Pressure
english.objectives: Destroy 8 Horde Supply Crates.
english.description: The Horde are consumed by pride and will fight to the death without a second thought.$b$bWe need to find a way to break their will that does not involve massive loss of our numbers.$b$bLook for the Horde supplies along the coastline and near their ships. Smash their supplies.$b$bNothing breaks the will of a defender like seeing their hope of food go up in a puff of smoke.$b$bWhen you are done, find Sully behind enemy lines. He has the next task for you.
english.completion: Thanks to your actions, the Horde knows it cannot feed its troops.$B$BThe timeframe they can withstand a siege is greatly reduced and their morale is going to start suffering soon.$B$BWe just need to keep applying pressure.
english.completed: Speak with Mishka aboard the Skyfire in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 小心你的脑袋
text.objectives: 击败石头守卫鲁克拉、首席炸弹技师斯尼克弗里兹和奥·达克。
text.description: 我的探测器在统御岗哨的广场上侦测到三个极度危险的目标。$b$b他们分别是一名食人魔密使、一名库卡隆军官和一个疯狂的地精炸弹工程师。$B$B我的自动攻城器还无法一对一地战胜他们，所以得靠你来消灭这些目标了。$b$b祝你好运！任务完成后，请回天火号来找我。
text.completion: Great work! Sorry to put good soldiers in harms way but my Auto-Demolish-o-Tronic Mk 2 isn't functional yet.
text.completed: Speak with Tinkmaster Overspark aboard the Skyfire in Krasarang Wilds.
text.giverWindow: 说话声从某个隐蔽装置中传出。

english.title: Don't Lose Your Head
english.objectives: Defeat Stone Guard Ruk'ra, Bombgineer Snicklefritz, and Or'Dac.
english.description: My probes have detected three very dangerous targets in the courtyard of Domination Keep.$b$bThey have an ogre emissary, a Kor'kron officer, and an insane goblin bomb maker.$B$BMy siege-o-matics are not ready for one on one combat so it is up to you to eliminate the targets.$b$bGood luck! Report back to me on the Skyfire when done.
english.completion: Great work! Sorry to put good soldiers in harms way but my Auto-Demolish-o-Tronic Mk 2 isn't functional yet.
english.completed: Speak with Tinkmaster Overspark aboard the Skyfire in Krasarang Wilds.
english.giverWindow: Broadcasting to you from an assortment of hidden devices.

text.title: 达摩克利斯之锤
text.objectives: 击败5只重装巨怪。
text.description: 看来部落自以为能够躲在他们的重装巨怪背后逍遥自在。$b$b巨怪很强壮，力大无穷，而且比宿醉中的食人魔还要蠢。$b$b快到下面去，让联盟的愤怒之锤落到他们头上！
text.completion: Thank you soldier. That should teach the Horde that it will take more than a couple of mooks to scare us away.
text.completed: Speak with Sky Admiral Rogers aboard the Skyfire in Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: Hammer to Fall
english.objectives: Kill 5 Heavy Mooks.
english.description: It looks like the Horde thinks they can hide behind their heavy hitting mooks.$b$bThe mooks are tough, powerful, and dumber than an ogre with a hangover.$b$bGo down there and bring the hammer of the Alliance fury down on them!
english.completion: Thank you soldier. That should teach the Horde that it will take more than a couple of mooks to scare us away.
english.completed: Speak with Sky Admiral Rogers aboard the Skyfire in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 进攻！前进！
text.objectives: 击败12名统御萨满或统御掠夺者。
text.description:
当然，他们在外面布置了大量步兵猛攻大门，想要将我们的脑袋全都砍下来。

我并不担心步兵。但他们的队伍中还有萨满和掠夺者。萨满可以用魔法强化步兵，而掠夺者则能迅速摧毁我们的建筑。

我要你出去干掉那些萨满和掠夺者。

快去！进攻！上！
text.completion: Good work, soldier. Without those shamans, I don't think they'll have much luck breaking down our defenses.
text.completed: Return to Marshal Troteman at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: Attack! Move!
english.objectives: Kill 12 Dominance Shamans or Dominance Raiders.
english.description:
Sure, they've got about plenty of grunts out there, pounding on our door, waiting to cut our heads off.

I'm not worried about grunts. But they've got shamans and raiders, too. The shamans use their magic to empower the grunts, and the raiders are fast and specialize in taking out our buildings.

I need you to get out there and kill some of those shamans and raiders.

Go! Attack! Move!
english.completion: Good work, soldier. Without those shamans, I don't think they'll have much luck breaking down our defenses.
english.completed: Return to Marshal Troteman at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds.

objectiveDetails.description: 击败统御萨满或掠夺者

text.title: 资源采集
text.objectives: 从被仓促遗弃的木材堆中收集12份雄狮港木材。
text.description:
噢，可怜的农夫……

他们是一群懦夫，这话当然没错。可他们不会战斗，而且他们是出去帮我们收集木材的……可部落却盯上了他们……这真是太可怕了！

可是，如果我们想要守住，就需要那些木材。快去把他们丢下的木材都带回来。
text.progress: Did you gather the lumber yet?
text.completion: Good work! With this, we'll be able to finish reinforcing the structure of the keep, which will help keep people safe. You've saved lives today!
text.completed: Return to Mishka at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: Resource Gathering
english.objectives: Collect 12 Lion's Landing Lumber by recovering it from piles of Hastily Abandoned Lumber.
english.description:
Oh, the poor peasants...

They are cowards, yes, of course. But they don't know how to fight, and they go out to collect lumber for our efforts... the Horde targets them... It's just awful all around!

But, we need that lumber if we're going to hold out. Go out and collect any they've dropped.
english.progress: Did you gather the lumber yet?
english.completion: Good work! With this, we'll be able to finish reinforcing the structure of the keep, which will help keep people safe. You've saved lives today!
english.completed: Return to Mishka at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 补给困难
text.objectives: 摧毁8个统御岗哨补给箱。
text.description:
部落决定让地精来负责他们的后勤工作。而有地精的地方，就一定会有到处乱丢的炸药。

斥候回报说，他们的补给箱里还装着歼灭者的弹药。那些箱子一旦处理不当，就会炸翻天。

只要我们摧毁足够多的部落资源，他们的进攻就会中断，如此便可挽救许多战士的生命。所以，快去毁掉那些箱子吧！
text.completion: Without those supplies, they won't be able to support bringing more warriors in the fight. If they can't bring in more warriors, we have a great shot at holding out.$B$BFor today, at least.
text.completed: Return to Mishka at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: Supply Block
english.objectives: Destroy 8 Domination Point Supply Carts.
english.description:
The Horde decided to put goblins in charge of their logistics. And where you have goblins, you have carelessly placed explosives.

Scouts have reported that they have their supplies in carts that also contain demolisher ammunition. Look at those crates the wrong way, and they'll blow sky high. 

With enough Horde resources destroyed, we'll put a time limit on their attack and save lives. So go and take out those carts!
english.completion: Without those supplies, they won't be able to support bringing more warriors in the fight. If they can't bring in more warriors, we have a great shot at holding out.$B$BFor today, at least.
english.completed: Return to Mishka at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 塔防建材
text.objectives: 收集20块松动的石头。石头可以在雄狮港采石场的锈水地精身上或被战斗余波摧毁的岩层附近找到。
text.description:
侏儒正在西北边管理采石场。那里的石头特别坚硬——侏儒们告诉我，魔古族曾用那种石头建造房子。

我也不知道那是不是真的。但我知道我们用那种石头来建造塔楼，而部落则派了一群锈水地精来窃取我们的石料。

快去把它们抢回来。另外——战斗的余波可能会破坏附近的岩层。如果你遇到的话，再拣些石头回来。
text.progress: You brought us the stone yet?
text.completion: Alright! We'll get that stone mortared into the cracks in our walls faster than a Dwarf downs a pint.
text.completed: Return to Marshal Troteman at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: Tower Defense
english.objectives: Collect 20 Animatable Stone at the Lion's Landing Quarry from Bilgewater Goblins or by destroying stone slabs there with collateral damage.
english.description:
The gnomes are running our quarry operation to the northwest. The stone there is especially tough - the gnomes tell me the mogu used it to fashion their constructs. 

I don't know. What I do know is that we use that stone to build our towers, and the Horde has dispatched the Bilgewater goblins to steal it from us.

Get out there and get some back. By the way - collateral damage may break up the stone slabs there. If so, pick that up, too.
english.progress: You brought us the stone yet?
english.completion: Alright! We'll get that stone mortared into the cracks in our walls faster than a Dwarf downs a pint.
english.completed: Return to Marshal Troteman at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 攻城利器
text.objectives: 在锈水工兵身上找到锈水雷管，然后将其放置在一台统御岗哨歼灭者上。
text.description:
部落派锈水地精来攻击采石场是一步妙棋。

他们都携带着大量炸药——数量大得足以让歼灭者的弹药发生殉爆。

干掉那些锈水地精，拿到他们的炸药，并将它放在一台歼灭者附近……然后“轰”！围攻就结束了。
text.progress: We need you to take out those demolishers, soldier!
text.completion: You really showed them who owns this beach, $n. Good work!
text.completed: Return to Marshal Troteman at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: Siege Damage
english.objectives: Find a Bilgewater Blasting Cap on a Bilgewater Sapper, and then plant it on a Domination Point Demolisher.
english.description:
The Horde got the bright idea to send Bilgewater goblins to attack our quarry.

They've been packing heavy explosives - heavy explosives that will react with the ammunition in their demolishers.

Kill the Bilgewater goblins until you find an explosive, plant it on one of the demolishers... and BOOM! Siege ended.
english.progress: We need you to take out those demolishers, soldier!
english.completion: You really showed them who owns this beach, $n. Good work!
english.completed: Return to Marshal Troteman at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 英雄杀手
text.objectives: 击败1名部落英雄。
text.description:
你瞧，你很强大。比我这里的所有人都更强大。所以我要交给你一个特别任务。

部落派出了他们的精英部队来对付我们，都是他们军中的英雄——剑圣、牛头人酋长，等等等等。

我要你去除掉他们。那将是一个重大打击，不仅是对他们的行动，更是对他们士气的重大打击。
text.completion: I know it wasn't easy, but you did it. Good work. You've got my respect, soldier.
text.completed: Return to Marshal Troteman at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: Hero Killer
english.objectives: Kill a Horde Hero.
english.description:
Look, you're tough. Tougher than the rest of the men and women I've got here. Which means I need you for a special mission.

The Horde is throwing their best against us. Heroes of their armies - Blademasters, Tauren Chieftans, you name it.

I need you to go take one out. It'll be a huge blow, not just to their offensive but also to morale.
english.completion: I know it wasn't easy, but you did it. Good work. You've got my respect, soldier.
english.completed: Return to Marshal Troteman at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 统统烧光！
text.objectives: 使用不稳定的炸药摧毁东北方油罐、西北方油罐以及北方油罐。
text.description: 那些地精真是无法无天！他们先是夷平了森林，建起了那座恶心的机器。现在，他们又开始把油桶扔进海湾里！$b$b我们必须阻止这种疯狂行径！至少也得拖延一下他们的进度。$b$b我们要销毁他们的燃料，没准还可以顺手解决掉几个地精！
text.completion: Wish I could've been there to watch their fuel burn! Probably put on quite the show.$B$BYou've done well, $n!
text.completed: Return to Sully "The Pickle" McLeary aboard the Skyfire.

english.title: Burn Out!
english.objectives: Use the Unstable Explosive to destroy the Northestern Fuel Tank, Northern Fuel Tank, and the Northwestern Fuel Tank.
english.description: Those goblins are gettin' out of hand! First they level the forest and set up that abomination of a rig. Then, they start dumpin' their oil barrels into the bay!$b$bWe got to put a stop to this madness! At the very least we need ta set them back.$b$bWe need to take out their fuel supply! Maybe you'll even get to kill a few goblins in the process!
english.completion: Wish I could've been there to watch their fuel burn! Probably put on quite the show.$B$BYou've done well, $n!
english.completed: Return to Sully "The Pickle" McLeary aboard the Skyfire.

text.title: Necessary Breaks
text.objectives: Steal 7 Rusty Valves from the fuel operation on Bilgewater Beach.
text.description: It goes against me nature to break things on purpose, but in this case it's necessary.$b$bThat rig the goblins are usin' is held together by a wish an' some bubblegum. We need to exploit the situation a little more.$b$bWe have some saboteurs down there already, but we can use someone of your expertise to hurry the job along.$b$bGet down there an' start breakin' and stealin' some valves!
text.completed: Return to Sully "The Pickle" McLeary aboard the Skyfire.

english.objectives: Steal 7 Rusty Valves from the fuel operation on Bilgewater Beach.
english.description: It goes against me nature to break things on purpose, but in this case it's necessary.$b$bThat rig the goblins are usin' is held together by a wish an' some bubblegum. We need to exploit the situation a little more.$b$bWe have some saboteurs down there already, but we can use someone of your expertise to hurry the job along.$b$bGet down there an' start breakin' and stealin' some valves!
english.completed: Return to Sully "The Pickle" McLeary aboard the Skyfire.

text.title: 最后的关怀
text.objectives: 从锈水海滩的阵亡的神盾士兵身上收集7枚神盾士兵狗牌。
text.description: 这是一场野蛮的战争，$c！为了防止锈水财阀继续扩张，我们已经牺牲了许多战士。$b$b那些阵亡的士兵都曾英勇奋战，理应得到临终关怀。至少，我们得将死讯通知他们的亲人。$b$b或许你能帮我们去收集一下他们的身份牌？至少让我们可以简单地向他们致敬。
text.progress: Even warfare should have some courtesies.
text.completion: You have done these soldiers a great service, $n. The only thing left to do is make sure they did not die in vain.
text.completed: Return to Mishka aboard the Skyfire in the Southern Isles.

english.title: It's Only Right
english.objectives: Retrieve 7 Shieldwall Soldier Dog Tags from the Fallen Shieldwall Soldiers in and around Bilgewater Beach.
english.description: This is barbaric warfare, $c! We've lost so many trying to keep the Bilgewater operation from spreading any further.$b$bThose fallen soldiers fought honorably and deserved to be given their last rights. At the very least we need to be able to notify their next of kin.$b$bPerhaps you can collect their identification tags so we can honor them in some small way.
english.progress: Even warfare should have some courtesies.
english.completion: You have done these soldiers a great service, $n. The only thing left to do is make sure they did not die in vain.
english.completed: Return to Mishka aboard the Skyfire in the Southern Isles.

text.title: 唯一的好地精……
text.objectives: 在锈水海滩击败10个锈水地精。
text.description: 卡桑琅所受到的破坏是不可原谅的，$c。阻止这场悲剧的唯一方法就是摧毁锈水公司。$b$b这是为了潘达利亚和联盟的福祉。快去锈水海滩干掉他们！部落肯定会去支援他们。$b$b把他们一块儿消灭掉！
text.completion: Excellent work, $C! Eventually we will wipe the Horde from this continent.
text.completed: Return to Sky Admiral Rogers aboard the Skyfire.

english.title: The Only Good Goblin...
english.objectives: Kill 10 Bilgewater Goblins in and around Bilgewater Beach.
english.description: The destruction in Krasarang is unforgivable, $c. The only way to put an end to this is to destroy the Bilgewater operation.$b$bThis is for the greater good of Pandaria and the Alliance. Go to Bilgewater Beach and cut them down! No doubt the Horde will come to their assistance.$b$bDestroy them!
english.completion: Excellent work, $C! Eventually we will wipe the Horde from this continent.
english.completed: Return to Sky Admiral Rogers aboard the Skyfire.

text.title: 两步走
text.objectives: 消灭快锯伐木场的粉碎大师帕克尔。
text.description: 这里大部分的植被破坏都要归咎于伐木大师帕克尔，$c。$b$b据说他改进了伐木机，提高了它的工作效率，却完全不考虑它可能带来的副作用。$b$b想想这些树木被滥砍滥伐时的痛苦吧。这种程度的破坏是很难恢复的。$b$b一切修复工作的第一步永远是确认问题，而第二步则是消灭问题。
text.completion: Excellent work, $n! Now the forest can begin its regrowth process. From all death comes new life, and a new opportunity to protect it.
text.completed: Return to Seraphine of the Winter aboard the Skyfire.

english.title: Two Step Program
english.objectives: Destroy Shredmaster Packle in Quickchop's Lumber Farm.
english.description: Shredmaster Packle is responsible for much of the devastation down there, $c.$b$bRumor has it he modified the shredders to work more quickly with less regard for the collateral damage they can inflict.$b$bImagine the agony the trees must endure being hacked at. It will be difficult to recover from this level of destruction.$b$bThe first step in any recovery is acknowledging the problem. Step two is eliminating that problem.
english.completion: Excellent work, $n! Now the forest can begin its regrowth process. From all death comes new life, and a new opportunity to protect it.
english.completed: Return to Seraphine of the Winter aboard the Skyfire.

text.title: Circle of Life
text.objectives: Plant 11 Energized Seeds near Quickchop's Lumber Farm.
text.description: We should attempt to offset the destruction being wrought on this continent as much as possible. For every tree they destroy, we will plant a new one!$b$bTake these seeds and begin the regrowth process, $n.$b$bDo not linger for too long though. Nature is unpredictable, and no doubt the anger and hate exuding from Domination Point has seeped into the ground.$b$bI cannot guarantee that the plant that springs from these seeds will not be hostile.
text.completed: Return to Seraphine of the Winter aboard the Skyfire.

english.objectives: Plant 11 Energized Seeds near Quickchop's Lumber Farm.
english.description: We should attempt to offset the destruction being wrought on this continent as much as possible. english.completed: Return to Seraphine of the Winter aboard the Skyfire.

text.title: 兽王的狩猎：仙鹤
text.objectives: 收集5根完整的金色冠羽和1根完整的墨黑冠羽。
text.description: 除了陷阱，我还要告诉你一些捕猎仙鹤的诀窍：$b$b卡桑琅丛林的巨型仙鹤并不在乎那些简单的东西，比如食物。如果你想把它们从林子里引出来，就得调动它们的情绪。$b$b在西边的赤精栖木和纳松峰有很多仙鹤。去那里弄几根仙鹤翎毛来，然后将它们放在朱鹤寺附近显眼的地方。你的猎物就会自己跑出来了。
text.progress: This is the spot, near the Crane Temple.
text.completion: You place the feathers in the dirt, then look off in the direction of the temple...
text.completed: Bring the pristine feathers to the shore south of the Temple of the Red Crane.

english.title: Beastmaster's Hunt: The Crane
english.objectives: Obtain 5 Pristine Golden Crownfeathers and a Pristine Jet Crownfeather.
english.description: Along with the snare, you get some advice on crane hunting:$b$bThe greatest cranes of the Krasarang Wilds are not tempted by simple things like food. You will need to play on the creatures' emotions if you wish to draw them from their hiding places in the jungle.$b$bCranes abound on both the Cradle of Chi-ji and the Narsong Spires, both of which can be found east of here. Pluck those cranes' quills, then place them in a visible spot near the Crane Temple. Your quarry will come running to you.
english.progress: This is the spot, near the Crane Temple.
english.completion: You place the feathers in the dirt, then look off in the direction of the temple...
english.completed: Bring the pristine feathers to the shore south of the Temple of the Red Crane.

text.title: 兽王的狩猎：老虎
text.objectives: 收集25块完整的牦牛腰肉。
text.description: 除了陷阱，我还要告诉你一些捕猎老虎的诀窍：$b$b老虎都很贪吃，而在这片丛林中，大型猎物是很少见的。如果你想把这些老猫从藏身处引出来，就需要一块诱人的肉。$b$b在蟠龙脊的另一边，你可以找到一群牦牛。去杀几头牛，把它们的肉带到丛林边缘并设下陷阱，然后耐心等待。
text.progress: This looks like an ideal spot for a tiger trap.
text.completion: You lay the meat out atop the trap, then turn your eyes toward the jungle...
text.completed: Bring the yak meat to the beach north of Domination Point.

english.title: Beastmaster's Hunt: The Tiger
english.objectives: Obtain 25 Unbruised Yak Haunches.
english.description: Along with the trap, you get some advice on tiger hunting:$b$bTigers are gluttonous creatures, and large game is hard to come by in this jungle. If you wish to tempt the most elder cats out of their hiding places, you may do so with a meal.$b$bJust on the other side of the Serpent's Spine, you will find a herd of yaks. Slay them, bring their meat to the jungle's edge, set up your trap, and wait.
english.progress: This looks like an ideal spot for a tiger trap.
english.completion: You lay the meat out atop the trap, then turn your eyes toward the jungle...
english.completed: Bring the yak meat to the beach north of Domination Point.

text.title: 兽王的狩猎：螃蟹
text.objectives: 从盎迦猴岛的盎迦村民处获得30条恶臭烂鱼。
text.description: 除了笼子，我还要告诉你一些捕捉螃蟹的诀窍：$b$b螃蟹是一种奇异而古老的生物，它们的兴趣和我们不同。$b$b小螃蟹很常见，也很容易捉。可大家伙们都藏在沙滩底下，令我们鞭长莫及。要想引它们出来，就得利用它们的嗅觉。$b$b西南边的盎迦村村民会在吃鱼前让其先发酵一下。只要带上足够的烂鱼，你就能抓到巨型螃蟹了。
text.progress: This looks like a good place to catch a crab.
text.completion: You spread out the decaying fish, prepare the crate, then turn your eyes toward the beach...
text.completed: Bring the rotten fish to the beach south of the Ruins of Dojan.

english.title: Beastmaster's Hunt: The Crab
english.objectives: Obtain 30 Funky Rotten Fish from Unga Villagers in Unga Ingoo.
english.description: Along with the crate, you get some advice on crab hunting:$b$bCrabs are strange, primordial creatures, with wildly different motivations than you or I.$b$bSmall crabs are easy to find and hunt, but the large ones hide beneath the sands, out of danger and out of our reach. To draw them out, we play on their sense of smell.$b$bThe Unga villagers to the southeast allow their fish to ferment before they eat them. Bring enough rotten fish together, and you will catch yourself a colossal crab.
english.progress: This looks like a good place to catch a crab.
english.completion: You spread out the decaying fish, prepare the crate, then turn your eyes toward the beach...
english.completed: Bring the rotten fish to the beach south of the Ruins of Dojan.

text.title: 兽王的狩猎：螃蟹
text.objectives: 从盎迦猴岛的盎迦村民处获得30条恶臭烂鱼。
text.description: 除了笼子，我还要告诉你一些捕捉螃蟹的诀窍：$b$b螃蟹是一种奇异而古老的生物，它们的兴趣和我们不同。$b$b小螃蟹很常见，也很容易捉。可大家伙们都藏在沙滩底下，令我们鞭长莫及。要想引它们出来，就得利用它们的嗅觉。$b$b西南边的盎迦村村民会在吃鱼前让其先发酵一下。只要带上足够的烂鱼，你就能抓到巨型螃蟹了。

english.title: Beastmaster's Hunt: The Crab
english.objectives: Obtain 30 Funky Rotten Fish from Unga Villagers in Unga Ingoo.
english.description: Along with the crate, you get some advice on crab hunting:$b$bCrabs are strange, old creatures, with different motivations than us.$b$bSmall crabs are easy to find and hunt, but the big ones hide beneath the sands, out of danger and out of our reach. To draw them out, we play on their sense of smell.$b$bThe Unga villagers to the southwest allow their fish to ferment before they eat them. Bring enough rotten fish together, and you will catch yourself a colossal crab.

text.title: 寒碜的陌生人
text.objectives: 与半山市集的巴纳比·弗莱彻谈一谈。
text.description: 今早，一个戴着尖帽子的怪家伙跑来推销一些特别的种子，还声称那是魔法种子。$B$B其实我并不介意有点竞争——毕竟生意就是生意——可这位先生长得……十分寒碜。噢，他还散发着很浓的恶臭。$B$B你能去查查这个人，看看他是否可靠吗？他就在坚·铁掌那边试吃呢。
text.completion: AUGHM... nomf... -slurp- mmmf...$B$B<Barnaby looks up from the table, revealing a tangled beard dotted with melon seeds. Juices rush down his chin as he greets you.>$B$BMmf... -cough- A customer! Hello! Name's Fletcher. Barnaby Fletcher - nice to meet you!$B$B<He wipes a hand on his robe before extending it, still visibly sticky and flecked with pulp.>
text.completed: 与半山市集的巴纳比·弗莱彻谈一谈。

english.title: A Shabby New Face
english.objectives: Speak with Barnaby Fletcher in Halfhill Market.
english.description: A strange fellow in a pointy hat showed up this morning trying to sell some kinda special seeds. Claimed they were magic.$B$BI welcome a little competition - business is business, after all - but this gentleman had a certain... shabby look to him. Oh, and he stunk somethin' FIERCE.$B$BWould you check up on him, just to make sure he's on the level? He's over there by Jian Ironpaw, making a meal out of the samples.
english.completion: AUGHM... nomf... -slurp- mmmf...$B$B<Barnaby looks up from the table, revealing a tangled beard dotted with melon seeds. Barnaby Fletcher - nice to meet you!$B$B<He wipes a hand on his robe before extending it, still visibly sticky and flecked with pulp.>
english.completed: Speak with Barnaby Fletcher in Halfhill Market.

text.title: 前往魔古岬
text.objectives: 去魔古岬找摄政王洛瑟玛·塞隆。你可以与统御岗哨的泰克泰克谈一谈，让他送你一程。
text.description: Throm-ka，$c。当我们在这儿忙着守卫要塞时，摄政王洛瑟玛·塞隆带着一支科研探险队北上进入了昆莱山地区。$B$B不幸的是，他们似乎遇到了麻烦。$B$B加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮酋长已经前去支援了，可他还需要更多的援军。$B$B快到北边的昆莱山去，听候他们的指挥。你可以去找泰克泰克，让他送你一程。
text.completion: Well met, $C. We are an archaeological expedition, sent to excavate these ruins. We had no idea that this area was crawling with dangerous mogu.
text.completed: Speak to Regent Lord Lor'themar Theron at Mogujia in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: To Mogujia
english.objectives: Find Regent Lord Lor'themar Theron at Mogujia. Speak to Tak-Tak at Domination Point for transportation.
english.description: Throm-ka, $c. While we were busy defending our foothold here, Regent Lord Lor'themar Theron led a research expedition north into Kun-Lai Summit.$B$BUnfortunately, it seems they have encountered trouble.$B$BWarchief Garrosh Hellscream has already departed to lend his assistance, but he will require additional reinforcements.$B$BGo northward into the mountains of Kun-Lai. Speak to Tak-Tak for transportation.
english.completion: Well met, $C. We are an archaeological expedition, sent to excavate these ruins. We had no idea that this area was crawling with dangerous mogu.
english.completed: Speak to Regent Lord Lor'themar Theron at Mogujia in Kun-Lai Summit.

objectiveDetails.description: 去魔古岬找洛瑟玛·塞隆

text.title: 远古守卫
text.objectives: 击败5名寇茹守卫者。
text.description: 在魔古族击溃我们斥候小队前，我们发现北边的废墟中散落着大量遗物。$B$B我想收集一些样本，可魔古族的陶俑看门狗太多了，我们应付不过来。$B$B如果你能把那里的怪物都清理掉，我们就能继续工作了。
text.completion: Ah! Well done! With the guardians gone, we should be able to excavate these ruins safely.
text.completed: Return to Fanlyr Silverthorn at Mogujia in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: Ancient Guardians
english.objectives: Kill 5 Korune Guardians.
english.description: Before the mogu overwhelmed our scouting party, we found relics scattered amongst the ruins to the north.$B$BI would like to collect some samples, but the mogu's terracotta watchdogs are too much for us to handle.$B$BIf you could clear the area of their presence, we will be able to resume our work.
english.completion: Ah! Well done! With the guardians gone, we should be able to excavate these ruins safely.
english.completed: Return to Fanlyr Silverthorn at Mogujia in Kun-Lai Summit.

text.title: 血脉相连
text.objectives: 消灭寇茹守望者，释放6名统御法师。
text.description: 我们设法避开了魔古守望者和他们的狗，可斥候小队的其他血精灵就没这么走运了。$B$B我的人大多被关在北边的废墟中。我们正在设法营救，可我觉得我们或许可以采用更加直接的办法。$B$B快去废墟干掉那些看守囚犯的守卫。如果我的直觉正确，这样就救出我们的同伴了。
text.completion: We blood elves have served the Horde faithfully. Lately, I wonder what we have to gain from Garrosh's leadership.
text.completed: Return to Lor'themar Theron at Mogujia in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: Bloodlines
english.objectives: Free 6 Domination Mages by killing Korune Wardens.
english.description: We managed to fend off the mogu wardens and their dogs, but many of the blood elves from the scouting party were not as lucky.$B$BMany of my people are trapped inside the ruins to the north. We are devising a solution to break them out, but I believe there may be a more straightforward approach.$B$BGo to the ruins and kill the wardens guarding each prisoner. If my intuition is correct, this will free our comrades.
english.completion: We blood elves have served the Horde faithfully. Lately, I wonder what we have to gain from Garrosh's leadership.
english.completed: Return to Lor'themar Theron at Mogujia in Kun-Lai Summit.

text.title: 前往魔古岬
text.objectives: 去魔古岬找布莱恩·铜须。你可以与雄狮港的范妮·盘角谈一谈，让她送你一程。
text.description: 探险者协会几天前向北方派出了一支探险队。$B$B之后他们就失去了音讯。要是能确定他们没有遇到麻烦，那我晚上也能睡得安心点。$B$B我得到的最后一个消息是，布莱恩·铜须正在向昆莱山的魔古岬进发。$B$B请你找到他，然后向我汇报他们的近况。如果有需要的话，那边的范妮也可以送你一程。
text.completion: These artifacts must be several thousand years old. Have ye ever seen the like?
text.completed: Speak to Brann Bronzebeard at Mogujia in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: To Mogujia
english.objectives: Find Brann Bronzebeard at Mogujia. Speak to Fennie Hornswaggle at Lion's Landing for transportation.
english.description: The Explorer's League sent an expedition north some days ago.$B$BWe haven't heard from them since, and I'd sleep better at night knowing our folks aren't in some sort of trouble.$B$BLast I heard, Brann Bronzebeard was heading toward Mogujia in the Kun-Lai Summit.$B$BFind him and report back with their status. Fennie over there can give you a ride if you need one.
english.completion: These artifacts must be several thousand years old. Have ye ever seen the like?
english.completed: Speak to Brann Bronzebeard at Mogujia in Kun-Lai Summit.

text.title: 血仇
text.objectives: 从银月觅符者、统御法师或统御骑士身上搜集5件寇茹神器。
text.description: 探险者协会正在这里发掘废墟，而我的任务就是保护他们。$B$B刚抵达时，我们发现这里到处都是血精灵。显然，部落对魔古族的兴趣和我们一样大。$B$B不过，这反而是一个既能削减敌人数量还能占有他们成果的好机会。$B$B去干掉你在废墟里见到的任何血精灵，然后把他们挖出来的东西给我带回来。
text.progress: What are those blood elves after?
text.completion: Well done, $c. I knew that you could get the job done.
text.completed: Return to Sarannha Skyglaive at Mogujia in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: Bad Blood
english.objectives: Collect 5 Korune Artifacts from Silvermoon Runeseekers, Dominance Mages, or Dominance Knights.
english.description: The Explorer's League is here to excavate the ruins, and it's my job to protect them.$B$BWhen we arrived, we found this place crawling with blood elves. Apparently,the Horde are just as interested in the mogu as we are.$B$BThis gives quite an opportunity to thin our enemies' numbers, and steal their findings, too.$B$BSlay any blood elves you find in the ruins, and bring back whatever they are digging up.
english.progress: What are those blood elves after?
english.completion: Well done, $c. I knew that you could get the job done.
english.completed: Return to Sarannha Skyglaive at Mogujia in Kun-Lai Summit.

text.title: Anger Remains
text.objectives: Kill 27 Angerlings.
text.description: From the looks o' our initial survey, this entire area is humming with residual sha energy.$B$BYou know what ta do, $n. Destroy any last traces ye can find o' the stuff!
text.completed: Return to Brann Bronzebeard at Mogujia in Kun-Lai Summit.
