text.title: 神秘肉卷
text.objectives: 从当地的野生动物身上收集7份神秘肉块。
text.description: 我们收到了大量的抱怨，说女工头只知道自己吃肉，让别人喝汤。$b$b我也就跟你说说，他们可能在秘密地搞什么勾当。我甚至都吃不惯她那么好的伙食！$b$b我们需要一些材料，至少能让塞兹克掩饰一下这里的食物有多么难以下咽……$b$b我想到了！神秘肉卷！
text.progress: What do ya got for me now?
text.completion: I have standards ya know! I'm a chef, not a magician!$B$BThe only mystery here is how Duke thinks he'll pull this over on everyone else!
text.completed: Return to Sezik Steampot on Bilgewater Beach near the Boiling Crustacean.

english.title: Mystery Meatloaf
english.objectives: Obtain 7 Chunks of Mystery Meat from the local wildlife.
english.description: We've been gettin' complaints right and left that the Boss-Lady gets all the good grub and leaves the scraps for the others.$b$bBetween you and I, they may be onto somethin' here. I don't even get to eat as good as she does!$b$bWe need somethin' Sezik can make a lot of that at least attempts to disguise how inedible the food is here...$b$bI got it! Mystery Meatloaf!
english.progress: What do ya got for me now?
english.completion: I have standards ya know! I'm a chef, not a magician!$B$BThe only mystery here is how Duke thinks he'll pull this over on everyone else!
english.completed: Return to Sezik Steampot on Bilgewater Beach near the Boiling Crustacean.

text.title: 来自浮空魔法城的垃圾……
text.objectives: 与巴纳比·弗莱彻交谈，进一步了解传送门碎片。
text.description: 在我们开始谈生意之前，按照我的康复疗程要求，我必须先告知你，我是一个治疗药水成瘾者。$B$B你瞧，既然我们已经把话说开了，那我们就来谈谈传送门吧！$B$B你知道的，主城中的那些大型传送门都是日夜运转的，所以会施放出大量魔法能量。因此它们的边缘为止会生成一些结晶——通常人们都把它们看做垃圾。$B$B可我在，呃……在达拉然下水道短暂停留期间，我注意到这些碎片也是含有能量的。$B$B怎么样？你有兴趣吗？
text.completion: I knew you would be!$B$BHere's the catch - the shards, in their current state, are unstable. But the soil in this valley is renowned for its magical properties! I am sure if you were to "plant" the shard, a very interesting reaction would take place.$B$BIt could stabilize, leaving you with a functioning portal! Or... it might tear open a magical rift that spits out transdimensional horrors!$B$BMy gut tells me it will be a little of both, but there's only one way to know for sure.$B$BHere, take a sample!
text.completed: 与半山市集的巴纳比·弗莱彻谈一谈。

english.title: One Magical, Flying Kingdom's Trash...
english.objectives: Speak with Barnaby Fletcher to learn more about Portal Shards.
english.description: Before we enter into a business relationship, I am required by the terms of my rehabilitation program to inform you that I am a recovering potion addict.$B$BThere, now that THAT's out of the way, let's talk portals!$B$BYou see, the big portals in the cities - the ones running all day and night - leak tons of magical energy. It crystallizes around the edges and is generally regarded as trash.$B$BBut I noticed during my, uh... hiatus in the sewers of Dalaran, that these shards still had power.$B$BInterested?
english.completion: I knew you would be!$B$BHere's the catch - the shards, in their current state, are unstable. But the soil in this valley is renowned for its magical properties! I am sure if you were to "plant" the shard, a very interesting reaction would take place.$B$BIt could stabilize, leaving you with a functioning portal! Or... it might tear open a magical rift that spits out transdimensional horrors!$B$BMy gut tells me it will be a little of both, but there's only one way to know for sure.$B$BHere, take a sample!
english.completed: Speak with Barnaby Fletcher in Halfhill Market.

text.title: 卡桑琅蒸蟹
text.objectives: 从锈水海滩的钳爪蟹身上收集5块被污染的钳爪蟹肉。
text.description: 女工头想要吃螃蟹！$b$b你干嘛那么看着我？像那位美人这样的上等人想吃个螃蟹是很平常的。你以为我是什么意思？$b$b锈水海滩上游荡着许多大螃蟹。它们应该能够满足她挑剔的口味。$b$b快帮塞兹克带些最好的蟹肉回来！
text.progress: Boss-Lady wants a steampot does she? Well, maybe she should come down here and make it herself!
text.completion: This meat is disgusting! It's going to take every spice I have to cover that smell up.$B$BOnly the best for the Boss-Lady!$B$B<Sezik grins and winks at you.>
text.completed: Return to Sezik Steampot on Bilgewater Beach near the Boiling Crustacean.

english.title: Krasarang Steampot
english.objectives: Obtain 5 chunks of Polluted Viseclaw Meat from the Viseclaw crabs on Bilgewater Beach.
english.description: The Boss-Lady desires crabs!$b$bWhy are you looking at me like that? It's not uncommon for a classy person, such as her loveliness, to want crab for dinner. What did you think I meant?$b$bThere are some big crabs wandering around on Bilgewater Beach that should be suitable for her refined palate.$b$bBring Sezik the best crab meat you can find!
english.progress: Boss-Lady wants a steampot does she? Well, maybe she should come down here and make it herself!
english.completion: This meat is disgusting! It's going to take every spice I have to cover that smell up.$B$BOnly the best for the Boss-Lady!$B$B<Sezik grins and winks at you.>
english.completed: Return to Sezik Steampot on Bilgewater Beach near the Boiling Crustacean.

text.title: 赞图尔的危机
text.objectives: 在赞图尔消灭12名巨魔。
text.description:
$n，我要你做的这件事几乎可以说是种族清洗，但我们别无选择。

为了我们所有人的安危，去巨魔的镇中或沙滩上找到他们，然后将其消灭。
text.completion: Much blood was spilled this day. It is on my hands, $n, not yours.
text.completed: Return to Halduron Brightwing at the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Dangers of Za'Tual
english.objectives: Slay 12 Trolls in Za'Tual.
english.description:
$n, what I ask of you is little short of genocide, but it is a task that must be done.

Find trolls within their town or on the beach and slay them, for the good of us all.
english.completion: Much blood was spilled this day. It is on my hands, $n, not yours.
english.completed: Return to Halduron Brightwing at the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 严峻局势
text.objectives: 击败10名山泽守陵者、山泽夺魂者或山泽唤雷者。
text.description: 白骨庭院里挤满了魔古族大军。他们正在那里肆无忌惮地施展召唤雷电的仪式。$B$B如果我们想要成功占领这座岛屿，就不能放任他们占据如此重要的战略位置。$B$B必须消灭他们。
text.completion: Excellent. You have dealt the mogu a blow that they shall not easily forget.
text.completed: Return to Grand Magister Rommath on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Grave Circumstances
english.objectives: Kill 10 Shan'ze Gravekeepers, Shan'ze Soulrippers, or Shan'ze Thundercallers.
english.description: The Court of Bones crawls with mogu forces. Endlessly do they perform their rituals of lightning and thunder.$B$BIf our mission to take this island is to succeed, then we cannot allow them to hold such a strategic position.$B$BThey must be eliminated.
english.completion: Excellent. You have dealt the mogu a blow that they shall not easily forget.
english.completed: Return to Grand Magister Rommath on the Isle of Thunder.

objectiveDetails.description: 击败白骨庭院的山泽魔古

text.title: 邪刃的威胁
text.objectives: 击败10个邪刃蜥蜴人。
text.description: 蜥蜴人正源源不断地从伊瓜鲁克峭壁上涌出来。那些畜生不但攻击我的士兵，还在附近的水源和野生动物中间传播病菌，妨碍我们的行动。$b$b快去削减他们的数量，$n。一旦部落完全控制了这片岛屿，我们就可以转而寻求更加彻底的解决办法了。
text.completion: One day, this island will belong to the Horde. I can only hope that it will be free of saurok before then.$B$B<Aethas sneers.>$B$BAt least they attack the Alliance, too.
text.completed: Return to Archmage Aethas Sunreaver on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: The Skumblade Threat
english.objectives: Slay 10 Skumblade saurok.
english.description: Ihgaluk Crag has no end of saurok. Those beasts attack my men and spread their disease into nearby water and wildlife, interfering with our operations.$b$bThin their numbers, $n. Once the Horde takes full control of this island, we can look for more permanent solutions.
english.completion: One day, this island will belong to the Horde. I can only hope that it will be free of saurok before then.$B$B<Aethas sneers.>$B$BAt least they attack the Alliance, too.
english.completed: Return to Archmage Aethas Sunreaver on the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: Gather Scout Reports
text.completed: Return to Girana the Blooded at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

english.title: Gather Scout Reports
english.completed: Return to Girana the Blooded at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

text.title: 这不管用
text.objectives: 在征服者平台击败任意8个赞达拉巨魔。
text.description: 这里的赞达拉巨魔非常强大，$c，绝对不可小觑。我们不能因为他们赤手空拳而忽视他们的威胁。$b$b每天都有大量巨魔涌来，带着他们积累了数个世纪的魔法知识。我们必须尽快应对这一威胁。$b$b帮助我们清扫这一地区，$c。或许我们还能在这个过程中了解一些他们的内情。
text.completion: It's impressive how easily you were able to cut them down.$B$BPerhaps, it's you they should not underestimate. Thank you for your assistance, $C.
text.completed: Return to Scout Captain Elsia within the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: This Just Won't Do
english.objectives: Kill any 8 Zandalari trolls within Conqueror's Terrace.
english.description: The Zandalari here are very powerful, $c. They should not be underestimated. We cannot afford to ignore them as a threat simply because they do not wield swords.$b$bMore arrive every day, and with them centuries of magic knowledge. This threat must be dealt with, and quickly.$b$bAid us in clearing this area, $c. Perhaps we can even learn something from them in the process.
english.completion: It's impressive how easily you were able to cut them down.$B$BPerhaps, it's you they should not underestimate. Thank you for your assistance, $C.
english.completed: Return to Scout Captain Elsia within the Isle of Thunder.

objectiveDetails.description: 击败征服者平台的巨魔

text.title: 纵龙者
text.objectives: 在兽栏中击败10名赞达拉巨魔。
text.description: 在兽栏中，你可能会遇到赞达拉部队中最老练的驯兽师。他们懂得用斧子、野兽和爪子进行攻击。他们就是在这里建立起自己的骑兵部队的。$b$b在他们骑着那些怪物出现在战场上之前，我们要你先去兽栏击败那里的赞达拉巨魔。
text.completion: A trained Zandalari beastcaller with a mount unleashed on the battlefield can kill twenty times their number. Your preemptive attack has saved many lives. Thank you!
text.completed: Speak with Magister Edien Sunhollow within the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Saur Loser
english.objectives: Defeat 10 Zandalari trolls in the Beast Pens.
english.description: Inside the Beast Pens you will encounter some of the most skilled beast tamers in the Zandalari military. They are trained to kill with axe, beast, and claw. This is where they build their cavalry.$b$bWe need you to kill any Zandalari you find in there before they can get their mounted monstrosities out into the open battlefield.
english.completion: A trained Zandalari beastcaller with a mount unleashed on the battlefield can kill twenty times their number. Your preemptive attack has saved many lives. Thank you!
english.completed: Speak with Magister Edien Sunhollow within the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 电容上限
text.objectives: 在闪电矿脉中与3个闪电钻头相互作用以摧毁它们，并击败金铁领主莫诺汗。
text.description:
魔古族正在北边的矿脉源源不断地开采幽冥铁，并用闪电力量为其充能。

我们要摧毁他们用来采矿的钻头。普通的攻击对其并无影响，但却可以通过适当的方法使其过载。

噢——你在那里的时候，记得顺手把在那里活动的敌人全干掉。

english.title: Maximum Capacitor
english.objectives: Interact with the three lightning drills in the Ghost Iron Mines to destroy them, and kill Metal Lord Mono-Han.
english.description:
The mines north of here are being used to extract Ghost Iron ore and energize it with lightning energy.

We need to destroy the drills they use to extract the ore. They are impervious to normal attack, but can be overloaded using the proper methods.

Oh - and while you're there, take out whoever is running the operation.

text.title: 救救斥候！
text.objectives: 在闪电矿脉中解救3名被捕的夺日者密探，并击败金铁领主莫诺汗。
text.description:
魔古族派重兵把守矿脉的做法表明这是一处重要地点——可我们需要搜集更多有关他们活动的情报。因此我们派了一些密探去打探情报。

不幸的是，许多人都被抓住了。我们发现其中有一些人正在矿脉中遭受折磨。你一定要救救他们——他们正在遭受非人的折磨……

还有，救出他们之后，请你把抓获他们的人都干掉。不要对那些人手软，$p！

english.title: Save Our Scouts!
english.objectives: Rescue the three captured Sunreaver agents within the Ghost Iron Mines, and kill Metal Lord Mono-Han.
english.description:
The heavy mogu presence in the mines let us know it was a place of great importance - but we needed to gather more information on their activities there, so we sent agents into the mines to spy on them.

Unfortunately, many were captured, and we've found that some are being tortured in the mines. You have to go rescue them - nobody deserves what they are going through...

And, when you finish, kill whoever captured them. No mercy, $p!

text.title: Kill mogu boss for key, use object behind jumping puzzle

english.title: Kill mogu boss for key, use object behind jumping puzzle

text.title: Nalak the Storm Lord
text.objectives: [PH] Kill Nalak [Log Description]
text.description: [PH] Kill Nalak [Description]
text.completed: [PH] Kill Nalak [Completion Text]

english.title: Nalak the Storm Lord
english.objectives: [PH] Kill Nalak [Log Description]
english.description: [PH] Kill Nalak [Description]
english.completed: [PH] Kill Nalak [Completion Text]

text.title: 突袭赞布图拉
text.objectives: 完成突袭赞布图拉。与洛瑟玛·塞隆交谈以开始攻击。
text.description: 我们在海岸沿线部署的侦察力量为我们提供了关于这座岛屿的宝贵情报，$c。$B$B然而，如果我们不向本岛推进，就必将一事无成。$B$B我已经集结了一支由精英空军单位组成的战队，准备发起攻击。$B$B我想让你参与这次行动。像你这样的英雄一定能帮我们在紧要关头力挽狂澜。$B$B当你做好出击准备时，来与我谈谈。
text.completion: Yes! You have done it, champion!$B$BWe will be as a tide that sweeps over this island, bringing with it a new destiny for our people. And you, hero, are at its forefront.
text.completed: Return to Lor'themar Theron at Dawnseeker Promontory on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: The Assault on Zeb'tula
english.objectives: Complete the Assault on Zeb'tula. Speak to Lor'themar Theron to begin the attack.
english.description: Our scouting efforts along the coast have given us valuable intelligence about the island, $c.$B$BHowever, we will accomplish nothing if we do not advance forward onto the mainland.$B$BI have assembled a team of our most elite aerial units to begin the attack.$B$BI would like you to join the assault. A champion such as yourself could turn the battle in our favor at the critical moment.$B$BWhen you are ready to begin the attack, speak to me.
english.completion: Yes! You have done it, champion!$B$BWe will be as a tide that sweeps over this island, bringing with it a new destiny for our people. And you, hero, are at its forefront.
english.completed: Return to Lor'themar Theron at Dawnseeker Promontory on the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 宿敌
text.objectives: 在雷神岛上击败10名肯瑞托单位或玩家。
text.description: 看来吉安娜和肯瑞托以为自己能再把我们赶出去一次？我决不会袖手旁观，看达拉然事件重复上演！$b$b我们反击的时刻到了！这一次，轮到我们采取主动了……$b$b前往紫罗兰高地，把你找到的任何肯瑞托密探全都干掉。
text.completion: So, Violet Rise runs red with the blood of our enemies? Well done, $n.$B$BThis will be an ongoing battle I fear. We must continue to show our strength here.
text.completed: Return to Lor'themar Theron at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

english.title: Old Enemies
english.objectives: Kill 10 Kirin Tor units or players on the Isle of Thunder.
english.description: So Jaina and the Kirin Tor think they can push us out again? I will not stand by and allow them to repeat the events of Dalaran!$b$bThis time we fight back! This time we do the pushing...$b$bGo to Violet Rise and slay any Kirin Tor agent you find.
english.completion: So, Violet Rise runs red with the blood of our enemies? Well done, $n.$B$BThis will be an ongoing battle I fear. We must continue to show our strength here.
english.completed: Return to Lor'themar Theron at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

text.title: 锈水渗透者
text.objectives: 在统御岗哨和锈水海滩击败10名军情七处破坏者。
text.description: 再也没有比好端端地干着自己的活儿时，听到有人跟踪你更让人紧张的事了。我发誓，我在这下面一直听到类似的动静！我们被监视了！$B$B我有一种感觉，整个海滩上充斥着间谍！$b$b为了制止他们的破坏活动，我制造了一些改良版的红外感温眼镜。没错，我说的就是破坏活动！现在，我只要你来试用一下！至于你抓到的间谍，就随你处置好了。
text.completion: Very nice, $n! I knew it! I knew there were Alliance sneaking around down there!$B$BNo one messes with a Bilgewater rig and gets away with it!
text.completed: Return to Rivett Clutchpop in Domination Point.

english.title: Bilgewater Infiltrators
english.objectives: Kill 10 SI: 7 Saboteurs around Domination Point and Bilgewater Beach.
english.description: There is nothing more unnerving than walking along, minding your own business, and hearing someone following you. I swear I hear it all over the place down here! We're being watched!$B$BI have a feeling the entire beach is just crawling with spies!$b$bI made some improvements to our infrared goggle tech to put an end to the sabotogery. That's right sabotogery! Now I just need you to try 'em out! Feel free to dispose of any spies you happen to catch.
english.completion: Very nice, $n! I knew it! I knew there were Alliance sneaking around down there!$B$BNo one messes with a Bilgewater rig and gets away with it!
english.completed: Return to Rivett Clutchpop in Domination Point.

text.title: 可憎的献祭
text.objectives: 摧毁赞达拉祭坛。
text.description:
赞达拉巨魔对我们的人民举行了可憎的仪式！必须阻止他们！

深入赞图尔的中心位置，摧毁他们的祭坛。
text.completion: I could feel the magic of their altars dissipating even here, $C.
text.completed: Return to Elina Zaralae at the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Heinous Sacrifice
english.objectives: Destroy the Zandalari sacrificial altars.
english.description:
The Zandalari perform heinous rites against our people! They must be stopped!

Delve into the heart of the Za'Tual and destroy their altars.
english.completion: I could feel the magic of their altars dissipating even here, $C.
english.completed: Return to Elina Zaralae at the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 苦痛折磨
text.objectives: 解救痛苦的啸天龙。
text.description:
赞达拉巨魔像对待劣等害虫那样训练他们的啸天龙宠物，用暴力和折磨使其听命于自己的意愿。

我能听到有一只啸天龙正在他们手中痛苦地哀号着。

去赞图尔找到那只痛苦的啸天龙，帮它挣脱束缚。
text.completion: It what?! It killed its master? Wonderful. These skyscreamers  have more fight in them than I realized. Thank you for helping free the beast, $R - it is one less threat to the Horde, and one more for the Zandalari.
text.completed: Return to Kethiel Sunlance at the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Pterrible Ptorment
english.objectives: Free the Tormented Skyscreamer.
english.description:
The Zandalari treat their skyscreamer pets as little more than scuttling vermin, bending them to their will with violence and torment.

I can hear one writhing in pain at their hands.

Find the tormented skyscreamer within Za'Tual and help it break free of its captors.
english.completion: It what?! It killed its master? Wonderful. These skyscreamers  have more fight in them than I realized. Thank you for helping free the beast, $R - it is one less threat to the Horde, and one more for the Zandalari.
english.completed: Return to Kethiel Sunlance at the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 邪恶供品
text.objectives: 摧毁6份赞达拉供品。
text.description:
赞达拉缚灵者通过献祭仪式来取悦神灵和他们的邪神。我们的人民也成了这些黑暗仪式的牺牲品。

把你在赞图尔帐篷间找到的任何供品全都摧毁，这样一来，我们也许就能让献祭无法如期进行。
text.completion: The tide of blood is slowed, at least for a time. Thank you for your efforts in stalling the sacrifices, $C.
text.completed: Return to Elina Zaralae at at the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Dark Offerings
english.objectives: Destroy 6 Zandalari Offerings.
english.description:
The spirtibinders of the Zandalari perform sacrificial rites to appease the loa and their vile gods. These dark rituals involve the sacrifice of our people.

Destroy any offerings you can find among their tents in Za'Tual and perhaps we can stall the sacrifices.
english.completion: The tide of blood is slowed, at least for a time. Thank you for your efforts in stalling the sacrifices, $C.
english.completed: Return to Elina Zaralae at at the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 敌人的骨灰
text.objectives: 超度8具干尸残骸。
text.description: 白骨庭院中的魔古族正在施法复活亡者之魂来扩充兵力。$B$B我们决不能任由他们让亡者士兵起死回生。$B$B带上这个火把，去超度你所找到的干尸遗骸。$B$B我们要在这些敌人复活之前先干掉他们。
text.completion: Their dead shall rise no more, thanks to you, $n. Excellent work.
text.completed: Return to Captain Aerthas Firehawk on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Ashes of the Enemy
english.objectives: Burn 8 Mummified Remains.
english.description: The mogu here at the Court of Bones are bolstering their army by resurrecting the spirits of their dead.$B$BWe cannot allow them to revive their fallen warriors.$B$BTake this torch and burn any mummified corpses that you can find.$B$BWe will destroy our enemies before they have a chance to rise.
english.completion: Their dead shall rise no more, thanks to you, $n. Excellent work.
english.completed: Return to Captain Aerthas Firehawk on the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 冷血石像
text.objectives: 摧毁8个陵寝守卫者。
text.description: 我们对白骨庭院的攻击仍在继续。尽管进展依旧缓慢，但却相当可观。$B$B不幸的是，我们收到了几份报告，接连有石魁麟雕像在毫无征兆的情况下就活了过来。我不能让这些魁麟威胁到我的研究事业。$B$B前往白骨庭院，消灭你所能找到的所有魁麟雕像。
text.completion: I am glad to hear that you left the quilen in a thousand tiny pieces. You have contributed much to our war effort.
text.completed: Return to Ryshelle Brightlock on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Stone Cold
english.objectives: Destroy 8 Grave Guardians.
english.description: Our assault on the Court of Bones continues. Our progress remains slow, but measurable.$B$BUnfortunately, we've received several reports of stone quilen statues coming to life without warning. I can't have these quilen threatening my research expedition.$B$BVenture into the Court of Bones and destroy any quilen statues that you can find.
english.completion: I am glad to hear that you left the quilen in a thousand tiny pieces. You have contributed much to our war effort.
english.completed: Return to Ryshelle Brightlock on the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 失魂者
text.objectives: 解救6名夺日者斥候或银色盟约斥候。
text.description: 我们攻击了白骨庭院的魔古族，可恐怕只是在给他们那邪恶的仪式输送牺牲品而已。$B$B魔古族不仅会消灭他们的俘虏，还会偷走他们的灵魂，将其注入石头里，图谋不轨，或者将牺牲者铸成幽魂战争武器。$B$B部落也好，联盟也罢，身份并不重要。我们决不能让魔古族扩充军力。$B$B快到墓穴去，救出所有一息尚存的俘虏。
text.completion: Thank you, $n. You have lightened my heart of a heavy burden through your heroic actions.$B$BI will remember your efforts on this day.
text.completed: Return to Grand Magister Rommath on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Soul Surrender
english.objectives: Save 6 Sunreaver Scouts or Silver Covenant Scouts.
english.description: We assault the mogu at the Court of Bones, but I fear we merely send them fodder for their abominable rituals.$B$BThe mogu do not merely kill their prisoners - they steal their souls and imbue them in machinations of stone, or reforge the fallen into ghostly tools of war.$B$BHorde or Alliance, it matters not. We cannot allow the mogu to bolster their numbers.$B$BGo into the crypts. Free any prisoners that are still living.
english.completion: Thank you, $n. You have lightened my heart of a heavy burden through your heroic actions.$B$BI will remember your efforts on this day.
english.completed: Return to Grand Magister Rommath on the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 海滩大反攻
text.objectives: 在锈水海滩附近击败任意10名神盾军士兵，包括军情七处破坏者。
text.description: 由于雄狮港的持续骚扰，我们的木材供应有点跟不上了。我们已经挡住了攻击者，现在该是我们展示肌肉的时候了！$b$b快去海滩上砸扁他们！
text.completion: Excellent work down there, $n! That should keep 'em outta our hair for awhile!
text.completed: Return to Rivett Clutchpop in Domination Point.

english.title: Storming the Beach
english.objectives: Kill any 10 Shieldwall Forces including SI: 7 Saboteurs in and around Bilgewater Beach.
english.description: Our lumber supply is being jeopardized by constant attacks from Lion's Landing.$b$bWe've been able to keep the attackers at bay, but it's time to really show 'em some muscle!$b$bHead down to the coast and start splitting some skulls!
english.completion: Excellent work down there, $n! That should keep 'em outta our hair for awhile!
english.completed: Return to Rivett Clutchpop in Domination Point.

text.title: 通缉：首席技师轮钳
text.objectives: 前往锈水海滩边缘消灭首席技师轮钳。
text.description: 因其对锈水公司所犯罪行，特此通缉首席技师轮钳！$b$b该犯最后一次现身时，正在锈水海滩边缘建造一台疑似蛛形坦克的装置。$b$b任何人接近该犯时必须格外小心。$b$b消灭轮钳者将获得巨额赏金。
text.completion: Excellent work, $C! This brings us one step closer to pushing them out of Pandaria!
text.completed: Return to Blood Guard Gro'Tash in Domination Point.

english.title: Wanted: Chief Engineer Cogwrench
english.objectives: Destroy Chief Engineer Cogwrench at the edge of Bilgewater Beach.
english.description: Wanted for crimes against the Bilgewater Operation!$b$bChief Engineer Cogwrench was last seen building what appeared to be a giant spider tank on the edge of Bilgewater Beach.$b$bExtreme caution should be used when approaching.$b$bA large reward has been posted for Cogwrench's destruction.
english.completion: Excellent work, $C! This brings us one step closer to pushing them out of Pandaria!
english.completed: Return to Blood Guard Gro'Tash in Domination Point.

text.title: 通缉：伊桑·雅各布森中尉
text.objectives: 去快锯伐木场南端的南部岛屿消灭伊桑·雅各布森中尉。
text.description: 因其对统御岗哨部队犯下的罪行，特此通缉伊桑·雅各布森中尉！$b$b伊桑·雅各布森中尉指挥了数次针对锈水公司伐木场的地面袭击。$b$b该犯最后一次现身时正盘踞在快锯伐木场南边的一座小岛上。
text.completion: It's a good day when another Lion's Landing leader falls, $C! Good work!
text.completed: Return to Blood Guard Gro'Tash in Domination Point.

english.title: Wanted: Lieutenant Ethan Jacobson
english.objectives: Destroy Lieutenant Ethan Jacobson in the Southern Isles south of Quickchop's Lumber Farm.
english.description: Wanted for crimes against the Domination Point forces!$b$bLieutenant Ethan Jacobson is responsible for leading several ground assaults against the Bilgewater lumber operation.$b$bLast spotted occupying an island south of Quickchop's Lumber Farm.
english.completion: It's a good day when another Lion's Landing leader falls, $C! Good work!
english.completed: Return to Blood Guard Gro'Tash in Domination Point.

text.title: 别再回来了！
text.objectives: 击败15个复生的先祖。
text.description: 你看见那些在坟场中徘徊的鬼魂了吗？$B$B他们是复生的先祖，是被重新召唤到这个世界上来的，魔古族死者的灵魂。$B$B当被激怒时，他们会迅捷无声地发起攻击，他们的数量也在日增夜长。$B$B他们不属于这里。去消灭他们，把他们送回坟墓里去。
text.completion: Wonderful work, $C. This will help our offensive a great deal.
text.completed: Return to Ryshelle Brightlock on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Rise No More!
english.objectives: Kill 15 Risen Ancestors.
english.description: Have you seen the ghosts wandering the graveyard?$B$BThey are risen ancestors, the spirits of slain mogu who have been called back to this world.$B$BWhen angered, they attack swiftly and silently, and their numbers increase by the day.$B$BThey do not belong here. Destroy them, and send them back beyond the grave.
english.completion: Wonderful work, $C. This will help our offensive a great deal.
english.completed: Return to Ryshelle Brightlock on the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 雷电的召唤
text.objectives: 阻止山泽唤雷者的仪式。
text.description: 在白骨庭院里，西边墓穴最深处的废墟间，雷电之王麾下最强大的巫师们正在用劈啪作响的电流为一柄闪电权杖充能。$B$B我们怀疑，这把武器将会给我们位于寻晨者海角的据点带来毁灭性的灾难。$B$B没时间耽搁了。你必须立即阻止他们的仪式。
text.completion: You continue to exceed my expectations, $C. Well done.
text.completed: Return to Grand Magister Rommath on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: The Call of Thunder
english.objectives: Stop the Shan'ze Thundercallers' ritual.
english.description: Within the graveyard, in the deepest ruins of their western crypt, the Thunder King's most powerful sorcerers are charging a lightning rod with crackling electricity.$B$BWe suspect that this weapon is meant to rain destruction on our stronghold at Dawnseeker Promontory.$B$BThere is no time to delay. You must stop their ritual at once.
english.completion: You continue to exceed my expectations, $C. Well done.
english.completed: Return to Grand Magister Rommath on the Isle of Thunder.

objectiveDetails.description: 阻止山泽唤雷者的仪式

text.title: 进入墓穴
text.objectives: 在至尊殿使用古拉的咒语，然后击败重生的古拉。
text.description: 神圣遗物学会在这里真是如鱼得水，我是说真的！$B$B每一天，我们的研究员都会带回更多可供研究和归档的遗物。$B$B最近，我们的一位探险者在白骨庭院中发现了这个卷轴。$B$B我相信这个咒语能够唤起坟墓中的死者。如果我的魔古知识没错，那你应该到至尊殿最深处的那个房间里使用它。$B$B你愿意去验证一下我的理论吗？
text.completion: Ah yes, you've just confirmed my theory! Thank you, $C.
text.completed: Return to Ryshelle Brightlock on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Into the Crypts
english.objectives: Use the Incantation of Gura in the Hall of the Exalted, then defeat Gura the Reclaimed.
english.description: The Reliquary is having a field day out here, literally!$B$BEvery day, the researchers find more relics to study and catalog.$B$BRecently, one of our adventurers found this scroll at the Court of Bones.$B$BI believe that this incantation can be used to call beyond the grave. And if my Mogu is up to date, I'd say you should use it in the last room in the Hall of the Exalted.$B$BWould you be willing to test out my theory?
english.completion: Ah yes, you've just confirmed my theory! Thank you, $C.
english.completed: Return to Ryshelle Brightlock on the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 防患未然
text.objectives: 在$1oa只啸天雏龙身边奔跑以惊吓它们。
text.description:
赞达拉巨魔骑乘的那些生物并非天生如此巨大，也不是生来就如此邪恶和忠诚。

要是你能把一些啸天雏龙吓离海岸，也许它们就有机会享受真正的生活了。
text.completion: You have returned, $R. It is my hope that these young skyscreamers have the lives they deserve without dealing with the harsh treatment of the trolls.
text.completed: Return to Kethiel Sunlance at the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Preventing a Future Threat
english.objectives: Frighten $1oa Hatchling Skyscreamers by running near them.
english.description:
The creatures the Zandalari ride don't start out so big, nor do they start out the vicious and loyal creatures they become.

If you can frighten some of the hatchling skyscreamers away from the beach, perhaps they will have a chance at a real life.
english.completion: You have returned, $R. It is my hope that these young skyscreamers have the lives they deserve without dealing with the harsh treatment of the trolls.
english.completed: Return to Kethiel Sunlance at the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 战栗的沼泽
text.objectives: 消灭强大的魔暴龙。
text.description: 在这片沼泽里有一只巨大的野兽。它目前还没对我们发起攻击，但我可不敢保证，我们是否会一直这么幸运下去。$B$B在它还没饿到要来突破我们的防线前，赶快将它消灭。
text.completion: You are not one to be trifled with. I am sure to have further use of your services.$B$BCome back to me in a day's time, $C.
text.completed: Return to Girana the Blooded at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

english.title: The Shuddering Moor
english.objectives: Kill the Mighty Devilsaur.
english.description: There is an immense beast in the swamp. It has not yet marched upon us, but I place no stock that we will continue to be so fortunate.$B$BStrike it down before it grows hungry enough to brave our defenses.
english.completion: You are not one to be trifled with. I am sure to have further use of your services.$B$BCome back to me in a day's time, $C.
english.completed: Return to Girana the Blooded at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

text.title: 赞达拉巨神像
text.objectives: 消灭赞达拉巨神像。
text.description: 巨魔已将一个巨大的构造体部署在南边的路上，阻碍了我们岛屿四周的通行。去帮我们除掉障碍，$c。
text.completion: When I give you a task, it gets handled.$B$BWell done, $C.
text.completed: Return to Girana the Blooded at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

english.title: The Zandalari Colossus
english.objectives: Destroy the Zandalari Colossus.
english.description: The trolls have dispatched one of their immense constructs on the southern road, blocking our passage around the island. See to it that the road is cleared, $c.
english.completion: When I give you a task, it gets handled.$B$BWell done, $C.
english.completed: Return to Girana the Blooded at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

text.title: Trailing Light in the Dark
text.objectives: Relight 8 torches within the Diremoor.
text.description: There is some dark magic in the Diremoor that extinguishes even our magical illuminations, and so our scouts struggle to find their way.$B$BAs you pass through the swamp, relight any torches you find that our men might find their way. Perhaps they will help you find your way back as well.
text.completed: Return to Magister Hathorel at the Dawnseeker Promitory.

english.title: Trailing Light in the Dark
english.objectives: Relight 8 torches within the Diremoor.
english.description: There is some dark magic in the Diremoor that extinguishes even our magical illuminations, and so our scouts struggle to find their way.$B$BAs you pass through the swamp, relight any torches you find that our men might find their way. Perhaps they will help you find your way back as well.
english.completed: Return to Magister Hathorel at the Dawnseeker Promitory.

text.title: 值得注意
text.objectives: 摧毁征服者平台的守护者塔克乌。
text.description: 我在上一次侦察时发现了一些奇怪的事。一群赞达拉巨魔正在对一个看上去像是巨型哨兵的玩意儿举行仪式。他们或许是在试图复活它。$b$b我们得阻止那个仪式，并摧毁那个哨兵。那么巨大的家伙多半不是什么好东西。$b$b我已经派斥候提前去打探他们的行动了。去与她会合，看看如何才能阻止他们。
text.completion: So I was correct to be concerned. It's a good thing you were there to stop them before that guardian was fully infused.$B$BGood work, $C.
text.completed: Return to Scout Captain Elsia within the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: What's Inside Counts
english.objectives: Destroy Guardian Tak'u in Conqueror's Terrace.
english.description: I noticed something strange on my last scouting mission. A group of Zandalari are performing a ritual on what appears to be a very large sentry. They may be trying to re-animate it.$b$bWe need that ritual stopped and the sentry destroyed. Anything that large can't be good.$b$bI've sent a scout ahead to observe their actions. Meet with her and figure out how to stop them.
english.completion: So I was correct to be concerned. It's a good thing you were there to stop them before that guardian was fully infused.$B$BGood work, $C.
english.completed: Return to Scout Captain Elsia within the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 缴除武装
text.objectives: 从征服者平台偷取7把灌注神力的利刃。
text.description: 看看周围吧，$c。你看到了什么？我看到的是机遇。$b$b这里的施法者正在使用强大的魔法给赞达拉武器灌魔，好像这些锋利的武器还不足以将最强大的战士切成两半似的。$b$b在我的侦探过程中，我发现他们对这些武器的看守并不严密。这就需要你出马了……$b$b如果能偷到一些这种武器，或许我们也可以使用它们。至少，也可以防止它们落入敌人的手里。
text.progress: So? What did you find?
text.completion: Excellent work, $c!$B$BThese weapons are terrifying on their own, nevermind the magic they are infused with.
text.completed: Return to Scout Captain Elsia within the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Very Disarming
english.objectives: Steal 7 Loa-Infused Blades from Conqueror's Terrace.
english.description: Look around you, $c. What do you see? I see an opportunity.$b$bThe casters here work to imbue the Zandalari weapons with powerful magic. As if a sharp blade isn't enough to cut even the strongest foe down to size.$b$bIn my scouting I've noticed the weapons are not very well guarded. This is where you come in...$b$bIf we can steal a few of these weapons we may be able to use them. At the very least they are out of enemy hands.
english.progress: So? What did you find?
english.completion: Excellent work, $c!$B$BThese weapons are terrifying on their own, nevermind the magic they are infused with.
english.completed: Return to Scout Captain Elsia within the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 知识就是力量
text.objectives: 在征服者平台附近夺取6件仪式神器。
text.description: 这里的赞达拉巨魔所使用的魔法非常与众不同。$c，要想击败它，我们必须先了解它，$c。$b$b他们对奥术和暗影的控制力十分惊人。我很想知道他们是怎么做到这一点的，这可是众多施法者梦寐以求的境界。$b$b我认为他们的仪式神器或许就藏着我想要的答案。给我带一些神器样品回来，我保证会好好奖励你的。
text.progress: Did you find the artifacts?
text.completion: These will do nicely, $c. Excellent work.
text.completed: Return to Magister Edien Sunhollow within the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Knowledge Is Power
english.objectives: Retrieve 6 Ritual Artifacts from around Conqueror's Terrace.
english.description: The Zandalari here practice a different kind of magic. We must understand it before we can defeat it, $c.$b$bTheir control over the arcane and shadow is impressive. I wish to learn how they have achieved what so many others have not.$b$bI believe their ritual artifacts may hold the answers I seek. Bring me a sampling of the artifacts you find, and I will ensure you are rewarded properly.
english.progress: Did you find the artifacts?
english.completion: These will do nicely, $c. Excellent work.
english.completed: Return to Magister Edien Sunhollow within the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 点火！哇啊啊！
text.objectives: 使用锈水燃烧瓶摧毁6架天火号旋翼机X2型。
text.description: 侏儒带来了他们的飞行器。我要肃清我的领空！$b$b快爬上你的坐骑，摧毁那些破烂装置。$b$b你可以用我从地精盟友那里“弄来”的烈酒。相比灌进那些绿皮小鬼的喉咙，它们更适合用来炸毁旋翼机。
text.completion: Ha! Simple mechanical toys are no match for a well aimed bottle of grog.
text.completed: Speak with Blood Guard Gro'tash at Domination Point in Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: Flash! Aaaaaahhhh!
english.objectives: Use the Bilgewater Molotovs to destroy 6 Skyfire Gyrocopter X2s.
english.description: The gnomes have brought their flying contraptions. I want my skies CLEAR!$b$bGet up there on whatever mount you have with you and destroy those paltry devices.$b$bYou may use this grog I "acquired" from our goblin allies. It would be better served blasting down gyrocopters than in the gullet of those little green fiends.
english.completion: Ha! Simple mechanical toys are no match for a well aimed bottle of grog.
english.completed: Speak with Blood Guard Gro'tash at Domination Point in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 除虫喷剂
text.objectives: 对5名兴奋的页岩蛛使用驱虫剂，消灭15只页岩小蜘蛛。
text.description: 这座洞穴里爬满了恶心的页岩蛛！有这些不断吞噬矿工和矿石的家伙在，我一个姑娘家怎么可能完得成工作嘛？！$b$b不过，这倒是个测试我的新发明——除虫喷剂的好机会。你要做的很简单，就是把试剂对着那些蜘蛛喷就是了。这种喷剂可以驱赶页岩蛛，而且对矿工没有多少长期副作用！$b$b所以，怎么可能会出麻烦呢？$b$b拿上这个便携式喷雾器，然后去干活儿吧！
text.completion: Now that's what I like to hear! I bet those spiders will think twice before messing with a Bilgewater operation again!
text.completed: Return to Bixy Buzzsaw in Oregrind's Dig.

english.title: Bug Off!
english.objectives: Spray 5 Agitated Shale Spiders with the Bug Off Sprayer and eradicate 12 Shale Shards.
english.description: This cave is crawlin' with nasty shale spiders! How's a girl supposed to get any work done with them gobbling up the miners AND the ore?!$b$bThis seemed like a good opportunity to use my newest invention, Bug Off. See, all you have to do is spray this stuff all over the shale spiders. They hate it and it doesn't seem to have many long term side-effects for the miners!$b$bWhat could possibly go wrong?$b$bTake this handy sprayer and get to work!
english.completion: Now that's what I like to hear! I bet those spiders will think twice before messing with a Bilgewater operation again!
english.completed: Return to Bixy Buzzsaw in Oregrind's Dig.

objectiveDetails.description: 对兴奋的页岩蛛喷洒驱虫剂

text.title: 珍贵资源
text.objectives: 在轮滑油井周围拧紧8个故障阀门。
text.description: 我们在这里可是大丰收啊，$n！$b$b我们的油井几乎应付不了泵出地面的大量原油。这是真正的井喷！或者更确切地说，是阀喷。$b$b我已经在加班抢修阀门了，可每次我刚修好，它们就又坏了。$b$b简直好像有人在跟着我搞破坏似的……不过这完全是无稽之谈……$b$b或许你的运气会好一些。请尽力去多拧紧一些阀门吧。
text.completion: So I was being followed! Those dirty rotten sneaks!$B$BI'm going to have to start planting some real nice surprises for those cowards. Surprises that will really knock 'em out!
text.completed: Return to Bixy Buzzsaw in Bilgewater Beach.

english.title: Precious Resource
english.objectives: Tighten 8 Faulty Valves in and around Gearslip's Gusher.
english.description: What we have here is too much of a good thing, $n!$b$bOur rig just can't handle the amount of oil we're pumping out of the ground. It's literally bursting at the seams! To be more accurate, it's bursting at the valves.$b$bI've been working double-time to get the valves repaired, but every time I finish the rounds, they're all broken again.$b$bIt's as if someone is following me... That's ridiculous though....$b$bMaybe you'll have better luck. Try getting as many of those valves tightened as you can.
english.completion: So I was being followed! Those dirty rotten sneaks!$B$BI'm going to have to start planting some real nice surprises for those cowards. Surprises that will really knock 'em out!
english.completed: Return to Bixy Buzzsaw in Bilgewater Beach.

text.title: 通用型遥控引爆器
text.objectives: 去快锯伐木场摧毁9个神盾机械碾压者。
text.description: 机械碾压者的确给我们造成了一些麻烦，可我想我能解决！$b$b我自制了一个通用遥控器，不过我似乎碰巧接入了一个特殊的频段。它对我们非常有用！$b$b显然这个频段能够削弱他们的护甲！$b$b快用这遥控器给他们留下点记号，然后干掉他们！
text.completion: Good work, $n! I saw the fireworks from here!$B$BWho knew being a genius was this easy? I don't even have to try anymore.
text.completed: Return to Bixy Buzzsaw in Quickchop's Lumber Farm.

english.title: Universal Remote-Explode
english.objectives: Destroy 9 Shieldwall Mecha-Pounders in and around Quickchop's Lumber Farm.
english.description: The Mecha-Pounders are really making things difficult down here, but I think I may have the solution!$b$bI made this universal remote for myself, but it looks like I hit a specific frequency that has an useful result!$b$bApparently this frequency weakens their armor!$b$bUse the remote to take them down a few notches then punch 'em in the face!
english.completion: Good work, $n! I saw the fireworks from here!$B$BWho knew being a genius was this easy? I don't even have to try anymore.
english.completed: Return to Bixy Buzzsaw in Quickchop's Lumber Farm.

text.title: 埋藏的秘密
text.objectives: 去锦绣谷的祖宗高地和法利尔·银棘谈一谈。
text.description: 我听过魔古族曾经拥有数百座秘密武器库，里面堆满了威力惊人的武器。$B$B当一支魔古族部队开始备战时，他们会将恐惧和敬畏植入敌人内心深处。$B$B这正是我来潘达利亚想要找到的秘密！$B$B我派了一支探险队去西边的废墟调查，可他们的进度跟那些没脑子的劳工一样慢！$B$B去跟他们的首领法利尔·银棘谈谈。告诉他，我要立刻看到成果。
text.completion: The Warchief sent you? What does he say?

english.title: Buried Secrets
english.objectives: Speak to Fanlyr Silverthorn at Ancestral Rise in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
english.description: I am told that the mogu once possessed hundreds of hidden armories full of earth-shattering weapons.$B$BWhen a mogu army prepared for war, they struck fear and terror into the hearts of their enemies.$B$BTHIS is the knowledge I seek here on Pandaria!$B$BI have sent an expedition to study some ruins to the west, but they work as slowly as dim-witted peons!$B$BGo speak to Fanlyr Silverthorn, their leader. Tell him that I want to see results immediately.
english.completion: The Warchief sent you? What does he say?

text.title: 寇茹力量之源
text.objectives: 从寇茹织法者身上获取一个染煞之爪。
text.description: 噢，你好啊！你有见过和这些雕像类似的东西吗？这真是太奇妙了！$B$B我先前探查这片废墟时，在高地顶上发现了一些有趣的东西。$B$B我没法靠得太近，可我想那应该也是一个魔古雕像。可是，它却会动！$B$B我没法闯过那些该死的血精灵的封锁线，但你看上去有这个能力。$B$B你能上去帮我搞点特别的东西下来吗？
text.progress: Did ya find anything up there?
text.completion: Oh my, look at this thing!
text.completed: Return to Hilda Hornswaggle at Mogujia in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: The Source of Korune Power
english.objectives: Collect a Sha-Touched Claw from the Korune Spellweaver.
english.description: Why hullo there! Have ya ever seen tha like o' these statues? Fascinatin'!$B$BI was scouting up along the ruins earlier, and I spotted somethin' innerestin' up on the highest rise.$B$BI couldn't get close enough, but I think it might be one o' these mogu statues, 'cept it was movin'!$B$BI can't get through all those nasty blood elves, but you look like you could.$B$BWould you mind going up there and bringing me back anything of interest?
english.progress: Did ya find anything up there?
english.completion: Oh my, look at this thing!
english.completed: Return to Hilda Hornswaggle at Mogujia in Kun-Lai Summit.

text.title: 寇茹魔古
text.objectives: 从寇茹织法者身上获取一份寇茹抄本。
text.description: 这些陶俑守卫很恐怖，可他们和我们在废墟顶上发现的那个生物完全没法比。$B$B我们幸存下来的一些斥候报告说，在北边最高的那片高地上看见了某种魔古织法者。$B$B他使用着某种我们从未见过的魔法。$B$B我们必须尽力了解这个生物。快去干掉他，并把你找到的任何东西带回来给我。
text.progress: What did you discover?
text.completion: Yes, this is remarkable! This is just the kind of artifact that we came here to find!
text.completed: Return to Fanlyr Silverthorn at Mogujia in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: The Korune
english.objectives: Collect a Korune Codex from the Korune Spellweaver.
english.description: These terracotta wardens are fearsome, but not nearly as horrifying as the creature that we found at the top of the ruins.$B$BSome of our surviving scouts reported seeing some kind of mogu spellweaver on the highest rise to the north.$B$BHe practices a type of magic unlike any other we have seen.$B$BWe must learn whatever we can from this creature. Slay him, and bring me anything you find.
english.progress: What did you discover?
english.completion: Yes, this is remarkable! This is just the kind of artifact that we came here to find!
english.completed: Return to Fanlyr Silverthorn at Mogujia in Kun-Lai Summit.

text.title: 会见斥候
text.objectives: 去卡桑琅丛林的卡桑琅海湾与斥候琳娜谈一谈。
text.description: 迷雾已经散去两个月了。我们派去为舰队寻找合适登陆点的联盟斥候在卡桑琅丛林的一片海滩上遭遇了部落。$B$B我要你去找斥候琳娜并帮她确保登陆点的安全。
text.completion: You have impeccable timing, $C. King Wrynn is just about to land, and the full might of our fleet will follow soon after.
text.completed: 去卡桑琅丛林的卡桑琅海湾与斥候琳娜谈一谈。

english.title: Meet the Scout
english.objectives: Speak with Scout Lynna at Krasarang Cove in Krasarang Wilds.
english.description: It has been two months since the parting of the mists. Alliance scouts, seeking a suitable landing site for the fleet, have engaged Horde forces on a beach in Krasarang Wilds.$B$BMeet with Scout Lynna and help secure the landing site.
english.completion: You have impeccable timing, $C. King Wrynn is just about to land, and the full might of our fleet will follow soon after.
english.completed: Speak with Scout Lynna at Krasarang Cove in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 人民的国王
text.objectives: 陪伴瓦里安·乌瑞恩国王找到托德曼元帅和希尔达·盘角并击败25名部落成员。
text.description: 不能再浪费时间了，我们得找到托德曼，守住海滩。$B$B我们还得去看看那些矮人——探险者协会的成员很顽强，但他们不是军人。他们应该就在北边的悬崖那里。$B$B上马吧，$c。为了我们的朋友。为了联盟。
text.completion: I'm satisfied with this site, it's time to bring in our fleet.
text.completed: Speak with King Varian Wrynn in Krasarang Cove.

english.title: A King Among Men
english.objectives: Accompany King Varian Wrynn to find Marshal Troteman, Hilda Hornswaggle, and slay 25 Horde.
english.description: There's no time to waste, we need to find Troteman and secure the beach.$B$BWe should check on the dwarves, too - the Explorer's League is tough, but they're no army. They should be along the cliff just north of here.$B$BLet us ride, $c. For our friends. For the Alliance.
english.completion: I'm satisfied with this site, it's time to bring in our fleet.
english.completed: Speak with King Varian Wrynn in Krasarang Cove.

text.title: 王者的耐心
text.objectives: 进入场景战役“王者的耐心”并向瓦里安·乌瑞恩国王报到。
text.description: 瓦里安国王正在召集果敢的冒险者前去协助他处理泰兰德·语风与一支固守朱鹤寺的部落小分队间的决战。$B$B立刻去向他报到吧！
text.completion: Good to see you again, $n.$B$BWe have a delicate situation on our hands here. We need to plan our next moves carefully.
text.completed: 进入场景战役“王者的耐心”并向瓦里安·乌瑞恩国王报到。

english.title: A Little Patience
english.objectives: Enter the "A Little Patience" scenario and report to King Varian Wrynn.
english.description: King Varian needs decisive adventurers to help him resolve a showdown between Tyrande Whisperwind and a detachment of Horde warriors holed up in the Temple of the Red Crane.$B$BReport to him immediately!
english.completion: Good to see you again, $n.$B$BWe have a delicate situation on our hands here. We need to plan our next moves carefully.
english.completed: Enter the "A Little Patience" scenario and report to King Varian Wrynn.

text.title: 寻找斥候
text.objectives: 去卡桑琅丛林的部落登陆点和斥候罗克拉谈一谈。
text.description: 迷雾散去已经有两个月了。部落斥候一直在为舰队寻找一个合适的登陆点，结果在卡桑琅丛林海岸附近的一座小岛上遭遇了联盟部队。$B$B快去找到斥候罗克拉并帮忙包围登陆点。
text.completion: You are just in time. The Warchief is about to land. Once this site passes his inspection, the fleet will follow.
text.completed: 去卡桑琅丛林的部落登陆点与斥候罗克拉谈一谈。

english.title: Meet the Scout
english.objectives: Speak with Scout Rokla at the Horde Landing Site in Krasarang Wilds.
english.description: It has been two months since the parting of the mists. Horde scouts, seeking a suitable landing site for the fleet, have engaged Alliance forces on a small island off the coast of Krasarang Wilds.$B$BMeet with Scout Rokla and help secure the landing site.
english.completion: You are just in time. The Warchief is about to land. Once this site passes his inspection, the fleet will follow.
english.completed: Speak with Scout Rokla at the Horde Landing Site in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 酋长的力量
text.objectives: 陪伴加尔鲁什找到血卫士高塔什和格里兹尔·轮滑并击败25名联盟成员。
text.description: 来吧，$c！我要视察这座岛，并确认我的登陆部队已经开始工作。$B$B血卫士高塔什应该就在这座岛的北边寻找建造堡垒的合适地点。地精勘测队则应该在东部海滩上探测石油。$B$B让我们碾碎这些臭虫，为部落夺取这片土地吧！
text.completion: Well done. Our presence here will not be denied!
text.completed: Speak with Garrosh Hellscream at the Horde Landing Site in Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: The Might of the Warchief
english.objectives: Accompany Garrosh Hellscream to find Blood Guard Gro'tash, Grizzle Gearslip, and slay 25 Alliance.
english.description: Come, $c! I want to inspect this island and ensure that my landing team has done their job.$B$BBlood Guard Gro'tash should be somewhere on the northern side of the island looking for a suitable place to build our keep. The goblin survey team will have gone up the eastern coast in search of oil.$B$BLet us crush this pitiful display and claim this land for the Horde!
english.completion: Well done. Our presence here will not be denied!
english.completed: Speak with Garrosh Hellscream at the Horde Landing Site in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 黑暗中的匕首
text.objectives: 进入场景战役“黑暗中的匕首”并向沃金报到。
text.description: 暗影猎手沃金将与一队库卡隆斥候一同出发，前去完成酋长交予的重要任务。$B$B像你这样光荣的部落成员当然也能一同前往，但你要小心——真相可能十分丑恶。
text.completion: Good ta see ya, mon. I be needin' true allies at my side for dis mission.
text.completed: 进入场景战役“黑暗中的匕首”并向沃金报到。

english.title: Dagger in the Dark
english.objectives: Enter the "Dagger in the Dark" scenario and report to Vol'jin.
english.description: Shadow Hunter Vol'jin has joined a group of Kor'kron scouts on an important mission for the warchief.$B$BOf course a proud member of the Horde such as yourself is welcome to go along, but be warned - it could get ugly.
english.completion: Good ta see ya, mon. I be needin' true allies at my side for dis mission.
english.completed: Enter the "Dagger in the Dark" scenario and report to Vol'jin.

text.title: 神灵先驱
text.objectives: 消灭2位神灵先驱。
text.description:
你听说过神灵吗？虽然我们一知半解，但那似乎是一种涉及感知力的黑暗魔法。

我们不知道神灵驾驭着何种力量，可我必须派你去中断他们的仪式，$c。
text.completion: I can only imagine what horrors you witnessed, $n. Your bravery was put to the test this day, and you did not fail the Horde in your task.
text.completed: Return to Halduron Brightwing at the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Harbingers of the Loa
english.objectives: Slay 2 Harbingers of the Loa.
english.description:
Have you heard of the loa? We do not understand all of what it is, but it seems to be a dark magic with some degree of sentience.

We do not know what power the loa might possess, but I must ask you to put a stop to their rituals, $c.
english.completion: I can only imagine what horrors you witnessed, $n. Your bravery was put to the test this day, and you did not fail the Horde in your task.
english.completed: Return to Halduron Brightwing at the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 掌控蜥蜴人
text.objectives: 向魔导师奥尔兰、魔导师萨雷恩和魔导师维莎拉报到。
text.description: 我向伊瓜鲁克峭壁派出了三名魔导师，以便监视这些不友好的蜥蜴人邻居，顺便看看能不能策反他们对抗魔古。我要你去找到他们，看看他们是否需要补给或帮助。$b$b他们都是隐身的。你只要找蜥蜴人村子里那些闪烁的光柱就行了。
text.completion: <The archmage listens carefully to your report.>$B$BI understand. Thank you for your aid, $C.
text.completed: Return to Archmage Aethas Sunreaver on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Manipulating the Saurok
english.objectives: Check in with Magister Arlan, Magister Sarien, and Magistrix Vesara.
english.description: I have three magisters entrenched in Ihgaluk Crag, monitoring the saurok and - where they can - turning them against the mogu. I need you to find them and see if they need any supplies or assistance.$b$bThey will be concealed from view. Look for shimmering columns of light within the saurok village.
english.completion: <The archmage listens carefully to your report.>$B$BI understand. Thank you for your aid, $C.
english.completed: Return to Archmage Aethas Sunreaver on the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 解体
text.objectives: 夺回4个被偷走的夺日者构造体。
text.description: 蜥蜴人一直在袭扰我们的边界，而我们的构造体通常都能击退他们。可是，有一些构造体却被他们击败并拖回了伊瓜鲁克峭壁。$b$b我想把这些构造体弄回来。那些滑溜溜的蜥蜴人休想从我眼皮底下偷走夺日者的任何财产。
text.completion: That's more like it.$B$BThank you, $C.
text.completed: Return to Archmage Aethas Sunreaver on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: De-Constructed
english.objectives: Recover the four stolen Sunreaver Constructs.
english.description: Saurok consistently test our borders, and our constructs usually fend them off. Some constructs, however, have been defeated and dragged back to Ihgaluk Crag.$b$bI want those constructs back. No slithering lizard will steal Sunreaver property under my watch.
english.completion: That's more like it.$B$BThank you, $C.
english.completed: Return to Archmage Aethas Sunreaver on the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 帝国的崛起
text.objectives: 去双月殿找加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮。可以与统御岗哨的泰克泰克谈一谈，让他送你一程。
text.description: 加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮酋长带着一队最精锐的士兵到北边去了。$B$B把我们对联盟的辉煌战绩报告给他吧。$B$B你可以去找泰克泰克，让他送你一程。
text.completion: What do you have to report?
text.completed: Speak to Warchief Garrosh Hellscream at the Shrine of Two Moons in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

english.title: Rise Of An Empire
english.objectives: Find Warchief Hellscream at the Shrine of Two Moons. Speak to Tak-Tak at Domination Point for transportation.
english.description: Warchief Garrosh Hellscream travels north with a squad of his most elite soldiers.$B$BReport to him with news of our continued victory against the Alliance.$B$BSpeak to Tak-Tak for transportation.
english.completion: What do you have to report?
english.completed: Speak to Warchief Garrosh Hellscream at the Shrine of Two Moons in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: 众神之声
text.objectives: 调查水银守护者，获得古代寇茹石板。
text.description: 太慢！？我们已经在尽力为酋长卖命了！$B$B发掘工作必须小心谨慎，所有的发现都得编列目录，当然还要走必要的安全流程。他必须明白这一点！$B$B好吧，我们很快就能向他展示一些成果了。你看到西边那个石雕了吗？$B$B我们怀疑那是一个古代的石头容器。现在，我们只需要想办法打开它就行了。$B$B如果你愿意帮助我们的话，就请帮我们小心地打开它吧。
text.progress: We are quite capable of handling this excavation. I understand the Warchief sent you, but he will get faster results if he leaves us to our work.
text.completion: Hmm... very interesting. This tablet will yield many secrets, indeed.
text.completed: Speak to Fanlyr Silverthorn at the Ancestral Rise in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

english.title: Voice of the Gods
english.objectives: Investigate the Mercurial Guardian and obtain the Ancient Korune Tablet.
english.description: Too slowly!? We are working as quickly as possible for the Warchief!$B$BWe must excavate carefully, catalogue each find, and of course follow safety procedures. He must understand!$B$BWell, we may have something to show him soon. Do you see that stone statue to the west?$B$BWe suspect it is an ancient stone storage vessel. Now we just have to find a way to open it.$B$BIf you would care to help us with our excavation, please go about it carefully.
english.progress: We are quite capable of handling this excavation. I understand the Warchief sent you, but he will get faster results if he leaves us to our work.
english.completion: Hmm... very interesting. This tablet will yield many secrets, indeed.
english.completed: Speak to Fanlyr Silverthorn at the Ancestral Rise in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: 不情愿的观众
text.objectives: 在紫罗兰高地附近解救5名夺日者俘虏。
text.description: 肯瑞托实在太过分了！他们现在竟把我们的夺日者同伴当成了战俘！$b$b不必商讨什么交换俘虏的事。我们会自己解决这个问题。$b$b前往紫罗兰高地，释放尽可能多的囚犯。你可千万别被抓了。我们不能连你也失去了。
text.completion: Those you have rescued today would no doubt thank you, if they had the strength.$B$BOur task here will be ongoing. I refuse to leave anyone behind!
text.completed: Return to Magister Hathorel at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

english.title: Captive Audience
english.objectives: Free 5 Sunreaver Captives around Violet Rise.
english.description: The Kirin Tor have gone too far! Now they hold our fellow Sunreavers as war prisoners!$b$bThere will be no discussion of prisoner exchange. We will handle this ourselves.$b$bGo to Violet Rise and free as many prisoners as you can. Do not get captured yourself. We cannot afford to lose you too.
english.completion: Those you have rescued today would no doubt thank you, if they had the strength.$B$BOur task here will be ongoing. I refuse to leave anyone behind!
english.completed: Return to Magister Hathorel at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

text.title: Find scout near enemy camp (injured, port him back)

english.title: Find scout near enemy camp (injured, port him back)

text.title: 魔法束缚
text.objectives: 从紫罗兰高地取回吉安娜的褪色法术书。
text.description: 吉安娜手里有不少强大的魔法神器。她一直把这些东西带在身边，从来不曾让它们远离自己的视线。我对其中一样东西很感兴趣。$b$b那是一本充满知识的书册，在大法师间流传已久。而我却只瞥过几眼而已。$b$b既然我们现在各自为战，从她手里把书卷夺过来也没什么不应该的。
text.progress: Do you have it? Do you have the book?!
text.completion: I have desired this book for many years, $R. It's power is too immense to describe. You have done me a great service.
text.completed: Return to High Arcanist Savor at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

english.title: Spellbound
english.objectives: Retrieve Jaina's Weathered Spellbook from Violet Rise.
english.description: Jaina possesses several very powerful magic artifacts. These items travel with her at all times, and are never far from her grasp. I have an interest in one of these items.$b$bA tome, filled with knowledge, passed from one archmage to another. I have only ever seen glimpses of it.$b$bNow that we fight on opposite sides I see no issue in removing the tome from her possession.
english.progress: Do you have it? Do you have the book?!
english.completion: I have desired this book for many years, $R. It's power is too immense to describe. You have done me a great service.
english.completed: Return to High Arcanist Savor at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

text.title: 充能绿柱石
text.objectives: 找到一块充能绿柱石，并将它带给高阶奥术师西瓦。
text.description: 我们每天都派间谍深入肯瑞托行动基地。有些肩负着从敌人手中找到充能绿柱石并将其带回的使命。$b$b他们还没回来，而且我能确定，他们已经离开了肯瑞托基地。$b$b在位于两地之间的丛林中展开搜寻，寻找任何有可能遗失在运输途中的充能绿柱石。把它带回来交给我，这会对我们大有用处。
text.completion: Well done, champion. This artifact will be put to better use in our hands than in the hands of the Kirin Tor.
text.completed: Speak with High Arcanist Savor in Dawnseeker Promontory at the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Charged Moganite
english.objectives: Recover a Charged Moganite and bring it to High Arcanist Savor.
english.description: We have been dispatching spies into the Kirin Tor base of operations on a daily basis. Some had orders to recover charged moganite from the enemy and bring it here.$b$bThey have not returned, and I can confirm they have left the Kirin Tor base.$b$bSearch the jungle between here and there and find any of the charged moganite that might have been lost in transit. Bring it to me and we will put it to good use.
english.completion: Well done, champion. This artifact will be put to better use in our hands than in the hands of the Kirin Tor.
english.completed: Speak with High Arcanist Savor in Dawnseeker Promontory at the Isle of Thunder.

objectiveDetails.description: 将充能绿柱石送回寻晨者海角

text.title: 法力展现
text.objectives: 击败9名肯瑞托嗜魔者。
text.description: 嗜魔者是令人讨厌的生物。体型小巧，很容易让敌人放松警惕，但对我们的施法者来说却是致命的对手。肯瑞托使紫罗兰高地各处都爬满了这种害虫。$b$b我们必须小心应对。落单的嗜魔者很好对付，可要是一大群嗜魔者聚在一起就另当别论了。$b$b前往紫罗兰高地，削减它们的数量。
text.completion: This task will be ongoing, but you have done as a great service, $R.
text.completed: Return to Girana the Blooded at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

english.title: Mana Manifestations
english.objectives: Kill 9 Kirin Tor Manafiends.
english.description: Manafiends are nasty creatures. Small and easy to underestimate, but deadly to our magic casters. The Kirin Tor have these pests crawling all over Violet Rise.$b$bWe will need to handle them carefully. Alone they are easily managed, but in groups they become a different challenge altogether.$b$bGo to Violet Rise and cut down their numbers.
english.completion: This task will be ongoing, but you have done as a great service, $R.
english.completed: Return to Girana the Blooded at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

text.title: Destroy enemy portal near camp (streaming attackers, defended, enemy can use)

english.title: Destroy enemy portal near camp (streaming attackers, defended, enemy can use)

text.title: 战术魔法炸弹
text.objectives: 在联盟舰船、联盟补给品和构造体仪式上放置战术魔法炸弹。
text.description: 啊，$p，你正是我要找的$r。我又得到了一批战术魔法炸弹，需要将它们安放在位于东南边紫罗兰高地对面的关键位置。$b$b这些就交给你了。我不放心让我们的常规步兵接触如此强力的军火。噢……切勿在任何时候摇晃它们。$b$b在其中一艘肯瑞托舰船上安放一枚，在他们的补给品附近安放一枚，最后再在他们正在建造的构造体上安放一枚。
text.completion: I am sure the use of even these smaller mana bombs has Jaina squirming with rage. Serves her right.$B$BDalaran was my home before her grandparents were born. What right did she have to expel me from my home?
text.completed: Return to Girana the Blooded at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

english.title: Tactical Mana Bombs
english.objectives: Plant a Tactical Mana Bomb on an Alliance Ship, Alliance Supply Shipment, and on the Construct Ritual.
english.description: Ah, $p, just the $r I was looking for. I have received another batch of tactical mana bombs that I need planted in key positions across Violet Rise to the southeast.$b$bHere, take these. I do not trust our standard soldiers with such firepower. Oh... and don't shake them, whatever you do.$b$bPlant one of the Kirin Tor ships, another one near their supplies, and the last on the construct they are building.
english.completion: I am sure the use of even these smaller mana bombs has Jaina squirming with rage. Serves her right.$B$BDalaran was my home before her grandparents were born. What right did she have to expel me from my home?
english.completed: Return to Girana the Blooded at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

objectiveDetails.description: 在联盟舰船上放置炸弹
在构造体仪式上放置炸弹

text.title: 粉碎防御
text.objectives: 摧毁6个肯瑞托监视结界。
text.description: 我们必须对肯瑞托和他们的日常活动严加监视。这通常并不难做到。只要派个间谍溜进去，把情报带回来就行了。$b$b然而，我们眼下却遇到了一个小麻烦，相信你能帮忙解决。$b$b肯瑞托监视结界变得强大起来了。现在要想派人闯过他们的防线，简直比登天还难。要是能令这些结界失效，我们也许就能趁它们被修复前溜进去。
text.completion: Good work, $C. With your help we were able to successfully sneak several spies behind enemy lines.
text.completed: Return to Girana the Blooded at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

english.title: Breaking Down the Defenses
english.objectives: Destroy 6 Kirin Tor Perimeter Wards.
english.description: We need to keep a close watch on the Kirin Tor and their day-to-day activities. Normally this would be easy. We would sneak in a spy and have them report back to us.$b$bHowever, we've run into a slight problem I believe you can help us with.$b$bThe Kirin Tor perimeter wards have increased in power. It's next to impossible to get someone past their lines. If they were disabled we might be able to sneak in before they can be repaired.
english.completion: Good work, $C. With your help we were able to successfully sneak several spies behind enemy lines.
english.completed: Return to Girana the Blooded at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

text.title: Disarm mines near enemy camp (poke them with a stick =P)

english.title: Disarm mines near enemy camp (poke them with a stick =P)

text.title: Set magical mines around camp (using modern warfare lightning)

english.title: Set magical mines around camp (using modern warfare lightning)

text.title: Destroy summoning circles in enemy camp (BloodElf_PowerOrb_Red)

english.title: Destroy summoning circles in enemy camp (BloodElf_PowerOrb_Red)

text.title: 伊瓜鲁克的住民
text.objectives: 击败1个邪刃蛮兵、1个邪刃蜥首牧师和1个邪刃海龙战士。
text.description: 邪刃部族威胁到了我们的人，可报之以毫不留情的消灭未免也太反应过度了。$b$b去干掉他们的部族首领或许是更加理性的回应方式。这样不仅能少一些流血冲突，也可以让他们尊重我们划下的边界。
text.completion: I know the true price of bloodshed. I know the cost of war.$B$BIt would be simpler to blindly massacre our attackers until they yield. But is it right?
text.completed: Return to Sunwalker Dezco on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: The Residents of Ihgaluk
english.objectives: Slay a Skumblade Brute, a Skumblade Saur-Priest, and a Skumblade Seadragon.
english.description: The Skumblade threaten our people, but responding with all-out slaughter would be an overreaction.$b$bA more reasonable response to their threat would be to slay some of their tribal leaders. There will be less bloodshed, and they will still respect our perimeter.
english.completion: I know the true price of bloodshed. I know the cost of war.$B$BIt would be simpler to blindly massacre our attackers until they yield. But is it right?
english.completed: Return to Sunwalker Dezco on the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 手术式死亡
text.objectives: 击败3名赞达拉缚灵者、3名赞达拉驭兽师和3名赞达拉丛林豹战士。
text.description:
赞达拉巨魔的奴兽师将啸天龙训练成翱翔于天际的凶残野兽。缚灵者不知满足地要把我的族人全都变成祭品。而丛林豹战士则更加逼近我们的营地中心。

去赞图尔找到他们，从而消除威胁。
text.completion: I shall continue my unrest until the threat is subdued, but your aid brings us closer to that goal. I thank you, $n.
text.completed: Return to Halduron Brightwing at the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Surgical Death
english.objectives: Slay 3 Zandalari Spiritbinders, 3 Zandalari Beastcallers, and 3 Zandalari Jaguar Warriors.
english.description:
The Zandalari train skyscreamers to become ferocious beasts in the skies. The spiritbinders require endless sacrifices - of our people - to be brought to them. And, the jaguar warriors venture ever closer toward the heart of our camp.

Find them in Za'Tual and remove the threat.
english.completion: I shall continue my unrest until the threat is subdued, but your aid brings us closer to that goal. I thank you, $n.
english.completed: Return to Halduron Brightwing at the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 摧毁城墙！
text.objectives: 与洛瑟玛·塞隆交谈，然后攻入城市下层，为部落夺取它。
text.description: 时机终于到了。我们的大军已在这里稳住阵脚，现在可以冒险突进，前往雷电之王的老巢了。不幸的是，他好像一时半会还没有打开大门的意思。$b$b那我们就只好自己弄出一道门来了。等你做好准备就来找我，$n。
text.completion: With your help, we're one giant step closer to our goal.
text.completed: Return to Lor'themar Theron on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Tear Down This Wall!
english.objectives: Speak with Lor'themar Theron, then break into the lower city and secure it for the Horde.
english.description: The time has come. Our forces are well-enough entrenched here that we can risk pressing forward, into the Thunder King's lair. Unfortunately, it doesn't look like he'll be opening that gate anytime soon.$b$bI suppose we'll have to make a gate of our own then. Let me know when you're ready, $n.
english.completion: With your help, we're one giant step closer to our goal.
english.completed: Return to Lor'themar Theron on the Isle of Thunder.

objectiveDetails.description: 与洛瑟玛·塞隆交谈以开始你的任务

text.title: 直冲云霄！
text.objectives: 进入闪电矿脉。
text.description:
我们可以用你找到的飞翼龙，对魔古族发起致命打击。

他们的采矿作业在空袭面前显得十分脆弱，而你的飞翼龙是眼下唯一能飞到那里的野兽。

等你准备好就来找我吧！
text.completion: Incredible work. This presents us with a monumental opportunity.
text.completed: Return to Lor'themar Theron at Dawnseeker Promontory.

english.title: To the Skies!
english.objectives: Gain access to the Lightning Vein Mine.
english.description:
We can use the pterrorwing that you found to strike a decisive blow against the mogu. 

Their mining operation is vulnerable to attack from the air, and your pterrorwing is the only beast we have capable of flying out there.

Let me know when you are ready!
english.completion: Incredible work. This presents us with a monumental opportunity.
english.completed: Return to Lor'themar Theron at Dawnseeker Promontory.

text.title: 果断行动
text.objectives: 渗透进风暴之海码头并从里面打开庭院大门。与陶矢交谈来开始任务。
text.description: 赞达拉战船在这座岛屿四周的海域上大肆掠夺。他们不断地从赞达拉运送士兵和作战野兽，来壮大雷神的军队。$B$B要是我们能夺取宫殿的船坞，雷电之王的补给线就会被截断，而你在这里的据点也会变得越发稳固。$B$B我有个计划可以实现这一目标，而且用不着劳烦整支大军出动。
text.completion: Excellent work! With that blasted warship out of commission, the bombardments on our forces along the coast will cease.$B$BTaran Zhu has informed me that the Shado-Pan will keep vigil over Stormsea Landing, freeing up Sunreaver resources to press the siege elsewhere. Taoshi will be there. I am sure she will be glad to work with you again.$B$BWe are all grateful for your contributions, $n. Thank you.
text.completed: Report to Lor'themar Theron at Dawnseeker Promontory on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Decisive Action
english.objectives: Infiltrate Stormsea Landing and open the courtyard gate from within. Speak with Taoshi to begin the mission.
english.description: Zandalari warships plunder the seas around this island. They ferry in soldiers and war beasts from Zandalar to bolster Lei Shen's army.$B$BIf we can capture the palace shipyard, the Thunder King's supply line will be cut off, and your foothold here will be secure.$B$BI have a plan to do just that, and it won't take an entire army.
english.completion: Excellent work! With that blasted warship out of commission, the bombardments on our forces along the coast will cease.$B$BTaran Zhu has informed me that the Shado-Pan will keep vigil over Stormsea Landing, freeing up Sunreaver resources to press the siege elsewhere. Taoshi will be there. I am sure she will be glad to work with you again.$B$BWe are all grateful for your contributions, $n. Thank you.
english.completed: Report to Lor'themar Theron at Dawnseeker Promontory on the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 山怖之死
text.objectives: 击败山怖。
text.description:
很久以前，雷神找到了几枚罕见的风暴龙蛋。从其中一枚龙蛋中孵化出的纳拉克，尤为残忍，雷神将它据为己有。

雷电之王的仆从山怖正致力于让雷神的巨龙纳拉克起死回生。

我们必须击败山怖，而且如果可以的话，还要阻止他复活巨龙。
text.completion: Well done, $n. Shan Bu's fall will weaken the Mogu and your heroism will surely be remembered.
text.completed: Return to Lor'themar Theron at Dawnseeker Promontory

english.title: The Fall of Shan Bu
english.objectives: Defeat Shan Bu
english.description:
Long ago, Lei Shen found a rare clutch of storm dragon eggs. One of these creatures - Nalak - was particularly brutal, and Lei Shen took it for his own.

The Thunder King's servant, Shan Bu, works to resurrect Lei Shen's dragon, Nalak.

We must defeat Shan Bu and, if we are able, prevent him from resurrecting the dragon.
english.completion: Well done, $n. Shan Bu's fall will weaken the Mogu and your heroism will surely be remembered.
english.completed: Return to Lor'themar Theron at Dawnseeker Promontory

text.title: Metalocalypse
text.objectives: Kill Metal Lord Mono-Han outside the Ghost Iron Mine on the Isle of the Thunder King.
text.description:
You've made a good start, but now it's time to really make a dent in their operations.

Take out Metal Lord Mono-Han,  of the mines.

english.title: Metalocalypse
english.objectives: Kill Metal Lord Mono-Han outside the Ghost Iron Mine on the Isle of the Thunder King.
english.description:
You've made a good start, but now it's time to really make a dent in their operations.

Take out Metal Lord Mono-Han,  of the mines.

text.title: Fleshcrafter's End
text.objectives: Kill Fleshcrafter Goju outside the Ghost Iron Mines on the Isle of the Thunder King.
text.description:
The mogu responsible for the torture of the agents, Fleshcrafter Goju, stands outside the mine.

Killing him would be the only justice for what he's done to your agents.

english.title: Fleshcrafter's End
english.objectives: Kill Fleshcrafter Goju outside the Ghost Iron Mines on the Isle of the Thunder King.
english.description:
The mogu responsible for the torture of the agents, Fleshcrafter Goju, stands outside the mine.

Killing him would be the only justice for what he's done to your agents.

text.title: 践踏掠食龙
text.objectives: 在兽栏杀死5只迅猛龙和10只训练有素的掠食龙。
text.description: 赞达拉的迅猛龙和掠食龙是对我们部队的重大威胁。它们是出色的狩猎者，能够长途追踪猎物，对毫无准备的目标尤为致命。$b$b我需要你前往兽栏减少那里的恐龙数量。我们要在训练完成前先干掉它们。
text.completion: We lost three good soldiers when we first arrived on this island. Killed in their sleep by compies that had snuck into their tent. Some nights I still hear the screams.
text.completed: Speak with Scout Captain Elsia within the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Compy Stomp
english.objectives: Kill 5 Raptors and 10 Trained Compies in the Beast Pens.
english.description: The raptors and compies of the Zandalari represent a substantial threat to our forces here. They are superb hunting beasts that can track prey over great distances and are often lethal to encounter when caught unawares.$b$bI need you to head into the Beast Pens and cull their numbers. We need to make sure to slay them before they are fully trained.
english.completion: We lost three good soldiers when we first arrived on this island. Killed in their sleep by compies that had snuck into their tent. Some nights I still hear the screams.
english.completed: Speak with Scout Captain Elsia within the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 神龙
text.objectives: 击败一名神谕者。
text.description: 赞达拉巨魔发现了一种将神灵束缚在野兽体内的方法，这可以让它们获得惊人而致命的力量。$b$b我们必须阻止他们。$b$b去兽栏寻找一个神谕者并击败他。你可以通过那些发光的野兽来辨认找到他们。$b$b我们不能让这样的暴行继续下去。
text.completion: Well done, champion. These beasts are strong enough. We don't need them infused with an angry spirit now do we?
text.completed: Speak with Magister Edien Sunhollow within the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Loa-saur
english.objectives: Defeat a Loa Speaker.
english.description: The Zandalari have found a way to bind loa to their beasts giving them impressive and lethal powers.$b$bWe need to put a stop to this.$b$bSearch the Beast Pens for a loa speaker and slay him. You should be able to find them by keeping a look out for their glowing beasts.$b$bWe must not allow these atrocities to continue.
english.completion: Well done, champion. These beasts are strong enough. We don't need them infused with an angry spirit now do we?
english.completed: Speak with Magister Edien Sunhollow within the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 必须见的人
text.objectives: 去滨岸村找陈·风暴烈酒。可以与统御岗哨的泰克泰克谈一谈，让他送你一程。
text.description: $p？能找到你真是太走运了。$b$b陈·风暴烈酒让我把这个交给你，并要你去昆莱山的滨岸村见他。$b$b他遇见了你的一个朋友。不过那家伙能不能活下去就得看运气了。$b$b陈说，你可以让泰克泰克送你一程。
text.completion: Ah! You received my note. Very good. Vol'jin is near death, and I will need your help healing his wounds.
text.completed: Speak with Chen Stormstout at Binan Village in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: Someone You Should See
english.objectives: Find Chen Stormstout at Binan Village. Speak to Tak-Tak at Domination Point for transportation.
english.description: $p? It is good fortune I find you.$b$bChen Stormstout says to give this to you and ask you to meet him at Binan Village of the Kun-Lai Summit.$b$bHe found a friend of yours who needs much luck to get healthy.$B$BChen say speak to Tak-Tak for fast travels.
english.completion: Ah! You received my note. Very good. Vol'jin is near death, and I will need your help healing his wounds.
english.completed: Speak with Chen Stormstout at Binan Village in Kun-Lai Summit.

objectiveDetails.description: 去滨岸村找陈·风暴烈酒

text.title: 无眠军团
text.objectives: 消灭6个复活的战士。
text.description: 山泽正在岛中央将雕像集结成一支大军，日夜不休地滋扰我们的防线。将你看到的会走路的雕像全都消灭。我们的防御者会对你感激不尽的。
text.completion: Your efforts are appreciated.
text.completed: Return to High Arcanist Savor at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

english.title: The Sleepless Legion
english.objectives: Kill 6 Animated Warriors.
english.description: The Shan'ze are animating an army from the statues in the center of the isle, an army that batters our defenses day and night. Destroy any of the walking statues you see. Our defenders will greatly appreciate it.
english.completion: Your efforts are appreciated.
english.completed: Return to High Arcanist Savor at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

text.title: Kill Mogu Blood-seekers (Roaming pairs, actively fighting scouts, and performing rituals on corpses)

english.title: Kill Mogu Blood-seekers (Roaming pairs, actively fighting scouts, and performing rituals on corpses)

text.title: 高塔下的强敌
text.objectives: 在阴惨泥沼消灭7个山泽魔古。
text.description: 魔古族正在阴惨泥沼的高塔附近集结雕像大军。洛瑟玛下令将他们全部消灭。我想你正好是执行这项任务的合适人选。
text.completion: Well done, $C. Thank you for the help.
text.completed: Return to High Arcanist Savor at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

english.title: Enemies Beneath the Tower
english.objectives: Kill 7 Shan'ze mogu in the Diremoor.
english.description: There are mogu in the Diremoor animating the army of statues near the tower. Lor'themar wants them dead. I think you're the one to do it.
english.completion: Well done, $C. Thank you for the help.
english.completed: Return to High Arcanist Savor at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

objectiveDetails.description: 击败阴惨泥沼的山泽魔古

text.title: 加强防御
text.objectives: 强化6个夺日者监视结界。
text.description: 在这座岛屿上潜伏着各式各样的危险。从四面八方都有威胁在逼近。我们必须不惜一切代价守住这片海滩。$b$b在寻晨者海角周围到处都是监视结界。它们在默认状态下会造成伤害，但却缺乏致命的攻击力。$b$b现在可不是心慈手软的时候，$r。必须要让监视结界具备毁灭性的杀伤力！$b$b去强化我们营地附近的监视结界吧。
text.completion: Now that the wards have been fully armed, we can focus our attention elsewhere. Nothing will be slipping past us now!
text.completed: Return to Magister Hathorel at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

english.title: Bolstering the Defenses
english.objectives: Empower 6 Sunreaver Perimeter Wards.
english.description: This island holds many dangers for us. Threats loom from every side. We must defend our hold on these shores at all costs.$b$bPerimeter wards have been placed around Dawnseeker Promontory. By default they will inflict damage, but are not fatal in their attack.$b$bNow is not the time to be merciful, $r. The perimeter wards need to be deadly!$b$bGo and empower the perimeter wards surrounding our camp.
english.completion: Now that the wards have been fully armed, we can focus our attention elsewhere. Nothing will be slipping past us now!
english.completed: Return to Magister Hathorel at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

text.title: [PH] The Fall of Shan Bu
text.objectives: [PH] Kill Shan Bu [Log Description]
text.description: [PH] Kill Shan Bu [Description]
text.completed: [PH] Kill Shan Bu [Completion Text]
