english.objectives: [PH] Kill Shan Bu [Log Description]
english.description: [PH] Kill Shan Bu [Description]
english.completed: [PH] Kill Shan Bu [Completion Text]

text.title: 近在眼前！
text.objectives: 击败锻造大师，并从雷神岛的塑肌者霍古身上取得一块法典碎片。
text.description:
熔炉就在你面前了，还有魔古族锻造武器的核心机密。

在它的后面，就是魔古族的守门者，他掌握着开启下一个城区的钥匙。

该我们行动了！
text.progress: Well?
text.completion: Good work. What you did today brings us one step closer to our ultimate goal.
text.completed: Return to Scout Captain Elsia.

english.title: Forge Ahead!
english.objectives: Kill the Master of the Forge and collect a Codex Fragment from Fleshcrafter Hoku in the Isle of Thunder.
english.description:
The forge lies ahead of you, and with it the heart of the mogu's weaponsmithing ability.

And beyond that, the mogu gatekeeper, who holds the key to unlocking the gate to the next part of the city.

It's time to move out!
english.progress: Well?
english.completion: Good work. What you did today brings us one step closer to our ultimate goal.
english.completed: Return to Scout Captain Elsia.

text.title: 白骨之间
text.objectives: 消灭锻骨者祖尔查卡。
text.description: 我的探子们在伊瓜鲁克峭壁西边的白骨间发现了一个危险的赞达拉巨魔。我需要有人解决掉他。你能完成这项任务吗？
text.completion: It's good to have a man I can trust close at hand.
text.completed: Return to Lor'themar Theron at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

english.title: Among the Bones
english.objectives: Kill Zur'chaka the Bonecrafter.
english.description: My scouts have spotted a dangerous Zandalari among the bones west of Ihgaluk Crag. I need someone capable to see him dispatched. Are you up to the task?
english.completion: It's good to have a man I can trust close at hand.
english.completed: Return to Lor'themar Theron at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

text.title: Raining Bones
text.objectives: Kill Zur'chaka the Bonecrafter.
text.description: We've spotted a Zandalari leader up the central stairs. We need to eliminate him before returning to camp.$B$BWould you be willing to do the deed?
text.completion: You're a good $C to have around, that's for certain. Thank you.
text.completed: Return to Scout Captain Elsia north of the Diremoor.

english.title: Raining Bones
english.objectives: Kill Zur'chaka the Bonecrafter.
english.description: We've spotted a Zandalari leader up the central stairs. We need to eliminate him before returning to camp.$B$BWould you be willing to do the deed?
english.completion: You're a good $C to have around, that's for certain. Thank you.
english.completed: Return to Scout Captain Elsia north of the Diremoor.

text.title: 与众不同的书
text.objectives: 与你的恶魔仆从对话，找出这本书的来源。
text.description: 这本书是用一种华丽而夸张的文字写成的，每一个词都仿佛要从书页上跳出来一般。它有一点像恶魔语，可却比你见过的任何一种恶魔语都要复杂。$B$B或许你的某个恶魔伙伴能告诉你更多信息。
text.completed: The codex appears to be a powerful tome written in an ancient, pre-demonic tongue. You strongly suspect this should be brought to the attention of the Warlock trainers in your capital city.

english.title: An Unusual Tome
english.objectives: Speak with your demonic minion to determine the origins of the tome.
english.description: The tome appears to be written in an ornate, sprawling script that seems to rise off the pages. It vaguely resembles Demonic, but the symbols are far more elaborate than any you've ever seen.$B$BPerhaps one of your demonic companions can tell you more.
english.completed: The codex appears to be a powerful tome written in an ancient, pre-demonic tongue. You strongly suspect this should be brought to the attention of the Warlock trainers in your capital city.

text.title: 雷电之王的宝藏
text.objectives: 与陶矢交谈来进入雷电堡。在里面，把雷神宫殿钥匙交给她，来开始对雷神宝藏护卫的计时突袭。
text.description: 据斥候们回报，有更多从雷神墓中挖出的财宝被运送到雷电堡里了。我们发现了一个秘密的下水道入口，但途中却隔着一道门，使我们无法顺利拦截他们的运送。要是我们想赢得这场奇袭，就要找到一把钥匙，它就在雷神大军最有威望的成员身上。$B$B要是你找到了这把钥匙，赶快带来交给我。$B$B不管你在这场奇袭中窃得什么战利品，全都归你所有。我只要确保没有任何物资被运送给雷神。
text.completion: Not entirely unsuccessful. Still, we'll do better next time.$B$BThanks for providing us with that key. The raid would not have gone off without you.
text.completed: Speak to Taoshi on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Treasures of the Thunder King
english.objectives: Speak to Taoshi to enter the Thunder King's Citadel.  Inside, provide her with a Key to the Palace of Lei Shen to begin the timed raid on his treasure convoy.
english.description: My scouts have returned with word that more of the treasures from Lei Shen's tomb are being brought up into the citadel. We have access to a secret sewer entrance, but a door bars us from intercepting the shipment. If we're going to succeed in this raid, we will need a key that only the most trusted of Lei Shen's forces carry.$B$BIf you get your hands on such a key, bring it to me.$B$BYou can keep whatever spoils you steal from our raid. I simply want to see that this shipment never makes it to Lei Shen.
english.completion: Not entirely unsuccessful. Still, we'll do better next time.$B$BThanks for providing us with that key. The raid would not have gone off without you.
english.completed: Speak to Taoshi on the Isle of Thunder.

objectiveDetails.description: 与阴冷洞窟的陶矢交谈

text.title: 恐角龙或魔暴龙
text.objectives: 击败傲慢的恐角龙或傲慢的魔暴龙身边的所有NPC以扰乱束缚仪式。
text.description: 眼下，我们有了一个干扰赞达拉战争机器的机会，还能顺便给自己找点乐子。$b$b在这片兽栏中，有一头魔暴龙和一头恐角龙，它们都是全副武装，并且心智被赞达拉符咒所奴役。$b$b我要你潜入营地并干扰那里的任意一个束缚仪式。没有特定目标。你只要解决掉那些想要束缚这些野兽的家伙就行了。这能够让这些武装到牙齿的野兽发狂并肆虐赞达拉的营地。然后，我们只要坐着看热闹就行了。
text.completion: Few things in this world and beyond are more entertaining than watching a rampaging ancient beast tearing through an enemy's settlement.$B$BIf times were not so dire I would consider selling tickets to such an event.
text.completed: Speak with Magister Edien Sunhollow within the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Direhorn or Devilsaur
english.objectives: Disrupt a binding ritual by killing all ritual NPCs around either a Defiant Direhorn or a Defiant Devilsaur.
english.description: We have an opportunity to disrupt the Zandalari war machine as well as have a little fun in the process.$b$bWithin these beast pens, a devilsaur and a direhorn are being outfitted with armor, their minds being enslaved to the Zandalari charms.$b$bGo into the camp and disrupt one of these binding rituals. It doesn't matter which one. Just kill those who are trying to bind the creature. This should let the fully armored beast run mad through the Zandalari camp. Then sit back and watch the hilarity ensue.
english.completion: Few things in this world and beyond are more entertaining than watching a rampaging ancient beast tearing through an enemy's settlement.$B$BIf times were not so dire I would consider selling tickets to such an event.
english.completed: Speak with Magister Edien Sunhollow within the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 史前巨兽
text.objectives: 找到并对兽栏中的5只迅猛龙、掠食龙、啸天龙或恐角龙使用恐龙神像。
text.description: 赞达拉巨魔使用了一系列的神像和符咒来维持他们对兽栏的控制。$b$b不妨以其人之道还治其人之身。$b$b我想让你找些这种神像来，然后在兽栏中的各种野兽身上试试效果。$b$b把每只野兽对神像的反应都认真记录下来。然后向我汇报。$b$b也许这能使我们取得对抗赞达拉的优势。
text.completion: Very interesting results. I am sure there is a mage somewhere that cares about the specifics. I, on the other hand, am just glad to hear the sound of trolls being assaulted by their own beasts.
text.completed: Speak with Scout Captain Elsia within the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Dino Might
english.objectives: Find and use Saur Fetishes on 5 raptors, compies, skyscreamers or direhorns in the Beast Pens.
english.description: The Zandalari use a series of fetishes and charms to maintain their control over their menagerie of beasts.$b$bTwo can play at that game.$b$bI want you to find some of these fetishes and try them out on the various beasts in the Beast Pens.$b$bTake careful note of how each beast responds to each fetish. Then report your results to me.$b$bMaybe this will give us the edge we need against the Zandalari.
english.completion: Very interesting results. I am sure there is a mage somewhere that cares about the specifics. I, on the other hand, am just glad to hear the sound of trolls being assaulted by their own beasts.
english.completed: Speak with Scout Captain Elsia within the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 清洁工作
text.objectives: 击败伊瓜鲁克峭壁的颤栗污泥怪以分解75块污物。
text.description: 我就坦白说吧，这可不是什么好活儿。$b$b邪刃蜥蜴人将他们产生的污物都堆在村子中央的一个坑里。那里的污物太过集中，恶臭熏天，以至于都浓缩成了一种能够移动的活物。$b$b那些蜥蜴人可以留着他们的垃圾坑，可当它扩散到村子外面的时候，那我们就该干涉了。
text.completion: Jobs like this make me glad that I left most of my nose in the tomb.
text.completed: Return to Amalia Penshire on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Just Some Light Clean-Up Work
english.objectives: Disperse 75 pieces of filth by killing Quivering Filth in Ihgaluk Crag.
english.description: This is not a glamorous job. Let me put it to you bluntly.$b$bThe Skumblade saurok pile all of their filth into a pool in the middle of their village. This filth is so concentrated and so rancid that it has congealed into moving, animate matter.$b$bThe saurok can keep their filth-pool, but once it starts spreading outside of the village, I'd say it's time to intervene.
english.completion: Jobs like this make me glad that I left most of my nose in the tomb.
english.completed: Return to Amalia Penshire on the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 枉费心机
text.objectives: 卸除部落舰船、占卜水晶和寻晨者海角桥梁处的战术魔法炸弹。
text.description: 嗯，看来普罗德摩尔女士决定用我们自己的武器对付我们了。我们的监视结界发现，已经有好几位间谍带着战术魔法炸弹偷偷闯过了我们的防线。$b$b要是这些炸弹全都变成哑炮，那就有好戏看了。$b$b去找出这些炸弹，然后将它们一一卸除。守卫们报告说，在北边的部落舰船附近、通往主岛的桥梁附近和位于海角东侧的占卜水晶附近各有一枚魔法炸弹。
text.completion: Good work. The real irony is had these been normal bombs we would have had a much harder time detecting them. Some gnomish devilry could have spelled the end of our operation here.
text.completed: Return to Magister Hathorel at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

english.title: Disarming Irony
english.objectives: Disarm the Tactical Mana Bombs at the Horde Ships, the Scrying Crystals, and the Bridge within Dawnseeker Promontory.
english.description: Well, it would seem the Lady Proudmoore has decided to use our own weaponry against us. Our perimeter wards reported several spies slipping through our defenses carrying tactical mana bombs.$b$bI would enjoy the irony if these bombs were less dangerous.$b$bSearch for these bombs and disarm them. Our wards reported one near the horde ships to the north, one on a bridge to the main isle, and one near our scrying crystals on the eastern side of the Promontory.
english.completion: Good work. The real irony is had these been normal bombs we would have had a much harder time detecting them. Some gnomish devilry could have spelled the end of our operation here.
english.completed: Return to Magister Hathorel at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

objectiveDetails.description: 拆除舰船上的战术魔法炸弹
拆除占卜水晶上的战术魔法炸弹
拆除桥上的战术魔法炸弹

text.title: 宿敌
text.objectives: 在雷神岛上击败10名夺日者密探或玩家。
text.description: 想想看，我们曾经是并肩作战的盟友！夺日者的背叛让我们措手不及。决不会再发生这种事！$b$b他们向我们展露了自己的本性。与加尔鲁什和他的疯狂为伍，他们全都难逃一死。$b$b消灭你所能找到的任何夺日者密探。我们决不会手下留情。
text.completion: You have put a good dent in the Sunreaver forces here. Like vermin, there will always be more. We must be at the ready at all times.
text.completed: Return to Vereesa Windrunner at the Violet Rise.

english.title: Old Enemies
english.objectives: Kill 10 Sunreaver agents or players on the Isle of Thunder.
english.description: To think, we were once on the same side! The Sunreavers' treachery caught us all off guard. Never again!$b$bThey have shown their true natures to us. Siding with Garrosh and his madness has marked them all for death.$b$bKill any agent of the Sunreavers that you find. We will show them no mercy here.
english.completion: You have put a good dent in the Sunreaver forces here. Like vermin, there will always be more. We must be at the ready at all times.
english.completed: Return to Vereesa Windrunner at the Violet Rise.

text.title: 解体
text.objectives: 在紫罗兰高地附近摧毁3个肯瑞托构造体。
text.description: 肯瑞托构造体充其量不过是原始未开化的玩意儿。可不管怎么说，还是有一定威胁的。$b$b前往紫罗兰高地，卸除吉安娜那不成气候的战争机器。让肯瑞托瞧瞧，他们是多么的不堪一击！$b$b这个信息一定会让肯瑞托阵脚大乱。
text.completion: So the constructs have fallen? Good!$B$BWe will remind Jaina and the Kirin Tor at every turn that the Sunreavers are not to be taken lightly.
text.completed: Return to Girana the Blooded at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

english.title: Desconstruction
english.objectives: Destroy 3 Kirin Tor Constructs around Violet Rise.
english.description: The Kirin Tor constructs are primitive at best. Nevertheless, they pose a threat.$b$bGo to Violet Rise and dismantle Jaina's pitiful war machines. Show the Kirin Tor how easily they can be defeated!$b$bThis will be a message the Kirin Tor cannot easily ignore.
english.completion: So the constructs have fallen? Good!$B$BWe will remind Jaina and the Kirin Tor at every turn that the Sunreavers are not to be taken lightly.
english.completed: Return to Girana the Blooded at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

text.title: 为战斗而生
text.objectives: 击败奥术毁灭者。
text.description: 吉安娜以为自己能轻易打赢这场战斗。我打算让她看看自己错得有多离谱！$b$b肯瑞托手里有一种武器，必须把它摧毁。奥术毁灭者是个体型庞大的构造体，其力量足以扭转战局。$b$b把这个怪物消灭，就能让普罗德摩尔看清形势。
text.completion: I wish I could be there to see the look on Proudmoore's face as she mourns the loss of her death machine!$B$BWe can be certain she will build another, but we have at least set her back.
text.completed: Return to High Arcanist Savor at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

english.title: Made for War
english.objectives: Kill the Arcane Destroyer.
english.description: Jaina thinks this battle will be easily won. I intend to show her how wrong she is!$b$bThe Kirin Tor brought a weapon with them that must be destroyed. The Arcane Destroyer is a large construct capable of turning the tides of war in their favor.$b$bDestroying this monstrosity would send a very clear message to Proudmoore.
english.completion: I wish I could be there to see the look on Proudmoore's face as she mourns the loss of her death machine!$B$BWe can be certain she will build another, but we have at least set her back.
english.completed: Return to High Arcanist Savor at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

text.title: 超强能量
text.objectives: 在紫罗兰高地附近摧毁7个法力焦镜。
text.description: 肯瑞托正在用法力焦镜来强化自己的军队。我们决不能让他们继续下去。$b$b你会发现这些焦镜散落在紫罗兰高地的外围各处。用这块法力水晶摧毁尽可能多的焦镜。$b$b每摧毁一个法力焦镜，都意味着我方又取得了一次小小的胜利。
text.completion: Excellent work, $C! It will take them days to rebuild those foci.
text.completed: Return to Magister Hathorel at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

english.title: Overpowered
english.objectives: Destroy 7 Mana Foci around Violet Rise.
english.description: The Kirin Tor are using mana foci to empower their forces. We cannot allow this to continue.$b$bYou'll find these foci scattered around the outskirts of Violet Rise. Use this mana crystal to destroy as many as you can.$b$bEach mana focus we destroy is another small victory for our cause.
english.completion: Excellent work, $C! It will take them days to rebuild those foci.
english.completed: Return to Magister Hathorel at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

text.title: 死物开口
text.objectives: 将抄本交给你的主城中的术士训练师。
text.description: 返回你的主城寻找术士训练师，对方或许知道更多有关这个抄本的情况。
text.completion: What... where in the great dark did you find this?

english.title: Reader for the Dead Tongue
english.objectives: Bring the codex to a Warlock trainer in your capital city.
english.description: Return to your capital city and seek out a warlock trainer who may know more about the codex.
english.completion: What... where in the great dark did you find this?

text.title: 大师传说
text.objectives: 阅读大师遗训第一章。
text.description: 这本书或许正是我们孜孜以求的东西……$B$B你对黑暗收割议会了解多少，$n？$B$B在死亡之翼被击败后，六位最伟大的术士聚集到了一起，向所有术士传授从落败的敌人处偷学到的进阶魔法。$B$B去看看我身后的书吧……
text.completion: You are ready to learn more...
text.completed: Return to your trainer.

english.title: A Tale of Six Masters
english.objectives: Read the first chapter of the Legacy of the Masters.
english.description: This book may be just the leverage we've been seeking... $B$BHow familiar are you with the Council of the Black Harvest, $n?$B$BAfter Deathwing was defeated, six of the greatest Warlocks gathered together to teach all Warlocks advanced forms of magic stolen from our defeated foes.$B$BTake a look at the tome beside me...
english.completion: You are ready to learn more...
english.completed: Return to your trainer.

text.objectives: 阅读大师遗训第一章。
text.description: 这本书或许正是我们孜孜以求的东西……$B$B你对黑暗收割议会了解多少，$n？$B$B在死亡之翼被击败后，六位最伟大的术士聚集到了一起，向所有术士传授从落败的敌人处偷学到的进阶魔法。$B$B去看看我身后的书吧……
text.completion: You are now ready to learn more...
text.completed: Return to your trainer.

english.completion: You are now ready to learn more...
english.completed: Return to your trainer.

text.title: Enlistment Orders
text.objectives: Find General Nazgrim at Domination Point in Krasarang Wilds
text.description: After the Council returned from their journey, they passed the knowledge of what they learned to all of the Warlock sects.$B$BHowever, they disappeared shortly afterwards...$B$B$n! The tome you possess may be just the thing we need to convince them to join us in our assault against the Alliance!$B$BFind General Nazgrim in Domination Point and convince him of the importance of your mission.

The tome you possess may be just the thing we need to convince them to join us in our assault against the Horde!$B$BFind Admiral Taylor in Lion's Landing and convince him of the importance of your mission.

text.title: Hunt Helheim
text.objectives: Obtain the second part of Legacy of the Masters from Hareem Helheim.
text.description: $n... You've heard correctly. Warchief Garrosh tasked me with tracking down this Council of the Black Harvest.$B$BUnfortunately, I have heard word that the Alliance is ahead of us. I heard that some Human Warlock by the name of Hareem Helheim has information which will help us locate them.$B$BHead to Lion's Landing, infiltrate their base and obtain the documents before Helheim's courier departs. Show Helheim no mercy.
text.completed: Return to General Nazgrim at Domination Point.

english.objectives: Obtain the second part of Legacy of the Masters from Hareem Helheim.
english.description: $n... You've heard correctly. Warchief Garrosh tasked me with tracking down this Council of the Black Harvest.$B$BUnfortunately, I have heard word that the Alliance is ahead of us. I heard that some Human Warlock by the name of Hareem Helheim has information which will help us locate them.$B$BHead to Lion's Landing, infiltrate their base and obtain the documents before Helheim's courier departs. Show Helheim no mercy.
english.completed: Return to General Nazgrim at Domination Point.

text.title: Slaughter Selenora
text.objectives: Obtain the second chapter of Legacy of the Masters from Shadowmancer Selenora in Domination Point.
text.description: $n... You've heard correctly. King Varian tasked me with tracking down this Council of the Black Harvest.$B$BUnfortunately, the Horde is seeking them out as well. One of my spies recently sent word that Shadowmancer Selenora has the second piece of their journal.$B$BHead to Domination Point, slaughter Selenora and bring back whatever you find on her rotting cadaver.
text.completed: Return to Admiral Taylor at Lion's Landing

english.objectives: Obtain the second chapter of Legacy of the Masters from Shadowmancer Selenora in Domination Point.

One of my spies recently sent word that Shadowmancer Selenora has the second piece of their journal.$B$BHead to Domination Point, slaughter Selenora and bring back whatever you find on her rotting cadaver.
english.completed: Return to Admiral Taylor at Lion's Landing

text.title: 安度因的求援
text.objectives: 去七星殿找安度因。你可以与雄狮港的范妮·盘角谈一谈，让她送你一程。
text.description: 啊，你正是我要找的$c。我收到一封来自年轻的安度因王子的急信。$B$B他正在锦绣谷的七星殿招待他父亲瓦里安国王，以及一些联盟高层。$B$B按照他最近传来的消息，城里发生了一些糟糕的事情。$B$B请立刻去找他谈谈。我必须留在雄狮港处理一些事务，但我很快就会来跟你汇合的。$B$B如果有需要，你可以让范妮送你一程。
text.completion: Well met, $C. We have much work to do here.
text.completed: Speak to Anduin Wrynn in The Imperial Exchange at the Shrine of Seven Stars in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

english.title: Anduin's Plea
english.objectives: Find Anduin at the Shrine of Seven Stars. Speak to Fennie Hornswaggle at Lion's Landing for transportation.
english.description: Ah, just the $c I was looking for. I have received an urgent letter from the young Prince Anduin.$B$BHe is playing host to his father, King Wrynn, and several other Alliance dignitaries at the Shrine of Seven Stars in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.$B$BAccording to his most recent correspondence, something bad is happening at the city.$B$BPlease go at once and speak with him. I must settle some affairs here at Lion's Landing, but I will join you soon.$B$BSpeak to Fennie if you'd like a ride to the Vale.
english.completion: Well met, $C. We have much work to do here.
english.completed: Speak to Anduin Wrynn in The Imperial Exchange at the Shrine of Seven Stars in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: 联盟之心
text.objectives: 对抗6名染煞步兵。要是你和安度因王子走散了，可以去帝皇商站找他。
text.description: 我简直不敢相信会发生这种事，$n。在潘达利亚经历了这么多事情之后，难道我们的人就永远不会从过去的错误中汲取一丁点的教训吗？$B$B布莱恩的探险队刚从魔古岬回来没多久，带回了一份煞魔样本准备用作研究。$B$B我从一开始就对他们的做法持保留意见，并且我最担心的事情现在成真了。$B$B煞魔逃脱了束缚，而我也不想再解释煞魔会给这片山谷带来什么样的恐惧了。$B$B我们必须清除我们能找到的任何煞魔，而且要快！
text.completion: I see that you and my son have been hard at work. Thank you for taking the initiative to aid our cause here in the Vale.
text.completed: Speak to King Varian Wrynn at the Shrine of Seven Stars in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

english.title: Heart Of The Alliance
english.objectives: Confront 6 Sha-Touched Footmen. Should you lose Prince Anduin, speak to him at The Imperial Exchange.
english.description: I can't believe this has happened, $n. After all we have been through here on Pandaria, will our people never learn from their past mistakes?$B$BBrann's expedition returned recently from Mogujia, bearing a sample of sha for study.$B$BI had my reservations about this endeavor in the first place, and my worst fears have been realized.$B$BThe sha has escaped containment. I do not need to explain the horror of bringing the sha into the heart of the Vale.$B$BWe must dispel any sha we can find, and quickly!
english.completion: I see that you and my son have been hard at work. Thank you for taking the initiative to aid our cause here in the Vale.
english.completed: Speak to King Varian Wrynn at the Shrine of Seven Stars in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: 寻找灵魂石
text.objectives: 阅读裘碧卡的日志并利用其中的线索找到四块灵魂石碎片的下落。
text.description: $n，拿上这个——裘碧卡·碎影的日志。$B$B我要你研读这本日志并利用其中的信息找出她去了哪里。$B$B然后再找回裘碧卡的灵魂石并用它来找到她的位置。
text.completed: Return to the Altar of Damnation in Shadowmoon Valley

english.title: Seeking the Soulstones
english.objectives: Read Jubeka's Journal and use the clues within to locate the four soulstone fragments.
english.description: $n, take this - the journal of Jubeka Shadowbreaker.$B$BRead the journal and use the information contained within to track down where she went.$B$BFind her soulstones and use them to locate her.
english.completed: Return to the Altar of Damnation in Shadowmoon Valley

text.title: 争分夺秒
text.objectives: 收集10根坚韧松针。
text.description: 要不是身为巨魔，沃金恐怕早已死透了。他的再生能力十分惊人，可这种能力被某种毒药抑制住了。$b$b我们得清除毒素，才能让他的伤口愈合。$b$b快飞去南边，在秘密鹰巢的高峰之后有一群松针林精。把他们身上最硬的松针带回来给我。$b$b有了它们，我就可以试着用针灸疗法来驱散他体内的毒素，并加快再生速度。
text.progress: My herbs are the only thing keeping Vol'jin from death. I dare not leave his side.
text.completion: Very good. These should work nicely.
text.completed: Speak with Chen Stormstout in Binan Village of Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: Regeneration Takes Time
english.objectives: Collect 10 Sturdy Needles.
english.description: Vol'jin would be dead if he were any race other than a troll. His regeneration is impressive, but it is being blocked by a poison.$b$bWe need to cleanse this poison so that he can regenerate the damage.$b$bTake to the skies and travel southeast. Across the mountain tops of the Secret Aerie you will find needle sprites. Bring me some of the hardest needles from them you can find.$b$bWith them I can attempt an acupuncture technique that should purge the poison from his body and accelerate his regeneration.
english.progress: My herbs are the only thing keeping Vol'jin from death. I dare not leave his side.
english.completion: Very good. These should work nicely.
english.completed: Speak with Chen Stormstout in Binan Village of Kun-Lai Summit.

text.title: 寻找萨尔！
text.objectives: 使用沃金的炉石找到萨尔。
text.description: <沃金半张着一只眼睛，嘴唇翕动，仿佛在说话。虽然听不到声音，可你还是辨认出了几个词。>$b$b去找萨尔。$b$b<沃金挣扎着将一块炉石塞进你手中，然后晕了过去。>
text.progress: You have come a long way to see me, $R. Speak.
text.completion: <Thrall stares at the stone you have handed him.>$B$BVol'jin's hearthstone? My friend, has it come to this?
text.completed: Speak with Thrall at the Valley of Trials in Durotar.

english.title: Find Thrall!
english.objectives: Find Thrall by using Vol'jin's Hearthstone.
english.description: <Vol'jin half opens an eye and begins to move his lips as if to speak.  Though no sound comes, you decipher two words.>$b$bFind Thrall.$b$b<With an effort, Vol'jin thrusts a hearthstone into your hands and then passes out.>
english.progress: You have come a long way to see me, $R. Speak.
english.completion: <Thrall stares at the stone you have handed him.>$B$BVol'jin's hearthstone? My friend, has it come to this?
english.completed: Speak with Thrall at the Valley of Trials in Durotar.

text.title: 部落即家庭
text.objectives: 护送萨尔前往回音群岛。
text.description: 这块炉石是我和沃金在很久以前一次谈话中的一部分。$b$b他认为他的人民正处于危险之中。虽然我不知道在我离开的这段时间究竟出了什么事情，但至少这件事我是能为朋友做的。$b$b来吧，$p，跟我去回音群岛。我们必须确保暗矛部族的安全。
text.completion: Vol'jin has saved my life many times in the past. To see my own Kor'kron used against his people cuts deeper than I can put into words.
text.completed: Speak with Thrall in the Echo Isles of Durotar.

english.title: The Horde Is Family
english.objectives: Escort Thrall to the Echo Isles.
english.description: This hearthstone was part of a conversation Vol'jin and I shared a long time ago.$b$bHe believes his people are in danger. I don't know what all has transpired in my absence, but I can at least do this for my friend.$b$bCome, $p, travel with me to the Echo Isles. We must make sure that the Darkspear are safe.
english.completion: Vol'jin has saved my life many times in the past. To see my own Kor'kron used against his people cuts deeper than I can put into words.
english.completed: Speak with Thrall in the Echo Isles of Durotar.

text.title: 美猴王
text.objectives: 在皇帝谷帮助安度因·乌瑞恩找到美猴王。
text.description: 自从部落得到圣钟起，我就一直在寻找克制这件神器的办法。$b$b我的研究全部指向了这座墓穴。我准备进去。如果你跟我一起去，我会在路上向你介绍具体情况。$b$b如果我们走散了，就回到墓穴入口这里来找我。你准备好了就告诉我一声吧。
text.completion: You come asking for the Monkey King?$B$BLet us see how well you ookin' sing.$B$BWho are you, so tiny and boring?$B$BYour cause is silly! You leave me snoring.$B$BThree riddles I will ask,$B$BThese riddles are a task,$B$BFinish each without pause,$B$BAnd we shall see if I help your cause.
text.completed: Speak with the Monkey King at the Tomb of Conquerers in Kun-Lai Summit.
text.giverWindow: 有时候，打败一个传奇的唯一办法，就是和另一个传奇联手。

english.title: The Monkey King
english.objectives: Help Anduin Wrynn find the Monkey King in the Valley of Emperors.
english.description: Ever since the Horde captured the Divine Bell I have been searching for a means to counter its power.$b$bMy research got as far as this tomb. I am going inside. If you follow me, I will share the rest as we go.$b$bIf we get separated, meet me back here at the entrance to the tomb. Speak to me when you are ready to proceed.
english.completion: You come asking for the Monkey King?$B$BLet us see how well you ookin' sing.$B$BWho are you, so tiny and boring?$B$BYour cause is silly! You leave me snoring.$B$BThree riddles I will ask,$B$BThese riddles are a task,$B$BFinish each without pause,$B$BAnd we shall see if I help your cause.
english.completed: Speak with the Monkey King at the Tomb of Conquerers in Kun-Lai Summit.
english.giverWindow: Sometimes the only way to beat a legend is with another legend.

text.title: 寻找信息
text.objectives: 跟随灵魂石的指引前往黑暗神殿。
text.description: 你手中的灵魂石碎片轻易地融合到了一起。$B$B奇怪的是，里面并没有储存灵魂。相反，它似乎还在不断地从影月谷的某处抽取能量。向东望去，你感觉到那股能量来自群山的另一边，一直到黑暗神殿的大门前。
text.completed: Take the Soulstone to the gates of Black Temple.

english.title: Seek the Signal
english.objectives: Follow the soulstone to the gates of the Black Temple.
english.description: The soulstone shards fuse together easily in your hands.$B$BStrangely, no soul is stored within the stone. Instead, the stone seems to be drawing power from somewhere in Shadowmoon Valley. Looking east, you feel the power linked beyond the mountains, to the very gates of the Black Temple.
english.completed: Take the Soulstone to the gates of Black Temple.

text.title: 潜入黑暗神殿
text.objectives: 在黑暗神殿的主入口处寻找裘碧卡的印记。进去之后，在神殿之巅与裘碧卡交谈。
text.description: 显然裘碧卡的灵魂石把你带到了黑暗神殿。$B$B可问题是……为什么？$B$B现在你唯一能做的，就是进去找出原因。
text.completion: You have done more for this world than you can know, $C. It is... something of a shame Kanrethad met this end. A shame, but inevitable.

english.title: Infiltrating the Black Temple
english.objectives: Look for Jubeka's mark on the main entrance of the Black Temple.  Once inside, speak to Jubeka at the Temple Summit.
english.description: It's clear that Jubeka's soulstone has lead you here to the Black Temple. $B$BThe question remains... why?$B$BThe only remaining option is to head inside and figure out why they were here.
english.completion: You have done more for this world than you can know, $C. It is... something of a shame Kanrethad met this end. A shame, but inevitable.

text.title: 潜伏
text.objectives: 使用统御岗哨的夺日者传送门潜入达纳苏斯。
text.description: $n！你就是最合适的人选。$b$b我们已经知道联盟把圣钟藏在哪儿了。我们已经在敌方的势力范围内安插了一名密探，只需要你去帮助他执行任务即可。$b$b赶快收拾行装吧，$n。你得去一趟达纳苏斯。
text.completion: $N! So glad Nazgrim selected you.$B$BIt's taken a great deal of the Horde's effort to get you here through Jaina's traps. Maintaining our illusion this close to Darnassus is considerably expensive.$B$BFurthermore, the Sunreavers of Dalaran are risking their neutrality by assisting the Horde with this operation.$B$BIn other words, we expect only the best from you.
text.completed: Report to Fanlyr Silverthorn near the gates of Darnassus.

english.title: Insertion
english.objectives: Use the Sunreaver Portal in Domination Point to secure a teleport to Darnassus.
english.description: $n! You'll do perfectly.$b$bWe know where the Alliance have hidden the Divine Bell. We've already inserted an agent into enemy territory, we just need you to help him execute his mission.$b$bPack up, $n. You're headed to Darnassus.
english.completion: $N! So glad Nazgrim selected you.$B$BIt's taken a great deal of the Horde's effort to get you here through Jaina's traps. Maintaining our illusion this close to Darnassus is considerably expensive.$B$BFurthermore, the Sunreavers of Dalaran are risking their neutrality by assisting the Horde with this operation.$B$BIn other words, we expect only the best from you.
english.completed: Report to Fanlyr Silverthorn near the gates of Darnassus.

objectiveDetails.description: 使用传送门前往达纳苏斯

text.title: 达纳苏斯行动
text.objectives: 拿到圣钟。$b$b如果陷入困境，你可以使用银月护符返回法利尔身边。
text.description: 圣钟就在城里。我们只想要那个神器，并不打算引发骚乱。我要你设法潜入城中，而且绝不能被抓住。也就是说，你不能用坐骑，也不能飞行，更不能一路杀进去。$b$b我可以协助你，用魔法遮蔽你的身形，让你进入潜行状态。我还会给你一个小护符。万一你陷入麻烦，可以用它脱身。$b$b现在就动身吧，$n，把圣钟一起带回来。
text.completion: Well executed, $R! I knew we could count on you.$B$BNow to get off this wretched tree.
text.completed: Return to Fanlyr Silverthorn near the gates of Darnassus.

english.title: The Darnassus Mission
english.objectives: Locate the Divine Bell.$b$bYou may use the Silvermoon Charm to return to Fanlyr if you get in trouble.
english.description: The Divine Bell is in the city. We don't want to cause a scene, we just want the artifact. I need you to find a way in, WITHOUT getting caught. That means no mounts, no flying, no fighting.$b$bI can provide aid. I will magically cloak you, so you may move with stealth. I will also give you a small charm that you may use to return to safety, should you get in trouble.$b$bNow go, $n. Go, locate the bell, and tag it to be teleported back with you.
english.completion: Well executed, $R! I knew we could count on you.$B$BNow to get off this wretched tree.
english.completed: Return to Fanlyr Silverthorn near the gates of Darnassus.

text.title: 凯旋而归
text.objectives: 前往卡桑琅丛林的统御岗哨，向纳兹戈林报告你的成功。
text.description: 我身边的传送门可以把你安全地送回统御岗哨。你先走，我稍后就来。在离开前，我得先把我们留下的痕迹抹去，以免普罗德摩尔发现我们插手此事。
text.completion: You found the bell! And Fanlyr teleported it to Silvermoon for study, as instructed? The Horde will put this to good use.$B$BYou have done the Horde a great service today. Lok'tar, friend!

english.title: Victorious Return
english.objectives: Report your success to Nazgrim at Domination Point in Krasarang Wilds.
english.description: The portal by my side will return you safely to Domination Point. I will return behind you; I must clean up our tracks a bit before we leave, so that Proudmoore doesn't discover our involvement.
english.completion: You found the bell! And Fanlyr teleported it to Silvermoon for study, as instructed? The Horde will put this to good use.$B$BYou have done the Horde a great service today. Lok'tar, friend!

text.title: 我要成果！
text.objectives: 去银月城与洛瑟玛·塞隆谈一谈。
text.description: 啊，$p。酋长让我派你去银月城。$b$b他对洛瑟玛的研究进度很不满意，并认为你……对魔古族……的特殊认识或许会对他们有帮助。$b$b所以请你去一趟银月城，命令洛瑟玛加快研究速度。
text.completion: The Warchief "demands" progress? His impatience is growing more destructive with each command.$B$BAs it stands, we could use your expertise.
text.completed: 去银月城与洛瑟玛·塞隆谈一谈。

english.title: Get My Results!
english.objectives: Speak with Lor'themar Theron in Silvermoon City.
english.description: Ah, $p. The Warchief has instructed me to dispatch you to Silvermoon.$b$bHe grows impatient with the progress of Lor'themar's research and feels they might benefit from your... unique... experiences with the mogu.$b$bGo to Silvermoon and demand that Lor'themar increase the speed of his research.
english.completion: The Warchief "demands" progress? His impatience is growing more destructive with each command.$B$BAs it stands, we could use your expertise.
english.completed: Speak with Lor'themar Theron in Silvermoon City.

text.title: 里面有什么？
text.objectives: 帮助艾萨斯和罗曼斯做实验。
text.description: 我们正在尝试揭开加尔鲁什让我们研究的一个魔古神器的奥秘。但这非常困难，因为所有使用魔法探查它的人，都会受到一股强烈的负面情绪的影响。$b$b我已经请求夺日者的大法师艾萨斯来帮忙，希望他和罗曼斯能够解开这个谜团。他们特别指名要你前去帮忙——你似乎有过类似的经验？$b$b就请你到东边远行者广场下的大厅里去看看能不能帮上忙吧。
text.completion: This reckless use of my people by Garrosh is becoming intolerable. If you had not been here to assist I dread to think what might have happened.
text.completed: Speak with Lor'themar Theron in Silvermoon City.

english.title: What's in the Box?
english.objectives: Assist with Aethas and Rommath's experiment.
english.description: We are trying to uncover the secrets of one of the mogu artifacts Garrosh insisted we investigate. It is proving most difficult, as anyone who probes it magically is greatly affected by raw, negative emotions.$b$bI called in the assistance of Arch-mage Aethas of the Sunreavers in the hopes that he and Rommath could crack this puzzle. They asked for you specifically - apparently you have some relevant experience?$b$bGo to the chamber below Farstrider Square east of here and see if you can assist them.
english.completion: This reckless use of my people by Garrosh is becoming intolerable. If you had not been here to assist I dread to think what might have happened.
english.completed: Speak with Lor'themar Theron in Silvermoon City.

objectiveDetails.description: 与大法师艾萨斯·夺日者交谈

text.title: 肯瑞托
text.objectives: 使用雄狮港通往紫色天台的传送门，与安度因王子见面。
text.description: $p，瓦里安国王让我派你跟随他的儿子一起前往达拉然。他相信你能帮忙说服对方驱逐那里的血精灵。$b$b这些“夺日者”忠于部落，对我们的战局是个重大威胁。$b$b肯瑞托现在的领袖吉安娜·普罗德摩尔是我们自己人，要说服她赶走城市中的部落势力应该不难。$b$b你可以使用雄狮港的传送门前往紫色天台，并助安度因王子一臂之力。
text.completion: I am glad to see you friend. While I have learned much about diplomacy I think Jaina is too familiar with my tactics.$B$BI could use a friendly hand in resolving this conflict.
text.completed: Speak with Anduin Wrynn at the Purple Parlor in Dalaran.

english.title: The Kirin Tor
english.objectives: Use the Portal to the Purple Parlor in Lion's Landing and meet with Anduin Wrynn.
english.description: $p, King Varian has asked that I send you after his son to Dalaran. He believes you can help negotiate the withdrawal of blood elves there.$b$bThese "Sunreavers" claim fealty to the Horde and represent a major threat to the war effort.$b$bNow that our very own Jaina Proudmoore is in charge of the Kirin Tor it should be easy to convince her to remove this Horde threat to her city.$b$bUse the portal here in Lion's Landing to go to the Purple Parlor and lend what aid you can to Prince Anduin.
english.completion: I am glad to see you friend. While I have learned much about diplomacy I think Jaina is too familiar with my tactics.$B$BI could use a friendly hand in resolving this conflict.
english.completed: Speak with Anduin Wrynn at the Purple Parlor in Dalaran.

objectiveDetails.description: 使用传送门前往紫色天台

text.title: 谜题一：仁慈
text.objectives: 找到美猴王的谜题所描述的东西。
text.description: 如此说来，你是为了一柄钟杵而吵醒了美猴王的，嗯？那就先解答我的三个谜题，然后你才能见到钟杵。$b$b第一个！$b$b“身如磐石，灵性天成。$b$b长于纷争之境，$b$b远在长城之南。$b$b茕茕蛰伏，静待相召。”$b$b把谜底带来给我。
text.progress: Ah, the wise-ish thing returns. Have you my amber?
text.completion: Ah! Amber! Fresh and untamed. Did you kill to get it? But of course.$B$BThough free, the untamed amber is a dangerous thing, and many might die because of it.$B$BMercy comes in many forms, like spikes and mantid and really ookin' spooky storms.
text.completed: Speak with the Monkey King at Lion's Landing in the Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: The First Riddle: Mercy
english.objectives: Find the object the Monkey King described in his riddle.
english.description: So, you wake up the Monkey King for a mallet hmmm? Answer first, these riddles three, and then the mallet you shall see.$b$bFirst riddle!$b$b  "Softly singing a song of pain$b$b    There is a creature tortured and lame.$b$b    Way down south and beyond the wall,$b$b    It hides from its wikket masters' call.$b$b    Seek out the creature sad and somber,$b$b    And free it from its untamed amber."$b$bBring me the untamed amber.
english.progress: Ah, the wise-ish thing returns. Have you my amber?
english.completion: Ah! Amber! Fresh and untamed. Did you kill to get it? But of course.$B$BThough free, the untamed amber is a dangerous thing, and many might die because of it.$B$BMercy comes in many forms, like spikes and mantid and really ookin' spooky storms.
english.completed: Speak with the Monkey King at Lion's Landing in the Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 谜题二：友谊
text.objectives: 获得金铁酒。
text.description: 你们想克制那口钟？那我们得先有那柄钟杵。$b$b你们想要钟杵？那我们得先交个朋友。$b$b你们想和我交朋友？那我们先得有一罐金铁酒。$b$b你们想要金铁酒？那你们得先去结义坛。$b$b你们想去结义坛？很好！那地方就在天禅院东南面的翡翠林里。$b$b到了那儿敲钟，然后给美猴王带些酒来。噢……你可能会有架要打。
text.progress: You have the Metal Brew?
text.completion: The Metal Brew is strong and lasting, a brew to be shared with friends after a battle.$B$BEmperor Shaohao and his Monkey King had many a round in our day. Many battles, and many good friends.
text.completed: Speak with The Monkey King at Lion's Landing in the Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: The Second Riddle: Fellowship
english.objectives: Obtain Metal Brew.
english.description: You want to stop the Divine Bell? We need the mallet first.$b$bYou want the mallet? We need to be friends first.$b$bYou want to be friends? We need a Metal brew first. $b$bYou want a Metal brew? You need to go to the Shrine of Fellowship first. $b$bYou want to go to the Shrine of Fellowship? Great! It's in the Jade Forest southeast of the Tian Monastery.$b$bRing the bell and get the Monkey King some brew while there. Oh... you may have to fight for it.
english.progress: You have the Metal Brew?
english.completion: The Metal Brew is strong and lasting, a brew to be shared with friends after a battle.$B$BEmperor Shaohao and his Monkey King had many a round in our day. Many battles, and many good friends.
english.completed: Speak with The Monkey King at Lion's Landing in the Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 谜题三：力量
text.objectives: 击败白虎寺的挑战者。
text.description: 你要找的钟杵可不是孩子的玩具。$b$b它就像女妖的歌声一样会招来麻烦。$b$b美猴王要考验你的力量。$b$b然后你才能得到要找的东西。$b$b你要去白虎寺。$b$b让挑战者看看你有多能打。$b$b穿过大门后走右边的斜坡。$b$b像个勇士那样，去挑战等着你的家伙吧！
text.completion: Why engage in duelery? Why engage in foolery?$B$BYou ask the Monkey King for an artifact of power, I have to make sure when the time comes you will not cower. One tough dooker you think you might ookin be, but against mogu, many will turn and flee.
text.completed: Speak with the Monkey King at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: The Third Riddle: Strength
english.objectives: Defeat the Challenger at the Tiger Temple.
english.description: The mallet you seek is not a toy for children,$b$bIt calls trouble like the song of a siren.$b$bA test of strength the Monkey King will require,$b$bBefore you receive this tool of your desire.$b$bAt the Temple of the White Tiger you will find$b$bA challenger to test how well you are resigned$b$bStep through the main door and then turn right down the ramp$b$bChallenge the ook waiting for you there like a champ!
english.completion: Why engage in duelery? Why engage in foolery?$B$BYou ask the Monkey King for an artifact of power, I have to make sure when the time comes you will not cower. One tough dooker you think you might ookin be, but against mogu, many will turn and flee.
english.completed: Speak with the Monkey King at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 最大的恶作剧
text.objectives: 倾听美猴王的故事。
text.description: 你答出了我的三个谜题。很好很好。美猴王还没老到将自己的把戏到处说的地步。$b$b这可是史上最大的恶作剧！$b$b你想要听钟杵和美猴王的故事？太糟了！没的选择了！
text.completion: It looks like it is going to take us a few days to track all of these "minions" down.$B$BThank you for your help, $n. Meet me in Lion's Landing in a few days and we will embark to track down these objects.
text.completed: Speak with Anduin Wrynn at Lion's Landing in the Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: The Greatest Prank
english.objectives: Listen to the Monkey King's story.
english.description: So riddles three you answered me. Good good. The Monkey King is not so old that he tells just anyone his tricks.$b$bIt was the greatest prank ever!$b$bYou want to hear story of the Mallet and the Monkey? Too bad! No choice!
english.completion: It looks like it is going to take us a few days to track all of these "minions" down.$B$BThank you for your help, $n. Meet me in Lion's Landing in a few days and we will embark to track down these objects.
english.completed: Speak with Anduin Wrynn at Lion's Landing in the Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 杵柄
text.objectives: 夺回杵柄。
text.description: 很久以前，有一个名叫盎迦盎迦的酋长。$b$b他在拼酒时赢了我。$b$b他就拿走了钟杵的柄作为胜利的奖品。$b$b但你是肯定喝不过美猴王的啦。$b$b美猴王必须藏好钟杵，远离圣钟。$b$b可盎迦的子孙没有好好使用杵柄。$b$b这么多年来，他们一直在用杵柄干坏事。$b$b现在，我们必须找到现任酋长并收缴他手中的杵柄。$b$b到南方的盎迦猴岛去，美猴王在那里等你。$b$b别忘了，只有蠢蛋才会空着手去参加派对哦。
text.progress: Ingoo was a great hozen. Good leader, nice parties, and good booze.
text.completion: Artifacts not make people great. Artifacts allow people to be more of themselves. Good becomes gooder. Bad becomes badder. And Chief Ingoo Ingoo became worser.
text.completed: Speak with the Monkey King at Lion's Landing in the Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: The Handle
english.objectives: Recover the Mallet Handle.
english.description: There once was a Chief named Ingoo Ingoo,$b$bWho beat me in a drink drink boogaloo.$b$bHe took the mallet's handle for winning,$b$bNot knowing you can't beat the King in drinking.$b$bMonkey King had to hide the mallet from the bell,$b$bBut Ingoo's children do not use the handle well.$b$bOver the years they have used the handle to do harm,$b$bNow we must find the current chief so we can disarm.$b$bGo south to Unga Ingoo, Monkey King meet you there.$b$bOnly wikkets show to a party with hands bare.
english.progress: Ingoo was a great hozen. Good leader, nice parties, and good booze.
english.completion: Artifacts not make people great. Artifacts allow people to be more of themselves. Good becomes gooder. Bad becomes badder. And Chief Ingoo Ingoo became worser.
english.completed: Speak with the Monkey King at Lion's Landing in the Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 杵头
text.objectives: 夺回杵头。
text.description: 美猴王知道该去哪里找杵头了。$b$b得到它的猢狲早就死了。$b$b这件圣物原本在昆森猢狲的酋长间世代相传。$b$b可是兔妖斯基奇特跑来抢走了它。$b$b现在，那个蠢蛋在一座山洞里膜拜它。$b$b就因为这个东西太大了，他吞不下去。$b$b我派了一个皇家搜寻者去北面找他。$b$b你可以去汇风岭西边的山里找他。
text.progress: You got head?
text.completion: What virmen do not understand, they worship, fight or flee.$B$BI should send them a few statues of me.
text.completed: Speak with the Monkey King in Lion's Landing of the Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: The Head
english.objectives: Recover the Mallet Head.
english.description: Monkey King receive word on where to find the head,$b$bThe hozen who got it has long since been dead. $b$bKunzen chiefs pass the relic from father to son, $b$bBut then virmen Skiggit came and the head it won. $b$bNow the wikket worships it in a hollow. $b$bSince it was too ookin' big for him to swallow. $b$bI sent a royal finder north to find him and stand. $b$bLook for finder in mountains west of the Heartland.
english.progress: You got head?
english.completion: What virmen do not understand, they worship, fight or flee.$B$BI should send them a few statues of me.
english.completed: Speak with the Monkey King in Lion's Landing of the Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 祥和药膏
text.objectives: 夺回祥和药膏。
text.description: 传奇不是天生的，它们是创造出来的。$b$B就像你的下一个目标一样。那是一个名叫“刀锋”的魔古。$b$B你可以在他的袋子里找到一种药膏。$b$b这种药膏可以发出惑人心神的声音。$b$b把这种神奇的药膏带回来给美猴王！$b$b有了它，美猴王就可以让钟杵唱歌啦！$b$b沿着长城到北方去，在走到底的地方左转就到了。
text.progress: How the mogu found the ointment is a wonder.$B$BBut a lot has happened since the world tore assunder.
text.completion: Woot woot!
text.completed: Speak with the Monkey King at Lion's Landing in the Krasarang Wilds.
text.giverWindow: 这名魔古刺客使用一种黑色的药膏，通过谐和的声率来杀戮他的敌人。

english.title: The Harmonic Ointment
english.objectives: Recover the Harmonic Ointment.
english.description: Legends are not born, they are made.$b$BMuch like your next target, a mogu named "The Blade." $b$BIn his bags you will find,$b$bAn ointment whose sound plays with the mind.$b$bBring this nibby ointment to the Monkey King!$b$bAnd with it, he shall make the mallet sing!$b$bTravel north along the wall, and when you reach the end, turn left.
english.progress: How the mogu found the ointment is a wonder.$B$BBut a lot has happened since the world tore assunder.
english.completion: Woot woot!
english.completed: Speak with the Monkey King at Lion's Landing in the Krasarang Wilds.
english.giverWindow: This mogu assassin uses an ointment of dark, harmonic power to slay his opponents.

text.title: Rebuilding the Mallet (Tracker)
text.objectives: Obtain the Harmonic Mallet.
text.description: Time for the fixing and then time for the mixing!
text.completed: Speak with Anduin Wrynn at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: Rebuilding the Mallet (Tracker)
english.objectives: Obtain the Harmonic Mallet.
english.description: Time for the fixing and then time for the mixing!
english.completed: Speak with Anduin Wrynn at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 劫掠黑暗神殿
text.objectives: 在到达欢愉之园的尽头之前尽量多拾取一些遗物。
text.description: 当阿卡玛和他的人忙着对付恶魔时，就没人能阻止你窃取一两件遗物了……
text.completion: You've looted everything you could grab on your way up. Time to tally up your plunder and hide it before Akama catches up...

english.title: Plunder the Black Temple
english.objectives: Loot everything you can grab and reach the end of the Den of Mortal Delights.
english.description: While Akama and his men are dealing with the demons, there is nobody to stop you from stealing a relic or two...
english.completion: You've looted everything you could grab on your way up. Time to tally up your plunder and hide it before Akama catches up...

text.title: Demonstrate Your Power
text.objectives: Slay the demons who are attacking Akama's men in the Halls of Anguish.
text.description: Akama and his men are under siege by the forces you unleashed in the Reliquary of Souls. $B$BDemonstrate your power to Akama by saving his men from the demonic forces!
text.end: Defeat the Demons before Akama's men are slain
text.completed: Return to Akama inside the Sanctuary of Shadows.

english.title: Demonstrate Your Power
english.objectives: Slay the demons who are attacking Akama's men in the Halls of Anguish.
english.description: Akama and his men are under siege by the forces you unleashed in the Reliquary of Souls. $B$BDemonstrate your power to Akama by saving his men from the demonic forces!
english.end: Defeat the Demons before Akama's men are slain
english.completed: Return to Akama inside the Sanctuary of Shadows.

objectiveDetails.description: Slay the Demons in the Halls of Anguish

text.title: 灵魂陷阱
text.objectives: 收集3个灵魂陷阱。
text.description:
我们在废墟里找到了一些强大的魔古神器。它们能够禁锢灵魂，可能是用来进行某些仪式或施展某些法术用的。

我们对这种装置还不了解，亟待研究——它们或许能揭开更多魔古缚魂术的奥秘。

快去帮我带些样品回来，这样我们的研究才能继续下去。
text.progress: Have you brought the traps?
text.completion: Ahh, yes. Hmm. Hand that over. Carefully.
text.completed: Return to Kaelis Sunsoar at the Ruins of Ogudei in Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: The Spirit Trap
english.objectives: Collect 3 Spirit Traps.
english.description:
Within the ruins we have identified several powerful mogu artifacts. They trapped spirits within, probably to use them in some ritual or conjuration.

They are a type of device that we haven't identified and desperately need to study - they may reveal more of the secrets of the mogu's spirit binding techniques. 

Go, find us a few samples so that we may continue a proper study.
english.progress: Have you brought the traps?
english.completion: Ahh, yes. Hmm. Hand that over. Carefully.
english.completed: Return to Kaelis Sunsoar at the Ruins of Ogudei in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 敖骨打的副官
text.objectives: 去敖骨打废墟收集孟都的精华和庚离的精华。
text.description:
那些笨手笨脚的联盟挖出了两个非常强大的魔古幽灵。

这简直是送上门的靶子，$c。如果你能干掉他们，并收集他们的精华，那将对我们揭开这个诡异废墟的历史起到极大的推动作用。
text.progress: The essence isn't going to make itself, $R.
text.completion: What treasures! With any luck, the spirits will return and we will be able to sample their essence further.
text.completed: Return to Kaelis Sunsoar at the Ruins of Ogudei in Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: Ogudei's Lieutenants
english.objectives: Collect Meng-do's Essence and Gen-li's Essence in the Ruins of Ogudei.
english.description:
There are two extremely powerful mogu spirits that the Alliance unearthed in their ineptitude.

These are choice targets for us, $c. If you kill them and collect each of their essences, we could make great progress on decoding the history of this strange ruin.
english.progress: The essence isn't going to make itself, $R.
english.completion: What treasures! With any luck, the spirits will return and we will be able to sample their essence further.
english.completed: Return to Kaelis Sunsoar at the Ruins of Ogudei in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 这是个谜
text.objectives: 使用奥术球体在敖骨打废墟中找出一个异形体。
text.description:
我们在这些矿场里侦测到了……若干异形体，似乎是某种奥术或灵魂体。它们一直在干扰我们，让我们无法查明这里缚灵仪式所使用的魔法类型。

虽然它们行踪诡异，但我们还是成功分离出了这些异形体的奥术信号，然后我们的一位法师把它的奥术信号附在了这颗球上。

带上这颗球。你离异形体越近，它发出的光就会越明亮。一旦你到达目的地，你可以使用这颗球把异形体吸引出来。
text.completion: Ahh, yes. I received word from one of our researchers that they are no longer troubled by that anomaly. Well done.
text.completed: Return to Kaelis Sunsoar at the Ruins of Ogudei in Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: It Is A Mystery
english.objectives: Use the Arcane Bauble to find an anomaly within the Ruins of Ogudei.
english.description:
We have detected several... anomalies in these mines, of an arcane or spiritual nature. They are disrupting our attempts to discern the nature of the magic used in the spirit binding rituals here.

They are quite elusive, but we've managed to isolate the arcane signature of one of these anomalies, and one of our mages has enchanted this bauble with its signature.

Take the bauble. It will begin to glow more brightly as you approach the anomaly. Once you reach it, you can use the bauble to draw it out.
english.completion: Ahh, yes. I received word from one of our researchers that they are no longer troubled by that anomaly. Well done.
english.completed: Return to Kaelis Sunsoar at the Ruins of Ogudei in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 我们不是怪物！
text.objectives: 解放14个不安的灵奴。
text.description:
神圣遗物学会过去的名声可能不太好，但我们不是怪物。我们和探险者协会只是对考古的看法不同而已。

我们有时也会见义勇为的。所以，请你去释放废墟里那些熊猫人奴隶的灵魂吧。
text.completion: Ah, good work. As much as it may seem trivial in comparison to our larger research goals, it is important that we maintain appearances, $n.
text.completed: Return to Kaelis Sunsoar at the Ruins of Ogudei in Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: We're Not Monsters!
english.objectives: Liberate 14 Troubled Slave Spirits.
english.description:
The Reliquary may have had a bad name in the past, but we're not monsters. We simply hold different views about archaeology than the Explorer's League.

We do focus on performing acts of heroism from time to time. So go, liberate some of the pandaren slave spirits in the ruins.
english.completion: Ah, good work. As much as it may seem trivial in comparison to our larger research goals, it is important that we maintain appearances, $n.
english.completed: Return to Kaelis Sunsoar at the Ruins of Ogudei in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 灾祸猛于鬼！
text.objectives: 击败12个缚魂魔古。
text.description:
你瞧，我们遇到了一件恶心事儿，要是不能把事态控制住的话，雄狮港的老托德曼非把我们踢出去不可。

帮个忙吧，拜托了！
text.completion: Alright! We'll be back up and runnin' in no time!
text.completed: Return to Hilda Hornswaggle at the Ruins of Ogudei in Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: Oi Ain't Afraid o' No Ghosts!
english.objectives: Kill 12 Spiritbound Mogu.
english.description:
Look. We got a nasty problem here, and ol' Troteman back at Lion's Landing's gonna throw us out of here if we don't get things under control.

Give us a hand, please!
english.completion: Alright! We'll be back up and runnin' in no time!
english.completed: Return to Hilda Hornswaggle at the Ruins of Ogudei in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 驱逐令
text.objectives: 在敖骨打废墟击败10名神圣遗物学会成员。
text.description:
该死的神圣遗物学会也混进废墟里来了。他们占据了地势较低的地区，并在那里搞起了他们那套装神弄鬼的把戏。

我要你去狠狠踢爆他们的屁股，把他们都赶走！
text.completion: Ha! That should send 'em runnin' back to Silvermoon with their tail 'tween their legs!
text.completed: Return to Hilda Hornswaggle at the Ruins of Ogudei in Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: Eviction Notice
english.objectives: Kill any 10 members of the Reliquary in the Ruins of Ogudei.
english.description:
The bloody Reliquary's snuck into the ruins. They've taken the lower section and are conducting all kinds of magical shenanigans down there.

It's time we gave 'em an eviction notice, in the form of your boot in their rear!
english.completion: Ha! That should send 'em runnin' back to Silvermoon with their tail 'tween their legs!
english.completed: Return to Hilda Hornswaggle at the Ruins of Ogudei in Krasarang Wilds.

objectiveDetails.description: 击败神圣遗物学会成员

text.title: 踢飞他们
text.objectives: 击败12个雄狮港的军事单位。
text.description:
联盟的作战基地离废墟很近，他们肯定以为自己已经稳操胜券了。

我们一定要打消他们的这种念头。去干掉几个联盟守卫吧。
text.completion: Oh, what a fine day. Alliance fools defeated, and our research is moving ahead quite nicely.
text.completed: Return to Kaelis Sunsoar at the Ruins of Ogudei in Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: Kick 'em While They're Down
english.objectives: Kill 12 Lion's Landing military units.
english.description:
The Alliance may think they have a stranglehold on the ruins, given that their base of operations is close.

We're going to disabuse them of that notion. Go take out some of their guards.
english.completion: Oh, what a fine day. Alliance fools defeated, and our research is moving ahead quite nicely.
english.completed: Return to Kaelis Sunsoar at the Ruins of Ogudei in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 雷霆的回响
text.objectives: 去双月殿找大酋长贝恩·血蹄。可以与统御岗哨的泰克泰克谈一谈，让他送你一程。
text.description: 啊，$n，我们又见面了。我听说了一些好消息。$B$B牛头人的大酋长贝恩·血蹄已经抵达了潘达利亚。$B$B他现在正在锦绣谷的双月殿会见加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮酋长和洛瑟玛·塞隆摄政王。$B$B他向我提出了一个古怪的要求——要我派一名部落的忠实勇士给他，不仅要能战斗……还要有足够的判断能力。$B$B我想不出比你更合适的人选了。如果你有需要，可以让泰克泰克送你一程。
text.completion: Well met, $C. You were sent from Domination Point? Very well. We have much to discuss.
text.completed: Speak to High Chieftain Baine Bloodhoof in The Imperial Mercantile at the Shrine of Two Moons in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

english.title: Echoes of Thunder
english.objectives: Find High Chieftain Baine Bloodhoof at the Shrine of Two Moons. Speak to Tak-Tak at Domination Point for transportation.
english.description: Ah, $n, we meet again. I have heard some wondrous news.$B$BHigh Chieftain Baine Bloodhoof of the tauren has arrived here on Pandaria.$B$BHe meets with Warchief Garrosh Hellscream and Regent Lord Lor'themar Theron now, at the Shrine of Two Moons in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.$B$BHe sent me a strange request - to send him a loyal champion of the Horde, capable of combat... and discretion.$B$BI can think of none better to send than you. Speak to Tak-Tak if you seek transport.
english.completion: Well met, $C. You were sent from Domination Point? Very well. We have much to discuss.
english.completed: Speak to High Chieftain Baine Bloodhoof in The Imperial Mercantile at the Shrine of Two Moons in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: 山雨欲来
text.objectives: 对抗6名染煞蛮兵。
text.description: 既然纳兹戈林将军派你过来，那我相信你一定有足够的判断能力。$B$B在我抵达这里之后，我发现加尔鲁什正在……试验……他在北边山区里发现的某种古代力量。$B$B他相信这种“煞”能够强化我们的士兵。$B$B不幸的是，目前为止我们得到的结论完全相反。$B$B我们的部队纷纷呈现出难以控制的暴力倾向。我要你去问问他们的情况。如果他们威胁你，你要做好防卫的准备。
text.completion: You bested my defenders? Finally, one who can control his hatred and violence!$B$BI need more men like you.
text.completed: Speak with Garrosh Hellscream at the Shrine of Two Moons in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

english.title: A Gathering Storm
english.objectives: Confront 6 Sha-Touched Grunts.
english.description: If General Nazgrim sent you, then I trust you are capable of discretion.$B$BWhen I arrived here, I found Garrosh... experimenting... with some ancient power that he found in the mountains to the north.$B$BHe believes that this "sha" can strengthen our soldiers.$B$BUnfortunately, so far the results have been quite the opposite.$B$BOur troops are erupting into random violence. Go and interrogate them. If they threaten you, be prepared to defend yourself.
english.completion: You bested my defenders? Finally, one who can control his hatred and violence!$B$BI need more men like you.
english.completed: Speak with Garrosh Hellscream at the Shrine of Two Moons in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: 祥和钟杵
text.objectives: 去征服者陵墓找安度因。与雄狮港的范妮·盘角谈一谈，让她送你一程。
text.description: $p！安度因王子不知怎么的又把他的警卫们给甩掉了。他对圣光的控制力正与日俱增。$b$b最后一次见到他的时候，他正前往昆莱山。他是在皇帝谷附近把我们的法师甩掉的。$b$b你能找找他吗？他坚持要去找那个所谓的能克制圣钟的东西。或许你可以在他控制你的心灵并让你一路手舞足蹈地跑回来之前，好好劝劝他。$B$B去和范妮谈谈，让她直接送你一程吧。
text.completion: I am glad you made it, my friend. I could really use your help with what is to come. My father would prefer I remain in the safe custody of his legion.$B$BBut if there is one thing Pandaria has taught me, it is a few people in the right place at the right time can make a bigger difference than the greatest of armies.
text.completed: Speak with Anduin Wrynn at the Tomb of Conquerers in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: The Harmonic Mallet
english.objectives: Find Anduin at the Tomb of Conquerors. Speak to Fennie Hornswaggle at Lion's Landing for transportation.
english.description: $p! Prince Anduin has somehow slipped his guards again. His control over the light is greatly increasing.$b$bHe was last seen heading to Kun-Lai Summit. He gave our mages the slip around the Valley of Emperors.$b$bCan you find him? He insists on searching for what he claims is a counter to the Divine Bell. Perhaps you can talk some sense into him before he seizes control of your mind and has you dance your way back here.$B$BTalk to Fennie for a ride into the mountains.
english.completion: I am glad you made it, my friend. I could really use your help with what is to come. My father would prefer I remain in the safe custody of his legion.$B$BBut if there is one thing Pandaria has taught me, it is a few people in the right place at the right time can make a bigger difference than the greatest of armies.

text.objectives: 将风暴之眼交给迷雾酒肆的拉希奥。
text.description: 灵魂之核变成了一块水晶。这显然就是坎雷萨德和裘碧卡试图制造的神器，但你还是不知道他们去了哪里。$B$B去迷雾酒肆找黑王子，看看能否打听到他们的下落。

english.description: The soulcore has transformed into a crystal. text.title: Awaiting the Black Harvest
text.objectives: Wait for Wrathion to contact you.$B$B[To Be Continued in Patch 5.2...]
text.description: $n, I have never heard of this Council of the Black Harvest. However, the fact that they are interested in my father's power concerns me greatly.$B$BHowever, I do have... contacts, who may be able to help us track them down. Most of my agents are preoccupied with the Alliance and Horde battle in Krasarang. Once that has settled down, I will help you.$B$BFor now, feel free to leave the Naaru relic in my protection, or not - just don't end up dead somewhere at the bottom of a swamp.

text.title: 达拉然的命运
text.objectives: 与吉安娜·普罗德摩尔交谈并倾听她的故事。
text.description: 吉安娜拒绝听我解释。虽然父亲以为她能听得进我的话，可我想她还是把我当成了小孩子。$b$b而你不同，作为联盟的英雄，我知道她很敬佩你的事迹。$b$b你能说服她来帮助我们吗？
text.completion: Thank you for your help, hero. I hear the wisdom in Jaina's words.$B$BLet's hope her faith in the Sunreavers is justified.
text.completed: Speak with Anduin Wrynn at the Purple Parlor in Dalaran.

english.title: The Fate of Dalaran
english.objectives: Speak with Jaina Proudmoore and hear her story.
english.description: Jaina is refusing to hear me out. Father was hoping I would have some pull with her, but I think she still sees me as a child.$b$bYou, on the other hand, are a hero of the Alliance and I know she respects your deeds.$b$bIs there something you can say to her to convince her we need her help?
english.completion: Thank you for your help, hero. I hear the wisdom in Jaina's words.$B$BLet's hope her faith in the Sunreavers is justified.
english.completed: Speak with Anduin Wrynn at the Purple Parlor in Dalaran.

text.title: 昆莱探险队
text.objectives: 去加尔鲁什尔先锋营找大酋长贝恩·血蹄。可以与统御岗哨的泰克泰克谈一谈，让他送你一程。
text.description: 我这里又收到一个血蹄大酋长给你的口信。$B$B看来你给他留下了深刻的印象。$B$B他与酋长的先锋一起去了北边的昆莱山。他们在那里建立了一个营地——加尔鲁什尔先锋营，就在酒坛集的东边。$B$B你最好不要让他久等。你可以让泰克泰克送你一程。
text.completion: Thank you for coming, $n.
text.completed: Speak to Baine Bloodhoof at Garrosh'ar Advance in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: The Kun-Lai Expedition
english.objectives: Find Baine Bloodhoof at Garrosh'ar Advance. Speak to Tak-Tak at Domination Point for transportation.
english.description: I have another message for you from High Chieftain Bloodhoof.$B$BIt seems you've made quite the impression on him.$B$BHe travels with the Warchief's vanguard into Kun-Lai Summit, to the north. They have set up an outpost, Garrosh'ar Advance, just east of One Keg.$B$BYou had best not keep him waiting. Speak to Tak-Tak for swift travel.
english.completion: Thank you for coming, $n.
english.completed: Speak to Baine Bloodhoof at Garrosh'ar Advance in Kun-Lai Summit.

text.description: While I was in the Vale, I came across an ancient pandaren recipe for Memory Wine. I believe this brew can coax some helpful information out of Shan Kien.$B$BI am needed here, so I have no choice but to ask you to find the ingredients for me.$B$BThe recipe can be found in a book near my other things, just behind me.

text.title: 昆莱探险队
text.objectives: 去土地精集市找康奈利。你可以与雄狮港的范妮·盘角谈一谈，让她送你一程。
text.description: 荣耀属于联盟，$c。虽然进展缓慢，但我们确实正在卡桑琅丛林逐步建立起对部落的优势。$B$B在守住这边战线的同时，我们还需要你去打响另一场战斗——直击敌人心脏的战斗。$B$B我们军情七处的密谍，特工康奈利传来消息说，一支部落先锋队正在向昆莱山北部山麓移动。$B$B我要你立即出发，到当地与特工康奈利取得联系，查出事情的真相。$B$B你可以去找那边的范妮，让她送你一程。
text.completion: <You do a doubletake when the Pandaren suddenly speaks with Connelly's voice.>$B$B'Bout time, laddie! I've been waitin' fer ya to show up.$B$BThese Pandaren are good people but can't mix a martini fer nothin'.
text.completed: Speak to Agent Connelly at the Grummle Bazaar in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: The Kun-Lai Expedition
english.objectives: Find Connelly at the Grummle Bazaar. Speak to Fennie Hornswaggle at Lion's Landing for transportation.
english.description: Glory to the Alliance, $c. We are making gains against the Horde in the Krasarang Wilds, albeit slowly.$B$BWhile we hold the front here, we need your help to fight a different battle - one that strikes at our enemy's heart.$B$BOur SI:7 informant, Agent Connelly, has sent word that a Horde vanguard is moving up into the northern reaches of Kun-Lai Summit.$B$BGo without delay. Make contact with Agent Connelly in the field, and find out what is going on.$B$BSpeak to Fennie over there for a flight in.
english.completion: <You do a doubletake when the Pandaren suddenly speaks with Connelly's voice.>$B$B'Bout time, laddie! I've been waitin' fer ya to show up.$B$BThese Pandaren are good people but can't mix a martini fer nothin'.

text.title: 反制
text.objectives: 击败10名库卡隆监督者、5名库卡隆征服者和征服者古尔塔。
text.description: 库卡隆是酋长麾下最精锐、最忠诚的战士。他们的出现就说明加尔鲁什也害怕会爆发起义。$b$b沃金和他的人民和兽人一样，也是部落的一员。$b$b我们必须赶走占领军，解放巨魔。虽然这让我很心痛，但你必须消灭足够多的库卡隆，好让巨魔夺回他们的城市。然后请到暗矛要塞来找我，我们要直接挑战他们的长官。
text.completion: The orcs have changed. My Horde has changed. Do I kill my fellow orcs until it is once again "my" Horde? Do I have any right to try force the Horde to be what it once was?$B$BThese are troubling times. But for now, I must see to Vol'jin's people.
text.completed: Speak to Thrall at Darkspear Hold in the Echo Isles.

english.title: De-Subjugation
english.objectives: Defeat 10 Kor'kron Overseers, 5 Kor'kron Subjugators, and Gul'tar the Subjugator.
english.description: The Kor'kron have been trained to be the finest, most loyal soldiers of the Warchief. Their presence here means that Garrosh fears an uprising.$b$bVol'jin and his people are as much a part of the Horde as any orc.$b$bWe must break this occupation and free the trolls. It pains me to say this, but you must eliminate enough of the Kor'kron so that the trolls can retake their city. Then meet me at Darkspear Hold so we might challenge their officer directly.
english.completion: The orcs have changed. My Horde has changed. Do I kill my fellow orcs until it is once again "my" Horde? Do I have any right to try force the Horde to be what it once was?$B$BThese are troubling times. But for now, I must see to Vol'jin's people.
english.completed: Speak to Thrall at Darkspear Hold in the Echo Isles.

text.title: 領袖的氣度
text.objectives: 與霧隱客棧的怒西昂交談。
text.description: 我們針對熊貓人的計畫已經進展到了下個階段。聯盟海軍載著可觀的兵力登陸，你的國王企圖遏止部落在這塊新大陸的積極擴張。$b$b卡爾洛斯‧地獄吼一路將部落推向戰爭，但是我對瓦里安‧烏瑞恩國王卻不太瞭解。你有空嗎?我希望能跟你聊聊你們聯盟的領袖。
text.completion: I am curious to see how King Wrynn rises to the occasion.$B$BI am even more curious to see what YOU are capable of. Let's find out...
text.completed: Speak with Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

english.title: The Measure of a Leader
english.objectives: Speak with Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists.
english.description: We've progressed to a new part of the Pandaren campaign. The Alliance has landed on the shores with the full might of its navy. Your King aims to check Horde aggression in this new land.$b$bGarrosh Hellscream is propelling the Horde headfirst into battle, but King Varian Wrynn is a little more of a mystery to me. Do you have a moment? I'd like to talk to you about this leader of yours.
english.completion: I am curious to see how King Wrynn rises to the occasion.$B$BI am even more curious to see what YOU are capable of. Let's find out...
english.completed: Speak with Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

text.title: 王子的追求
text.objectives: 击败卡桑琅丛林南部海滩上的部落军队，直到你在黑王子阵营的声望达到崇敬。
text.description: 我的目标就是暂时终止这场代价高昂的战争。在我看来，联盟完全应该获胜。让我看看你在战场上的实力吧。$b$b我不是要你去面对那些抽象的敌人，例如煞魔，而是要你正面对抗你的敌人。$b$b你是否能凯旋归来呢？
text.completion: Marvelous! Even in the midst of the chaos of battle you've proven that an individual can have an impact. The Horde has learned that their actions in Pandaria will not be unopposed.$B$BI believe it is time for a more substantial challenge...
text.completed: Return to Wrathion in the Tavern in the Mists at the Veiled Stair.

english.title: The Prince's Pursuit
english.objectives: Kill Horde forces along the southern shores of Krasarang Wilds until you are Revered with the Black Prince.
english.description: My goal is an expedient end to this costly war. Prove to me that the Alliance deserves to win. Show me your prowess on the battlefield.$b$bYou are not fighting some abstract force like the sha: You are facing your enemy head-on, eye-to-eye.$b$bWill you triumph?
english.completion: Marvelous! Even in the midst of the chaos of battle you've proven that an individual can have an impact. The Horde has learned that their actions in Pandaria will not be unopposed.$B$BI believe it is time for a more substantial challenge...
english.completed: Return to Wrathion in the Tavern in the Mists at the Veiled Stair.

text.objectives: Collect 100 Buttonbelly Mushrooms.
text.description: 100 Buttonbelly Mushrooms. Must be freshly harvested from a wet, dark place.$B$B<Scrawled along the edge of the page is a hand-written note.>$B$BFungus is very good for the health! (Or it might kill you, cause serious illness, rash, hallucination, or loosen bowels. Note to self - MUST be careful when selecting wild mushrooms!)
