text.title: 前往皇帝谷！
text.objectives: 去皇帝谷找“来自银月城的朋友”。你可以与统御岗哨的泰克泰克谈一谈，让他送你一程。
text.description:
这封密封信函是寄给你的，里面是一份紧急命令，要求你立刻前往昆莱山的皇帝谷。

情况看来很严重。如果我是你的话，就绝不会耽搁时间。$B$B你可以让泰克泰克送你一程。
text.completion: Ah, good. You have come. $B$BAgain, I apologize for the cryptic note - but Garrosh is increasingly distrustful of us. I do not want this operation disturbed by hasty action on his part.
text.completed: Meet your "Friend from Silvermoon" at the Valley of Emperors in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: To the Valley!
english.objectives: Find your "Friend from Silvermoon" at the Valley of Emperors. Speak to Tak-Tak at Domination Point for transportation.
english.description:
This sealed communication was sent for you, along with urgent orders to travel to the Valley of Emperors in Kun-Lai Summit.

This looks serious. I'd not delay if I were you.$B$BSpeak to Tak-Tak for transportation.
english.completion: Ah, good. You have come. $B$BAgain, I apologize for the cryptic note - but Garrosh is increasingly distrustful of us. I do not want this operation disturbed by hasty action on his part.
english.completed: Meet your "Friend from Silvermoon" at the Valley of Emperors in Kun-Lai Summit.

objectiveDetails.description: 找到“来自银月城的朋友”

text.title: 混入库卡隆
text.objectives: 收集1个库卡隆头盔、1件库卡隆护甲和1双库卡隆长靴，然后用它们合成库卡隆伪装。
text.description: 加尔鲁什执意要寻找那座圣钟。即使他为了找那件神器而将昆莱山翻个底朝天，我也不会吃惊。$B$B酋长正在北边的加尔鲁什尔先锋营地的召集部队。$B$B我得留在这里监视部队动向，所以你得潜入他们的营地，偷听他们的谈话。$B$B快去加尔鲁什尔先锋营地，从劫掠者、荣誉守卫和斥候那里窃取库卡隆护甲。$B$B带上这个无线电耳机。别联络我……我会联络你的。
text.progress: Just as you look at the assembled Kor'kron disguise, your radio earpiece crackles.
text.completion: <Agent Connelly's voice comes over the radio.>$B$BEy, you're good! I knew those Kor'kron wouldn't be a problem fer ya. Couldn't've done much better meself.

english.title: A Kor'kron In Our Midst
english.objectives: Collect 1 Kor'kron Helmet, 1 Kor'kron Armor, and 1 Kor'kron Boots, then combine them into a Kor'kron Disguise.
english.description: Garrosh is hell-bent on finding that Divine Bell. I wouldn't be surprised if he tore Kun-Lai Summit apart to find that artifact.$B$BThe Warchief's called a gathering at Garrosh'ar Advance, just to our north.$B$BI need to stay here to monitor troop movements, so you'll have to infiltrate their camp and overhear their discussion.$B$BGo to Garrosh'ar Advance and steal some Kor'kron Armor from Reavers, Honor Guards, and Scouts.$B$BTake this radio earpiece. Don't contact me... I'll contact you.
english.progress: Just as you look at the assembled Kor'kron disguise, your radio earpiece crackles.
english.completion: <Agent Connelly's voice comes over the radio.>$B$BEy, you're good! I knew those Kor'kron wouldn't be a problem fer ya. Couldn't've done much better meself.

text.title: 扫清道路
text.objectives: 击败10个寇茹魔古。
text.description:
首先，如果我们要抓住那个首领，就得先削减他手下的数量。

小心点。这些魔古族非常危险——他们似乎拥有操纵煞能的手段，这是我们从未见过的。
text.completion: Good. We should be ready to make our move.
text.completed: Return to Lor'themar Theron at the Valley of Emperors in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: Clearing a Path
english.objectives: Kill 10 Korune Mogu.
english.description:
First thing's first. If we're going to take the leader captive, we'll need to thin the numbers of his agents.

Be careful. These mogu are particularly dangerous - they appear to be manipulating the sha in ways we haven't seen before.
english.completion: Good. We should be ready to make our move.
english.completed: Return to Lor'themar Theron at the Valley of Emperors in Kun-Lai Summit.

text.title: 寇茹的遗产
text.objectives: 在皇帝谷找到有关寇茹遗产的卷轴，并从寇茹魔古族身上收集封印的寇茹神器和寇茹指令。
text.description:
我可不想再派我的人去对付我们根本不了解的敌人了。

我要你去看看能不能在这里发现什么线索，找出这些“寇茹”魔古究竟是什么人。一旦有什么意外，这次行动就无法按计划进行了。
text.progress: Have you found anything on the mogu?
text.completion: Good. There's quite a bit to pore through here... $B$BI will have the Reliquary investigate these. Surely we can use them to discern more of the secrets of these Korune mogu.
text.completed: Return to Lor'themar Theron at the Valley of Emperors in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: Legacy of the Korune
english.objectives: Find the document Legacy of the Korune in the Valley of the Emperors, and collect the Sealed Korune Artifact and Korune Orders from Korune Mogu.
english.description:
I'm not prepared to throw away more of our people fighting against an enemy we don't know or understand. 

See if you can find any clues in the area as to who exactly these "Korune" mogu are. A contingency in case this operation doesn't go as planned.
english.progress: Have you found anything on the mogu?
english.completion: Good. There's quite a bit to pore through here... $B$BI will have the Reliquary investigate these. Surely we can use them to discern more of the secrets of these Korune mogu.
english.completed: Return to Lor'themar Theron at the Valley of Emperors in Kun-Lai Summit.

text.title: 最佳人选
text.objectives: 去暴风城的矿道地铁找比兹莫搏击俱乐部的卧底探员汤斯丽。
text.description: 要想搞明白加尔鲁什针对潘达利亚的计划，我们就需要帮助。$b$b我的脑子里就有一个人选，可这人不容易说服。$b$b特工康奈利觉得自己已经退休了，但军情七处可不是能让人随意进出的地方。这几个月来，我们的卧底一直在监视着他的一举一动。$b$b目前，他就在比兹莫搏击俱乐部里乔装成一名烂赌鬼，好像是有一笔旧账要收。$b$b去搏击俱乐部见见我们的卧底吧。
text.completion: Following Connelly has been interesting to say the least. The man is a master of disguise!$B$BTalking him into joining you won't be the hard part, $C. Figuring out which of these lively individuals is him will be next to impossble.

english.title: The Best Around
english.objectives: Report to undercover agent Townsley in Bizmo's Brawlpub in the Stormwind side of Deeprun Tram.
english.description: We're going to need help if we hope to figure out Garrosh's plans for Pandaria.$b$bI have someone specific in mind, but he will not be easy to convince.$b$bAgent Connelly considers himself retired, but one does not simply leave the SI: 7. We've had an undercover agent following his every move for months.$b$bCurrently, he is disguising himself as a high roller at Bizmo's Brawlpub. Something about settling an old debt.$b$bMeet with our undercover agent in the Brawler's Guild.
english.completion: Following Connelly has been interesting to say the least. The man is a master of disguise!$B$BTalking him into joining you won't be the hard part, $C. Figuring out which of these lively individuals is him will be next to impossble.

objectiveDetails.description: 找到比兹莫搏击俱乐部

text.title: 排查间谍
text.objectives: 将粉色旱獭、魔古鲜榨甜瓜汁和锈色利刃送给正确的顾客。
text.description: 现在，我可以告诉你哪个是康奈利，可这就太简单了！要想抓住间谍，你就得像间谍那样思考。$b$b你得先通过考验。$b$b间谍会关注到最小的细节。一些细枝末节往往就能透露出很多信息。$b$b我会让你去送一杯饮料，并告诉你接收者身上的一个小细节。然后就看你的了。$b$b仔细辨别出你应该把饮料送给谁。这里的人要是你把酒水给他送错了，他们可是要揍人的！
text.completion: You have a keen eye, $C! I think you are ready to meet Connelly.
text.completed: Speak with Barkeep Townsley in the Brawler's Guild

english.title: To Catch A Spy
english.objectives: Deliver the Pink Marmot, the Mogu Melon Twist, and the Rusty Dagger to the correct patron.
english.description: Now, I could tell you who Connelly is, but that would be too easy! To catch a spy you have to think like a spy.$b$bYou have to pass the test first!$b$bThe small things can say a lot about a person. It's all in the details.$b$bI'm going to give you a drink to deliver. I will give you a small detail about something the recipient is wearing. From there it will be up to you.$b$bBe careful who you pick to give drinks to. People here tend to get pretty hostile if you give them the wrong order!
english.completion: You have a keen eye, $C! I think you are ready to meet Connelly.
english.completed: Speak with Barkeep Townsley in the Brawler's Guild

text.title: 深入敌后
text.objectives: 去昆莱山找康奈利。与雄狮港的范妮·盘角谈一谈，让她送你一程。
text.description: 特工康奈利已经设法潜入了加尔鲁什在昆莱山的营地！他一直混在部落的战士当中监视他们的一举一动。$b$b他指名要你去帮他收集一些重要情报。$b$b他还送来一套伪装。那里的守卫肯定很森严。在靠近营地前，你一定要穿上它！$b$b他坚持认为你能够认出他来。还说你有一双善于发现细节的眼睛……$B$B去和范妮说一声，让她送你一程吧。
text.completion: You've arrived just in time. From the intel I've gathered, Garrosh is hot on the trail of some sort of ancient mogu artifact of power.$B$BIf we can figure out what he's after, we can stop him from getting it!$B$BWe have to act fast to gather as much information as possible.
text.completed: Speak to Connelly in Kun-Lai Summit at Fire Camp Bataar.

english.title: He's In Deep
english.objectives: Meet Connelly in Kun-Lai Summit. Speak to Fennie Hornswaggle at Lion's Landing for transportation.
english.description: Agent Connelly has managed to infiltrate Garrosh's camp in Kun-Lai! He's been following their every move.$b$bConnelly requested you specifically to assist him in gathering some vital intelligence.$b$bHe sent along a disguise for you. Make sure you put it on before approaching the camp! It will no doubt be heavily guarded.$b$bHe insists you will know him when you see him. Something about your keen eye for details...$B$BGo talk to Fennie over there for a drop-off.
english.completion: You've arrived just in time. From the intel I've gathered, Garrosh is hot on the trail of some sort of ancient mogu artifact of power.$B$BIf we can figure out what he's after, we can stop him from getting it!$B$BWe have to act fast to gather as much information as possible.
english.completed: Speak to Connelly in Kun-Lai Summit at Fire Camp Bataar.

text.title: 窃听风云
text.objectives: 将精心伪装的窃听器放在大帐篷里、小帐篷附近和补给中。
text.description: 我已经在营地里安装了一些窃听器，但窃听器是永远不嫌多的。$b$b这些雕像其实都是经过伪装的录音机。它们和周围的其他古物看起来别无二致。$b$b你的伪装应该可以让你在营地里自由行动。只要你别去接近狗和加尔鲁什就行！尼禄和加尔鲁什能看穿你的伪装。$b$b万一你被抓，我可帮不了你。我不能搞砸任务！
text.completion: Well done! Everyone always underestimates the little guys and it is always a grave mistake!
text.completed: Return to Cousin Goottooth in Fire Camp Bataar.

english.title: Bugging Out
english.objectives: Plant the Cleverly Disguised Bugs in the large tent, near the small tents, and in the supplies.
english.description: I've managed to plant a few bugs around the camp, but there could always be more.$b$bI disguised the bugs to look like statues. They blend in perfectly with the other artifacts lying around.$b$bYour disguise should allow you to move freely around the camp. Just don't go near the dog and don't linger around Garrosh! Nero and Garrosh will see through your disguise.$b$bIf you get caught I can't help you. I can't compromise the mission!
english.completion: Well done! Everyone always underestimates the little guys and it is always a grave mistake!
english.completed: Return to Cousin Goottooth in Fire Camp Bataar.

text.title: 擒贼擒王
text.objectives: 前往昆莱山的暗影古陵，削弱并俘获单简。
text.description:
现在该我们行动了。快去暗影古陵削弱并抓住他。

我会留在这里，以防加尔鲁什赶到——我会尽量拖住他，好让我们在他愤怒地摧毁一切前拿到属于我们的战利品。

快去吧！
text.completion: We managed to capture our quarry. $B$BIn truth, though, I am not sure what our next move should be. I will contact the leaders of our allies and see if they have ideas - I don't know that our arcane talents are going to pry the secrets of our mogu captive.
text.completed: Speak with Lor'themar Theron at the Valley of Emperors in Kun-Lai Summit.
text.giverWindow: 寇茹魔古的首领。活捉他！

english.title: Trapping the Leader
english.objectives: Weaken and capture Shan Kien at the Tomb of Shadows in Kun-Lai Summit.
english.description:
It is time to make our move. Go to the Tomb of Shadows, weaken him, and take him captive.

I will stay here in case Garrosh arrives. He must be delayed so that we can take our prize before he destroys it in his anger.

Hurry!
english.completion: We managed to capture our quarry. $B$BIn truth, though, I am not sure what our next move should be. I will contact the leaders of our allies and see if they have ideas - I don't know that our arcane talents are going to pry the secrets of our mogu captive.
english.completed: Speak with Lor'themar Theron at the Valley of Emperors in Kun-Lai Summit.
english.giverWindow: The leader of the Korune. Take him alive!

text.title: 朝令夕改
text.objectives: 去卡桑琅丛林的统御岗哨击败血柄督军。建议你组队前往。
text.description: 我一直在密切监视一个兽人将军。由于在南贫瘠之地击退了联盟的先头部队，血柄督军获得了加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮的赏识。他现在就呆在统御岗哨的堡垒里。$b$b我很怀疑联盟能否干掉他。可是……你以前就曾证明过我的判断有误。$b$b如果你想干掉他，一定要找几个朋友一起去。记得多带点人。
text.completion: <Wrathion grins.>$B$BYou were being tested, $C. I knew you were capable of great things by yourself.$B$BBut you have proven to me that you have the makings of a leader, cobbling together support among a group of strangers in the midst of a battlefield.$B$BThe Alliance is fortunate to have you.
text.completed: Return to Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

english.title: A Change of Command
english.objectives: Kill Warlord Bloodhilt at Domination Point in Krasarang Wilds. You will need a group.
english.description: There's an orc general I've been keeping a close eye on. Warlord Bloodhilt curried a lot of favor with Garrosh Hellscream by beating back an Alliance advance in Southern Barrens. He's now entrenched within the fortress at Domination Point.$b$bI doubt the Alliance can take him out. But... you've proven me wrong before.$b$bIf you wish to finish him off, bring friends. Lots of friends.
english.completion: <Wrathion grins.>$B$BYou were being tested, $C. I knew you were capable of great things by yourself.$B$BBut you have proven to me that you have the makings of a leader, cobbling together support among a group of strangers in the midst of a battlefield.$B$BThe Alliance is fortunate to have you.
english.completed: Return to Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

text.title: 雄狮怒吼
text.objectives: 赢得寇魔古寺和碎银矿脉的胜利。
text.description: 这是一场全球战争，$n。它不仅波及了潘达利亚，连卡利姆多和东部王国也同样战火频燃。你在有组织的战场上会表现如何呢？我很想亲眼看一看。$b$b我期待听到你从前线带回的报告。
text.completion: <Wrathion hungrily listens to tales of your exploits on the battlefield, his eyes gleaming bright red.>$B$BOhh... oh! Incredible! In the very eye of battle, one's true heart is revealed.$B$BYou do not disappoint, $n.$B$BNeither does your Alliance.
text.completed: Return to Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

english.title: The Lion Roars
english.objectives: Win battles at the Temple of Kotmogu and the Silvershard Mines.
english.description: This is a global war, $n. It has spilled onto Pandaria, and it has set hot spots across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms ablaze. How will you fare on an organized battlefront? I would like to see for myself.$b$bI look forward to hearing your report from the front lines.
english.completion: <Wrathion hungrily listens to tales of your exploits on the battlefield, his eyes gleaming bright red.>$B$BOhh... oh! Incredible! In the very eye of battle, one's true heart is revealed.$B$BYou do not disappoint, $n.$B$BNeither does your Alliance.
english.completed: Return to Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

objectiveDetails.description: 在寇魔古寺赢得一场胜利
在碎银矿脉赢得一场胜利

text.title: 头狼的召唤
text.objectives: 与拉希奥谈一谈。
text.description: $C，通过你的眼睛，我也见证了海滩上的激战，那是一场震动世界的史诗战役。你很有耐心……并提供了大量情报。$b$b我一直在密切关注你们的国王。你想听听我对他的看法吗？
text.completion: <A strange device sits within an ornate silk-lined chest. It appears as though it can be fastened to your sha-touched weapon as an additional upgrade. The empty socket is disconcerting; you feel as though it is staring back at you. A single, hollow, judgmental eye...>
text.completed: Choose your reward from Wrathion's chest at the Tavern in the Mist.

english.title: Call of the Packmaster
english.objectives: Speak with Wrathion.
english.description: $C, through your eyes I've been able to witness the fighting along the coast, and the epic course of battles around the world. You've been very patient... and most informative.$b$bI've also been keeping a close eye on your King. Would you be interested to hear what I've learned?
english.completion: <A strange device sits within an ornate silk-lined chest. It appears as though it can be fastened to your sha-touched weapon as an additional upgrade. The empty socket is disconcerting; you feel as though it is staring back at you. A single, hollow, judgmental eye...>
english.completed: Choose your reward from Wrathion's chest at the Tavern in the Mist.

text.title: 寇茹废墟
text.objectives: 去寇茹废墟找伊什。你可以与统御岗哨的泰克泰克谈一谈，让他送你一程。
text.description: 加尔鲁什派出了一百名骑兵搜索昆莱山的北部海岸，去寻找你在单简的记忆中看到的那座魔古墓穴。$B$B其中有一个人找到了圣钟的埋藏地。$B$B剑圣伊什已经带着一支先遣队赶去保护圣钟了。$B$B我要你去协助他。守住那件神器，把碍事的家伙全干掉！$B$B快去找泰克泰克，他会送你过去的。
text.completion: The Alliance beat us here. How could this happen?
text.completed: Speak to Ishi at the Ruins of Korune in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: The Ruins of Korune
english.objectives: Find Ishi at the Ruins of Korune. Speak to Tak-Tak at Domination Point for transportation.
english.description: Garrosh sent a hundred riders to search the northern coast of Kun-Lai Summit, to seek a mogu crypt matching the one you saw in Shan Kien's memory.$B$BOut of those, one found the resting place of the Divine Bell.$B$BBlademaster Ishi is leading an advance party to secure the bell now.$B$BGo and assist him. Defend that artifact from anyone who might stand in your way!$B$BSpeak to Tak-Tak without delay. He can take you there.
english.completion: The Alliance beat us here. How could this happen?
english.completed: Speak to Ishi at the Ruins of Korune in Kun-Lai Summit.

text.title: 圣钟
text.objectives: 击败萨拉哈·天剑。
text.description: 要是联盟以为能从我们手中偷走圣钟，那他们就错了！$B$B现在，我们就把他们困在了下面的墓穴里。$B$B敢于反抗我们的代价就是死亡。$B$B来吧，$c。我们要让他们知道自己错得有多离谱。
text.completion: Darnassus, is it?$B$BThe Alliance believes they have won the day. Now, when their arrogance is at its greatest, is our opportunity to pluck the prize from their fingers.
text.completed: Speak to Ishi at the Ruins of Korune in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: The Divine Bell
english.objectives: Kill Sarannha Skyglaive.
english.description: If the Alliance thought they could steal the Divine Bell from us, they were wrong!$B$BEven now, we have them trapped in the crypts beneath us.$B$BDeath will be the price they pay for defying us.$B$BCome, $c. Let us show them the error of their ways.
english.completion: Darnassus, is it?$B$BThe Alliance believes they have won the day. Now, when their arrogance is at its greatest, is our opportunity to pluck the prize from their fingers.
english.completed: Speak to Ishi at the Ruins of Korune in Kun-Lai Summit.

text.title: 寇茹废墟
text.objectives: 去寇茹废墟找萨拉哈·天剑。你可以与雄狮港的范妮·盘角谈一谈，让她送你一程。
text.description: 接下来将是我们最大胆的一次行动，$n。$B$B在你打听到圣钟的位置后，我们立刻就召集了一支精英小队前去发掘神器。$B$B指挥官萨拉哈·天剑带着远征队进入了昆莱山的最北部。$B$B你要立刻加入他们，尽你的一切力量确保行动成功。$B$B祝你好运，$c。我就不用向你强调这次行动对联盟有多么重要了吧？$B$B去跟范妮谈谈。她能把你快速送到目的地。
text.completion: We blasted the doors open moments ago, $C. You arrived just in time to join us for the excavation.
text.completed: Speak to Sarannha Skyglaive at the Ruins of Korune in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: The Ruins of Korune
english.objectives: Find Sarannha Skyglaive at the Ruins of Korune. Speak to Fennie Hornswaggle at Lion's Landing for transportation.
english.description: It's time for our boldest move yet, $n.$B$BSince you acquired intel on the location of the Divine Bell, we've amassed a top team to excavate the artifact without delay.$B$BCommander Sarannha Skyglaive leads the expedition into the northern-most reaches of Kun-Lai Summit.$B$BJoin them at once, and use whatever skills you need to make the endeavor a success.$B$BGood luck, $c. I don't need to tell you how important this mission is to the Alliance.$B$BSpeak to Fennie. She'll get you there quickly.
english.completion: We blasted the doors open moments ago, $C. You arrived just in time to join us for the excavation.
english.completed: Speak to Sarannha Skyglaive at the Ruins of Korune in Kun-Lai Summit.

objectiveDetails.description: 去寇茹废墟找萨拉哈·天剑

text.title: 圣钟
text.objectives: 击败织恐者阿瓦图并夺取圣钟。
text.description: 谁也不知道下面会有什么，所以我会亲自带领一队斥候下去进行初步勘察。$B$B如果你的情报准确，那寇茹魔古应该就把圣钟藏在我们脚下的墓室里。$B$B我有预感，如此宝贵的神器肯定不会无人看守。$B$B我正需要像你这样能力出众的$c来掩护我。你准备好之后，请告诉我一声。
text.completion: Fantastic work, $n. I could not even imagine the atrocity that Garrosh would commit if this bell were to fall into his hands.$B$BToday, we have secured a safe future for the Alliance. I will see to it that the bell makes it safely to Darnassus.$B$BI will extoll your deeds to the King.
text.completed: Speak to Sarannha Skyglaive at the Ruins of Korune in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: The Divine Bell
english.objectives: Kill Dreadweaver Avartu and recover the Divine Bell.
english.description: There's no telling what lies below, so I will lead the initial scouting party myself.$B$BIf your report was correct, then the Korune mogu hid the Divine Bell in the rooms below our very feet.$B$BI have a feeling they would not have left such a precious artifact unguarded.$B$BI could use a capable $c such as yourself to watch my back. Let me know when you're ready.
english.completion: Fantastic work, $n. I could not even imagine the atrocity that Garrosh would commit if this bell were to fall into his hands.$B$BToday, we have secured a safe future for the Alliance. I will see to it that the bell makes it safely to Darnassus.$B$BI will extoll your deeds to the King.
english.completed: Speak to Sarannha Skyglaive at the Ruins of Korune in Kun-Lai Summit.

text.title: 他不会发现的
text.objectives: 在营地制造混乱，趁机窃取褪色日志。
text.description: 我注意到加尔鲁什和一位神圣遗物学会的血精灵在一起，而且那位血精灵还随身带着某种日志。$b$b那本日志几乎从不离身，肯定非常重要！$b$b如果你能制造出足够大的混乱，就可以偷走桌上的日志了。$b$b这些牦牛或许能派上用处。只要狠狠给它们一鞭子，它们就会帮你搞定剩下的事。$b$b不过你一定得做好快跑的准备！
text.progress: What did you find?
text.completion: Phew! That was a close one! I never doubted you for a minute though.$B$BNow let me take a look at that journal...
text.completed: Return to Cousin Goottooth in Fire Camp Bataar.

english.title: He Won't Even Miss It
english.objectives: Create a distraction in the camp and steal the Weathered Journal.
english.description: I've noticed Garrosh and that Reliquary blood elf carrying around some sort of journal.$b$bThe journal is never more than a stone's throw away. It must be important!$b$bIf you can cause enough of a distraction, you may be able to swipe the journal off the table.$b$bThese yaks might just do the trick. Give one of 'em a tap and they'll do the rest.$b$bJust be ready to move fast!
english.progress: What did you find?
english.completion: Phew! That was a close one! I never doubted you for a minute though.$B$BNow let me take a look at that journal...
english.completed: Return to Cousin Goottooth in Fire Camp Bataar.

text.title: 圣钟鸣响
text.objectives: 去帝皇之域找马尔考罗克。你可以与统御岗哨的泰克泰克谈一谈，让他送你一程。
text.description: 你的努力终于得到了回报，$c。$B$B加尔鲁什酋长召集了部落最精锐的勇士前往昆莱山见证圣钟的鸣响。$B$B而你更将有机会参与其中。$B$B快去吧。新部落的黎明将从今天开始。$B$B去跟泰克泰克谈一谈，他会帮你安排行程的。
text.completion: I was wondering when you would arrive, $n.
text.completed: Speak to Malkorok at Emperor's Reach in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: The Bell Speaks
english.objectives: Find Malkorok at Emperor's Reach. Speak to Tak-Tak at Domination Point for transportation.
english.description: Your efforts have culminated in this moment, $c.$B$BWarchief Garrosh gathers the most elite champions of the Horde in Kun-Lai Summit to witness the ringing of the Divine Bell.$B$BYou have more than earned the right to participate.$B$BGo now. The dawn of the new Horde begins today.$B$BSpeak to Tak-Tak. He should be able to secure your travel arrangements.
english.completion: I was wondering when you would arrive, $n.
english.completed: Speak to Malkorok at Emperor's Reach in Kun-Lai Summit.

objectiveDetails.description: 去帝皇之域找马尔考罗克

text.title: 深黯之息
text.objectives: 见证圣钟的鸣响。
text.description: 是时候了，$n。我们历经千难万险，终于等来了这个时刻。$B$B今天，我们的酋长，加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮将永远改写我们的历史。$B$B今天，我们将见证加尔鲁什的新部落诞生！$B$B不要让任何人干扰仪式！
text.completion: They may have destroyed the Divine Bell, but I have taken the life of the Alliance's prodigal son!$B$BIt is nothing less than my own father would have expected of me.$B$BThis victory may have come at a high cost, but it is of little consequence.$B$BI will find other ways to destroy my enemies, and bring glory to the Horde!
text.completed: Speak to Garrosh at Emperor's Reach in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: Breath of Darkest Shadow
english.objectives: Witness the ringing of the Divine Bell.
english.description: It is time, $n. We have traveled a long path to reach this moment.$B$BToday, our Warchief, Garrosh Hellscream, will change the course of our people's history forever.$B$BToday, we witness the birth of Garrosh's Horde!$B$BDo not let anything interfere with the ceremony!
english.completion: They may have destroyed the Divine Bell, but I have taken the life of the Alliance's prodigal son!$B$BIt is nothing less than my own father would have expected of me.$B$BThis victory may have come at a high cost, but it is of little consequence.$B$BI will find other ways to destroy my enemies, and bring glory to the Horde!
english.completed: Speak to Garrosh at Emperor's Reach in Kun-Lai Summit.

text.title: 圣钟鸣响
text.objectives: 去帝皇之域找安度因。与雄狮港的范妮·盘角谈一谈，让她送你一程。
text.description: 部落军队正在向昆莱山的帝皇之域大量集结。$B$B那里有一座古代魔古宫殿，而且显然是某种未知力量的源头。$B$B这只能说明一件事：加尔鲁什打算要使用圣钟了。而安度因……和祥和钟杵……都失踪了。$B$B我毫不怀疑，那个傻小子肯定亲身前往北方了。$B$B我没时间召集精锐部队去找他了。你必须去阻止安度因。$B$B范妮会送你过去的。
text.completion: $n! Just the $c I was hoping to see. You couldn't have arrived at a better time.
text.completed: Speak to Anduin at Emperor's Reach in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: The Bell Speaks
english.objectives: Find Anduin at Emperor's Reach. Speak to Fennie Hornswaggle at Lion's Landing for transportation.
english.description: Horde forces are amassing in huge numbers at the Emperor's Reach, high up in the mountains of Kun-Lai Summit.$B$BThe area is an ancient mogu palace, and certainly a source of untold power.$B$BThis can only mean one thing. Garrosh is going to use the Divine Bell, and Anduin... and the Harmonic Mallet... are both missing.$B$BI have no doubt that the fool boy went north by himself.$B$BI don't have time to gather an elite force to detain him. You must go and stop Anduin.$B$BFennie can take you.
english.completion: $n! Just the $c I was hoping to see. You couldn't have arrived at a better time.
english.completed: Speak to Anduin at Emperor's Reach in Kun-Lai Summit.

text.title: 深黯之息
text.objectives: 击败伊什并摧毁圣钟。
text.description: 加尔鲁什就在那里，他马上就要敲响那个钟了。$B$B我们没时间等待我父亲的援军了。这是我们阻止他的最后机会！$B$B我会设法吸引他的注意力，然后使用祥和钟杵。$B$B你准备好之后就冲吧，$n。我会跟紧你的。
text.completion: <Anduin looks like a crumpled doll. He lays as still as a stone, and the only movement comes from the frigid air ruffling his fair, golden hair.>$B$B<You sit quietly for a while, until the cold settles into your bones. The bell is destroyed, but the silence is deafening.>$B$B<Out of the corner of your eye, you see the slightest flicker from the boy's hand. You lean in close. He breathes - but just barely! Anduin is alive!>
text.completed: Speak to Anduin at Emperor's Reach in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: Breath of Darkest Shadow
english.objectives: Defeat Ishi and destroy the Divine Bell.
english.description: Garrosh is right over there, and he's going to ring that bell at any moment.$B$BWe don't have time to wait for my father's army. This is our only chance to stop him!$B$BI'll attempt to appeal to his senses before resorting to using the Harmonic Mallet.$B$BCharge in whenever you're ready, $n. I'll be right behind you.
english.completion: <Anduin looks like a crumpled doll. He lays as still as a stone, and the only movement comes from the frigid air ruffling his fair, golden hair.>$B$B<You sit quietly for a while, until the cold settles into your bones. The bell is destroyed, but the silence is deafening.>$B$B<Out of the corner of your eye, you see the slightest flicker from the boy's hand. You lean in close. He breathes - but just barely! Anduin is alive!>
english.completed: Speak to Anduin at Emperor's Reach in Kun-Lai Summit.

text.title: 达拉然的局势
text.objectives: 与库姆萨尔谈一谈，让他送你去达拉然。
text.description: 暗夜精灵知道圣钟被偷了。我们对此早有预料。$b$b可是，他们还发现达拉然那群一直保持“中立”的夺日者也是这次事件的同谋。这样，我们就有麻烦了。$b$b我要你去一趟达拉然。你可以去跟库姆萨尔谈谈，让他送你一程。当你抵达之后，就去跟大法师罗曼斯汇合。
text.completion: Good... you've arrived. It's not a good day to be Horde in Dalaran.$B$BJaina's called for the exile of all the Sunreavers. You and I are going to save as many as we can - including Archmage Aethas Sunreaver himself - and then get out of here as fast as possible.
text.completed: Report to Grand Magister Rommath.

english.title: The Situation In Dalaran
english.objectives: Speak with Kromthar to obtain a ride to Dalaran.
english.description: The night elves learned that the Divine Bell was stolen. This much we anticipated.$b$bHowever, they've also found out that the "neutral" Sunreavers of Dalaran were complicit. Now, we've got a situation.$b$bI need you to go to Dalaran. Speak with Kromthar for a ride. You are to rendezvous with Grand Magister Rommath once you arrive.
english.completion: Good... you've arrived. It's not a good day to be Horde in Dalaran.$B$BJaina's called for the exile of all the Sunreavers. You and I are going to save as many as we can - including Archmage Aethas Sunreaver himself - and then get out of here as fast as possible.
english.completed: Report to Grand Magister Rommath.

text.title: 从下水道开始
text.objectives: 疏散9名夺日者平民。
text.description: 比起城市的其他地方，这一段下水道相对平静。这样最好——比起战斗，我们可以在悄无声息的情况下撤走更多的夺日者。$b$b你要尽可能多找到一些平民，告诉他们这里已经不安全了，让他们立刻离开这座城市。$b$b尽量不要靠近银色盟约的人。如果有可能的话，我们并不想惹麻烦。至少目前不行。
text.completion: Let's press on.
text.completed: Return to Grand Magister Rommath in Dalaran.

english.title: It Starts in the Sewers
english.objectives: Evacuate 9 Sunreaver Citizens.
english.description: Compared to the rest of the city, this part of the sewers is relatively calm. This is good - we can extract more Sunreavers in peace than we can in war.$b$bFind as many citizens as you can. Tell them that it is not safe here, that they must leave the city at once.$b$bAnd try to stay clear of the Silver Covenant. We don't want to cause a scene if we can avoid it. Not yet, anyhow.
english.completion: Let's press on.
english.completed: Return to Grand Magister Rommath in Dalaran.

text.title: 竞技场的暴行
text.objectives: 击败6名银色盟约刽子手和4名银色盟约投法者。
text.description: 跟我想的一样，前面的情况要糟糕得多。银色盟约的人正在拼命攻击无辜的夺日者！$b$b这是无法容忍的暴行。虽然我们的首要任务是营救艾萨斯·夺日者，但我们也要尽可能地保护其他血精灵。$b$b我会继续在前面探路。好好打，$c！
text.completion: So much bloodshed! In a place of peace!$B$BJaina has gone too far this time.
text.completed: Return to Grand Magister Rommath in Dalaran.

english.title: Violence in the Arena
english.objectives: Slay 6 Silver Covenant Enforcers and 4 Silver Covenant Spellbows.
english.description: As I suspected, it gets worse up ahead. The Silver Covenant is outright attacking innocent Sunreavers!$b$bThis cannot stand. While our prime directive is to rescue Aethas Sunreaver, we must also protect as many blood elves as we can.$b$bI will continue to scout ahead. Fight well, $c!
english.completion: So much bloodshed! In a place of peace!$B$BJaina has gone too far this time.
english.completed: Return to Grand Magister Rommath in Dalaran.

text.title: 银色盟约之手
text.objectives: 击败索林·法师之手。
text.description: 吉安娜从这座城市里每驱逐出一个夺日者，就会多一个为部落、为我们而战的战士。$b$b我会去召集更多强大的精灵。而你已经证明了自己的战斗力——我要你去解决混进黑市的那个家伙。$b$b等你完成的时候，我们就在坡道上集合并准备冲出地面。
text.completion: The first stage of our mission is complete. That was the easy part.$B$B<Rommath takes a deep, measured breath, then continues...>
text.completed: Return to Grand Magister Rommath in Dalaran.

english.title: Hand of the Silver Covenant
english.objectives: Slay Sorin Magehand.
english.description: Every Sunreaver Jaina expels from this city is a new blade that fights for the Horde. For US.$b$bI'm off to gather more strong elves. You've proven your hand in combat thus far - go take care of that creep in the black market.$b$bWhen you're done, we'll meet at the ramp and prepare to go aboveground.
english.completion: The first stage of our mission is complete. That was the easy part.$B$B<Rommath takes a deep, measured breath, then continues...>
english.completed: Return to Grand Magister Rommath in Dalaran.

text.title: 战术突击
text.objectives: 跟随大法师罗曼斯进入达拉然的中心区域。
text.description: 如果我们想在地面上活下去，就需要一个行动基地。$b$b我会设法占领市中心。这样做风险很大，只能寄望于吉安娜和银色盟约没有想到这一点。$b$b现在，跟紧我，$n。
text.completion: Now, let's move quickly.

english.title: A Tactical Assault
english.objectives: Follow Grand Magister Rommath into the center of Dalaran.
english.description: If we're to survive up above ground, we're going to need a base of operations.$b$bI'm going to try to take the center of the city. It's risky, but hopefully Jaina and the Silver Covenant won't expect it.$b$bStay by my side now, $n.
english.completion: Now, let's move quickly.

text.title: 银色盟约的堡垒
text.objectives: 击败奥术师兰塞拉。
text.description: 有可靠证据表明，大法师艾萨斯·夺日者被囚禁在银色盟约的大本营，银色领地里。奥术师兰塞拉正看守着他。$b$b大部分银色盟约的成员现在正在外面屠杀夺日者，营救的时机已经成熟了。去干掉兰塞拉，将艾萨斯救出来吧。
text.completion: We will continue saving Sunreavers for a while longer. Aethas' location may become clearer as we press on.
text.completed: Return to Grand Magister Rommath in Dalaran.

english.title: The Silver Covenant's Stronghold
english.objectives: Slay Arcanist Rathaella.
english.description: I have it on good authority that Archmage Aethas Sunreaver is being held in the Silver Enclave, home of the Silver Covenant. Arcanist Rathaella holds him in captivity.$b$bMost Covenant agents are out slaughtering Sunreavers right now, which means our chance is ripe. Slay Rathaella, and spring Aethas from his prison.
english.completion: We will continue saving Sunreavers for a while longer. Aethas' location may become clearer as we press on.
english.completed: Return to Grand Magister Rommath in Dalaran.

text.title: 肯瑞托的立场
text.objectives: 击败考文中尉和他手下的10名士兵。
text.description: 无论肯瑞托用什么借口继续假称“中立”组织，他们的谎言都已经正式破产了。我听说吉安娜已经悄悄让联盟部队抵达了安东尼达斯纪念碑附近。$b$b那一地区并没有夺日者存在，可肯瑞托这种公然偏袒联盟的做法仍然让我无比愤怒。$b$b到纪念碑那里去，$n……并狠狠教训一下你沿途遇到的联盟成员。
text.completion: Thank you for that, $n.$B$BIt unsettles me to have to fight directly with the high elves of the Silver Covenant... but I never tire of slaying Alliance.
text.completed: Return to Grand Magister Rommath in Dalaran.

english.title: The Kirin Tor's True Colors
english.objectives: Slay Lieutenant Corwin and 10 of his troops.
english.description: Any pretense that the Kirin Tor might have had at being a "neutral" group can officially be discarded. I'm now hearing that Jaina's got Alliance troops stowed away near Antonidas Memorial.$b$bThe area's free of Sunreavers, but it still makes my blood boil to see such blatant favoritism from the Kirin Tor.$b$bGo visit the memorial, $n... and give those Alliance dogs a good kick on your way through.
english.completion: Thank you for that, $n.$B$BIt unsettles me to have to fight directly with the high elves of the Silver Covenant... but I never tire of slaying Alliance.
english.completed: Return to Grand Magister Rommath in Dalaran.

text.title: 克拉苏斯平台
text.objectives: 救下6只夺日者龙鹰。
text.description: 我们可以尽力营救夺日者，可如果他们都逃不出去，那就毫无意义了。$b$b银色盟约肯定在收服并屠杀夺日者的龙鹰。你必须阻止他们。
text.completion: Well done, $n. Well done.
text.completed: Return to Grand Magister Rommath in Dalaran.

english.title: Krasus' Landing
english.objectives: Free 6 Sunreaver Dragonhawks.
english.description: We can rescue as many Sunreavers as we want, but if they can't escape, then there's no point.$b$bThe Silver Covenant will certainly be subduing and killing the Sunreavers' dragonhawks. Put a stop to it.
english.completion: Well done, $n. Well done.
english.completed: Return to Grand Magister Rommath in Dalaran.

text.title: 夺日者残兵
text.objectives: 对兽女乌达、高阶奥术师西瓦、魔导师哈瑟尔、魔导师索迪耶尔和魔导师维莎拉使用辛多雷之殇。
text.description: 仍然有相当数量的夺日者下落不明。他们很可能是在出其不意的情况下被困在了夺日者圣殿里。$b$b<罗曼斯交给你一件神器，它显然出自血精灵之手。>$b$b那里到处都是银色盟约的人。你可以用它进入圣殿，救出那里的重要人物，然后再撤离。$b$b好好活下去，$n。
text.completion: Excellent. They should be waiting for us in Silvermoon when we return.
text.completed: Return to Grand Magister Rommath in Dalaran.

english.title: The Remaining Sunreavers
english.objectives: Slay Lieutenant Corwin and 10 of his troops.
english.description: There's still a number of significant Sunreavers who haven't been accounted for. Odds are that they're in the Sunreaver's Sanctuary, caught by surprise.$b$b<Rommath hands you an artifact, clearly made by blood elf hands.>$b$bThe place is crawling with Silver Covenant. You'll need to get in, use the Tear to evacuate the VIPs, and then get out.$b$bStay alive, $n.
english.completion: Excellent. They should be waiting for us in Silvermoon when we return.
english.completed: Return to Grand Magister Rommath in Dalaran.

text.title: 最后一根稻草
text.objectives: 击败法师指挥官左洛斯然后逃出达拉然。
text.description: 我们找遍了他可能去的地方，除了紫罗兰城堡。$b$b去看看大法师艾萨斯是不是被关在城堡里了，$n。我们只能碰碰运气了。如果还是没有的话……至少我们今天也救了许多性命。
text.completion: Is this... $n? What's going on here?
text.completed: Report to Lor'themar Theron in Silvermoon City.

english.title: One Last Grasp
english.objectives: Slay Mage-Commander Zuros, then escape from Dalaran.
english.description: We've looked everywhere he's likely to be, except for one place: the Violet Citadel.$b$bFind out if Archmage Aethas is being held within the citadel, $n. We may get lucky. If not... at least we saved a number of lives today.
english.completion: Is this... $n? What's going on here?
english.completed: Report to Lor'themar Theron in Silvermoon City.

text.title: 返回卡桑琅
text.objectives: 去卡桑琅丛林的统御岗哨找纳兹戈林将军。
text.description: 无论你效忠谁——我和罗曼斯，或是加尔鲁什，或是别的什么人——有一件事是确定无疑的：你今天的行动非常英勇。$b$b我可以安排你传送回卡桑琅丛林。在你准备返回潘达利亚时，请告诉我一声，$n。
text.completion: <Nazgrim listens as you recount the day's events.>$B$BWe take the bell... and the Alliance takes Dalaran. That escalated quickly.$B$BWar is coming, $n. Be on your toes.

english.title: A Return to Krasarang
english.objectives: Report to General Nazgrim at Domination Point in Krasarang Wilds.
english.description: Wherever your loyalties might lie - with Rommath and I, with Garrosh, or elsewhere - one thing is true: your acts today were truly heroic.$b$bI can arrange for your transport back to Krasarang Wilds. Speak with me if you would like passage back to Pandaria, $n.
english.completion: <Nazgrim listens as you recount the day's events.>$B$BWe take the bell... and the Alliance takes Dalaran. That escalated quickly.$B$BWar is coming, $n. Be on your toes.

text.title: 达纳苏斯遭袭？
text.objectives: 去找雄狮港的谢默斯·金足，传送去达纳苏斯，到那以后与吉安娜谈一谈。
text.description: 你应该已经知道了，为了方便保管和研究，我们的暗夜精灵盟友将你夺回的圣钟运去了达纳苏斯。不久之前，他们派了几个高等精灵法师前来求援。具体情况不明——好像是有人偷袭了那座城市？$b$b我不知道那是怎么发生的，可吉安娜·普罗德摩尔已经赶到了现场。我想他们会需要一切可能的帮助。$b$b去跟那边的谢默斯·金足谈谈，快速传送去达纳苏斯，找到吉安娜！
text.completion: The Bell is gone...$B$BAt the scene of the crime, we found traces of arcane magic... I may be able to use my skills to track the thieves.
text.completed: Report to Lady Jaina Proudmoore outside of Darnassus.

english.title: Darnassus Attacked?
english.objectives: Speak with Seamus Goldenkicks in Lion's Landing to be ported to Darnassus, then speak with Jaina once you arrive.
english.description: As you know, our night elven allies moved the Divine Bell you retrieved to Darnassus for safekeeping and study. Moments ago, they portaled some Highbourne mages over here to ask for backup. Details are hazy - some sort of stealth attack on the city?$b$bI don't know what to make of it, but Jaina Proudmoore is already on the scene and I suspect they need all the help they can get.$b$bSpeak to Seamus Goldenkicks over there for a quick portal to Darnassus. Find Jaina!
english.completion: The Bell is gone...$B$BAt the scene of the crime, we found traces of arcane magic... I may be able to use my skills to track the thieves.
english.completed: Report to Lady Jaina Proudmoore outside of Darnassus.

text.title: 吉安娜的决意
text.objectives: 使用传送门从达纳苏斯前往达拉然，然后与另一边的温蕾萨·风行者谈一谈。
text.description: 长久以来，我一直在努力修补联盟和部落间的关系。我一次又一次的假定部落是无辜的——可他们却一次又一次的在背后捅我刀子。$b$b我绝不容忍又一次的背叛！如果部落想要将肯瑞托变成对付联盟的武器，那达拉然将不再有他们的位置。$b$b跟我来，$n。
text.completion: I will instruct you from here on out.$B$BJaina will be going down into the city to enforce our new rules.
text.completed: Report to Vereesa Windrunner in Dalaran.

english.title: Jaina's Resolution
english.objectives: Use the portal from Darnassus to Dalaran, then speak with Vereesa Windrunner on the other side.
english.description: For too long, I have toiled to mend fences between Alliance and Horde. Time and time again, I've given the Horde the benefit of the doubt - and time and time again, they stab me in the back.$b$bI refuse to be betrayed again! If the Horde intends to use the Kirin Tor as a weapon against the Alliance, then they have no place in Dalaran.$b$bCome with me, $n.
english.completion: I will instruct you from here on out.$B$BJaina will be going down into the city to enforce our new rules.
english.completed: Report to Vereesa Windrunner in Dalaran.

objectiveDetails.description: 使用达纳苏斯的传送门前往达拉然

text.title: 清理下水道
text.objectives: 在达拉然下水道中击败12名夺日者。
text.description: 吉安娜清理附近夺日者的行动很成功，但还有很多人躲在下水道里。$b$b去找出那些满口谎言的鼠辈并消灭他们！
text.completion: It's nice to have those rats out of here for good. Well done, hero.
text.completed: Return to Vereesa Windrunner in Dalaran.

english.title: Sewer Cleaning
english.objectives: Slay 12 Sunreavers in the Dalaran Sewers.
english.description: Jaina's doing a good job taking care of Sunreavers above ground, but there's still plenty rooting around in the sewers.$b$bGo find those lying rats and exterminate them!
english.completion: It's nice to have those rats out of here for good. Well done, hero.
english.completed: Return to Vereesa Windrunner in Dalaran.

objectiveDetails.description: 击败达拉然下水道中的夺日者

text.title: 不公平的交易
text.objectives: 击败墨水大师艾伦、托莉雅、火轮法师艾斯泰伦和辛瑟莉亚·织烬。
text.description: 魔法商业区的大部分商店老板都支持银色盟约，可还有一部分负隅顽抗的家伙需要我们去解决。$b$b<温蕾萨给你看了一份名单。>$b$b不能让他们轻易逃脱。
text.completion: While I can't say I agree completely with Jaina's methods, I do understand her motives.$B$BSometimes, you have to fight back.
text.completed: Return to Vereesa Windrunner in Dalaran.

english.title: Unfair Trade
english.objectives: Slay Inkmaster Aelon, Tolyria, Gearmage Astalon, and Sintharia Cinderweave.
english.description: Most shopkeepers in the Magus Commerce Exchange have sided with the Silver Covenant, but there remain a few holdouts that must be taken care of.$b$b<Vereesa shows you a list of names.>$b$bThey will not go easily.
english.completion: While I can't say I agree completely with Jaina's methods, I do understand her motives.$B$BSometimes, you have to fight back.
english.completed: Return to Vereesa Windrunner in Dalaran.

text.title: 无处可藏
text.objectives: 在夺日者圣殿击败16名夺日者。
text.description: 那些死忠部落的夺日者还躲在夺日者圣殿里。$b$b吉安娜会将那些愿意接受劝降的人送去紫罗兰监狱。而拒绝离开的人，则拿起了武器反抗我们。$b$b去让他们明白反抗的代价吧。他们将面对联盟、银色盟约和肯瑞托的审判！
text.completion: This is a bloody day, $n, and this is bloody work.$B$BBut do not forget what the Sunreavers did to bring this on: They used neutral Kirin Tor resources to aid the Horde in their fight against the Alliance.$B$BDo not hesitate to believe that they would do the same to us, given the chance.
text.completed: Return to Vereesa Windrunner in Dalaran.

english.title: Nowhere to Hide
english.objectives: Slay 16 Sunreavers in the Sunreaver's Sanctuary.
english.description: The Sunreaver's Sanctuary is still crawling with those Horde-loving Sunreavers.$b$bJaina will have sent the reasonable ones to the Violet Hold. The rest refuse to leave, raising their weapons against us.$b$bShow them the cost of their defiance. They now face the judgment of the Alliance, the Silver Covenant, and the Kirin Tor!
english.completion: This is a bloody day, $n, and this is bloody work.$B$BBut do not forget what the Sunreavers did to bring this on: They used neutral Kirin Tor resources to aid the Horde in their fight against the Alliance.$B$BDo not hesitate to believe that they would do the same to us, given the chance.
english.completed: Return to Vereesa Windrunner in Dalaran.

objectiveDetails.description: 击败夺日者圣殿中的夺日者

text.title: 兑现
text.objectives: 击败魔导师布拉塞尔。
text.description: 我刚刚看见一名夺日者——我想他叫布拉塞尔——朝北边的银行方向逃去了。毫无疑问，他是想在逃走前卷走一切财产。$b$b去找到他，绝不能让他偷走我们金库中的一分一毫。当他和他那些夺日者同党背叛我们的时候，他已经放弃了自己存在银行里的一切资产。
text.completion: I suppose it wasn't enough for him to be a coward and a backstabber... he had to be a greedy thief as well.$B$BHmph. The Horde and the Sunreavers aren't all that different. They deserve one another.
text.completed: Return to Vereesa Windrunner in Dalaran.

english.title: Cashing Out
english.objectives: Slay Magister Brasael.
english.description: I just saw one of the Sunreavers - Brasael, I think his name was - running off in the direction of the bank to the north. No doubt he's trying to gather whatever assets he can before he leaves.$b$bHead him off and make sure he doesn't steal any resources from our coffers. He relinquished whatever funds he left in the bank when he and his Sunreaver kind betrayed us.
english.completion: I suppose it wasn't enough for him to be a coward and a backstabber... he had to be a greedy thief as well.$B$BHmph. The Horde and the Sunreavers aren't all that different. They deserve one another.
english.completed: Return to Vereesa Windrunner in Dalaran.

text.title: 无处可逃
text.objectives: 令5头夺日者龙鹰失去飞行能力。
text.description: 投降的夺日者将被送去紫罗兰监狱。反抗者将死于利剑之下。$b$b他们一个也别想跑。$b$b夺日者将他们的龙鹰坐骑养在克拉苏斯平台上。带上这把粉尘，用它剥夺龙鹰的飞行能力。$b$b或者杀了它们，我不在乎。
text.completion: Now, the Sunreavers have to answer to us. Jail or death - their fate is in their own hands.
text.completed: Return to Vereesa Windrunner in Dalaran.

english.title: Nowhere to Run
english.objectives: Render 5 Sunreaver Dragonhawks incapable of flying.
english.description: Compliant Sunreavers will be sent to the Violet Hold. Defiant ones are put to the sword.$b$bNONE are to escape.$b$bThe Sunreavers keep their dragonhawk mounts on Krasus' Landing. Take this dust, and use it to render them incapable of flying.$b$bOr kill them. I don't care.
english.completion: Now, the Sunreavers have to answer to us. Jail or death - their fate is in their own hands.
english.completed: Return to Vereesa Windrunner in Dalaran.

text.title: 有所必为
text.objectives: 去找温蕾萨·风行者交谈以前往雄狮港，到那以后与瓦里安·乌瑞恩国王谈一谈。
text.description: 感谢你今天的帮助，$n。从现在起，整肃工作就由我来负责了。$b$b吉安娜很快就会去雄狮港与瓦里安会谈。她希望你也能在场。
text.completion: I can't fault you for following orders. In fact, I can't really fault Jaina for acting on her own behalf, for once.$B$BBut still... we aren't playing a game here. We are dealing with war, with people's lives, with the future of the Alliance itself.$B$BAt the very least, we now have the Kirin Tor on our side. Today will be remembered by all as a victory for the Alliance.

english.title: What Had To Be Done
english.objectives: Speak with Vereesa Windrunner to travel to Lion's Landing, then speak with King Varian Wrynn.
english.description: Thank you for your aid today, $n. I will be handling the purge from here on out.$b$bJaina will soon be off to Lion's Landing, to speak with King Varian. She asked for your attendance.
english.completion: I can't fault you for following orders. In fact, I can't really fault Jaina for acting on her own behalf, for once.$B$BBut still... we aren't playing a game here. We are dealing with war, with people's lives, with the future of the Alliance itself.$B$BAt the very least, we now have the Kirin Tor on our side. Today will be remembered by all as a victory for the Alliance.

text.title: 烦而不乱
text.objectives: 去搏击俱乐部的贵宾室找到基尔特教授。
text.description: 好吧，我来告诉该怎么找康奈利。$b$b特工康奈利现在假扮成了烂赌鬼——基尔特教授。他大部分时间都呆在贵宾室里。据说他跟踪某位拳手而来，一个早就被人遗忘的叛徒。$b$b不幸的是，只有拥有邀请函的人才能进入贵宾室。而幸运的是，我正好就有一张。$b$b你走过那些保镖身边时，尽量不要引人注意。如果你被抓住了，千万别说邀请函是我给的。$b$b事实上，咱俩根本就没见过！
text.completion: So the SI: 7 needs a reminder in what the word retirement means?$B$BI suppose they wouldn't be comin' to me if the situation weren't dire.$B$BI'll help, but I'll need a few days to gather some intel.

english.title: Stirred, Not Shaken
english.objectives: Find Professor Kilt in the Boom Room in Bizmo's Brawlpub.
english.description: Alright, I'll tell you how to find Connelly.$b$bAgent Connelly is currently posing as the high roller, Professor Kilt. He spends most of his time in the Boom Room. Rumor has it he's after one of the fighters for some long forgotten betrayal.$b$bUnfortunately, the lounge is by invitation only. Lucky for you I just happen to have an invitation.$b$bTry not to look too obvious when you walk past the bouncers. If you get caught you didn't get this pass from me.$b$bIn fact you and I have never met!
english.completion: So the SI: 7 needs a reminder in what the word retirement means?$B$BI suppose they wouldn't be comin' to me if the situation weren't dire.$B$BI'll help, but I'll need a few days to gather some intel.

text.title: 领袖的标准
text.objectives: 与迷雾酒肆的拉希奥谈一谈。
text.description: 我们的熊猫人战役已经发展到了新的阶段。你们的酋长试图以部落的强大武力震慑熊猫人。无论熊猫人是否愿意，他都会攫取这片土地的资源。$b$b我理解你们领袖的意愿，但我更想理解酋长本人的意图。到底是什么在驱使着他？部落究竟会走向何方？我想跟你谈谈你们的这位领袖。
text.completion: Like all great leaders, Garrosh has greatly extended himself. Just what is he ultimately capable of?$B$BMore importantly, what YOU are capable of? Fresh bloodshed along the coast gives us an opportunity to find out...
text.completed: Speak with Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

english.title: The Measure of a Leader
english.objectives: Speak with Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists.
english.description: We've progressed to a new part of the Pandaren campaign. Your Warchief aims to impress the Pandaren with the full might of the Horde's military. He will lay claim to the resources of this land, with or without Pandaren aid.$b$bI understand your leader's aims, but I really want to understand the Warchief himself. What drives him? And where is the Horde ultimately going? I'd like to talk to you about this leader of yours.
english.completion: Like all great leaders, Garrosh has greatly extended himself. Just what is he ultimately capable of?$B$BMore importantly, what YOU are capable of? Fresh bloodshed along the coast gives us an opportunity to find out...
english.completed: Speak with Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

text.title: 熊猫人驭灵师
text.objectives: 在宠物对战中击败所有的熊猫人古灵。
text.description: 传说在潘达利亚游荡着一些神秘的熊猫人古灵。去找到他们，并在战斗中击败他们吧。
text.completion: I can't belive you took out those spirits!
text.completed: Return to the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
text.giverWindow: 打败那些古灵！

text.title: 朝令夕改
text.objectives: 去卡桑琅丛林的雄狮港击败大元帅双辫。建议你组队前往。
text.description: 我一直在密切监视一个联盟矮人将军。大元帅双辫是个棘手的家伙。巴尔莫丹失陷之后，他在南贫瘠之地击退了部落部队。他现在就呆在雄狮港的联盟堡垒里帮助协调卡桑琅的反攻战。$b$b只有由部落的传奇英雄组成的队伍才有可能打败他。$b$b如果你想干掉他，一定找几个朋友一起去。记得多带点人。
text.completion: <Wrathion grins.>$B$BYou were being tested, $c. I knew you were capable of great things by yourself.$B$BBut you have proven to me that you have the makings of a leader, cobbling together support among a group of strangers in the midst of a battlefield.$B$BThe Horde is fortunate to have you.
text.completed: Return to Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

english.title: A Change of Command
english.objectives: Kill High Marshal Twinbraid at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds. You will need a group.
english.description: There's an Alliance dwarf I've been keeping a close eye on. High Marshal Twinbraid proved to be a nuisance in Southern Barrens when he struck back at the Horde after the loss of Bael Modan. He's now entrenched within the Alliance stronghold in Lion's Landing, helping to orchestrate the Krasarang counter-offensive.$b$bOnly a legendary group of Horde heroes could possibly defeat him.$b$bIf you wish to finish him off, bring friends. Lots of friends.
english.completion: <Wrathion grins.>$B$BYou were being tested, $c. I knew you were capable of great things by yourself.$B$BBut you have proven to me that you have the makings of a leader, cobbling together support among a group of strangers in the midst of a battlefield.$B$BThe Horde is fortunate to have you.
english.completed: Return to Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

text.title: 荣耀属于部落
text.objectives: 赢得寇魔古寺和碎银矿脉的胜利。
text.description: 这是一场全球战争，$n。它不仅波及了潘达利亚，卡利姆多和东部王国也同样战火频燃。你在有组织的战场上会表现如何呢？我很想亲眼看一看。$b$b我期待听到你从前线带回的报告。
text.completion: <Wrathion hungrily listens to tales of your exploits on the battlefield, his eyes gleaming bright red.>$B$BOhh... oh! Incredible! In the very eye of battle, one's true heart is revealed.$B$BYou do not disappoint, $n.$B$BNeither does this Horde of yours.
text.completed: Return to Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

english.title: Glory to the Horde
english.objectives: Win battles at the Temple of Kotmogu and the Silvershard Mines.
english.description: This is a global war, $n. It has spilled onto Pandaria, and it has set hot spots across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms ablaze. How will you fare on an organized battlefront? I would like to see for myself.$b$bI look forward to hearing your report from the front lines.
english.completion: <Wrathion hungrily listens to tales of your exploits on the battlefield, his eyes gleaming bright red.>$B$BOhh... oh! Incredible! In the very eye of battle, one's true heart is revealed.$B$BYou do not disappoint, $n.$B$BNeither does this Horde of yours.
english.completed: Return to Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

text.title: 部落之魂
text.objectives: 与拉希奥谈一谈。
text.description: $C，通过你的眼睛，我也见证了海滩上的激战，那是一场震动世界的史诗战役。你很有耐心……并提供了大量情报。$b$b我一直在密切关注加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮。你想听听我对他的看法吗？
text.completion: <A strange device sits within an ornate silk-lined chest. It appears as though it can be fastened to your sha-touched weapon as an additional upgrade. The empty socket is disconcerting; you feel as though it is staring back at you. A single, hollow, judgmental eye...>

english.objectives: Speak with Wrathion.
english.description: $C, through your eyes I've been able to witness the fighting along the coast, and the epic course of battles around the world. You've been very patient... and most informative.$b$bI've also been keeping a close eye on Garrosh Hellscream. Would you be interested to hear what I've learned?

text.objectives: Destroy Grezik Oregrind at Oregrind's Dig.
text.description: Grezik Oregrind has become a nuisance that must be eliminated.$b$bThis land responds to all of our actions as I am sure you are aware, $c. Because of this, we cannot allow the goblins to haphazardly destroy it.$b$bOur scouts have reported Sha emerging from Oregrind's Dig. The brains behind the operation is a goblin named Grezik Oregrind.$b$bDestroy him and perhaps we will stall the operation just long enough to contain the Sha.
text.completed: Return to Sky Admiral Rogers aboard the Skyfire.

text.title: 迫在眉睫
text.objectives: 完成任务“迫在眉睫”。
text.description: 大宗师，我们的斥候发现一艘恶魔的指挥舰出现在地平线上，它的航向似乎与迷踪岛相冲突。$B$B我们应该进行部署，以备迎接最糟糕的情况——一场全力进攻。$B$B与此同时，让我们先派出勇士，试着转移军团战舰的注意力。

text.title: 拆卸请求
text.objectives: 使用重置的遥控器摧毁丛林伐木机并收集6个废金属。
text.description: 那些伐木机已经变成了一个大麻烦，$c。$b$b我们派出了机械碾压者，可这还不够。它们损坏的速度比我们修理的速度还要快！$b$b我在侦察时，凑巧捡到了这个奇怪的遥控器。我想只要稍微重置一下，我们就能使用它了。$b$b去对丛林伐木机使用这个遥控器，但愿它能摧毁它们。还有，把那些废金属带回来给我。
text.progress: So what did that remote do?
text.completion: Goblin construction leaves somethin' to be desired, but it'll have to do. Good work, $n!
text.completed: Return to Sully "The Pickle" McLeary aboard the Skyfire.

english.title: Dis-Assembly Required
english.objectives: Destroy the Jungle Shredders using the Re-Configured Remote and then collect 6 pieces of Scrap Metal.
english.description: Those shredders are becoming a problem down there, $c.$b$bWe've sent in the Mecha-Pounders, but it just isn't enough. They're getting damaged faster than we can repair 'em!$b$bI happened upon this strange remote while scouting. With a little bit of re-configurin' I think we can use it.$b$bTry usin' it on the Jungle Shredders. Hopefully it will destroy them and then you can bring me the scrap metal.
english.progress: So what did that remote do?
english.completion: Goblin construction leaves somethin' to be desired, but it'll have to do. Good work, $n!
english.completed: Return to Sully "The Pickle" McLeary aboard the Skyfire.

text.title: 旧日的羁绊
text.objectives: 获得瓦拉图的灵魂精华。
text.description: 我在锦绣谷时，得到了一份酿造溯源酒的熊猫人古方。我相信这种酒能帮我们从单简那里挖出有用信息。$B$B这里离不开我，所以我只能请你帮我去收集材料了。我们需要一个与我们想看的记忆处在同时代的魔古族灵魂精华。$B$B你可以在东北边的征服者之路找到这样的幽灵。
text.progress: You never know what you will find in a book. Especially an ancient pandaren one.$B$BI'm eager to see how this Memory Wine works.
text.completion: Ah, very good. This is the last thing we needed.
text.completed: Return to Baine Bloodhoof at the Garrosh'ar Advance.

english.title: Ties with the Past
english.objectives: Recover the Spirit Essence of Varatus.
english.description: While I was in the Vale, I came across an ancient pandaren recipe for Memory Wine. I believe this brew can coax some helpful information out of Shan Kien.$B$BI am needed here, so I have no choice but to ask you to recover the essential ingredient for me. We need the spirit essence of a mogu that lived in the time of the memory we wish to see.$B$BYou should be able to find just such a spirit inside the Path of Conquerors, to the northeast.
english.progress: You never know what you will find in a book. Especially an ancient pandaren one.$B$BI'm eager to see how this Memory Wine works.
english.completion: Ah, very good. This is the last thing we needed.
english.completed: Return to Baine Bloodhoof at the Garrosh'ar Advance.

text.title: 敖骨打废墟
text.objectives: 去火箭岗哨找贝洛克·辉刃。
text.description: 我们在火箭岗哨的斥候报告说，一个名为敖骨打废墟的地方附近有新情况。$b$b我们需要收集相关情报，看看联盟在那里做什么。更重要的是，我们得知道他们发现了什么。我们不能留下情报的盲区。$b$b快去火箭岗哨找到贝洛克·辉刃，看看他知道些什么。
text.completion: We have a lot of work to do, $c. Who knows what has already been uncovered in Ogudei!

english.title: The Ruins of Ogudei
english.objectives: Report to Belloc Brightblade in Sparkrocket Outpost.
english.description: Our scouts at Sparkrocket Outpost have reported some new activity near an area called the Ruins of Ogudei.$b$bWe need to gather intelligence on what it is the Alliance are doing, and more importantly what it is they found. We cannot afford to have any unknowns.$b$bMeet up with Belloc Brightblade in Sparkrocket Outpost and find out what he knows.
english.completion: We have a lot of work to do, $c. Who knows what has already been uncovered in Ogudei!

text.title: 就是现在！
text.objectives: 去火箭岗哨找匿踪大师琪麟。
text.description: 决一死战的时候到了，$c！$b$b去火箭岗哨找匿踪大师琪麟。她会给你下命令的。$b$b我倒要看看，当部落全力攻击他们那个宝贝堡垒时，他们会如何应对！
text.completion: Now things can get interesting! I have a few plans for Lion's Landing...

english.title: The Time Is Now!
english.objectives: Report to Shademaster Kiryn in Sparkrocket Outpost.
english.description: Now we take the fight to them, $c!$b$bReport to Shademaster Kiryn in Sparkrocket Outpost. She will have your orders.$b$bNow we'll see how they handle the full might of the Horde rushing at their precious keep!
english.completion: Now things can get interesting! I have a few plans for Lion's Landing...

text.title: 明确的信息
text.objectives: 去卡桑琅丛林的天火号找空军上将罗杰斯。
text.description: 是时候让那些部落杂碎看看联盟的实力了！今天我们要将战火烧到他们家门口。$b$b去天火号上找空军上将罗杰斯，她会给你下达进一步的指令。$b$b祝你好运，$c。让联盟为你骄傲吧！
text.completion: The battle is already underway, $c. Let's get you out there!

english.title: Send A Message
english.objectives: Report to Sky Admiral Rogers aboard the Skyfire in Krasarang Wilds.
english.description: It's time we show these Horde mongrels the full strength of the Alliance! Today we bring the battle to their door.$b$bReport to Admiral Rogers aboard the Skyfire. She will have further instructions.$b$bGood luck out there, $c. Do the Alliance proud!
english.completion: The battle is already underway, $c. Let's get you out there!

text.title: 还有地精
text.objectives: 去卡桑琅丛林的天火号找空军上将罗杰斯。
text.description: 我们正在打一场全面战争，$c。就连潘达利亚本身也需要我们的保护。$b$b锈水地精正在摧残不属于他们的土地。我们必须阻止他们！$b$b快去天火号上找空军上将罗杰斯。她占据了有利地形，应该可以找出他们的弱点。
text.completion: It's about time we dealt with this nuisance. Those Bilgewater runts need to be taught a lesson!

english.title: And Then There Were Goblins
english.objectives: Report to Sky Admiral Rogers aboard the Skyfire in Krasarang Wilds.
english.description: We're fighting a war on all fronts, $c. Even Pandaria itself needs our protection.$b$bThe Bilgewater goblins are destroying land that doesn't belong to them. They must be stopped!$b$bReport to Sky Admiral Rogers aboard the Skyfire. From her vantage point she should have a good idea of where their weak spots are.
english.completion: It's about time we dealt with this nuisance. Those Bilgewater runts need to be taught a lesson!

text.title: 寂静无声
text.objectives: 使用联盟信号枪。
text.description: 我们……成功……了吗？$B$B<安度因努力吐出了几个词，这显然消耗了他大量的精力。>$B$B看……我的……包……$B$B用……信号……
text.completion: I hesitate to guess what would have happened if you had not been there with the young Prince, $n.$B$BToday, you put an end to Garrosh's plans.$B$BYou have undoubtedly saved thousands of lives, and most importantly, you brought Anduin back to us.$B$BWe are doing everything we can for the boy, but we can only wait and see.$B$BI believe he has the fight in him. I must believe it...
text.completed: Speak to Admiral Taylor at Lion's Landing in the Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: The Silence
english.objectives: Use the Alliance Flare Gun.
english.description: D..did we... do it?$B$B<Anduin mumbles the words, even though the effort clearly costs him.>$B$BL..look... in.. my... bag...$B$BUse... flare...
english.completion: I hesitate to guess what would have happened if you had not been there with the young Prince, $n.$B$BToday, you put an end to Garrosh's plans.$B$BYou have undoubtedly saved thousands of lives, and most importantly, you brought Anduin back to us.$B$BWe are doing everything we can for the boy, but we can only wait and see.$B$BI believe he has the fight in him. I must believe it...
english.completed: Speak to Admiral Taylor at Lion's Landing in the Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 雷电之王
text.objectives: 在雾纱栈道的迷雾酒肆二楼与拉希奥取得联系。
text.description: 你注意到昆莱山最近的情况了吗？大量赞达拉巨魔已经登上了北部海岸并开始拉拢旧日的盟友了。为此，他们复活了雷电之王。$b$b即使在魔古族当中，这位开国皇帝的名字仍然等同于敬畏和恐惧。雷电之王曾建立起一个充满奴役和苦难的庞大帝国……可它也同样强大、富饶、显赫。$b$b我们很快就将与他开战。当你的阵营开始行动时，请再来找我。
text.completion: The Sunreavers and the Kirin-Tor are mounting an assault on the Thunder King's base of operations! My new friend here and I were just discussing the ramifications of their attack.$B$BYou and I can stand to benefit from the situation, $n. I have a few ideas...
text.completed: 去雾纱栈道的迷雾酒肆二楼找拉希奥。

english.title: The Thunder King
english.objectives: Contact Wrathion on the second floor of the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.
english.description: Are you aware of recent events in Kun-Lai Summit? The Zandalari have landed on the northern shores in great numbers and have set about renewing old alliances. To that end, they have resurrected The Thunder King.$b$bEven among the mogu, the name of the first emperor commands awe and fear. The Thunder King founded a vast empire of slavery and suffering... but also of power, riches, and splendor.$b$bWe will take the fight to him soon. Find me when your faction makes its move.
english.completion: The Sunreavers and the Kirin-Tor are mounting an assault on the Thunder King's base of operations! My new friend here and I were just discussing the ramifications of their attack.$B$BYou and I can stand to benefit from the situation, $n. I have a few ideas...
english.completed: Contact Wrathion on the second floor of the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

text.title: 追捕窃贼
text.objectives: 帮助吉安娜找出是谁夺走了圣钟，并把它藏在哪里。你可以去找雄狮港的谢默斯·金足，传送去达纳苏斯。
text.description:
我们一定要彻查此事。

$n，你跟我来。如果有必要的话，即使搜遍这座城市的每一个角落，我们也要找出他们窃取圣钟的手段……和地点。

我在这里追踪到了魔法的踪迹……我们得跟着线索走！
text.completion: I've decided.$B$BCertain members of the Kirin-Tor have put their allegiance to the Horde above the order, and I will NOT tolerate it. This is nothing short of a betrayal.$B$B<Jaina's eyes flare with rage.>$B$BCome with me, $n. We're going to clean up Dalaran.
text.completed: Report to Lady Jaina Proudmoore outside of Darnassus.

english.title: Tracking the Thieves
english.objectives: Help Jaina discover who took the Divine Bell, and where they took it. You may speak with Seamus Goldenkicks in Lion's Landing to be ported to Darnassus.
english.description:
We WILL get to the bottom of this.

$n, you're coming with me. We'll search every inch of this city if we have to, but we'll find out how they took the bell... and where.

I'm picking up traces of arcane magic here... we need to follow the trail!
english.completion: I've decided.$B$BCertain members of the Kirin-Tor have put their allegiance to the Horde above the order, and I will NOT tolerate it. This is nothing short of a betrayal.$B$B<Jaina's eyes flare with rage.>$B$BCome with me, $n. We're going to clean up Dalaran.
english.completed: Report to Lady Jaina Proudmoore outside of Darnassus.

text.title: 云端翔龙骑士团
text.objectives: 去翡翠林的百木园和天荆教头谈一谈。
text.description: 啊，看来你已经光荣地获得了一头威严的云端翔龙。$B$B在你骑上这头强大的生物翱翔天际之前，你必须学会驾驭它的技巧。$B$B云端翔龙骑士团能够教你这种骑术。$B$B如果你希望追寻我们的道路，你应该去翡翠林的百木园和天荆教头谈一谈。$B$B祝你好运，$r。
text.completion: Ah, have you come to join the Order?
text.giverWindow: 只有少数人才能获得骑上云端翔龙的荣誉。

english.title: The Order of the Cloud Serpent
english.objectives: Speak to Instructor Skythorn at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.
english.description: Ahhh, it seems you have found yourself the proud owner of a majestic cloud serpent.$B$BBefore you may fly the skies on this powerful creature, you must first earn the skill to ride it.$B$BThe Order of the Cloud Serpent can teach you the knowledge that you seek.$B$BIf you wish to follow our way, you should speak to Instructor Skythorn at The Arboretum in the Jade Forest.$B$BI wish you luck, $r.
english.completion: Ah, have you come to join the Order?
english.giverWindow: To ride a cloud serpent is a privilege given to few.

text.title: Sacrificial Prevention [PH]
text.objectives: Kill 5 Zandalari Priests.
text.description:
The Zandalari Priests in the town to the north prepare the bodies of our fallen allies for sacrifice.

The best way to prevent this from happening? Kill them. Kill them all.
text.completed: Return to Dodge south of the Troll Town in Isle of the Thunder King.

english.title: Sacrificial Prevention [PH]
english.objectives: Kill 5 Zandalari Priests.
english.description:
The Zandalari Priests in the town to the north prepare the bodies of our fallen allies for sacrifice.

The best way to prevent this from happening? Kill them. Kill them all.
english.completed: Return to Dodge south of the Troll Town in Isle of the Thunder King.

text.title: 澄澈水晶
text.objectives: 从荆棘谷的尤亚姆巴岛的水晶之脊主母身上收集一个原生水晶碎片。
text.description:
如果你有兴趣的话，有个办法可以强化你的自拍神器。只要拿到合适的聚焦透镜，我就可以给那玩意添加很多功能。

我听说，有人在荆棘谷的尤亚姆巴岛上看到了蜥蜴之母。她的外皮上点缀着许多宝石，是做透镜的完美材料。你只要把宝石交给我，其他就包在我身上。

但她可没那么容易对付，你最好带上几个朋友。
text.completed: Return to Dodge south of the Troll Town in Isle of the Thunder King.

english.title: Disarming Axe Throwers [PH]
english.objectives: Collect 6 Edged Throwing Axes.
english.description:
The Zandalari Edgetossers to the north are known for becoming fierce Pterodactyl riders and axe throwers. Even now, they train the Pterodactly Hatchlings to become ravenous beasts.

Please, dispatch of some of the Edgetossers and bring back some of their throwing axes so they cannot be used against us.
english.completed: Return to Dodge south of the Troll Town in Isle of the Thunder King.

text.title: 澄澈水晶
text.objectives: 从荆棘谷的尤亚姆巴岛的水晶之脊主母身上收集一个原生水晶碎片。
text.description:
又见面了！哦，我忘了告诉你！我设计了简单好用的方法，可以强化你的自拍神器！

只要有合适的宝石，我就可以做出一种万能镜头！

有些探险者同行告诉我说，荆棘谷的尤亚姆巴岛上有只大蜥蜴。她的外皮上满是高级水晶！真是个美丽的巧合！

但她非常，非常厉害！你最好带几个朋友一起去！
text.completed: Return to Dodge south of the Troll Town in Isle of the Thunder King.

english.title: Urging on Hatchlings [PH]
english.objectives: Frighten 12 Pterodactyl Hatchlings.
english.description:
The Pterodactyl Hatchlings being trained by Zandalari to the north are not yet the violent and savage beasts they are to become.

I believe we should save these creatures before the trolls corrupt them. If you could just frighten them off, perhaps some of them will be spared an unfortunate fate.
english.completed: Return to Dodge south of the Troll Town in Isle of the Thunder King.

text.title: 灯光，镜头，开拍
text.objectives: 在暴风城内的位置收集一个铁盒子和一条赤色腰带，并从一名工程师处获得一个普通瞄准镜。
text.description:
哦，嗨！这张照片是不是棒极了？我真喜欢我的自拍神器！

你想让我给你也做一个，是吧？我只要几个配件就行！

带子的话，我需要暴风城的护甲商人出售的赤色腰带。

外壳的话，我已经下好单了，你可以直接去拿，只要查到我的货送到哪儿了就好！

哦，还要一个普通瞄准镜，基本上只要是工程师就会做。

那么，你的姿势摆好了吗？！
text.completed: Return to Dodge south of the Troll Town in Isle of the Thunder King.

english.title: Plundering Profferings [PH]
english.objectives: Collect 15 Plundered Profferings.
english.description:
While the Zandalari perform live sacrifices, they will not offend their gods by sacrificing a life without also sacrificing offerings of food, treasure, and other items of value.

Recover some of the offerings from cairns in the Troll Town to the north so we might delay their sacrifices further.
english.completed: Return to Dodge south of the Troll Town in Isle of the Thunder King.

text.title: 灯光，镜头，开拍
text.objectives: 在奥格瑞玛内的位置收集一个铁盒子和一条赤色腰带，并从一名工程师处获得一个普通瞄准镜。
text.description:
看来你对视觉艺术的眼光还不错，想试试亲手拍照吗？

我可以给你制作一个自拍神器，但我需要几个配件。

带子的话，去附近的护甲商人那里给我找条赤色腰带就好。

我多订了一单外壳，放在了奥格瑞玛后门，你路过时可以顺路给我拿一个。

哦，还有一个普通瞄准镜，只要是工程师应该就会做的。

行动起来吧，小鬼。艺术的巅峰在向你招手！
text.completed: Return to Dodge south of the Troll Town in Isle of the Thunder King.

english.title: Apple Crushing [PH]
english.objectives: Crush 20 apples.
english.description: The troops love cider. Hard cider. Before we can make any, we need to get all these apples crushed. Mind giving us a hand - or a foot - and crushing some of the apples in that vat behind me?
english.completed: Return to Dodge south of the Troll Town in Isle of the Thunder King.

text.title: Frighten Pterodactyls [PH]
text.objectives: Frighten 12 Pterodactyl Hatchlings.
text.description:
The Pterodactyl Hatchlings being trained by Zandalari to the north are not yet the violent and savage beasts they are to become.

I believe we should save these creatures before the trolls corrupt them. If you could just frighten them off, perhaps some of them will be spared an unfortunate fate.
text.completed: Return to Dodge south of the Troll Town in Isle of the Thunder King.

text.title: 勇气的试炼
text.objectives: 获取总共3000点勇气点数，达成“勇气的试炼”成就。
text.description: <毫无征兆地，拉希奥朝他的拇指上划了一道口子，并将这根手指贴上了你的额头。他的血液带有烧灼的触感，不过很快就渗入你的皮肤并消失了。>$b$b好了！我的眼睛会跟随你，$c。我在注视着你。$b$b那些熊猫人，和联盟一样崇尚“勇气”。在这片大陆上，你有很多种办法证明你的勇气。你可以去完成日常任务，也可以深入强大敌人的巢穴将他们击败。我会让你自己去选择你的事业。$b$b向我证明你的勇气吧，$n！
text.completion: <Wrathion nods slowly.>$B$BYes, $n. I saw your deeds, and I was most impressed.$B$BYou are truly an instrument of change.
text.completed: Return to Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

english.title: A Test of Valor
english.objectives: Gain the "A Test of Valor" Achievement by earning a total of 3000 Valor Points.
english.description: <Without warning Wrathion slices his thumb and presses it against your forehead. His blood burns to the touch, but rapidly disappears into your skin.>$b$bThere! My eye is upon you, $c. I am watching.$b$bThe Pandaren, like the Alliance, value the concept of "Valor." There are many ways to prove yourself valorous on this continent, from daily tasks to the defeat of heroic enemies within their lair. I will let you choose your own course.$b$bProve your bravery to me, $n!
english.completion: <Wrathion nods slowly.>$B$BYes, $n. I saw your deeds, and I was most impressed.$B$BYou are truly an instrument of change.
english.completed: Return to Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

text.title: 生命的閃光
text.objectives: 將雷紋雲蛟蛋帶去雷王島給雅里亞‧賢語者。
text.description: 當你握著雷紋雲蛟蛋時，手心感到一陣灼熱。你想起影潘的雅里亞‧賢語者曾談論過雷霆雲蛟的歷史，也許她知道該怎麼辦。

english.title: A Spark of Life
english.objectives: Deliver the Thunder-Laced Egg to Yalia Sagewhisper on the Isle of Thunder.
english.description: The Thunder-Laced Egg burns your hand as you hold it. You recall that Yalia Sagewhisper of the Shado-Pan discussing the history of the Thundering Cloud Serpents, perhaps she will know what to do with it.

I will let you choose your own course.$b$bProve your bravery to me, $n!
text.completion: <Wrathion nods slowly.>$B$BYes, $n. I saw your deeds, and I was most impressed.$B$BYou are truly an instrument of change.
text.completed: Return to Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

text.title: Tracking Event: Player is Back in Time

english.title: Tracking Event: Player is Back in Time

text.title: 加强防御
text.objectives: 在紫罗兰高地附近强化6个肯瑞托监视结界。
text.description: 这座岛屿十分危险，$n。我们要提防来自赞达拉巨魔、魔古族、蜥蜴人的攻击，最要命的是，还有夺日者。$b$b我在我们营地外围布满了监视结界，以提供额外保护。在当前状态下，它们只会对一名攻击者造成伤害，可我已经厌倦警告了！$b$b在你的帮助下，我们可以强化这些结界，把它们变成更具致命杀伤力的防御系统。
text.completion: Excellent work, $n. Those perimeter wards should keep out all manner of filth.$B$BWith Violet Rise protected we can focus on more pressing matters.
text.completed: Return to Lady Jaina Proudmoore at the Violet Rise.

english.title: Bolstering the Defenses
english.objectives: Empower 6 Kirin Tor Perimeter Wards around Violet Rise.
english.description: This island is a dangerous place, $n. We have to worry about attacks from the Zandalari, mogu, saurok, and worst of all the Sunreavers.$b$bI had perimeter wards placed on the outskirts of our camp for additional protection. In their current state they will only injure an attacker, but I'm done with warnings!$b$bWith your help we can super-charge the wards into a more deadly defense system.
english.completion: Excellent work, $n. Those perimeter wards should keep out all manner of filth.$B$BWith Violet Rise protected we can focus on more pressing matters.
english.completed: Return to Lady Jaina Proudmoore at the Violet Rise.

text.title: 伊瓜鲁克的恐怖地毯
text.objectives: 踩死75只伊瓜鲁克蟑螂。
text.description: 啊，蟑螂！我曾在幽暗城买过一只宠物蟑螂。$b$b蟑螂会像海绵一样吸收病菌，然后将它们散播到自己所经之处。而它们的活动范围偏偏又很广。$b$b伊瓜鲁克峭壁上爬满了这种东西，将邪刃部族的秽物传播到岛上的每一个角落。当你去那里时，记得尽可能多踩死几只蟑螂。
text.completion: Every little bit helps.
text.completed: Return to Amalia Penshire on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: The Creeping Carpet of Ihgaluk
english.objectives: Crush 75 Ihgaluk Roaches.
english.description: Ah, roaches! I once bought a pet roach in the Undercity.$b$bRoaches will soak up disease like a sponge, and then spread it as far as they can run. Which is pretty far.$b$bIhgaluk Crag is crawling with the things, and they carry Skumblade filth all over of this island. Crush as many of them as you can while you're there.
english.completion: Every little bit helps.
english.completed: Return to Amalia Penshire on the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 任其腐烂
text.objectives: 摧毁3堆恶臭肉堆。
text.description: 邪刃蜥蜴人并不会将他们打到的肉全吃光。他们会将大部分的肉堆在房子附近，任由其腐烂，以吸引害虫并散播病毒。$b$b我们不能让蜥蜴人将病毒散播到伊瓜鲁克峭壁以外的地方。快去处理掉那些剩余的肉类吧。
text.completion: Left standing, those piles of discarded food are the perfect breeding ground for disease.$B$BWere I still in the disease-spreading business, I'd consider using them myself.
text.completed: Return to Amalia Penshire on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Left To Rot
english.objectives: Destroy 3 Fetid Meat Piles.
english.description: The Skumblade saurok do not eat all of the meat they hunt. They reserve large portions of it to rot in piles near their homes, attracting pests and spreading disease.$b$bWe can't have the saurok spreading their disease beyond the borders of Ihgaluk Crag. Dispose of any excess meat that you find.
english.completion: Left standing, those piles of discarded food are the perfect breeding ground for disease.$B$BWere I still in the disease-spreading business, I'd consider using them myself.
english.completed: Return to Amalia Penshire on the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 他们都倒下了
text.objectives: 消灭5名缚灵哨兵，并使用共振水晶捕捉被禁锢在哨兵中的赞达拉巨魔灵魂。
text.description: 赞达拉巨魔是不会怜悯部落中的弱者的，$c。$b$b那些被视为弱者的人常常会被当成野蛮仪式中的祭品。受害者的灵魂会被禁锢到那些担任守卫的哨兵里。$b$b我想要研究一下他们的精华。因此我需要你的帮助。$b$b带上这枚共振水晶，将灵魂从哨兵的尸体里吸出来。$b$b别让它们跑了！
text.completion: Excellent work, $c! This will aid my studies greatly, as well as advance our cause here.
text.completed: Return to Magister Edien Sunhollow within the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: They All Fall Down
english.objectives: Kill 5 Spirit-Bound Sentries and then use the Resonance Crystal to capture the Zandalari Spirits trapped within.
english.description: The Zandalari do not tolerate weakness in their ranks, $c.$b$bThose that are deemed weak are often sacrificed in barbaric ceremonies. The victims' spirits are captured and entombed within the sentries you see guarding the grounds.$b$bI wish to study their essence. For this I will need your help.$b$bTake this resonance crystal and siphon the spirits from the sentry corpses.$b$b Do not allow them to escape!
english.completion: Excellent work, $c! This will aid my studies greatly, as well as advance our cause here.
english.completed: Return to Magister Edien Sunhollow within the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 以多打少
text.objectives: 从征服者平台的缚灵者图切克和魔术士拉古尔处夺取黑暗秘法面具和唤魂者面具。
text.description: 赞达拉巨魔有一种方法，能将他们的神灵精华注入到强大的物品中去。这些物品通常都是代代相传，而每一个继承者都会增添物品的威力。$b$b这里就有两件这样的物品。确切的说，是两个面具，分别在两兄弟的手中。$b$b我们必须阻止缚灵者图切克和魔术士拉古尔，并摧毁他们的面具。$b$b快去击败他们，将他们的面具带回来给我。我会处理掉这些面具的。
text.progress: Do you have the masks?
text.completion: Getting these masks was no easy task, $c. I am grateful for your service.
text.completed: Return to Magister Edien Sunhollow in the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Power Play
english.objectives: Retrieve the Mask of the Dark Mystic and the Mask of the Spirit-Caller from Spiritbinder Tu'chek and Arcanital Ra'kul within Conqueror's Terrace.
english.description: The Zandalari have found a way to infuse items of great power with the essence of their loa. These items are often passed from one generation to another, each recipient adding to the item's power.$b$bTwo such items exist here. To be specific, two masks, worn by two brothers.$b$bSpiritbinder Tu'chek and Arcanital Ra'kul must be stopped and their masks destroyed.$b$bKill them and return their masks to me. I will make sure the masks are disposed of.
english.progress: Do you have the masks?
english.completion: Getting these masks was no easy task, $c. I am grateful for your service.
english.completed: Return to Magister Edien Sunhollow in the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 放血者
text.objectives: 击败放血者喀岱。
text.description: 我收到了一份令人不安的报告，$c。$B$B在距离我们不远的白骨庭院中，魔古族会将俘虏都交给一个名叫放血者喀岱的将军。$B$B具体的细节我就不说了，总之他惯于拷打受害者。$B$B我们必须阻止这个怪物。如果你倒在他的剑下，那我只能祈祷你能速死。
text.completion: I am glad to hear that this piece of filth is slain. You have done us all a great favor, $n.
text.completed: Return to Grand Magister Rommath on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: The Bloodletter
english.objectives: Kill Kaida the Bloodletter.
english.description: I have heard a disturbing report, $c.$B$BJust beyond our position, in the Court of Bone, the mogu bring captives to a general named Kaida the Bloodletter.$B$BI will spare you the details, but he thrives on torturing his victims.$B$BThis monster must be stopped. If you fall to his blade, I wish you a swift death.
english.completion: I am glad to hear that this piece of filth is slain. You have done us all a great favor, $n.
english.completed: Return to Grand Magister Rommath on the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 祭拜这团火焰
text.objectives: 祭拜恐惧废土的仲夏篝火。
text.description: 仲夏火焰节是敬拜元素的时刻。火焰元素会在我们所有人心中点燃激情。在许多时候，这种激情会喷发出来，演变成侵略性的行动。但在这个地方，我们将心中的激情变为虔诚的祭拜。$b$b我们会遵循传统，为火焰举行庆典。你愿意和我们一同敬拜火焰吗，$n？
text.completion: Honor the Dread Wastes flame.
text.end: 祭拜恐惧废土的仲夏篝火。

english.title: Honor the Flame
english.objectives: Honor the Midsummer Bonfire in Dread Wastes.
english.description: The Midsummer Fire Festival is a time to honor the elements.  The element of fire stirs passion within us all.  Many times, that passion pours out into aggressive actions.  But here, in this land, we focus our passion on reverence.$b$bWe will honor the flame as tradition dictates.  Will you honor the flame with us, $n?
english.completion: Honor the Dread Wastes flame.
english.end: Honor the Midsummer Bonfire in Dread Wastes.

text.completion: Honor the Jade Forest flame.
text.end: 祭拜翡翠林的仲夏篝火。

But here, in this land, we focus our passion on reverence.$b$bWe will honor the flame as tradition dictates.  Will you honor the flame with us, $n?
