text.title: Mission: The Secrets of Stormwind
text.description: Send undercover forces into the heart of enemy territory in an effort to learn of their plans.

english.title: Mission: The Secrets of Stormwind
english.description: Send undercover forces into the heart of enemy territory in an effort to learn of their plans.

text.title: 破碎的侍从官
text.objectives: 获得侍从官之肩、侍从官之颅、侍从官之杖、侍从官之发和侍从官之躯。
text.description: 你！过来帮帮我。$b$b在活着的时候，我是雷电之王陛下的侍从官。而我的忠诚，却只换来了这副岩石身躯，不得不永远看守着他的宝藏。$b$b有人亵渎了我神圣的躯体，并将碎片散落到岛上的各个地方。一想到要在没有躯体的情况下永远活下去，我就感到沮丧。$b$b去搜索一下这座岛，将我的身躯碎片带回来，我可以将陛下珍藏的一样宝贝赠送给你。
text.progress: I require ALL of my pieces. If so much as a pebble is missing, I shall consider forfeiting our agreement.
text.completion: Ah! To feel whole again! You have my gratitude, servant. Take this stone and use it wisely. Should you encounter his majesty the Thunder King in your travels, do not tell him where you received it, or you will be standing in a statue next to me for the remainder of eternity.
text.completed: "Speak" with the Statue of the Chamberlain in the the cave beneath the Court of Bones on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: The Crumbled Chamberlain
english.objectives: Recover the Shoulder, Head, Staff, Hair and Torso of the Chamberlain.
english.description: You there! Assist me.$b$bIn life I was the Royal Chamberlain for his majesty, the Thunder King. For my dedication, I was condemned to this stone form, forever forced to watch over a portion of his wealth.$b$bSomeone has desecrated my glorious body and sent pieces of it across the island. The thought of spending an eternity as nothing more than a head depresses me.$b$bSearch the island, recover these pieces and I shall grant you one of his majesty's treasures.
english.progress: I require ALL of my pieces. If so much as a pebble is missing, I shall consider forfeiting our agreement.
english.completion: Ah! To feel whole again! You have my gratitude, servant. Take this stone and use it wisely. Should you encounter his majesty the Thunder King in your travels, do not tell him where you received it, or you will be standing in a statue next to me for the remainder of eternity.
english.completed: "Speak" with the Statue of the Chamberlain in the the cave beneath the Court of Bones on the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 翱翔之翼
text.objectives: 找回一只野生飞翼幼龙。
text.description: 我刚刚收到报告，在阴惨泥沼里又发现了另一只飞翼幼龙。$B$B我们要把能找到的所有飞翼幼龙都找回来。它们也许是在这岛上飞行的关键所在。
text.progress: A great gloom looms over this island...
text.completion: Wonderful! I'll pass him off to our caretaker. Thank you.
text.completed: Return to Magister Hathorel at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

english.title: A Wing to Fly On
english.objectives: Recover a Wild Ptrerrorwing Hatchling.
english.description: I've just received a report that another young pterrorwing has been spotted in the Diremoor.$B$BWe need to recover as many of these as we can find. They may be the key to flying on this island.
english.progress: A great gloom looms over this island...
english.completion: Wonderful! I'll pass him off to our caretaker. Thank you.
english.completed: Return to Magister Hathorel at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

text.title: 蜥蜴人的皮
text.objectives: 前往伊瓜鲁克峭壁并消灭一名邪刃蜥蜴人。
text.description: 伊瓜鲁克峭壁是一个危险的地方。幸运的是，你还有夺日者的魔法支援。$b$b我可以把你变成蜥蜴人。$b$b我会先对你施放一半的幻术。然后，你要直接前往伊瓜鲁克峭壁，消灭其中一名邪刃蜥蜴人。等你到了之后，我会再联系你，并完成后一半的幻术。

english.title: Skin of the Saurok
english.objectives: Go to Ihgaluk Crag and slay a Skumblade saurok.
english.description: Ihgaluk Crag is a dangerous place. Luckily, you have the magic of the Sunreavers behind you.$b$bI can transform you into a saurok.$b$bI will perform the first half of the illusion on you now. Afterwards, you should go directly to Ihgaluk Crag and slay one of the Skumblade saurok. Once you have done this, I will contact you and complete the second half of the illusion.
english.turninWindow: I will transform you to look like a saurok.

text.title: The Bloodletter
text.objectives: Kill Kaida the Bloodletter.
text.description: I have heard a disturbing report, $c.$B$BTo the south, in the Court of Bones, the mogu bring captives to a general named Kaida the Bloodletter.$B$BI will spare you the details, but he thrives on torturing his victims.$B$BThis monster must be stopped. If you fall to his blade, I wish you a swift death.
text.completed: Return to Grand Magister Rommath at [Horde Hub] at the Isle of the Thunder King.

english.objectives: Kill Kaida the Bloodletter.

If you fall to his blade, I wish you a swift death.
english.completed: Return to Grand Magister Rommath at [Horde Hub] at the Isle of the Thunder King.

text.title: 征服岩石
text.objectives: 阻止在白骨庭院主殿中举行的古代岩石征服者仪式。
text.description: 在白骨庭院中，雷电之王麾下的巫师们正在举行黑暗的仪式。$B$B为扩充军力，山泽夺魂者们将从生者身上偷取的灵魂，注入古老的石头雕像里。$B$B当这些岩石征服者被赋予生命后，他们就会成为战场上可怕的敌手。$B$B我们必须在这些雕像被复活前，阻止他们的仪式。
text.completion: A good defense is just as effective as a strong offense. One less enemy to worry about.$B$BWell done.
text.completed: Return to Ryshelle Brightlock on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: The Conquest of Stone
english.objectives: Stop the Ancient Stone Conqueror ritual in the main temple at the Court of Bones.
english.description: In the Court of Bones, the Thunder King's sorcerers perform dark rituals.$B$BTo bolster their numbers, the Shan'ze soulrippers are imbuing ancient stone statues with stolen spirits from the living.$B$BAfter these stone conquerors are brought to life, they will be formidable opponents on the battlefield.$B$BWe must stop their ritual before these statues can be revived.
english.completion: A good defense is just as effective as a strong offense. One less enemy to worry about.$B$BWell done.
english.completed: Return to Ryshelle Brightlock on the Isle of Thunder.

objectiveDetails.description: 阻止古代岩石征服者仪式

text.title: 魔法竞赛
text.objectives: 消灭织魔者琼古瓦。
text.description: 我的探子们在赞图尔的这一侧发现了一个危险的赞达拉巨魔。我需要有人解决掉他。你能完成这项任务吗？
text.completion: Your skills are impressive indeed. Thank you for doing this for me, $n.
text.completed: Return to Lor'themar Theron at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

english.title: Competing Magic
english.objectives: Kill Arcweaver Jor'guva.
english.description: My scouts have spotted a dangerous Zandalari just this side of Za'Tual. I need someone capable to see him dispatched. Are you up to the task?
english.completion: Your skills are impressive indeed. Thank you for doing this for me, $n.
english.completed: Return to Lor'themar Theron at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

text.title: 渗透力量
text.objectives: 消灭赞达拉战争首领奴卡拉。
text.description: 我的探子们在北部海滩上发现了一支赞达拉作战小队。我需要有人解决掉他们。你能完成这项任务吗？
text.completion: You have our gratitude, $n.
text.completed: Return to Lor'themar Theron at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

english.title: Encroaching Force
english.objectives: Kill Nurkala, the Zandalari War Leader.
english.description: My scouts have spotted a Zandalari war party on the northern beach. I need someone capable to see him dispatched. Are you up to the task?
english.completion: You have our gratitude, $n.
english.completed: Return to Lor'themar Theron at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

text.title: 危机四伏
text.objectives: 消灭奴役者霍嘎克。
text.description: 我的探子们在中央高塔底下发现了一位魔古族首领。得赶在他袭击我们的据点前将他消灭。$B$B你能替我完成这项任务吗？
text.completion: One less threat at our doorstep. Thank you, $n.
text.completed: Return to Lor'themar Theron at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

english.title: Imposing Threat
english.objectives: Kill Horgak the Enslaver.
english.description: My scouts have spotted a mogu leader under the central tower. He needs to be killed before he can mount an offensive on our position.$B$BCan you take care of this for me?
english.completion: One less threat at our doorstep. Thank you, $n.
english.completed: Return to Lor'themar Theron at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

text.title: 兽栏
text.objectives: 在兽栏找到斥候队长艾尔希娅。
text.description: 我们必须击退那些被赞达拉巨魔派来攻打我们营地的野兽。我已经派出斥候队长艾尔希娅带领数名战斗法师前往兽栏提供掩护。$b$b去东边的城墙缺口附近找到她，帮她消灭那些攻打我们的骑兵和攻城巨兽。$b$b他们都是隐身的，注意寻找他们魔法隐形法术散发的微光。
text.completion: I'm glad you were the one Lor'themar sent. These beasts are more than we can handle on our own. Time to spook the livestock.
text.completed: Find Scout Captain Elsia at the Beast Pens on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: The Beast Pens
english.objectives: Find Scout Captain Elsia at the Beast Pens.
english.description: We need to counter the beasts the Zandalari are using to strike at our camp. I have dispatched Scout Captain Elsia to the Beast Pens along with some war mages to provide cover.$b$bGo and find her east of here near the breaches in the wall and help her trim down the cavalry and siege beasts being levied against us.$b$bThey are masked, so look for the shimmers of their magical cloaking spells.
english.completion: I'm glad you were the one Lor'themar sent. These beasts are more than we can handle on our own. Time to spook the livestock.
english.completed: Find Scout Captain Elsia at the Beast Pens on the Isle of Thunder.

objectiveDetails.description: 在兽栏找到斥候队长艾尔希娅

text.title: 巨魔鼓声
text.objectives: 在征服者平台找到斥候队长艾尔希娅。
text.description: 你听见了吗，$c？在远处擂响的战鼓声。那是赞达拉巨魔们在准备迎战呢。$b$b我们可不能让他们安逸地部署防御。现在就得发起攻击！$b$b去征服者平台向斥候队长艾尔希娅回报。她会向你传达更多指示。
text.completion: These Zandalari are even more dangerous than we anticipated.$B$BDo not make the mistake of underestimating them, for that may be the last mistake you make.

english.title: The Beating of Troll Drums
english.objectives: Locate Scout Captain Elsia within Conqueror's Terrace.
english.description: Do you hear that, $c? The beating of war drums in the distance. The Zandalari are preparing for us.$b$bLet's not give them the luxury of time to organize their defenses. We need to push the attack now!$b$bReport to Scout Captain Elsia within Conqueror's Terrace. She will have further orders for you.
english.completion: These Zandalari are even more dangerous than we anticipated.$B$BDo not make the mistake of underestimating them, for that may be the last mistake you make.

text.title: 敌人的骨灰
text.objectives: 超度8具干尸残骸。
text.description: 白骨庭院中的魔古族正在施法复活亡者之魂来扩充兵力。$B$B我们决不能任由他们让亡者士兵起死回生。$B$B带上这个火把，去超度你所找到的干尸遗骸。$B$B我们要在这些敌人复活之前先干掉他们。
text.completion: Their dead shall rise no more, thanks to you, $n. Excellent work.
text.completed: Return to Danara Silverglass on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Ashes of the Enemy
english.objectives: Burn 8 Mummified Remains.
english.description: The mogu at the Court of Bones are bolstering their army by resurrecting the spirits of their dead.$B$BWe cannot allow them to revive their fallen warriors.$B$BTake this torch and burn any mummified corpses that you can find.$B$BWe will destroy our enemies before they have a chance to rise.
english.completion: Their dead shall rise no more, thanks to you, $n. Excellent work.
english.completed: Return to Danara Silverglass on the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 失魂者
text.objectives: 解救6名银色盟约斥候或夺日者斥候。
text.description: 我们攻击了白骨庭院的魔古族，可恐怕只是在给他们那邪恶的仪式输送牺牲品而已。$B$B魔古族不仅会消灭他们的俘虏，还会偷走他们的灵魂，将其注入石头里，图谋不轨，或者将牺牲者铸成幽魂战争武器。$B$B联盟也好，部落也罢，身份并不重要。我们决不能让魔古族扩充军力。$B$B快到墓穴去，救出所有一息尚存的俘虏。
text.completion: Thank you, $n. You have lightened my heart of a heavy burden through your heroic actions.$B$BI will remember your efforts on this day.
text.completed: Return to Narasi Snowdawn on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Soul Surrender
english.objectives: Save 6 Silver Covenant Scouts or Sunreaver Scouts.
english.description: We assault the mogu at the Court of Bones, but I fear we merely send them fodder for their abominable rituals.$B$BThe mogu do not merely kill their prisoners - they steal their souls and imbue them in machinations of stone, or reforge the fallen into ghostly tools of war.$B$BAlliance or Horde, it matters not. We cannot allow the mogu to bolster their numbers.$B$BGo into the crypts. Free any prisoners that are still living.
english.completion: Thank you, $n. You have lightened my heart of a heavy burden through your heroic actions.$B$BI will remember your efforts on this day.
english.completed: Return to Narasi Snowdawn on the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 严峻局势
text.objectives: 击败10名山泽守陵者、山泽夺魂者或山泽唤雷者。
text.description: 白骨庭院里挤满了魔古族大军。他们正在那里肆无忌惮地施展召唤雷电的仪式。$B$B如果我们想要成功占领这座岛屿，就不能放任他们占据如此重要的战略位置。$B$B必须消灭他们。
text.completion: Excellent. You have dealt the mogu a blow that they shall not easily forget.
text.completed: Return to Narasi Snowdawn on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Grave Circumstances
english.objectives: Kill 10 Shan'ze Gravekeepers, Shan'ze Soulrippers, or Shan'ze Thundercallers.
english.description: The Court of Bones crawls with mogu forces. Endlessly do they perform their rituals of lightning and thunder.$B$BIf our mission to take this island is to succeed, then we cannot allow them to hold such a strategic position.$B$BThey must be eliminated.
english.completion: Excellent. You have dealt the mogu a blow that they shall not easily forget.
english.completed: Return to Narasi Snowdawn on the Isle of Thunder.

objectiveDetails.description: 击败白骨庭院的山泽魔古

text.title: 进入墓穴
text.objectives: 在至尊殿使用古拉的咒语，然后击败重生的古拉。
text.description: 每一天，我们都会从白骨庭院发现更多的遗物。$B$B最近，他们在其中一处最深处墓穴的石碑上找到了这个卷轴。$B$B我相信这个咒语能够唤起坟墓中的死者。如果我的魔古知识没错，那你应该到至尊殿的最后一个房间里使用它。$B$B你愿意去验证一下我的理论吗？
text.completion: Ah yes, you've just confirmed my theory! Thank you, $c.
text.completed: Return to Danara Silverglass on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Into the Crypts
english.objectives: Use the Incantation of Gura in the Hall of the Exalted, then defeat Gura the Reclaimed.
english.description: Every day, we uncover additional relics from the Court of Bones.$B$BRecently, we discovered this scroll amongst the gravestones in one of the deepest crypts.$B$BI believe that this incantation can be used to call beyond the grave. And if my Mogu is up to date, I'd say you should use it in the last room in the Hall of the Exalted.$B$BWould you be willing to test out my theory?
english.completion: Ah yes, you've just confirmed my theory! Thank you, $c.
english.completed: Return to Danara Silverglass on the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 雷电的召唤
text.objectives: 阻止山泽唤雷者的仪式。
text.description: 在白骨庭院里，西边墓穴最深处的废墟间，雷电之王麾下最强大的巫师们正在用劈啪作响的电流为一柄闪电权杖充能。$B$B我们怀疑，这把武器将会给我们位于紫罗兰高地的据点带来毁灭性的灾难。$B$B没时间耽搁了。你必须立即阻止他们的仪式。
text.completion: You continue to exceed my expectations, $c. Well done.
text.completed: Return to Vylene Amaranth on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: The Call of Thunder
english.objectives: Stop the Shan'ze Thundercallers' ritual.
english.description: Within the graveyard, in the deepest ruins of their western crypt, the Thunder King's most powerful sorcerers are charging a lightning rod with crackling electricity.$B$BWe suspect that this weapon is meant to rain destruction on our stronghold at Violet Rise.$B$BThere is no time to delay. You must stop their ritual at once.
english.completion: You continue to exceed my expectations, $c. Well done.
english.completed: Return to Vylene Amaranth on the Isle of Thunder.

objectiveDetails.description: 阻止山泽唤雷者的仪式

text.title: 放血者
text.objectives: 击败放血者喀岱。
text.description: 我收到了一份令人不安的报告，$c。$B$B在距离我们不远的白骨庭院中，魔古族会将俘虏都交给一个名叫放血者喀岱的将军。$B$B他惯于拷打受害者。$B$B我们必须阻止这个怪物。如果你倒在他的剑下，那我只能祈祷你能速死。
text.completion: I am glad to hear that this piece of filth is slain. You have done us all a great favor, $n.
text.completed: Return to Vylene Amaranth on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: The Bloodletter
english.objectives: Kill Kaida the Bloodletter.
english.description: I have heard a disturbing report, $c.$B$BJust beyond our position, in the Court of Bones, the mogu bring captives to a general named Kaida the Bloodletter.$B$BHe thrives on torturing his victims.$B$BThis monster must be stopped. If you fall to his blade, I wish you a swift death.
english.completion: I am glad to hear that this piece of filth is slain. You have done us all a great favor, $n.
english.completed: Return to Vylene Amaranth on the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 征服岩石
text.objectives: 打断在白骨庭院主殿中举行的古代岩石征服者仪式。
text.description: 在白骨庭院中，雷电之王麾下的巫师们正在举行黑暗的仪式。$B$B为扩充军力，山泽夺魂者们将从生者身上偷取的灵魂，注入古老的石头雕像里。$B$B当这些岩石征服者被赋予生命后，他们就会成为战场上可怕的敌手。$B$B我们必须在这些雕像被复活前，阻止他们的仪式。
text.completion: A good defense is just as effective as a strong offense. One less enemy to worry about.$B$BWell done.
text.completed: Return to Vylene Amaranth on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: The Conquest of Stone
english.objectives: Disrupt the Ancient Stone Conqueror ritual in the main temple at the Court of Bones.
english.description: In the Court of Bones, the Thunder King's sorcerers perform dark rituals.$B$BTo bolster their numbers, the Shan'ze soulrippers are imbuing ancient stone statues with stolen spirits from the living.$B$BAfter these stone conquerors are brought to life, they will be formidable opponents on the battlefield.$B$BWe must stop their ritual before these statues can be revived.
english.completion: A good defense is just as effective as a strong offense. One less enemy to worry about.$B$BWell done.
english.completed: Return to Vylene Amaranth on the Isle of Thunder.

objectiveDetails.description: 中断古代岩石征服者仪式

text.title: 别再回来了！
text.objectives: 击败15个复生的先祖。
text.description: 你看见那些在坟场中徘徊的鬼魂了吗？$B$B他们是复生的先祖，是被重新召唤到这个世界上来的，魔古族死者的灵魂。$B$B当被激怒时，他们会迅捷无声地发起攻击，他们的数量也在日增夜长。$B$B他们不属于这里。去消灭他们，把他们送回坟墓里去。
text.completion: Wonderful work, $c. This will help our offensive a great deal.
text.completed: Return to Danara Silverglass on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Rise No More!
english.objectives: Kill 15 Risen Ancestors.
english.description: Have you seen the ghosts wandering the graveyard?$B$BThey are risen ancestors, the spirits of slain mogu who have been called back to this world.$B$BWhen angered, they attack swiftly and silently, and their numbers increase by the day.$B$BThey do not belong here. Destroy them, and send them back beyond the grave.
english.completion: Wonderful work, $c. This will help our offensive a great deal.
english.completed: Return to Danara Silverglass on the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 冷血石像
text.objectives: 摧毁8个陵寝守卫者。
text.description: 我们对白骨庭院的攻击仍在继续。尽管进展依旧缓慢，但却相当可观。$B$B不幸的是，我们收到了几份报告，接连有石魁麟雕像在毫无征兆的情况下就活了过来。这些魁麟太过危险，决不能放任不管。$B$B前往白骨庭院，消灭你所能找到的所有魁麟雕像。
text.completion: I am glad to hear that you left the quilen in a thousand tiny pieces. They are little more than a nuisance to my work here on the island.
text.completed: Return to Danara Silverglass on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Stone Cold
english.objectives: Destroy 8 Grave Guardians.
english.description: Our assault on the Court of Bones continues. Our progress remains slow, but measurable.$B$BUnfortunately, we've received several reports of stone quilen statues coming to life without warning. These quilen are too dangerous to ignore.$B$BVenture into the Court of Bones and destroy any quilen statues that you can find.
english.completion: I am glad to hear that you left the quilen in a thousand tiny pieces. They are little more than a nuisance to my work here on the island.
english.completed: Return to Danara Silverglass on the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: The Skumblade Threat
text.objectives: Slay 10 Skumblade saurok.
text.description: Ihgaluk Crag has no end of saurok. Those beasts attack my men and spread their disease into nearby water and wildlife, interfering with our operations.$b$bThin their numbers, $n. Once the Horde takes full control of this island, we can look for more permanent solutions.
text.completed: Return to Archmage Aethas Sunreaver at [TEMP] Horde Town on Mogu Island.

english.title: The Skumblade Threat
english.objectives: Slay 10 Skumblade saurok.
english.description: Ihgaluk Crag has no end of saurok. Those beasts attack my men and spread their disease into nearby water and wildlife, interfering with our operations.$b$bThin their numbers, $n. Once the Horde takes full control of this island, we can look for more permanent solutions.
english.completed: Return to Archmage Aethas Sunreaver at [TEMP] Horde Town on Mogu Island.

text.title: 邪刃的威胁
text.objectives: 击败10个邪刃蜥蜴人。
text.description: 蜥蜴人正源源不断地从伊瓜鲁克峭壁上涌出来。那些畜生不但攻击我的士兵，还在附近的水源和野生动物中间传播病菌，妨碍我们的行动。$b$b快去削减他们的数量，$n。一旦联盟完全控制了这片岛屿，我们就可以转而寻求更加彻底的解决办法了。
text.completion: One day, this island will belong to the Alliance. I can only hope that it will be free of saurok before then.$B$B<Modera sneers.>$B$BAt least they attack the Horde, too.
text.completed: Return to Archmage Modera on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: The Skumblade Threat
english.objectives: Slay 10 Skumblade saurok.
english.description: Ihgaluk Crag has no end of saurok. Those beasts attack my men and spread their disease into nearby water and wildlife, interfering with our operations.$b$bThin their numbers, $n. Once the Alliance takes full control of this island, we can look for more permanent solutions.
english.completion: One day, this island will belong to the Alliance. I can only hope that it will be free of saurok before then.$B$B<Modera sneers.>$B$BAt least they attack the Horde, too.
english.completed: Return to Archmage Modera on the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 掌控蜥蜴人
text.objectives: 向魔导师亚利斯、魔导师莱尼斯和魔导师莎纳尔报到。
text.description: 我向伊瓜鲁克峭壁派出了三名魔导师，以便监视这些不友好的蜥蜴人邻居，顺便看看能不能策反他们对抗魔古族。我要你去找到他们，看看他们是否需要补给或帮助。$b$b他们都是隐身的。你只要找蜥蜴人村子里那些闪烁的光柱就行了。
text.completion: <The archmage listens carefully to your report.>$B$BI understand. Thank you for your aid, $c.
text.completed: Return to Archmage Modera on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Manipulating the Saurok
english.objectives: Check in with Magister Yalis, Magister Lyanis, and Magistrix Sanal.
english.description: I have three magisters entrenched in Ihgaluk Crag, monitoring the saurok and - where they can - turning them against the mogu. I need you to find them and see if they need any supplies or assistance.$b$bThey will be concealed from view. Look for shimmering columns of light within the saurok village.
english.completion: <The archmage listens carefully to your report.>$B$BI understand. Thank you for your aid, $c.
english.completed: Return to Archmage Modera on the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 解体
text.objectives: 夺回4个被偷走的银色盟约构造体。
text.description: 蜥蜴人一直在袭扰我们的边界，而我们的构造体通常都能击退他们。可是，有一些构造体却被他们击败并拖回了伊瓜鲁克峭壁。$b$b我想把这些构造体弄回来。那些滑溜溜的蜥蜴人休想从我眼皮底下偷走银色盟约的任何财产。
text.completion: That's more like it.$B$BThank you, $c.
text.completed: Return to Archmage Modera on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: De-Constructed
english.objectives: Recover the four stolen Silver Covenant Constructs.
english.description: Saurok consistently test our borders, and our constructs usually fend them off. Some constructs, however, have been defeated and dragged back to Ihgaluk Crag.$b$bI want those constructs back. No slithering lizard will steal Silver Covenant property under my watch.
english.completion: That's more like it.$B$BThank you, $c.
english.completed: Return to Archmage Modera on the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 可憎的献祭
text.objectives: 摧毁赞达拉祭坛。
text.description:
有些最强大的缚灵者通过邪恶的仪式取悦自己扭曲的神灵。

我们已经想出了摧毁他们祭坛的办法，最艰巨的任务就是活着接近每个祭坛。

深入赞图尔，摧毁那些祭坛。
text.completion: $c, the destruction of those altars will force the trolls to halt their most heinous of sacrifices. You have the thanks of everyone here.
text.completed: Return to Dalvin Jaacor at the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Heinous Sacrifice
english.objectives: Destroy the Zandalari's sacrificial altars.
english.description:
Some of the strongest of the spiritbinders perform heinous rites to their wretched gods.

We've devised a method to destroy their altars, so the difficult task will be getting to each altar alive.

Venture into the depths of Za'Tual and destroy their altars.
english.completion: $c, the destruction of those altars will force the trolls to halt their most heinous of sacrifices. You have the thanks of everyone here.
english.completed: Return to Dalvin Jaacor at the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 邪恶供品
text.objectives: 摧毁6份赞达拉供品。
text.description:
赞达拉缚灵者通过举行黑暗献祭来取悦神灵，残害我们的族人。

把你在赞图尔所能找到的所有赞达拉供品全都摧毁，拖延他们黑暗献祭的时间。
text.completion: Without the offerings, they will need to collect more before their sacrifices can proceed. Thank you, $c.
text.completed: Return to Dalvin Jaacor at the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Dark Offerings
english.objectives: Destroy 6 Zandalari Offerings.
english.description:
The Zandalari's spiritbinders perform dark sacrifices to appease their gods, killing our people in the process.

Destroy any Zandalari offerings you can find in Za'Tual to help slow the pace of their dark sacrifices.
english.completion: Without the offerings, they will need to collect more before their sacrifices can proceed. Thank you, $c.
english.completed: Return to Dalvin Jaacor at the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 神灵先驱
text.objectives: 消灭2个神灵先驱。
text.description:
如果你在赞图尔待上一会儿，就会看到他们其中一个最大的帐篷散发着纯粹的邪恶气息。

拜托了，请你前往巨魔营地，别让这些邪恶无比的仪式再继续下去。
text.completion: Most who witness such rituals never return, and those that do tend to be shaken. You, $n, seem little moved by your incredible deeds. I am impressed.
text.completed: Return to Archmage Lan'dalock at the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Harbingers of the Loa
english.objectives: Slay 2 Harbingers of the Loa.
english.description:
If you spend some time in Za'Tual, you will likely see one of their large tents emanating a pure form of evil.

Please, venture into the troll camp and put a stop to these unspeakable rituals.
english.completion: Most who witness such rituals never return, and those that do tend to be shaken. You, $n, seem little moved by your incredible deeds. I am impressed.
english.completed: Return to Archmage Lan'dalock at the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 防患未然
text.objectives: 在$1oa只啸天雏龙身边奔跑以惊吓它们。
text.description:
一想到这些可怜的啸天龙在被巨魔训练成战争工具的过程中需要遭受何种折磨，我就感到无比难过。

雏龙相当胆小，只要你一靠近就会吓得飞走。拜托了，在赞达拉巨魔腐化它们之前，把它们吓走吧。
text.completion: Welcome back, $r. The hatchlings you frightened will live a better life without their captors.
text.completed: Return to Ako at the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Preventing a Future Threat
english.objectives: Frighten $1oa Hatchling Skyscreamers by running near them.
english.description:
It pains me to think of the torture the poor skyscreamers  must endure as the trolls train them to become implements of war.

The hatchlings are quite fearful, and will fly away if you even get close them. Please, frighten some away before the Zandalari corrupt them.
english.completion: Welcome back, $r. The hatchlings you frightened will live a better life without their captors.
english.completed: Return to Ako at the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 手术式打击
text.objectives: 击败3名赞达拉缚灵者、3名赞达拉驭兽师和3名赞达拉丛林豹战士。
text.description:
赞达拉缚灵者举行献祭来取悦神灵，驭兽师迫使无辜的啸天龙听命于自己的意志，而丛林豹战士则向我们日渐逼近。

去赞图尔消灭这些威胁，$r，削弱巨魔的力量。
text.completion: With a few of their more threatening kin slain, perhaps the Zandalari will show reluctance next time they decide to trifle with us.
text.completed: Return to Archmage Lan'dalock at the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Surgical Strike
english.objectives: Slay 3 Zandalari Spiritbinders, 3 Zandalari Beastcallers, and 3 Zandalari Jaguar Warriors.
english.description:
Zandalari spiritbinders perform sacrifices to their gods, the beastcallers bend innocent skyscreamers to their will, and the jaguar warriors venture closer to us by the day.

Dispose of these threats in Za'Tual, $r, and watch the might of the trolls weaken.
english.completion: With a few of their more threatening kin slain, perhaps the Zandalari will show reluctance next time they decide to trifle with us.
english.completed: Return to Archmage Lan'dalock at the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 赞图尔的危机
text.objectives: 在赞图尔消灭12名巨魔。
text.description:
赞达拉巨魔是强大的敌人——比我们之前遇到的许多敌人都要可怕。但你也是个令人敬畏的对手，$n。

进入赞图尔，让他们瞧瞧，与像你这样的人作对会有什么下场。
text.completion: $n, your help against the Zandalari is appreciated. I realize it seems we cannot stem the tide, but your efforts make a difference.
text.completed: Return to Archmage Lan'dalock at the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Dangers of Za'Tual
english.objectives: Slay 12 Trolls in Za'Tual.
english.description:
The Zandalari are a formidable foe - more so than many foes we've encountered in the past. But you are a formidable foe as well, $n.

Enter Za'Tual to and show them the risks associated with opposing the likes of you.
english.completion: $n, your help against the Zandalari is appreciated. I realize it seems we cannot stem the tide, but your efforts make a difference.
english.completed: Return to Archmage Lan'dalock at the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 苦痛折磨
text.objectives: 解救痛苦的啸天龙。
text.description:
在赞图尔，其中一只巨魔的啸天龙正在经受某种仪式的摧残，它的意志会被彻底扭曲，效忠自己的主人。

消灭那些折磨它的恶徒，我们只能希望，它能重新在空中展翼翱翔。
text.completion: I hope that creature has the intelligence necessary to know who saved it. It seems to me that it would be a dangerous foe if provoked.
text.completed: Return to Ako at the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Pterrible Ptorment
english.objectives: Free the Tormented Skyscreamer.
english.description:
One of the trolls' skyscreamers in Za'Tual is undergoing a ritual of torture, its will being bent forever to serve its masters.

Kill those that inflict such torment on the creature and we can only hope that it will return to the skies.
english.completion: I hope that creature has the intelligence necessary to know who saved it. It seems to me that it would be a dangerous foe if provoked.
english.completed: Return to Ako at the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 伊瓜鲁克的住民
text.objectives: 击败1个邪刃蛮兵、1个邪刃蜥首牧师和1个邪刃海龙战士。
text.description: 邪刃部族威胁到了我们的人，可报之以毫不留情的消灭未免也太反应过度了。$b$b去干掉他们的部族首领或许是更加理性的回应方式。这样不仅能少一些流血冲突，也可以让他们尊重我们划下的边界。
text.completion: I know the true price of bloodshed. I know the cost of war.$B$BIt would be simpler to blindly massacre our attackers until they yield. But is it right?
text.completed: Return to Lyalia on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: The Residents of Ihgaluk
english.objectives: Slay a Skumblade Brute, a Skumblade Saur-Priest, and a Skumblade Seadragon.
english.description: The Skumblade threaten our people, but responding with all-out slaughter would be an overreaction.$b$bA more reasonable response to their threat would be to slay some of their tribal leaders. There will be less bloodshed, and they will still respect our perimeter.
english.completion: I know the true price of bloodshed. I know the cost of war.$B$BIt would be simpler to blindly massacre our attackers until they yield. But is it right?
english.completed: Return to Lyalia on the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 清洁工作
text.objectives: 击败伊瓜鲁克峭壁的颤栗污泥怪以分解75块污物。
text.description: 我就坦白说吧，这可不是什么好活儿。$b$b邪刃蜥蜴人将他们产生的污物都堆在村子中央的一个坑里。那里的污物太过集中，恶臭熏天，以至于都浓缩成了一种能够移动的活物。$b$b那些蜥蜴人可以留着他们的垃圾坑，可当它扩散到村子外面的时候，那我们就该干涉了。
text.completion: Well done, $n. Looking at you, I'm suddenly quite proud of Dalaran's state-of-the-art plumbing system.
text.completed: Return to Sanitation Sorcerer Stephen Litmatch on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Just Some Light Clean-Up Work
english.objectives: Disperse 75 pieces of filth by killing Quivering Filth in Ihgaluk Crag.
english.description: This is not a glamorous job. Let me put it to you bluntly.$b$bThe Skumblade saurok pile all of their filth into a pool in the middle of their village. This filth is so concentrated and so rancid that it has congealed into moving, animate matter.$b$bThe saurok can keep their filth-pool, but once it starts spreading outside of the village, I'd say it's time to intervene.
english.completion: Well done, $n. Looking at you, I'm suddenly quite proud of Dalaran's state-of-the-art plumbing system.
english.completed: Return to Sanitation Sorcerer Stephen Litmatch on the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 伊瓜鲁克的恐怖地毯
text.objectives: 踩死75只伊瓜鲁克蟑螂。
text.description: 啊，蟑螂！我曾在藏宝海湾买过一只宠物蟑螂。$b$b蟑螂会像海绵一样吸收病菌，然后将它们散播到自己所经之处。而它们的活动范围偏偏又很广。$b$b伊瓜鲁克峭壁上爬满了这种东西，将邪刃部族的秽物传播到岛上的每一个角落。当你去那里时，记得尽可能多踩死几只蟑螂。
text.completion: Every little bit helps.
text.completed: Return to Sanitation Sorcerer Stephen Litmatch on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: The Creeping Carpet of Ihgaluk
english.objectives: Crush 75 Ihgaluk Roaches.
english.description: Ah, roaches! I once bought a pet roach in Booty Bay.$b$bRoaches will soak up disease like a sponge, and then spread it as far as they can run. Which is pretty far.$b$bIhgaluk Crag is crawling with the things, and they carry Skumblade filth all over of this island. Crush as many of them as you can while you're there.
english.completion: Every little bit helps.
english.completed: Return to Sanitation Sorcerer Stephen Litmatch on the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 任其腐烂
text.objectives: 摧毁3堆恶臭肉堆。
text.description: 邪刃蜥蜴人并不会将他们打到的肉全吃光。他们会将大部分的肉堆在房子附近，任由其腐烂，以吸引害虫并散播病毒。$b$b我们不能让蜥蜴人将病毒散播到伊瓜鲁克峭壁以外的地方。快去处理掉那些剩余的肉类吧。
text.completion: Left standing, those piles of discarded food are the perfect breeding ground for disease.$B$BWere I still in the disease-spreading business, I'd consider using them myself.
text.completed: Return to Sanitation Sorcerer Stephen Litmatch on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Left To Rot
english.objectives: Destroy 3 Fetid Meat Piles.
english.description: The Skumblade saurok do not eat all of the meat they hunt. They reserve large portions of it to rot in piles near their homes, attracting pests and spreading disease.$b$bWe can't have the saurok spreading their disease beyond the borders of Ihgaluk Crag. Dispose of any excess meat that you find.
english.completion: Left standing, those piles of discarded food are the perfect breeding ground for disease.$B$BWere I still in the disease-spreading business, I'd consider using them myself.
english.completed: Return to Sanitation Sorcerer Stephen Litmatch on the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 蜥蜴人的皮
text.objectives: 前往伊瓜鲁克峭壁并消灭一名邪刃蜥蜴人。
text.description: 伊瓜鲁克峭壁是一个危险的地方。幸运的是，你还有肯瑞托的魔法支援。$b$b我可以把你变成蜥蜴人。$b$b我会先对你施放一半的幻术。然后，你要直接前往伊瓜鲁克峭壁，消灭其中一名邪刃蜥蜴人。等你到了之后，我会再联系你，并完成后一半的幻术。

english.title: Skin of the Saurok
english.objectives: Go to Ihgaluk Crag and slay a Skumblade saurok.
english.description: Ihgaluk Crag is a dangerous place. Luckily, you have the magic of the Kirin Tor behind you.$b$bI can transform you into a saurok.$b$bI will perform the first half of the illusion on you now. Afterwards, you should go directly to Ihgaluk Crag and slay one of the Skumblade saurok. Once you have done this, I will contact you and complete the second half of the illusion.
english.turninWindow: I will transform you to look like a saurok.

text.title: 纵龙者
text.objectives: 在兽栏中击败的10名赞达拉巨魔。
text.description: 在兽栏中，你可能会遇到赞达拉部队中最老练的驯兽师。他们懂得用斧子、野兽和爪子进行攻击。他们就是在这里建立起自己的骑兵部队的。$b$b在他们骑着那些怪物出现在战场上之前，我们要你先去兽栏击败那里的赞达拉巨魔。
text.completion: These trolls have been using dark magics to achieve their goals. No patience, no honor. You have done the world a good service in reducing their numbers today.
text.completed: Speak with Scout Captain Daelin within the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Saur Loser
english.objectives: Defeat 10 Zandalari trolls in the Beast Pens.
english.description: Inside the Beast Pens you will encounter some of the most skilled beast tamers in the Zandalari military. They are trained to kill with axe, beast, and claw. This is where they build their cavalry.$b$bWe need you to kill any Zandalari you find in the Beast Pens before they can get their mounted monstrosities out into the open battlefield.
english.completion: These trolls have been using dark magics to achieve their goals. No patience, no honor. You have done the world a good service in reducing their numbers today.
english.completed: Speak with Scout Captain Daelin within the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 践踏掠食龙
text.objectives: 在兽栏消灭5只迅猛龙和10只训练有素的掠食龙。
text.description: 赞达拉的迅猛龙和细颚龙是对我们部队的重大威胁。它们是出色的狩猎者，能够长途追踪猎物，对毫无准备的目标尤为致命。$b$b我需要你前往兽栏减少那里的恐龙数量。我们要在训练完成前先干掉它们。
text.completion: We lost three good soldiers when we first arrived on this island. Killed in their sleep by compies that had snuck into their tent. Some nights I still hear the screams.
text.completed: Speak with Scout Captain Daelin within the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Compy Stomp
english.objectives: Kill 5 Raptors and 10 Trained Compies in the Beast Pens.
english.description: The raptors and compies of the Zandalari represent a substantial threat to our forces here. They are superb hunting beasts that can track prey over great distances and are often lethal to encounter when caught unawares.$b$bI need you to head into the Beast Pens and cull their numbers. We need to make sure to slay them before they are fully trained.
english.completion: We lost three good soldiers when we first arrived on this island. Killed in their sleep by compies that had snuck into their tent. Some nights I still hear the screams.
english.completed: Speak with Scout Captain Daelin within the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 神龙
text.objectives: 击败一名神谕者。
text.description: 赞达拉巨魔发现了一种将神灵束缚在野兽体内的方法，这可以让它们获得惊人而致命的力量。$b$b我们必须阻止他们。$b$b去兽栏寻找一个神谕者并击败他。你可以通过那些发光的野兽来辨认找到他们。$b$b我们不能让这样的暴行继续下去。
text.completion: Well done, champion. These beasts are strong enough. We don't need them infused with an angry spirit now do we?
text.completed: Speak with Miura Brightweaver within the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Loa-saur
english.objectives: Defeat a Loa Speaker.
english.description: The Zandalari have found a way to bind loa to their beasts giving them impressive and lethal powers.$b$bWe need to put a stop to this.$b$bSearch the Beast Pens for a loa speaker and slay him. You should be able to find them by keeping a look out for their glowing beasts.$b$bWe must not allow these atrocities to continue.
english.completion: Well done, champion. These beasts are strong enough. We don't need them infused with an angry spirit now do we?
english.completed: Speak with Miura Brightweaver within the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 恐角龙大战魔暴龙
text.objectives: 击败傲慢的恐角龙或傲慢的魔暴龙身边的所有NPC以扰乱束缚仪式。
text.description: 眼下，我们有了一个干扰赞达拉战争机器的机会，还能顺便给自己找点乐子。$b$b在这片兽栏中，有一头魔暴龙和一头恐角龙，它们都是全副武装，并且心智被赞达拉符咒所奴役。$b$b我要你潜入营地并干扰那里的任意一个束缚仪式。没有特定目标。你只要解决掉那些想要束缚这些野兽的家伙就行了。这能够让这些武装到牙齿的野兽发狂并肆虐赞达拉的营地。然后，我们只要坐着看热闹就行了。
text.completion: Few things in this world and beyond are more entertaining than watching a rampaging ancient beast tearing through an enemy's settlement.$B$BIf times were not so dire I would consider selling tickets to such an event.
text.completed: Speak with Miura Brightweaver within the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Direhorn vs Devilsaur
english.objectives: Disrupt a binding ritual by killing all ritual NPCs around either a Defiant Direhorn or a Defiant Devilsaur.
english.description: We have an opportunity to disrupt the Zandalari war machine as well as have a little fun in the process.$b$bWithin these beast pens, a devilsaur and a direhorn are being outfitted with armor, their minds being enslaved to the Zandalari charms.$b$bGo into the camp and disrupt one of these binding rituals. It doesn't matter which one. Just kill those who are trying to bind the creature. This should let the fully armored beast run mad through the Zandalari camp. Then sit back and watch the hilarity ensue.
english.completion: Few things in this world and beyond are more entertaining than watching a rampaging ancient beast tearing through an enemy's settlement.$B$BIf times were not so dire I would consider selling tickets to such an event.
english.completed: Speak with Miura Brightweaver within the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 史前巨兽
text.objectives: 找到并对兽栏中的5只迅猛龙、掠食龙、啸天龙或恐角龙使用恐龙神像。
text.description: 赞达拉巨魔使用了一系列的神像和符咒来维持他们对兽栏的控制。$b$b不妨以其人之道还治其人之身。$b$b我想让你找些这种神像来，然后在兽栏中的各种野兽身上试试效果。$b$b把每只野兽对每个神像的反应都认真记录下来。然后向我汇报。$b$b也许这能使我们取得对抗赞达拉的优势。
text.completion: Very interesting results. I am sure there is a mage somewhere that cares about the specifics. I, on the other hand, am just glad to hear the sound of trolls being assaulted by their own beasts.
text.completed: Speak with Scout Captain Daelin within the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Dino Might
english.objectives: Find and use Saur Fetishes on 5 raptors, compies, skyscreamers or direhorns in the Beast Pens.
english.description: The Zandalari use a series of fetishes and charms to maintain their control over their menagerie of beasts.$b$bTwo can play at that game.$b$bI want you to find some of these fetishes and try them out on the various beasts in the Beast Pens.$b$bTake careful note of how each beast responds to each fetish. Then report your results to me.$b$bMaybe this will give us the edge we need against the Zandalari.
english.completion: Very interesting results. I am sure there is a mage somewhere that cares about the specifics. I, on the other hand, am just glad to hear the sound of trolls being assaulted by their own beasts.
english.completed: Speak with Scout Captain Daelin within the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 世代戍守
text.objectives: 消灭5名缚灵哨兵，并使用共振水晶捕捉被禁锢在哨兵中的赞达拉巨魔灵魂。
text.description: 献祭在赞达拉社会中不足为奇。但在这些野蛮的仪式中却存在一种诡异的现象，那就是志愿者。他们竟把它视作莫大的荣耀！$b$b弱者仍然渴望作出贡献，哪怕那意味着要将自己的生命束缚在那些四处游荡的哨兵身上，从而以这种方式为人民效忠。$b$b拿上这块共振水晶。消灭那些赞达拉哨兵，然后把深藏其中的灵魂汲取出来。完成任务后再把水晶交还给我。
text.completion: This is very interesting, $c. The crystal hums with the rage of its captive inhabitants. Even after the passage of time their devotion has not decreased.$B$BI will need to study this further.
text.completed: Return to Miura Brightweaver within the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Centuries in Sentries
english.objectives: Kill 5 Spirit-Bound Sentries and then use the Resonance Crystal to capture the Zandalari spirits trapped within.
english.description: Sacrifices are common place in Zandalari society. There is however one oddity among these barbaric rituals; volunteers. They treat it as a great honor!$b$bThe weak still seek to contribute, even if that means giving their lives to be bound to the sentries you see walking around. Locked away in service to their people.$b$bTake this resonating crystal. Once destroyed, drain the sentry of its Zandalari inhabitant. Return the crystal to me when your task is complete.
english.completion: This is very interesting, $c. The crystal hums with the rage of its captive inhabitants. Even after the passage of time their devotion has not decreased.$B$BI will need to study this further.
english.completed: Return to Miura Brightweaver within the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 知己知彼
text.objectives: 在征服者平台附近找回6个仪式神器。
text.description: 这里到处都是赞达拉神器。要是我跟你说，我没兴趣研究它们，那我一定是在说谎。这些器物对赞达拉仪式的重要性令我着迷。$b$b知己知彼，才能百战百胜。$b$b要想研究它们，我就必须得近距离观察清楚才行。把你能找到的所有神器都带回来交给我。
text.progress: What have you brought me, $c?
text.completion: These are excellent finds! Studying them will take time, but there is much to be gained in understanding the Zandalari.
text.completed: Return to Miura Brightweaver within the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: The More You Know
english.objectives: Retrieve 6 Ritual Artifacts from around Conqueror's Terrace.
english.description: This whole area is littered with Zandalari artifacts. I would be lying if I said studying them didn't interest me. I am fascinated by the significance of these objects to their rituals.$b$bThe more we understand our enemies, the better prepared we are to defeat them.$b$bIf I am to study them, I will need to see them up close. Bring me as many artifacts as you can find.
english.progress: What have you brought me, $c?
english.completion: These are excellent finds! Studying them will take time, but there is much to be gained in understanding the Zandalari.
english.completed: Return to Miura Brightweaver within the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 夺自敌手
text.objectives: 从征服者平台偷取7把灌注神力的利刃。
text.description: 魔法只有被老练的施法者驾驭，才会变成可怕的敌人。但利刃则不然——即使是被毫无战斗经验的人挥持，也足以令人胆寒。$b$b赞达拉巨魔掌管着一些颇具杀伤力的武器，灌注其上的魔法又更加令其如虎添翼。我们一定要让他们丧失这种优势。$b$b把你所能找到的武器全都偷回来。
text.progress: What did you find out there? Anything that can be of use?
text.completion: Excellent work, $c! These weapons are impressive. Now we have a few less things to worry about in the field of battle.
text.completed: Return to Scout Captain Daelin within the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Out of Enemy Hands
english.objectives: Steal 7 Loa-Infused Blades from Conqueror's Terrace.
english.description: Magic is a frightening opponent when wielded by an experienced caster. A blade however, is terrifying in even the most inexperienced hands.$b$bThe Zandalari have some impressive weapons, made even more deadly by the magic they are enhanced with. We should relieve them of this advantage.$b$bSteal as many of the weapons as you can find.
english.progress: What did you find out there? Anything that can be of use?
english.completion: Excellent work, $c! These weapons are impressive. Now we have a few less things to worry about in the field of battle.
english.completed: Return to Scout Captain Daelin within the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 不得外传
text.objectives: 从征服者平台的缚灵者图切克和魔术士拉古尔处夺取黑暗秘法面具和唤魂者面具。
text.description: 缚灵者图切克和魔术士拉古尔这两兄弟看守着征服者平台。他们会使用强大的魔法，绝对不容小觑。$b$b他们的力量似乎是来源于他们的面具，那是代代相传的圣物。每位拥有者在将面具传世之前，都会将自己的法力灌注在面具上。$b$b我们必须解决掉这两兄弟，然后摧毁面具，以免让其落入恶人手中。
text.progress: Where are the masks?
text.completion: It's a shame really that these masks must be destroyed. I would have liked to study this ancient magic, but it is better that they be destroyed than become the tools of the Horde.$B$BGood work, $c.
text.completed: Return to Miura Brightweaver within the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: All In the Family
english.objectives: Retrieve the Mask of the Dark Mystic and the Mask of the Spirit-Caller from Spiritbinder Tu'chek and Arcanital Ra'kul within Conqueror's Terrace.
english.description: Conqueror's Terrace is watched over by two brothers; Spiritbinder Tu'chek and Arcanital Rak'ul. They are powerful magic users and should not be underestimated.$b$bTheir power seems to stem from the ornate masks they wear; relics passed down from one generation to the next. Each owner imbuing it with their own magic before passing it on.$b$bWe must deal with the brothers and destroy their masks before they fall into the wrong hands.
english.progress: Where are the masks?
english.completion: It's a shame really that these masks must be destroyed. I would have liked to study this ancient magic, but it is better that they be destroyed than become the tools of the Horde.$B$BGood work, $c.
english.completed: Return to Miura Brightweaver within the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 巨人的陨殁
text.objectives: 在征服者平台消灭守护者塔克乌。
text.description: 赞达拉巨魔崇拜神灵，通常会召唤这些动物之魂与自己并肩作战。他们会尝试将这些魂灵束缚在一个巨像身上。这会招致毁灭性的后果。$b$b我已经派斥候前去搜集信息了，但这项任务也许需要由你发挥专长。$b$b不惜一切代价阻止那个仪式！
text.completion: It's fortunate that you were able to intervene, $c. Who knows what damage that golem would have caused had he not been stopped.
text.completed: Return to Scout Captian Daelin within the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Even Giants Fall
english.objectives: Destroy Guardian Tak'u within Conqueror's Terrace.
english.description: The Zandalari worship the loa; animal spirits they often call to their aid. They may be trying to bind these spirits into a huge golem. The outcome would be disastrous.$b$bI've sent ahead a scout to gather more information, but I think this task may require your expertise.$b$bStop that ritual at all costs!
english.completion: It's fortunate that you were able to intervene, $c. Who knows what damage that golem would have caused had he not been stopped.
english.completed: Return to Scout Captian Daelin within the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 保守秘密
text.objectives: 在征服者平台消灭任意8名赞达拉巨魔。
text.description: 这里的赞达拉巨魔对我们的行动构成了威胁，$c。$b$b他们对魔法的使用更是让人难以容忍。巨魔们将奥术之力与无边幽暗混为一体，丝毫不考虑后果。$b$b我们决不能让他们在这里变得羽翼渐丰，或是让部落领悟到他们扭曲的魔法。$b$b必须削减他们的数量。我把这项任务交给你了。
text.completion: Well done, $c. The more Zandalari we destroy, the less chance their magic will fall into Horde hands.
text.completed: Return to Scout Captain Daelin within the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Keep It Secret
english.objectives: Kill any 8 Zandalari trolls within Conqueror's Terrace.
english.description: The Zandalari here are a threat to our campaign, $c.$b$bTheir use of magic is an abomination. They mix the power of arcane with the darkness of shadow with little care to consequence.$b$bWe cannot afford for them to find their full strength here or for the Horde to learn of their twisted magic.$b$bTheir numbers must be thinned. I will leave this task to you.
english.completion: Well done, $c. The more Zandalari we destroy, the less chance their magic will fall into Horde hands.
english.completed: Return to Scout Captain Daelin within the Isle of Thunder.

objectiveDetails.description: 击败征服者平台的巨魔

text.title: Competing Magic
text.objectives: Kill Arcweaver Jor'guva.
text.description: One of my scryers has identified a Zandalari leader near the central tower. He needs to be removed.$B$BWould you be willing to do this for me, $c?
text.completion: You're dependable, $n. I like that.
text.completed: Return to Lor'themar Theron on the Crimson Treader.

text.completion: Thank you, $n. That's a worry off my mind.
text.completed: Return to Scout Captain Elsia north of the Diremoor.

text.title: 兽栏
text.objectives: 在兽栏找到斥候队长戴林。
text.description: 我不想再看到赞达拉的猛兽骑士突破我们的防线了！$b$b我已经派斥候队长戴林和其它战斗法师前往位于西北方向的兽栏。他们的任务是渗透其中，并侵扰赞达拉的攻城和骑兵作战单位。我希望你前去加入他们，发挥你的专长。$b$b注意他们的魔法隐身法术所散发的微光。
text.completion: Today, we hunt the hunters!
text.completed: Find Scout Captain Daelin at the Beast Pens on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: The Beast Pens
english.objectives: Find Scout Captain Daelin at the Beast Pens.
english.description: I do not want to see another Zandalari beast rider breach our defenses!$b$bI have dispatched Scout Captain Daelin and some war mages to the Beast Pens northwest of here. Their mission is to infiltrate and harass the Zandalari siege and cavalry units. I want you to join them and lend your expertise.$b$bKeep an eye out for the tell tale shimmer of their magical cloaking spell.
english.completion: Today, we hunt the hunters!
english.completed: Find Scout Captain Daelin at the Beast Pens on the Isle of Thunder.

objectiveDetails.description: 在兽栏找到斥候队长戴林

text.title: 分秒必争
text.objectives: 在征服者平台找到斥候队长戴林。
text.description: 自从抵达此地，我们已经略有所成，可现在还不是休息的时候。你的努力已经帮我们突破了雷电之王据点的上层防线。$b$b现在，我希望你能继续我们的战斗。到征服者平台向斥候队长戴林回报。他会对你下达进一步指示。
text.completion: The Zandalari here are not to be under-estimated, $c. Powerful magic overwhelms this space.$B$BWe must be diligent in our efforts.

english.title: No Time To Rest
english.objectives: Locate Scout Captain Daelin within Conqueror's Terrace.
english.description: We have accomplished much since arriving here, but now is not the time to rest. Your efforts have helped us breach the upper level of the Thunder King's stronghold.$b$bNow, I call on you to continue our campaign. Report to Scout Captain Daelin within Conqueror's Terrace. He will have further orders for you.
english.completion: The Zandalari here are not to be under-estimated, $c. Powerful magic overwhelms this space.$B$BWe must be diligent in our efforts.

text.title: Trailing Light in the Dark
text.objectives: Relight 8 torches in the Diremoor.
text.description: There is some dark magic in the Diremoor that extinguishes even our magical illuminations, and so our scouts struggle to find their way.$B$BAs you pass through the swamp, relight any torches you find that our men might find their way. Perhaps they will help you find your way back as well.
text.completed: Return to Warmage Yurias at the Violet Rise.

text.title: 翱翔之翼
text.objectives: 找回一只野生飞翼幼龙。
text.description: 我刚刚收到报告，在阴惨泥沼里又发现了另一只飞翼幼龙。$B$B我们要把能找到的所有飞翼幼龙都找回来。它们也许是在这岛上飞行的关键所在。
text.progress: A great gloom looms over this island...
text.completion: Wonderful! I'll pass him off to our caretaker. Thank you.
text.completed: Return to Warmage Yurias at the Violet Rise.

english.title: A Wing to Fly On
english.objectives: Recover a Wild Ptrerrorwing Hatchling.
english.description: I've just received a report that another young pterrorwing has been spotted in the Diremoor.$B$BWe need to recover as many of these as we can find. They may be the key to flying on this island.
english.progress: A great gloom looms over this island...
english.completion: Wonderful! I'll pass him off to our caretaker. Thank you.
english.completed: Return to Warmage Yurias at the Violet Rise.

text.title: 无眠军团
text.objectives: 消灭6个复活的战士。
text.description: 山泽正在岛中央将雕像集结成一支大军，日夜不休地滋扰我们的防线。将你看到的会走路的雕像全都消灭。我们的防御者会对你感激不尽的。
text.completion: Your efforts are appreciated, $c.
text.completed: Return to Captain Elleane Wavecrest at the Violet Rise.

english.title: The Sleepless Legion
english.objectives: Kill 6 Animated Warriors.
english.description: The Shan'ze are animating an army from the statues in the center of the isle, an army that batters our defenses day and night. Destroy any of the walking statues you see. Our defenders will greatly appreciate it.
english.completion: Your efforts are appreciated, $c.
english.completed: Return to Captain Elleane Wavecrest at the Violet Rise.

text.title: 高塔下的强敌
text.objectives: 在阴惨泥沼消灭7个山泽魔古。
text.description: 魔古族正在阴惨泥沼的高塔附近集结雕像大军。温蕾萨下令将他们全部消灭。我想你正好是执行这项任务的合适人选。
text.completion: Well done, $c. Thank you for the help.
text.completed: Return to Captain Elleane Wavecrest at the Violet Rise.

english.title: Enemies Beneath the Tower
english.objectives: Kill 7 Shan'ze mogu in the Diremoor.
english.description: There are mogu in the Diremoor animating the army of statues near the tower. Vereesa wants them dead. I think you're the one to do it.
english.completion: Well done, $c. Thank you for the help.
english.completed: Return to Captain Elleane Wavecrest at the Violet Rise.

objectiveDetails.description: 击败阴惨泥沼的山泽魔古

text.title: 战栗的沼泽
text.objectives: 消灭强大的魔暴龙。
text.description: 沼泽里有一只巨大的野兽。它目前还未对我们发起攻击，但我可不敢保证我们是否会一直这么幸运下去。$B$B趁它现在还没饿到要挑战我们的防线，赶快将它消灭。
text.completion: You are not one to be trifled with. I am sure to have further use of your services.$B$BCome back to me in a day's time, $c.
text.completed: Return to Vareesa Windrunner at the Violet Rise.

english.title: The Shuddering Moor
english.objectives: Kill the Mighty Devilsaur.
english.description: There is an immense beast in the swamp. It has not yet marched upon us, but I place no stock that we will continue to be so fortunate.$B$BStrike it down before it grows hungry enough to brave our defenses.
english.completion: You are not one to be trifled with. I am sure to have further use of your services.$B$BCome back to me in a day's time, $c.
english.completed: Return to Vareesa Windrunner at the Violet Rise.

text.title: 赞达拉巨神像
text.objectives: 消灭赞达拉巨神像。
text.description: 巨魔已将一个巨大的构造体部署在南边的路上，阻碍了我们岛屿四周的通行。去帮我们除掉障碍，$c。
text.completion: When I give you a task, it gets handled.$B$BWell done, $c.
text.completed: Return to Vereesa Windrunner on the Violet Rise.

english.title: The Zandalari Colossus
english.objectives: Destroy the Zandalari Colossus.
english.description: The trolls have dispatched one of their immense constructs on the southern road, blocking our passage around the island. See to it that the road is cleared, $c.
english.completion: When I give you a task, it gets handled.$B$BWell done, $c.
english.completed: Return to Vereesa Windrunner on the Violet Rise.

text.completion: You're dependable, $n. I like that.
text.completed: Return to Jaina Proudmoore on the Seabolt.

text.title: 白骨之间
text.objectives: 消灭锻骨者祖尔查卡。
text.description: 斥候们在伊瓜鲁克峭壁西部的白骨间发现了一个危险的赞达拉巨魔。我需要有人去解决他。你能完成这项任务吗？
text.completion: It's good to have a man I can trust close at hand.
text.completed: Return to Jaina Proudmoore at the Violet Rise.

english.title: Among the Bones
english.objectives: Kill Zur'chaka the Bonecrafter.
english.description: The scouts have spotted a dangerous Zandalari among the bones west of Ihgaluk Crag. We need someone capable to see him dispatched. Are you up to the task?
english.completion: It's good to have a man I can trust close at hand.
english.completed: Return to Jaina Proudmoore at the Violet Rise.

text.title: 魔法竞赛
text.objectives: 消灭织魔者琼古瓦。
text.description: 斥候们在赞图尔的这一侧发现了一个危险的赞达拉巨魔。我需要有人去解决他。你能完成这项任务吗？
text.completion: Your skills are impressive indeed. Thank you for doing this for me, $n.
text.completed: Return to Jaina Proudmoore at the Violet Rise.

english.title: Competing Magic
english.objectives: Kill Arcweaver Jor'guva.
english.description: The scouts have spotted a dangerous Zandalari just this side of Za'Tual. We need someone capable to see him dispatched. Are you up to the task?
english.completion: Your skills are impressive indeed. Thank you for doing this for me, $n.
english.completed: Return to Jaina Proudmoore at the Violet Rise.

text.title: 渗透力量
text.objectives: 消灭赞达拉战争首领奴卡拉。
text.description: 我们收到消息，海滩上出现了一支赞达拉作战小队，就在我们据点的北边。我需要有人前去追击并消灭他们。$B$B你愿意帮我们完成这项任务吗，$c？
text.completion: You have our gratitude, $n.
text.completed: Return to Jaina Proudmoore at the Violet Rise.

english.title: Encroaching Force
english.objectives: Kill Nurkala, the Zandalari War Leader.
english.description: We've received word of a Zandalari war party up the beach, north of our foothold. We need them hunted down and killed.$B$BAre you willing to do this thing for us, $c?
english.completion: You have our gratitude, $n.
english.completed: Return to Jaina Proudmoore at the Violet Rise.

text.title: 危机四伏
text.objectives: 消灭奴役者霍嘎克。
text.description: 占卜师们在中央高塔处发现了一位魔古首领。趁他还没对我们的据点发起攻击，应该尽早将他消灭。$B$B你能帮我们解决这件事吗？
text.completion: One less threat at our doorstep. Thank you, $n.
text.completed: Return to Jaina Proudmoore at the Violet Rise.

english.title: Imposing Threat
english.objectives: Kill Horgak the Enslaver.
english.description: The scryers have spotted a mogu leader at the central tower. He needs to be killed before he can mount an offensive on our position.$B$BCan you take care of this for us?
english.completion: One less threat at our doorstep. Thank you, $n.
english.completed: Return to Jaina Proudmoore at the Violet Rise.

text.objectives: Kill Zur'chaka the Bonecrafter.
text.description: We've spotted a Zandalari leader up the central stairs. We need to eliminate him before returning to camp.$B$BWould you be willing to do the deed?
text.completion: You're a good $c to have around, that's for certain. Thank you.
text.completed: Return to Scout Captain Daelin north of the Diremoor.
