english.completion: Your skills are impressive. You have our gratitude.
english.completed: Return to Scout Captain Daelin north of the Diremoor.

text.title: 电容上限
text.objectives: 在闪电矿脉中摧毁3个闪电钻，并击败金铁领主莫诺汗。
text.description:
位于此地北方的矿脉对魔古的补给线至关重要。他们正在用经由闪电灌能的巨型钻机开采矿石。

要是你能破坏这些钻机，它们就会瘫痪，这将大大折损他们制造武器的能力。

噢，还有，不管那里是谁在负责，都别让他活命，没问题吧？

english.title: Maximum Capacitor
english.objectives: Destroy the 3 lightning drills in the Ghost Iron Mines, and kill Metal Lord Mono-Han.
english.description:
The mines north of here are critical to the mogu supply line. They are using giant lightning enchanted drills to extract the ore.

If you can disrupt the drills, they'll be destroyed, greatly slowing their ability to make weapons.

Oh, also, kill whoever is in charge, will you?

text.title: 近在眼前！
text.objectives: 击败锻造大师，并从雷神岛的塑肌者霍古身上取得一块法典碎片。
text.description:
熔炉就在你面前了，还有魔古族锻造武器的核心机密。

在它的后面，就是魔古族的守门者，他掌握着开启下一个城区的钥匙。

该我们行动了！
text.progress: Well?
text.completion: Good work. What you did today brings us one step closer to our ultimate goal.
text.completed: Return to Scout Captain Daelin.

english.title: Forge Ahead!
english.objectives: Kill the Master of the Forge and collect a Codex Fragment from Fleshcrafter Hoku in the Isle of Thunder.
english.description:
The forge lies ahead of you, and with it the heart of the mogu's weaponsmithing ability.

And beyond that, the mogu gatekeeper, who holds the key to unlocking the gate to the next part of the city.

It's time to move out!
english.progress: Well?
english.completion: Good work. What you did today brings us one step closer to our ultimate goal.
english.completed: Return to Scout Captain Daelin.

text.title: 女士密令
text.objectives: 在闪电矿脉中解救3名被捕的肯瑞托密探，并击败金铁领主莫诺汗。
text.description:
奉吉安娜本人之命，我们的部分间谍试图溜过魔古族防线，探明在矿脉里究竟发生着什么事。

结果他们被抓住了，正在遭受难以言喻的可怕酷刑。

你必须把他们解救出来，并消灭那些囚禁他们的人。我们的格言是，不抛弃，不放弃！

english.title: On Her Magic-ey Secret Service
english.objectives: Rescue the three captured Kirin Tor agents within the Ghost Iron Mines, and kill Metal Lord Mono-Han.
english.description:
Under orders from Jaina herself, some of our agents attempted to sneak past mogu lines to find out what was going on in the mines.

They were captured, and are being subjected to who-knows-what kind of awful tortures.

You must free them and kill whoever captured them. We don't leave anyone behind!

text.title: 生命力
text.objectives: 使用调和水晶从雷电王座的黑暗意志身上取得意志残渣。
text.description: 斥候们在闪电矿脉中发现了这个诡异的构造体。这无疑是雷电之王的秘密武器。$b$b也许，我们有机会从这一发现中获益。只要我们能重新将它激活，就可以对其加以研究。更为重要的是，还可以探明它的弱点。$b$b前往雷电王座，并用这枚水晶捕获任何能激活这些构造体的精华。$b$b等任务完成后再回来找我。
text.progress: Were you successful in our endeavor?
text.completion: Excellent work, $c. This is a dark magic indeed. We have much to learn here if we are to succeed.$B$BNow, we have only to hope that we can reanimate this creature.
text.completed: Return to Lor'Themar Theron in Dawnseeker Promontory.

english.title: Life Blood
english.objectives: Use the Attuned Crystal to retrieve the Remnants of the Animus from the Dark Animus within the Throne of Thunder.
english.description: Scouts unearthed this strange construct hidden within the Lightning Vein Mine. A secret weapon of the Thunder King no doubt.$b$bPerhaps, there is a chance we can use this discovery to our benefit. If we can re-animate it, we can study it. More importantly, we can discover its weakness.$b$bGo to the Throne of Thunder and use this crystal to capture whatever essence animates these constructs.$b$bReturn to me when the task is complete.
english.progress: Were you successful in our endeavor?
english.completion: Excellent work, $c. This is a dark magic indeed. We have much to learn here if we are to succeed.$B$BNow, we have only to hope that we can reanimate this creature.
english.completed: Return to Lor'Themar Theron in Dawnseeker Promontory.

items.name: Glorious Standard of the Sunreaver Onslaught

text.title: 楼上的约见
text.objectives: 在雾纱栈道的迷雾酒肆二楼与拉希奥会面。
text.description: 我想带你见个人。暴风城的王子殿下不久前造访了这间简陋的旅舍。我命令守卫保护他，使他免受任何来自部落的威胁——当然，我可不想为自己招来任何不必要的关注。$b$b他与我纵谈世界大事，比如发生在南部海岸上的战争，他与加尔鲁什的会面，以及雷电之王即将发起的攻击。$b$b来吧！让我们到楼上聊聊……
text.completion: <Wrathion introduces you both.>$B$BPrince Anduin, this is $n, possibly the most powerful $c in Pandaria.$B$BOh - do you already know of each other? Interesting.
text.completed: 在雾纱栈道的迷雾酒肆二楼与拉希奥会面。

english.title: Meet Me Upstairs
english.objectives: Meet Wrathion upstairs on the second floor of the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.
english.description: There's someone I'd like you to meet. Stormwind's own crown prince recently paid a visit to this humble inn. I've instructed my guards to defend him from any Horde aggression - I don't want to draw any undue attention to myself.$b$bHe and I have been discussing world events, such as the battle along the southern shores, his encounter with Garrosh, and the upcoming assault on the Thunder King.$b$bCome! Let's talk upstairs...
english.completion: <Wrathion introduces you both.>$B$BPrince Anduin, this is $n, possibly the most powerful $c in Pandaria.$B$BOh - do you already know of each other? Interesting.
english.completed: Meet Wrathion upstairs on the second floor of the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

text.title: 第一帝国的秘密
text.objectives: 收集20份帝国秘史和40块延极锭。
text.description: 两千年来，这片土地始终都在魔古族的统治之下。他们施行的暴政如此残酷，以至于无人敢大声说出它的名字——熊猫人将它称作“古代王朝”或“第一王朝”。$b$b雷电之王是这一王朝的创建者，也是它的第一任君主。他在如今被称作雷神岛的地方积聚着巨大的力量。$b$b他的时代已经过去了，$n。我们应该将他的部分力量化为己用。替我从雷电王座收集圣物，再找些延极锭来——我有个好办法！
text.progress: What have you uncovered from the Throne of Thunder? Is the Thunder King's ferocious reputation warranted?
text.completion: <Wrathion inspects the treasures you brought him.>$B$BWell done. The trillium will need additional refinement, of course, but these samples are pure.$B$BI will need to study these artifacts for a time but I believe I can use the knowledge contained here to craft something of great value to us both.
text.completed: Return to Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

english.title: Secrets of the First Empire
english.objectives: Collect 20 Secrets of the Empire and 40 Trillium Bars.
english.description: For two thousand years the mogu ruled this entire land. So brutal was their regime that its name is never uttered aloud: Pandaren call it either the "Old Kingdom" or "First Dynasty."$b$bThe Thunder King was its founder and first emperor. He amassed enormous power on what is now the Isle of Thunder.$b$bHis time has passed, $n. We should claim some of his power for ourselves. Gather mogu relics for me from the Throne of Thunder, and amass some trillium - I have a plan!
english.progress: What have you uncovered from the Throne of Thunder? Is the Thunder King's ferocious reputation warranted?
english.completion: <Wrathion inspects the treasures you brought him.>$B$BWell done. The trillium will need additional refinement, of course, but these samples are pure.$B$BI will need to study these artifacts for a time but I believe I can use the knowledge contained here to craft something of great value to us both.
english.completed: Return to Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

text.title: 雷霆熔炉
text.objectives: 在雷神岛上继续探索，直到你找到雷霆熔炉。与拉希奥在雷霆熔炉外面碰头，并完成他的任务。
text.description: 一切都准备好了，$n，我也已经将你选为我的勇士。$b$b接下来，我们必须接近传说中雷神本尊的雷霆熔炉！你和你的阵营需要继续前进，直到雷霆熔炉暴露出来——如果它还没暴露的话。$b$b等你接近熔炉后，与我在那里会面。做好战斗的准备吧！
text.completion: Behold! The Lightning Lance! A conduit that can channel and control the very same power that the Thunder King used to found an empire.$B$BIt is dormant... but you're about to change that. If you're worthy.
text.completed: Speak with Wrathion near the Thunder Forge on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: The Thunder Forge
english.objectives: Progress through the Isle of Thunder until you unlock the Thunder Forge. Meet Wrathion outside the Thunder Forge and complete his task.
english.description: Everything is prepared, $n, and I have selected you to be my champion.$b$bNext, we must infiltrate the legendary Thunder Forge of Lei Shen himself! You and your faction will need to advance forward until the Thunder Forge is exposed, if it isn't already.$b$bOnce you have infiltrated the forge, meet me there. Be ready for a fight!
english.completion: Behold! The Lightning Lance! A conduit that can channel and control the very same power that the Thunder King used to found an empire.$B$BIt is dormant... but you're about to change that. If you're worthy.
english.completed: Speak with Wrathion near the Thunder Forge on the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 暴风领主之魂
text.objectives: 在雷神岛上继续探索，直到你找到最后一个庭院。将长枪插进暴风领主纳拉克的身体里，坚持到将他的力量虹吸出来，以获得淬火闪电长枪。
text.description: 我们的下一个目标，就是要用充满雷电之王力量的半神之血来调节这把武器。$b$b据密探回报，有位名叫山怖的魔古族正在创造这样一种怪物，想让其戍守雷电堡。$b$b当你的阵营攻到前门时，攻击暴风领主纳拉克，并将这根长枪插进它的身侧。这只怪物会使出浑身解数来阻止你——在成功将暴风领主的力量吸出来以前，千万要挺住！
text.progress: What of Storm Lord Nalak? And the lance? Details!
text.completion: You've done it! The lance seethes with power and potential!$B$BOh my friend, you have earned a great reward...
text.completed: Bring the Tempered Lightning Lance to Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

english.title: Spirit of the Storm Lord
english.objectives: Progress through the Isle of Thunder until you unlock the final courtyard. Obtain a Tempered Lightning Lance by thrusting the lance into Storm Lord Nalak and surviving long enough to siphon his power.
english.description: Our next objective is to temper this weapon with the blood of a demigod, one imbued with the Thunder King's powers.$b$bMy agents tell me that the mogu named Shan Bu is creating just such a creature, intended to guard the Thunder King's citadel.$b$bOnce your faction has fought your way to the front gates, attack Storm Lord Nalak and thrust this lance into his side. The creature will do everything in his power to stop you - stay alive long enough to siphon out the power of the Storm Lord!
english.progress: What of Storm Lord Nalak? And the lance? Details!
english.completion: You've done it! The lance seethes with power and potential!$B$BOh my friend, you have earned a great reward...
english.completed: Bring the Tempered Lightning Lance to Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

text.title: 苍穹之冠
text.objectives: 与拉希奥在雾纱栈道的石匠之愚碰面，并领取奖赏。
text.description: 你还记得石匠之愚吗？就在东边的山顶上，我们曾在那里见过面。$b$b我要用这把闪电长枪创造一样特别的东西，当然不能在这进行了。$b$b去石匠之愚与我会面，让我们共同欢庆胜利！
text.completion: The Crown of Heaven! Use this to augment any piece of headgear.$B$BIt will also act as a third eye - I will be able to follow your progress as we embark on the next stage of our journey.
text.completed: Speak with Wrathion atop Mason's Folly in the Veiled Stair.

english.title: The Crown of Heaven
english.objectives: Meet Wrathion atop Mason's Folly in the Veiled Stair and collect your reward.
english.description: Do you recall Mason's Folly, the hilltop east of here where you and I met before?$b$bI'm going to use the Lightning Lance to create something special, and I certainly can't do it in here.$b$bMeet me atop Mason's Folly so that we may celebrate our victories together!
english.completion: The Crown of Heaven! Use this to augment any piece of headgear.$B$BIt will also act as a third eye - I will be able to follow your progress as we embark on the next stage of our journey.
english.completed: Speak with Wrathion atop Mason's Folly in the Veiled Stair.

text.title: 泰坦回音
text.objectives: 从修身殿和风暴之巅的团队首领身上取得12块泰坦符文石。
text.description: 我开始放眼大局了，并开始了解魔古族与泰坦的关联。但每个答案却衍生出更多的问题！$b$b要想把谜团解开，唯一的办法就是把从雷电之王宫殿里找到的所有关于泰坦的信息碎片都搜集起来。消灭雷电之王和他的爪牙，把能找到的泰坦符文石都拿回来！
text.progress: What have you discovered so far?$B$BWe need to gather all the information we can!
text.completion: Thanks to your work, $n, we've reconstructed an ancient narrative. The mogu were once creatures of stone, enacting the will of the Titans. But then their master fell silent, and they succumbed to the curse of the flesh. Eventually Lei Shen came along, imprisoned the keeper Ra, and took his power. Ah, what an empire he built!$B$BArmed with this knowledge, it's time to act...
text.completed: Bring the Titan Runestones to Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

english.title: Echoes of the Titans
english.objectives: Collect 12 Titan Runestones from raid bosses in the Halls of Flesh-Shaping and the Pinnacle of Storms.
english.description: I'm beginning to see the bigger picture, now, and how the mogu relate to the Titans. But every answer brings with it more questions!$b$bThe only way to put this puzzle together is to find every scrap of Titan information we can scavenge from the Thunder King's palace. Destroy the Thunder King and his minions and collect as many Titan runestones as you can find!
english.progress: What have you discovered so far?$B$BWe need to gather all the information we can!
english.completion: Thanks to your work, $n, we've reconstructed an ancient narrative. The mogu were once creatures of stone, enacting the will of the Titans. But then their master fell silent, and they succumbed to the curse of the flesh. Eventually Lei Shen came along, imprisoned the keeper Ra, and took his power. Ah, what an empire he built!$B$BArmed with this knowledge, it's time to act...
english.completed: Bring the Titan Runestones to Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

text.title: 雷神之核
text.objectives: 在雷电王座内殿里消灭雷电之王，并取得雷神之核。
text.description: 已死去一万两千年之久的雷电之王，却被赞达拉的声音唤了回来。无疑是泰坦之力使他邪恶的尸身恒久不腐。$b$b泰坦之力应该归我所有。$b$b$n！把雷神之核给我带回来。一旦我得到了它，谁也别想再让他起死回生。$b$b把它带来交给我，$c。把他冰冷的核心交给我！
text.progress: The Thunder King! What has become of him?
text.completion: <Wrathion squeezes the black heart in his hand, his eyes burning brightly.>$B$BYou did it... you did it! The black heart of the Thunder King!
text.completed: Bring the heart to Wrathion at the Tavern in the mists in the Veiled Stair.

english.title: Heart of the Thunder King
english.objectives: Slay the Thunder King in the Halls of Thunder and collect the Heart of the Thunder King.
english.description: The Thunder King. Dead for twelve thousand years, only to be brought back by Zandalari voice. No doubt Titan power preserved his vile corpse.$b$bTitan power that's mine by right.$b$b$n! Bring me the heart of the Thunder King. I will have it, and once it is mine, none will ever be able to resurrect him again.$b$bBring it to me, $c. Bring me his cold, dead heart!
english.progress: The Thunder King! What has become of him?
english.completion: <Wrathion squeezes the black heart in his hand, his eyes burning brightly.>$B$BYou did it... you did it! The black heart of the Thunder King!
english.completed: Bring the heart to Wrathion at the Tavern in the mists in the Veiled Stair.

text.title: 清算
text.objectives: 在雾纱栈道的迷雾酒肆楼上与拉希奥交谈。
text.description: 雷电之王死了，他用于镇压的工具已由联盟和部落夺取，以实现自己的目的。$b$b我们现在已来到熊猫人战役的巅峰。地狱咆哮的诡计已使联盟无力应对——但更为重要的是，他还使部落变得分崩离析。正如熊猫人所说：“打铁趁热。”必须采取行动了，我们所有的努力也都是为了这个。$b$b我需要时间来制定计划。等你的阵营做好准备就来见我！
text.completed: 去雾纱栈道迷雾酒肆的楼上找拉希奥谈一谈。

english.title: A Reckoning
english.objectives: Speak with Wrathion upstairs at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.
english.description: The Thunder King is dead, and his instruments of oppression are being picked over by the Alliance and Horde for their own ends.$b$bWe come now to the climax of the pandaren campaign. Hellscream's machinations have brought the Alliance down on his head - but even more importantly, he's fractured the unity of the Horde. As the Pandaren say: "The Wok is Hot." Something is about to give, and all of our work comes down to this.$b$bI need time to plan. See me as soon as your faction is ready to make its move!
english.completed: Speak with Wrathion upstairs at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

text.title: 开创未来
text.objectives: 在风暴之巅击败雷电之王，然后用安东尼达斯之杖从他的平台中汲取剩余力量。
text.description: 有传闻说，雷电之王的力量是直接来自他宫殿内的某个秘密源头。$b$b即便在他被击败后，新的暴君，比如说加尔鲁什，也能凭借这股魔法酿成悲剧。$b$b除非我们先发制人！$b$b带上我的法杖，进入风暴之巅。击败雷神后，将我的法杖插进他平台的正中央。$b$b我们要将他剩下的力量汲取出来，确保不落在他人手中。
text.progress: We will be unstoppable once Lei Shen's power has been fused with my staff.
text.completion: You have just secured our advantage, $n. Your work here will be remembered.$B$BGarrosh will be made to pay for his actions!
text.completed: Return to Lady Jaina Proudmoore in the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Securing A Future
english.objectives: Defeat the Thunder King within the Pinnacle of Storms and use the Staff of Antonidas to drain the remaining power from his dais.
english.description: It is rumored that the Thunder King's power comes directly from a hidden source within his palace.$b$bEven when he is defeated a new tyrant, Garrosh perhaps, could still use this magic to a terrible end.$b$bThat is unless we make the first move!$b$bTake my staff into the Pinnacle of Storms. Once Lei Shen has been defeated place my staff in the center of his dais.$b$bWe will drain the rest of his power and make sure it stays in our hands.
english.progress: We will be unstoppable once Lei Shen's power has been fused with my staff.
english.completion: You have just secured our advantage, $n. Your work here will be remembered.$B$BGarrosh will be made to pay for his actions!
english.completed: Return to Lady Jaina Proudmoore in the Isle of Thunder.

objectiveDetails.description: 取回充能的安东尼达斯之杖

items.name: Glorious Standard of the Kirin Tor Offensive

text.title: 赞达拉预言书
text.objectives: 将赞达拉预言书带给游学者周卓。
text.description: 亲爱的$p，$b$b我已经读过了你关于赞达拉巨魔的报告，并确信我已经拼凑出他们近期进攻的线索。$b$b如果你能到锦绣谷的闻道之座来一趟，我们就可以将这一成果加入你的私人收藏。$b$b感谢你的努力！$b$b此致，$b$b游学者周卓
text.completion: No wonder the Zandalari have come. They are in need of a new home, and I am sure their mogu allies have promised them much.$B$BWe will add this knowledge to your collection. If you wish me to narrate this for you, simply point at the correct volume in your Private Collection.
text.completed: 去锦绣谷的闻道之座和游学者周卓谈一谈。

english.title: The Zandalari Prophecy
english.objectives: Bring The Zandalari Prophecy to Lorewalker Cho.
english.description: Dear $p,$b$bI have read your reports on the Zandalari and believe I have some clues as to their most recent aggression.$b$bIf you visit us at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms we can add this contribution to your personal collection.$b$bThank you for your diligence!$b$bSincerely,$b$bLorewalker Cho
english.completion: No wonder the Zandalari have come. They are in need of a new home, and I am sure their mogu allies have promised them much.$B$BWe will add this knowledge to your collection. If you wish me to narrate this for you, simply point at the correct volume in your Private Collection.
english.completed: Speak with Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: 雷电轰鸣
text.objectives: 将雷电轰鸣带给游学者周卓。
text.description: 亲爱的$p，$b$b滚雷的不祥之音令我一代又一代的族人饱受困扰。正如你在自己研究中发现的那样，雷神正是那恐惧的源头所在。$b$b如果你能到锦绣谷的闻道之座来一趟，我们就可以将这一成果加入你的私人收藏。$b$b感谢你的努力！$b$b此致，$b$b游学者周卓
text.completion: What we know of Lei Shen are dark legends that have been remembered over the vast span of time. I often wondered if these legends had exaggerated the power of Lei Shen. But your research would suggest they may have greatly underestimated the Thunder King. These are dark days indeed.$B$BWe will add this knowledge to your collection. If you wish me to narrate this for you, simply point at the correct volume in your Private Collection.
text.completed: 去锦绣谷的闻道之座和游学者周卓谈一谈。

english.title: Rumbles of Thunder
english.objectives: Bring the Rumbles of Thunder to Lorewalker Cho.
english.description: Dear $p,$b$bThe foreboding sound of thunder has haunted my people for generations. And as you have discovered in your own research, Lei Shen is at the heart of that fear.$b$bIf you visit us at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms we can add this contribution to your personal collection.$b$bThank you for your diligence!$b$bSincerely,$b$bLorewalker Cho
english.completion: What we know of Lei Shen are dark legends that have been remembered over the vast span of time. I often wondered if these legends had exaggerated the power of Lei Shen. But your research would suggest they may have greatly underestimated the Thunder King. These are dark days indeed.$B$BWe will add this knowledge to your collection. If you wish me to narrate this for you, simply point at the correct volume in your Private Collection.
english.completed: Speak with Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: 神祇与妖魔
text.objectives: 将神祇与妖魔带给游学者周卓。
text.description: 亲爱的$p，$b$b魔古族当真与泰坦存在着某种关联吗？这简直太令人难以置信了。但在看过了你的研究报告后，关于魔古族的部分真相开始浮出水面。$b$b如果你能到锦绣谷的闻道之座来一趟，我们就可以将这一成果加入你的私人收藏。$b$b感谢你的努力！$b$b此致，$b$b游学者周卓
text.completion: Your research is most distressing. But it sheds light on a truth we have long sought: "Where did the mogu come from? And why were they such tyrants?"$B$BWe will add this knowledge to your collection. If you wish me to narrate this for you, simply point at the correct volume in your Private Collection.
text.completed: 去锦绣谷的闻道之座和游学者周卓谈一谈。

english.title: Gods and Monsters
english.objectives: Bring the Gods and Monsters to Lorewalker Cho.
english.description: Dear $p,$b$bIs it true that the mogu are really connected to the titans? I find this very hard to believe. But looking over your research, some of the truth about the mogu begins to take shape.$b$bIf you visit us at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms we can add this contribution to your personal collection.$b$bThank you for your diligence!$b$bSincerely,$b$bLorewalker Cho
english.completion: Your research is most distressing. But it sheds light on a truth we have long sought: "Where did the mogu come from? And why were they such tyrants?"$B$BWe will add this knowledge to your collection. If you wish me to narrate this for you, simply point at the correct volume in your Private Collection.
english.completed: Speak with Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: 寓言之兽
text.objectives: 击败熊猫人寓言中的精英战宠。
text.description: 你读过伟大的熊猫人寓言之书了吗？熊猫人把这些故事讲给自己的孩子们听——故事的主角或是蟋蟀和老鹰，或是缓慢爬行的海龟，通过这些故事，让孩子们懂得对今后的人生大有裨益的哲理。但很少有孩子知道，这些生物竟在潘达利亚活生生地存在着！尽管关于它们游历的故事是编造出来的，但它们可是这世界上强大的住民。要是你在旅途中遇到了它们，不妨试试自己宠物的身手，与这些传奇的大家伙们较量一番。
text.completion: You found them all? Amazing! So the stories ARE true! Perhaps you will write the next great Pandaren fable based on your own incredible journey!
text.completed: Return to the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
text.giverWindow: 打败那些寓言之兽！

english.title: Beasts of Fable
english.objectives: Defeat the Elite Battle Pets of the Pandaren fables.
english.description: Have you ever read the great Pandaren book of fables?  Pandaren pass these stories on to their cubs - stories of the cricket and the hawk, or the slow-moving turtle - to teach them lessons that they will find useful in life. What few cubs know is that these creatures exist, here, in Pandaria! Though the stories of their travels are made up, they are powerful denizens of this world. Should you happen upon them in your travels, you may test the might of your pets against their storied statures.
english.completion: You found them all? Amazing! So the stories ARE true! Perhaps you will write the next great Pandaren fable based on your own incredible journey!
english.completed: Return to the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
english.giverWindow: Take on the fabled beasts!

text.title: 《寓言之兽》第一册
text.objectives: 击败贪吃的卡瓦、尼顿、咖菲和多斯里加。
text.description: 贪吃的卡瓦、尼顿、咖菲和多斯里加的故事将永远流传在这片土地上。你想再和它们较量一次吗？
text.completion: I bow to you who continues to walk in the footfalls of the great Pandaren fables.
text.completed: Return to the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

english.title: Beasts of Fable Book I
english.objectives: Defeat Ka'wi the Gorger, Nitun, Kafi, and Dos-Ryga.
english.description: The stories of Ka'wi the Gorger, Nitun, Kafi, and Dos-Ryga will exist in this land, always. Do you wish to meet them in battle once more?
english.completion: I bow to you who continues to walk in the footfalls of the great Pandaren fables.
english.completed: Return to the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: 微妙的鼓励
text.objectives: 将魔古武器插在9个邪刃蜥蜴人的尸体附近。
text.description: 蜥蜴人非常邪恶，但我们却有着共同的敌人——魔古族。我更愿意派蜥蜴人去消灭魔古族，而不是让我自己的兄弟去送死。$b$b我们一直在收集魔古的武器。击败蜥蜴人后，将这些长矛插在它们身边。让我们的敌人自相残杀，就能挽救大批部落手足的性命。
text.completion: Masterfully done, $c.
text.completed: Return to Archmage Aethas Sunreaver on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Subtle Encouragement
english.objectives: Plant Mogu Weapons into the corpses of 9 Skumblade saurok.
english.description: The saurok are vile, but we share an enemy: the mogu. And I'd rather send saurok to kill mogu than send my own men.$b$bWe've been collecting mogu weaponry. Bury these polearms into the skulls of the saurok. Feed our enemies' rivalry, and you may save Horde lives.
english.completion: Masterfully done, $c.
english.completed: Return to Archmage Aethas Sunreaver on the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: Extended Shore Leave
text.objectives: Steal the Workshop Orders and slay the new captain of the Zandalari warship.
text.description: The Zandalari have already begun repairing that warship, but we can keep it crippled with minimal effort.$B$BSimply relieve the new captain of his post, and steal the ship's damage report from that workshop just outside the vault.$B$BNo captain. No repairs. No warship.
text.progress: Each passing hour brings us closer to breaking the Thunder King.
text.completion: Casualties are down significantly with that warship out of commission, and we continue to press the siege on Lei Shen.$B$BFantastic work out there today, hero.$B$BPlease, take this - you have earned it.
text.completed: Report to Lady Jaina Proudmoore at Violet Rise.

english.objectives: Steal the Workshop Orders and slay the new captain of the Zandalari warship.

text.title: 突袭宝库
text.objectives: 从浮华宝库里偷取风暴项圈。
text.description: 在浮华宝库里存满了雷神最难对付的武器和最珍贵的饰物——不必惊讶，这些通常总是千篇一律，毫无新意。$B$B但其中有一样神器很特别，那是一件名叫风暴项圈的护符，能帮我们弄清他驾驭闪电的奥秘。$B$B进入宝库，消灭宝藏看守者。拿走他的钥匙，用它从宝库后面的储物箱里找回护符。
text.progress: The Thunder King's strength is legendary. We need every advantage we can get if we want to defeat him.
text.completion: What's this? A necklace? What are you trying to- ahh, I see... A relic from the Thunder King's vault! Fascinating... Powerful, too.$B$BThe Kirin Tor will keep it safe. In return, please accept this.
text.completed: Report to Lady Jaina Proudmoore at Violet Rise.

english.title: Raiding the Vault
english.objectives: Steal the Choker of Storms from The Swollen Vault.
english.description: The Swollen Vault is a repository for some of Lei Shen's nastiest weaponry and most prized trinkets - not surprisingly, these are often one and the same.$B$BOne artifact in particular, an amulet known as the Choker of Storms, could help us to understand is apparent mastery over lightning.$B$BBreak into the vault and slay the hoard-keeper. Take his key and use it to recover the amulet from a cache at the back of the vault.
english.progress: The Thunder King's strength is legendary. We need every advantage we can get if we want to defeat him.
english.completion: What's this? A necklace? What are you trying to- ahh, I see... A relic from the Thunder King's vault! Fascinating... Powerful, too.$B$BThe Kirin Tor will keep it safe. In return, please accept this.
english.completed: Report to Lady Jaina Proudmoore at Violet Rise.

text.title: 学习骑乘
text.objectives: 找到兰达尔·亨特。
text.description: 你该学习骑术了！到艾尔文森林的东谷伐木场找兰达尔·亨特。到那别忘了买坐骑！
text.completion: Don't forget to buy your mount while you are here!  Katie Hunter can be found here in camp.
text.giverWindow: 找到兰达尔·亨特并学习如何骑乘坐骑！

english.title: Learn To Ride
english.objectives: Find Randal Hunter.
english.description: It's time for you to learn how to ride!  Seek out Randal Hunter at the Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest.  Don't forget to buy your mount while you are there!
english.completion: Don't forget to buy your mount while you are here!  Katie Hunter can be found here in camp.
english.giverWindow: Find Randal Hunter and learn how to ride a mount!

text.title: 霹雳钢
text.objectives: 调查雷霆熔炉，找到霹雳钢的奥秘。
text.description: 你训练有素的双眼能看出这块金属有着某种极其诡异的属性。也许在这附近能找到与它特质相关的蛛丝马迹？
text.completion: While the language is incomprehensible, the diagrams in this book yield their knowledge to your skilled blacksmith's eye. It is clear that, by manipulating the properties of ghost iron, you can create a material of great power, perhaps powerful enough to recreate and increase the power of weapons long lost to the mists of time.
text.completed: 找到霹雳钢的奥秘。

english.title: Lightning Steel
english.objectives: Investigate the Thunder Forge to find the Secrets of Lightning Steel.
english.description: Your trained eyes can see that this metal ingot has some very strange properties. Perhaps there are clues to its nature somewhere around here?
english.completion: While the language is incomprehensible, the diagrams in this book yield their knowledge to your skilled blacksmith's eye. It is clear that, by manipulating the properties of ghost iron, you can create a material of great power, perhaps powerful enough to recreate and increase the power of weapons long lost to the mists of time.
english.completed: Find the Secrets of Lightning Steel.

text.title: 充能绿柱石
text.objectives: 找到一块充能绿柱石，并将它带给战斗法师尤里亚斯。
text.description: 我们每天都派间谍深入夺日者行动基地。有些肩负着从敌人手中找到充能绿柱石并将其带回的使命。$b$b他们还没回来，而且我能确定，他们已经离开了夺日者基地。$b$b在位于两地之间的丛林中展开搜寻，寻找任何有可能遗失在运输途中的充能绿柱石。把它带回来交给我，这会对我们大有用处。
text.completion: Well done, champion. This artifact will be put to better use in our hands than in the hands of the Sunreavers.
text.completed: Speak with Warmage Yurias in Violet Rise at the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Charged Moganite
english.objectives: Recover a Charged Moganite and bring it to Warmage Yurias.
english.description: We have been dispatching spies into the Sunreaver base of operations on a daily basis. Some had orders to recover charged moganite from the enemy and bring it here.$b$bThey have not returned, and I can confirm they have left the Sunreaver base.$b$bSearch the jungle between here and there and find any of the charged moganite that might have been lost in transit. Bring it to me and we will put it to good use.
english.completion: Well done, champion. This artifact will be put to better use in our hands than in the hands of the Sunreavers.
english.completed: Speak with Warmage Yurias in Violet Rise at the Isle of Thunder.

objectiveDetails.description: 将充能绿柱石送回紫罗兰高地

text.title: 战术魔法炸弹
text.objectives: 在一艘夺日者舰船上、占卜水晶和寻晨者海角最靠近内陆的桥梁上各放置一枚战术魔法炸弹。
text.description: 啊，$p，你正是我要找的$r。我又得到了一批战术魔法炸弹，需要将它们安放在位于西北边寻晨者海角对面的关键位置。$b$b这些就交给你了。是时候让夺日者尝尝自己酿下的苦果。$b$b在其中一艘夺日者舰船上安放一枚，在他们的占卜水晶上安放一枚，最后再在通往他们前沿基地的桥梁上安放一枚。
text.completion: It pains me to resort to such weaponry, but the Sunreavers must be taught the price of their actions.
text.completed: Return to Captain Elleane Wavecrest at the Violet Rise.

english.title: Tactical Mana Bombs
english.objectives: Plant a Tactical Mana Bomb on a Sunreaver ship, the Scrying Crystals, and on the most inland bridge of Dawnseeker Promontory.
english.description: Ah, $p, just the $r I was looking for. I have received another batch of tactical mana bombs that I need planted in key positions across Dawnseeker Promontory to the northwest.$b$bHere, take these. It is time to give the Sunreavers a taste of their own medicine.$b$bPlant one on the Sunreaver ships, another one on their scrying crystals, and the last on the bridge that connects to their forward base.
english.completion: It pains me to resort to such weaponry, but the Sunreavers must be taught the price of their actions.
english.completed: Return to Captain Elleane Wavecrest at the Violet Rise.

objectiveDetails.description: 在夺日者舰船上放置炸弹
在占卜水晶上放置炸弹

text.title: 首席工程师贾德的日记
text.objectives: 调查雷霆熔炉，找到固化闪电的秘诀。
text.description: 多么另类的能量之源啊！不知它是怎么运作的？它又能创造出什么呢？
text.completed: 找到固化闪电的秘诀。

english.title: Chief Engineer Jard's Journal
english.objectives: Investigate the Thunder Forges to find the Secrets of Stabilized Lightning.
english.description: What an unusual power source. Wonder how it works? And what it can be used to create?
english.completed: Find the Secrets of Stabilized Lightning.

text.title: 高度评价
text.completed: Return to Warmage Yurias at the Violet Rise.

english.title: High Recognition
english.completed: Return to Warmage Yurias at the Violet Rise.

text.title: 为战斗而生
text.objectives: 击败葬火之星歼灭者。
text.description: 制作者在造就某些东西时，为其赋予了多种用途。而有些东西的唯一用途就是毁灭。$b$b一种名叫葬火之星歼灭者的巨型构造体戍守着寻晨者海角。它的作用就是摧毁。必须将它卸除。
text.completion: Excellent work, $r. The problem with constructs is they can always be rebuilt.$B$BI imagine it will not take the Sunreavers long to build a new death machine.
text.completed: Return to Warmage Yurias at the Violet Rise.

english.title: Made for War
english.objectives: Kill the Pyrestar Demolisher.
english.description: Some things are built with multiple purposes in mind. Some things are built with the sole purpose of destruction.$b$bA massive construct called the Pyrestar Demolisher sits guarding Dawnseeker Promontory. Its purpose is solely to destroy. It must be dismantled.
english.completion: Excellent work, $r. The problem with constructs is they can always be rebuilt.$B$BI imagine it will not take the Sunreavers long to build a new death machine.
english.completed: Return to Warmage Yurias at the Violet Rise.

text.title: 魔法束缚
text.objectives: 从寻晨者海角找回罗曼斯的咒术之书。
text.description: 大法师罗曼斯手里有件令我向往的东西。$b$b他随身带着一本非常强大的书卷。要是能把它从夺日者手中抢过来，就会对我们大有益处。$b$b找到罗曼斯的咒术之书，把它交给我。
text.progress: Did you find the tome?
text.completion: Ah yes! This is it. You've done well, $r.
text.completed: Return to Warmage Yurias at the Violet Rise.

english.title: Spellbound
english.objectives: Retrieve Rommath's Book of Incantations from Dawnseeker Promontory.
english.description: Grand Magister Rommath has something in his possession that I want.$b$bHe brought a very powerful tome with him. It would be better for our cause if it were no longer in Sunreaver hands.$b$bLocate Rommath's book of incantations and bring it to me.
english.progress: Did you find the tome?
english.completion: Ah yes! This is it. You've done well, $r.
english.completed: Return to Warmage Yurias at the Violet Rise.

text.title: 粉碎防御
text.objectives: 在寻晨者海角附近摧毁6个夺日者监视结界。
text.description: 哪怕是最无懈可击的防御也会有薄弱点，$c。我们只需要找到夺日者防线的薄弱点，然后尽可能地加以利用。$b$b据斥候回报，在寻晨者海角四处布满了监视结界。这些结界十分强大，可并不具有致命的杀伤力。$b$b如果能让它们失效，我们就能近距离监视夺日者的行动了。
text.completion: Excellent work, $r! I was able to get a few of my scouts behind their lines before the perimeter wards were repaired.
text.completed: Return to Captain Elleane Wavecrest at the Violet Rise.

english.title: Breaking Down the Defenses
english.objectives: Destroy 6 Sunreaver Perimeter Wards around Dawnseeker Promontory.
english.description: Even the strongest defense can still have a weakness, $c. We just need to find the weakness in the Sunreaver's defense and then exploit it as much as possible.$b$bScouts have reported the use of perimeter wards around Dawnseeker Promontory. They're powerful, but not deadly.$b$bDisabling them would allow us to keep closer watch on their activities.
english.completion: Excellent work, $r! I was able to get a few of my scouts behind their lines before the perimeter wards were repaired.
english.completed: Return to Captain Elleane Wavecrest at the Violet Rise.

text.title: 终止爆炸！
text.objectives: 在紫罗兰高地卸除联盟舰船、构造体仪式和补给品附近的战术魔法炸弹。
text.description: 夺日者在我们的营地四周布满了战术魔法炸弹。必须在这些炸弹爆破前将其卸除。$b$b在重要区域搜寻这些炸弹，比如我们的补给品附近。一定要找到并把它们全都卸除。我们决不能再失去任何阵地了。
text.completion: I'm grateful for your efforts here, $n. We would have lost so much had you not disarmed those bombs in time.
text.completed: Return to Lady Jaina Proudmoore at the Violet Rise.

english.title: Enough with the Bombs!
english.objectives: Disarm the Tactical Mana Bombs at the Alliance Ships, the Construct Ritual, and the Supplies within Violet Rise.
english.description: The Sunreavers have planted tactical mana bombs around our camp. These must be dismantled before they are detonated.$b$bLook for them in areas of high importance such as our supplies. Make sure you find and disable them all. We cannot afford to lose any ground here.
english.completion: I'm grateful for your efforts here, $n. We would have lost so much had you not disarmed those bombs in time.
english.completed: Return to Lady Jaina Proudmoore at the Violet Rise.

objectiveDetails.description: 拆除舰船上的战术魔法炸弹
拆除补给品附近的战术魔法炸弹
拆除构造体仪式上的战术魔法炸弹

text.title: 不情愿的观众
text.objectives: 在寻晨者海角附近解救5名肯瑞托俘虏。
text.description: 夺日者会毫无底线地实现自己的目标，$n。$b$b我之前收到报告，几位肯瑞托成员不知所踪。我怀疑这也许跟夺日者有关。$b$b希望他们还没惨遭毒手，否则我的怒火恐怕要喷薄而出了。相信你能把他们安然无恙地带回来，但一定要抓紧时间。
text.completion: You have saved many today, $n. I cannot imagine the horror of being frozen and helpless among so many enemies.
text.completed: Return to Lady Jaina Proudmoore at the Violet Rise.

english.title: Captive Audience
english.objectives: Free 5 Kirin Tor Captives near Dawnseeker Promontory.
english.description: The Sunreavers will stoop to even the lowest levels to get what they want, $n.$b$bI received reports earlier that several Kirin Tor have gone missing. I suspect the Sunreavers may have something to do with this.$b$bHopefully they have not been harmed, or my wrath will be swift and terrible. I trust you to bring them back in one piece, but please hurry.
english.completion: You have saved many today, $n. I cannot imagine the horror of being frozen and helpless among so many enemies.
english.completed: Return to Lady Jaina Proudmoore at the Violet Rise.

text.title: 超强能量
text.objectives: 在寻晨者海角附近摧毁7个夺日者法力收集器。
text.description: 夺日者的军队近来变得越发强大。我怀疑与魔法有关，但还不能确定。$b$b我认为比较明智的方法是去调查下他们的营地，看看是否能找到这股额外力量的源头。$b$b等你找到之后，用这块水晶使其过载，并摧毁它。
text.completion: So they've constructed objects that infuse their forces with additional power? This will have to be watched closely.$B$BThank you for your efforts today.
text.completed: Return to Lady Jaina Proudmoore at the Violet Rise.

english.title: Overpowered
english.objectives: Destroy 7 Sunreaver Mana Collectors around Dawnseeker Promontory.
english.description: The Sunreaver forces have grown more powerful recently. I suspect magic to be at play here, but I can't be certain.$b$bI think it would be wise to investigate their camp to see if you can find the source of this extra power.$b$bOnce you find it, use this crystal to overload and destroy it.
english.completion: So they've constructed objects that infuse their forces with additional power? This will have to be watched closely.$B$BThank you for your efforts today.
english.completed: Return to Lady Jaina Proudmoore at the Violet Rise.

objectiveDetails.description: 摧毁夺日者法力收集器

text.title: 魔法清道夫
text.objectives: 消灭9只夺日者法力浮龙。
text.description: 有时候，最微不足道的生物却能造成最大的威胁。$b$b夺日者携带法力浮龙作战。虽然体型小巧，但却能让我们的施法者在战斗中阵脚大乱。许多人都为轻敌付出了惨痛代价。$b$b必须尽快消灭它们。
text.completion: You've made excellent progress today, $c. Rest assured however, our work here is nowhere close to done.
text.completed: Return to Captain Elleane Wavecrest at the Violet Rise.

english.title: Mana Scavengers
english.objectives: Kill 9 Sunreaver Mana Wyrms.
english.description: Sometimes, even the smallest creatures can be the biggest threat.$b$bThe Sunreavers brought mana wyrms with them. Though small in size they have the ability to cripple our casters in combat. Many have learned the hard way not to underestimate them.$b$bThey must be dealt with and quickly.
english.completion: You've made excellent progress today, $c. Rest assured however, our work here is nowhere close to done.
english.completed: Return to Captain Elleane Wavecrest at the Violet Rise.

text.title: 解体
text.objectives: 在寻晨者海角外摧毁3个夺日者构造体。
text.description: 据斥候回报，有大批构造体在寻晨者海角外面巡逻。$b$b如果不加抑制，一旦夺日者发起攻击，这些构造体会对我们形成重大威胁。$b$b唯一的办法就是先发制人。我们要在夺日者发起攻击之前摧毁它们！
text.completion: Good work, $c. As long as we keep the construct numbers in check, we will ensure our success here.
text.completed: Return to Captain Elleane Wavecrest at the Violet Rise.

english.title: Deconstruction
english.objectives: Destroy 3 Sunreaver Constructs outside of Dawnseeker Promontory.
english.description: Scouts are reporting a large number of constructs patrolling outside of Dawnseeker Promontory.$b$bIf left unchecked they will pose a considerable threat should the Sunreavers mount an attack.$b$bThe only answer is a preemptive strike. We'll destroy them before they can attack us!
english.completion: Good work, $c. As long as we keep the construct numbers in check, we will ensure our success here.
english.completed: Return to Captain Elleane Wavecrest at the Violet Rise.

text.title: 雷电之王的勇士
text.objectives: 在雷神岛的各个位置使用山泽仪式石举行闪电仪式、灵魂仪式和原始仪式，然后击败被召唤出的强大对手。
text.description: 在这座岛屿上布满了伺机而动的敌对力量，主要来自三个强大的组织，时刻准备朝我们发起攻击。他们分别是驾驭雷电的大师，古老而强大的幽灵，以及原始赞达拉畸体。$B$B要是你能找到一些散落在这岛屿四处的山泽仪式石，你应该就能让这些强大的敌人现身，一举击败他们。$B$B找到并消灭每个组织的成员，让他们阵脚大乱，我不会让你白忙的。
text.completion: Yours skills as a $c are unquestionable. You've aided the cause greatly this day. You have my thanks.$B$BAnd now for that reward I promised you...
text.completed: Return to Taran Zhu in Bleak Hollow.

english.title: Champions of the Thunder King
english.objectives: Use Shan'ze Ritual Stones to perform the Lightning Ritual, the Spirit Ritual, and the Primal Ritual at various locations across the Isle of Thunder, and then defeat the powerful opponents that are summoned forth.
english.description: This island is riddled with lurking threats from three powerful groups, waiting for the chance to pounce on us. Masters of lightning, ancient and powerful spirits, and primal Zandalari monstrosities.$B$BIf you can get your hands on some of the Shan'ze Ritual Stones scattered across the isle, you should be able to beckon these powerful opponents out of hiding and strike out at them.$B$BFind and destroy members of each group to keep them destabilized, and I will make it worth your time.
english.completion: Yours skills as a $c are unquestionable. You've aided the cause greatly this day. You have my thanks.$B$BAnd now for that reward I promised you...
english.completed: Return to Taran Zhu in Bleak Hollow.

召唤并击败一名闪电勇士
召唤并击败一名原始勇士

text.title: 产品订单：统御先锋军I
text.objectives: 在日歌农场播种8颗红韭花种子。
text.description: <从老愚的字迹中可以看出来，他的内心似乎充满矛盾。>$b$b我总是尽量避免冲突，但订单就是订单。鉴于你是部落的成员，我决定把这份订单交给你处理。$b$b统御先锋军要订购一批红韭花。$b$b下方的军队仿佛有再多红韭花都不够用！

english.title: Work Order: Dominance Offensive I
english.objectives: Plant 8 Red Blossom Leek Seeds on Sunsong Ranch.
english.description: <Yoon's writing decorates the page though his feelings seem conflicted.>$b$bI normally try to stay out of conflict, but an order is an order. Since you are of the Horde I decided to pass this order your way.$b$bThe Dominance Offensive has requested an order of red blossom leeks.$b$bThe troops down there just can't seem to get enough of them!

text.title: 产品订单：统御先锋军II
text.objectives: 收获8个成熟的红韭花，并向统御先锋军提供40份红韭花。
text.description: 等你的红韭花长到可以采摘时，你只要将它们打包，等待提取就好了。$b$b记住一点，你的红韭花能帮你提升在潘达利亚的阵营声望！
text.progress: The crate sits empty awaiting your crops.
text.completion: Throw the Red Blossom Leeks into the crate! A Dominance Offensive representative will be along shortly for pick-up.
text.completed: Package the Red Blossom Leeks in the Empty Crate on Sunsong Ranch.

english.title: Work Order: Dominance Offensive II
english.objectives: Harvest 8 Ripe Red Blossom Leek plants and provide 40 Red Blossom Leeks for the Dominance Offensive.
english.description: Once your red blossom leeks are ready to be picked, you'll need only to package them for pick-up.$b$bJust think; your red blossom leeks will be a part of your faction's efforts in Pandaria!
english.progress: The crate sits empty awaiting your crops.
english.completion: Throw the Red Blossom Leeks into the crate! A Dominance Offensive representative will be along shortly for pick-up.
english.completed: Package the Red Blossom Leeks in the Empty Crate on Sunsong Ranch.

text.title: 突袭绍尔马拉
text.objectives: 完成突袭绍尔马拉。与吉安娜·普罗德摩尔交谈从而开始进攻。
text.description: 我们在海岸沿线部署的侦察力量为我们提供了关于这座岛屿的宝贵情报，$c。$B$B然而，如果我们不向本岛推进，就必将一事无成。$B$B我已经集结了一支由精英空军单位组成的战队，准备发起攻击。$B$B我想让你参与这次行动。像你这样的英雄一定能帮我们在紧要关头力挽狂澜。$B$B当你做好出击准备时，来与我谈谈。
text.completion: Yes! You have done it, champion!$B$BNow, the Thunder King will taste the full force of the Kirin Tor!
text.completed: Return to Jaina Proudmoore at Violet Rise on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: The Assault on Shaol'mara
english.objectives: Complete the Assault on Shaol'mara. Speak to Jaina Proudmoore to begin the attack.
english.description: Our scouting efforts along the coast have given us valuable intelligence about the island, $c.$B$BHowever, we will accomplish nothing if we do not advance forward onto the mainland.$B$BI have assembled a team of our most elite aerial units to begin the attack.$B$BI would like you to join the assault. A champion such as yourself could turn the battle in our favor at the critical moment.$B$BWhen you are ready to begin the attack, speak to me.
english.completion: Yes! You have done it, champion!$B$BNow, the Thunder King will taste the full force of the Kirin Tor!
english.completed: Return to Jaina Proudmoore at Violet Rise on the Isle of Thunder.

objectiveDetails.description: 与吉安娜·普罗德摩尔交谈

text.title: 产品订单：神盾守备军I
text.objectives: 在日歌农场播种8颗女巫浆果种子。
text.description: <从老愚的字迹中可以看出来，他的内心似乎充满矛盾。>$b$b我总是尽量避免冲突，但订单就是订单。鉴于你是联盟的成员，我决定把这份订单交给你处理。$b$b神盾守备军要订购一批女巫浆果。$b$b尽管我不能确定，但我想他们有办法把它们用在某种武器上。

english.title: Work Order: Operation: Shieldwall I
english.objectives: Plant 8 Witchberry Seeds on Sunsong Ranch.
english.description: <Yoon's writing decorates the page though his feelings seem conflicted.>$b$bI normally try to stay out of conflict, but an order is an order. Since you are of the Alliance I decided to pass this order your way.$b$bOperation: Shieldwall has requested a whole heap of witchberries.$b$bI can't be sure, but I think they have an idea to use them in some sort of weapon.

text.title: 产品订单：神盾守备军II
text.objectives: 收获8个成熟的女巫浆果，并向神盾守备军提供40份女巫浆果。
text.description: 等你的女巫浆果长到可以采摘时，你只要将它们打包，等待提取就好了。$b$b记住一点，你的女巫浆果能帮你提升在潘达利亚的阵营声望！
text.progress: The crate sits empty awaiting your crops.
text.completion: Throw the Witchberries into the crate! An Operation: Shieldwall representative will be along shortly for pick-up.
text.completed: Package the Witchberries in the Empty Crate on Sunsong Ranch.

english.title: Work Order: Operation: Shieldwall II
english.objectives: Harvest 8 Ripe Witchberry plants and provide 40 Witchberries for Operation: Shieldwall.
english.description: Once your witchberries are ready to be picked, you'll need only to package them for pick-up.$b$bJust think; your witchberries will be a part of your faction's efforts in Pandaria!
english.progress: The crate sits empty awaiting your crops.
english.completion: Throw the Witchberries into the crate! An Operation: Shieldwall representative will be along shortly for pick-up.
english.completed: Package the Witchberries in the Empty Crate on Sunsong Ranch.

text.title: 产品订单：金莲教I
text.objectives: 在日歌农场播种8颗白色芜菁种子。
text.description: <老愚对这份订单的要求说得简明扼要。>$b$b金莲教要订购一大批白色芜菁。$b$b他们在提出需求时提到了在雾临村里大肆破坏的捣蛋林精。显然，林精不喜欢芜菁！

english.title: Work Order: Golden Lotus I
english.objectives: Plant 8 White Turnip Seeds on Sunsong Ranch.
english.description: <Yoon kept this order request short.>$b$bThe Golden Lotus have requested a large number of white turnips.$b$bTheir request mentioned something about trouble-making sprites wreaking havoc on Mistfall Village. Apparently the sprites don't like turnips!

text.title: 产品订单：金莲教II
text.objectives: 收获8个成熟的白色芜菁，并向金莲教提供40份白色芜菁。
text.description: 嗯，希望这些作物符合他们的要求！$b$b等你的白色芜菁长到可以采摘时，你只要将它们打包，等待提取就好了。
text.progress: The crate sits empty awaiting your crops.
text.completion: Throw the White Turnips into the crate! A Golden Lotus representative will be along shortly for pick-up.
text.completed: Package the White Turnips in the Empty Crate on Sunsong Ranch.

english.title: Work Order: Golden Lotus II
english.objectives: Harvest 8 Ripe White Turnip plants and provide 40 White Turnips for the Golden Lotus.
english.description: Well, hopefully these crops will be suitable!$b$bOnce your white turnips are ready to be picked, you'll need only to package them for pick-up.
english.progress: The crate sits empty awaiting your crops.
english.completion: Throw the White Turnips into the crate! A Golden Lotus representative will be along shortly for pick-up.
english.completed: Package the White Turnips in the Empty Crate on Sunsong Ranch.

text.title: 产品订单：影踪派I
text.objectives: 在日歌农场播种8颗绿色卷心菜种子。
text.description: <老愚的字迹显得仓促潦草。他一定是在异常兴奋的情况下书写的。>$b$b影踪派想让你帮他们种庄稼！这简直是无上的荣耀！$b$b我在今天早上收到了他们订购绿色卷心菜的订单。显然，他们能用这种食材熬制出相当可口的卷心菜汤来。$b$b只有最优质的果蔬才配得上影踪派！

english.title: Work Order: Shado-Pan I
english.objectives: Plant 8 Green Cabbage Seeds on Sunsong Ranch.
english.description: <Yoon's writing seems rushed. He must have been excited.>$b$bThe Shado-Pan want crops from you! What an honor indeed!$b$bA request came in this morning for green cabbages. Apparently, they make a rather tasty cabbage soup with them.$b$bOnly the finest will do for the Shado-Pan!

text.title: 产品订单：影踪派II
text.objectives: 收获8个成熟的绿色卷心菜，并向影踪派提供40份绿色卷心菜。
text.description: 嗯，你今天的工作已经完成了！等待明天的收获吧。$b$b等你的绿色卷心菜长到可以采摘时，你只要将它们打包，等待提取就好了。$b$b只有最棒的卷心菜才配得上影踪派！
text.progress: The crate sits empty awaiting your crops.
text.completion: Gently place the Green Cabbages into the crate! A Shado-Pan representative will be along shortly for pick-up.
text.completed: Package the Green Cabbages in the Empty Crate on Sunsong Ranch.

english.title: Work Order: Shado-Pan II
english.objectives: Harvest 8 Ripe Green Cabbage plants and provide 40 Green Cabbages for the Shado-Pan
english.description: Well, your work is done for the day! Now to wait for the harvest tomorrow.$b$bOnce your green cabbages are ready to be picked, you'll need only to package them for pick-up.$b$bOnly the finest cabbage will do for the Shado-Pan!
english.progress: The crate sits empty awaiting your crops.
english.completion: Gently place the Green Cabbages into the crate! A Shado-Pan representative will be along shortly for pick-up.
english.completed: Package the Green Cabbages in the Empty Crate on Sunsong Ranch.

objectiveDetails.description: 收获成熟的绿色卷心菜

text.title: 直冲云霄！
text.objectives: 进入闪电矿脉。
text.description:
我们想出了终止魔古族武器锻造的计划，而且要用上你从赞达拉那里找回的飞翼龙。

等你准备好了解更多细节时，来和我交谈吧。
text.completion: Incredible work. This presents us with a monumental opportunity.
text.completed: Return to Jaina Proudmoore at the Violet Rise.

english.title: To the Skies!
english.objectives: Gain access to the Lightning Vein Mine.
english.description:
We have a plan to halt the mogu's weaponmaking capabilities, and it involves the creature you recovered from the Zandalari.

Speak to me when you're ready to learn more.
english.completion: Incredible work. This presents us with a monumental opportunity.
english.completed: Return to Jaina Proudmoore at the Violet Rise.

text.title: 产品订单：至尊天神I
text.objectives: 在日歌农场播种8颗菜瓜种子。
text.description: <老愚熟悉的字迹出现在这张破烂的纸条上。>$b$b在赤精栖木的学徒们需要菜瓜。显然，他们在训练中要用到这种果实。$b$b明天会有代表前来收集你所能种出来的所有菜瓜。

english.title: Work Order: The August Celestials I
english.objectives: Plant 8 Striped Melon Seeds on Sunsong Ranch.
english.description: <Yoon's familiar writing scrolls across the tattered paper.>$b$bThe trainees out at the Cradle of Chi-Ji are in need of striped melons. Apparently, they use them in their training exercises.$b$bA representative will be by tomorrow to collect whatever striped melons you can spare.

text.title: 摧毁城墙！
text.objectives: 与吉安娜·普罗德摩尔交谈，然后攻入城市下层，为联盟夺取它。
text.description: 时机终于到了。我们的大军已在这里稳住阵脚，现在可以冒险突进，前往雷电之王的老巢了。不幸的是，他好像一时半会还没有打开大门的意思。$b$b那我们就只好自己弄出一道门来了。等你做好准备就来找我，$n。
text.completion: With your help, we're one giant step closer to our goal.
text.completed: Return to Lady Jaina Proudmoore on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Tear Down This Wall!
english.objectives: Speak with Lady Jaina Proudmoore, then break into the lower city and secure it for the Alliance.
english.description: The time has come. Our forces are well-enough entrenched here that we can risk pressing forward, into the Thunder King's lair. Unfortunately, it doesn't look like he'll be opening that gate anytime soon.$b$bI suppose we'll have to make a gate of our own then. Let me know when you're ready, $n.
english.completion: With your help, we're one giant step closer to our goal.
english.completed: Return to Lady Jaina Proudmoore on the Isle of Thunder.

objectiveDetails.description: 与吉安娜·普罗德摩尔交谈以开始你的任务

text.title: 大胆的点子
text.objectives: 渗透进风暴之海码头并从里面打开庭院大门。与陶矢交谈来开始任务。
text.description: 赞达拉战船在这座岛屿四周的海域上大肆掠夺。他们不断地从赞达拉运送士兵和作战野兽，来壮大雷神的军队。$B$B要是我们能夺取宫殿的船坞，雷电之王的补给线就会被截断，而你在这里的据点也会变得越发稳固。$B$B我有个计划可以实现这一目标，而且用不着劳烦整支大军出动。
text.completion: Well done. That warship won't be raining fire on us again any time soon.$B$BTaran Zhu has informed me that the Shado-Pan will keep vigil over Stormsea Landing, freeing up Kirin Tor resources to press the siege elsewhere. Taoshi will be there. I am sure she will be glad to work with you again.$B$BWe are all grateful for your contributions, $n. Thank you.
text.completed: Report to Lady Jaina Proudmoore at Violet Rise on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: A Bold Idea
english.objectives: Infiltrate Stormsea Landing and open the courtyard gate from within. Speak with Taoshi to begin the mission.
english.description: Zandalari warships plunder the seas around this island. They ferry in soldiers and war beasts from Zandalar to bolster Lei Shen's army.$B$BIf we can capture the palace shipyard, the Thunder King's supply line will be cut off, and your foothold here will be secure.$B$BI have a plan to do just that, and it won't take an entire army.
english.completion: Well done. That warship won't be raining fire on us again any time soon.$B$BTaran Zhu has informed me that the Shado-Pan will keep vigil over Stormsea Landing, freeing up Kirin Tor resources to press the siege elsewhere. Taoshi will be there. I am sure she will be glad to work with you again.$B$BWe are all grateful for your contributions, $n. Thank you.
english.completed: Report to Lady Jaina Proudmoore at Violet Rise on the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 山怖之死
text.objectives: 击败山怖。
text.description:
雷神在早年的征战途中找到了几枚罕见的风暴龙蛋。其中一条名叫纳拉克的巨龙尤为残忍，干掉了所有训练师，于是雷神将它据为己有。

现在，雷神最为忠实的仆从之一——山怖，正在复活这条巨龙。

我们攻击山怖的时刻到了！

等你做好出击准备时，再来与我交谈。
text.completion: You've done it, $c! Shan Bu is dead once and for all, and we've learned that Lor'themar may not be all that he seems.
text.completed: Return to Lady Jaina Proudmoore at Violet Rise

english.title: The Fall of Shan Bu
english.objectives: Defeat Shan Bu
english.description:
Lei Shen found a clutch of rare storm dragon eggs early in his campaign. One - known as Nalak - was particularly brutal and killed all of its handlers, so he took it for his own.

Now, Shan Bu, one of Lei Shen's most loyal servants, works to resurrect the dragon.

It is time for us to strike against Shan Bu!

Speak to me when you are ready to launch the assault!
english.completion: You've done it, $c! Shan Bu is dead once and for all, and we've learned that Lor'themar may not be all that he seems.
english.completed: Return to Lady Jaina Proudmoore at Violet Rise

objectiveDetails.description: 与吉安娜·普罗德摩尔交谈

text.title: 产品订单：至尊天神II
text.objectives: 收获8个成熟的菜瓜，并向至尊天神提供40份菜瓜。
text.description: 等你的菜瓜长到可以采摘时，你只要将它们打包，等待提取就好了。$b$b有位来自赤精栖木的学徒很快就会来这里取货。
text.progress: The crate sits empty awaiting your crops.
text.completion: Throw the Striped Melons into the crate! Now the August Celestials' order is ready to go!
text.completed: Package the Striped Melons in the Empty Crate on Sunsong Ranch.

english.title: Work Order: The August Celestials II
english.objectives: Harvest 8 Ripe Striped Melon plants and provide 40 Striped Melons for the August Celestials.
english.description: Once your striped melons are ready to be picked, you'll need only to package them for pick-up.$b$bA trainee from the Cradle of Chi-Ji will be along shortly to collect their order.
english.progress: The crate sits empty awaiting your crops.
english.completion: Throw the Striped Melons into the crate! Now the August Celestials' order is ready to go!
english.completed: Package the Striped Melons in the Empty Crate on Sunsong Ranch.

text.title: 产品订单：卡拉克西I
text.objectives: 在日歌农场播种8颗魔古南瓜种子。
text.description: <尽管老愚书写的字迹潦草，但在农场上收到来自他的只言片语总是好的。>$b$b我们在今天早上接到了来自卡拉克西的订单。奇怪的是，他们要收购一批魔古南瓜来进行什么研究。$b$b我觉得最好不要问长问短……$b$b赶快完成他们的订单吧。要是没能如期交货，我可不知道像他们那么大的虫子会对你的庄稼做出什么事儿来！

english.title: Work Order: The Klaxxi I
english.objectives: Plant 8 Mogu Pumpkin Seeds on Sunsong Ranch.
english.description: <Though Yoon's writing leaves something to be desired, it's nice to still have a little piece of him on the farm.>$b$bAn order came in this morning from the Klaxxi. Strangely enough they are requesting mogu pumpkins for some kind of research.$b$bI find it's best not to ask them too many questions...$b$bBest get started on their order. I'd hate to see what a bug of that size could do to your crops if you don't!

text.title: 产品订单：卡拉克西II
text.objectives: 收获8个成熟的魔古南瓜，并向卡拉克西提供40份魔古南瓜。
text.description: 等你的魔古南瓜长到可以采摘时，你只要将它们打包，等待提取就好了。$b$b如果我是你，我可不会磨磨蹭蹭的。卡拉克西从来都没什么耐心！

text.title: 延長修理時間
text.objectives: 偷走工坊報告並殺死贊達拉戰艦的新艦長。
text.description: 贊達拉已經開始修理戰艦，可是我們只要動點手腳就可以阻撓這件事。$B$B只要殺了那位新艦長，並且偷走倉庫外頭工坊裡的船艦損壞報告，事情就大功告成。$B$B沒了艦長，沒了報告，就不可能修好船艦。
text.progress: Lei Shen will fall to our onslaught, and my people will find glory in his ruin.
text.completion: This so-called "Thunder King" is surrounded and cut off from his allies. No tyrant is strong enough to stand alone.$B$BYour efforts have not gone unnoticed. Take this, with my thanks.
text.completed: Report to Lor'themar Theron at Dawnseeker Promontory.

english.title: Extended Shore Leave
english.objectives: Steal the Workshop Orders and slay the new captain of the Zandalari warship.
english.description: The Zandalari have already begun repairing that warship, but we can keep it crippled with minimal effort.$B$BSimply relieve the new captain of his post, and steal the ship's damage report from that workshop just outside the vault.$B$BNo captain. No repairs. No warship.
english.progress: Lei Shen will fall to our onslaught, and my people will find glory in his ruin.
english.completion: This so-called "Thunder King" is surrounded and cut off from his allies. No tyrant is strong enough to stand alone.$B$BYour efforts have not gone unnoticed. Take this, with my thanks.
english.completed: Report to Lor'themar Theron at Dawnseeker Promontory.

text.title: 突袭宝库
text.objectives: 从浮华宝库里偷取风暴项圈。
text.description: 在浮华宝库里存满了雷神最难对付的武器和最珍贵的饰物——不必惊讶，这些通常总是千篇一律，毫无新意。$B$B但其中有一样神器很特别，那是一件名叫风暴项圈的护符，能帮我们弄清驾驭闪电的奥秘。$B$B进入宝库，消灭宝藏看守者。拿走他的钥匙，用它从宝库后面的储物箱里找回护符。
text.progress: You have good news, I hope.
text.completion: Ah, I know a powerful artifact when I see one. You were wise to bring this here. I will see that Aethas examines it right away - perhaps we can put it to work in our favor.$B$BIn the meantime, take this in trade.
text.completed: Report to Lor'themar Theron at Dawnseeker Promontory.

english.title: Raiding the Vault
english.objectives: Steal the Choker of Storms from The Swollen Vault.
english.description: The Swollen Vault is a repository for some of Lei Shen's nastiest weaponry and most prized trinkets - not surprisingly, these are often one and the same.$B$BOne artifact in particular, an amulet known as the Choker of Storms, could help us to understand his apparent mastery over lightning.$B$BBreak into the vault and slay the hoard-keeper. Take his key and use it to recover the amulet from a cache at the back of the vault.
english.progress: You have good news, I hope.
english.completion: Ah, I know a powerful artifact when I see one. You were wise to bring this here. I will see that Aethas examines it right away - perhaps we can put it to work in our favor.$B$BIn the meantime, take this in trade.
english.completed: Report to Lor'themar Theron at Dawnseeker Promontory.

text.title: 雷霆召唤
text.objectives: 去螳螂高原的影踪卫戍营向斥候队长艾尔希娅报告。
text.description: 攻击雷电之王的时机到了！$b$b一支夺日者小分队正在螳螂高原的影踪卫戍营附近等着你。$b$b向斥候队长艾尔希娅报告，以取得进一步指示。
text.completion: We must move quickly, $n! The others have gone ahead of us, but I will brief you in the flight over.

english.title: Thunder Calls
english.objectives: Report to Scout Captain Elsia at the Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.
english.description: The time to attack the Thunder King has come!$b$bA small group of Sunreavers awaits you near the Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.$b$bReport to Scout Captain Elsia for further instructions.
english.completion: We must move quickly, $n! The others have gone ahead of us, but I will brief you in the flight over.

text.title: 风雨欲来
text.objectives: 与斥候队长艾尔希娅一同前往雷神岛。
text.description: 没时间浪费了，$n。我们耽搁得越久，就等于让吉安娜和肯瑞托拥有对岛屿更加牢固的控制权。$b$b洛瑟玛在等着我们。等你准备好离开时就来与我交谈吧。我会亲自护送你过去。
text.completion: You have arrived just in time, $r. It is crucial we gain control of these shores before the Kirin Tor.$B$BThere is much to explain.
text.completed: Speak with Lor'themar Theron in the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: The Storm Gathers
english.objectives: Travel with Scout Captain Elsia to the Isle of Thunder.
english.description: There is no time to waste, $n. Every moment we delay here gives Jaina and the Kirin Tor more of a hold on the Isle.$b$bLor'themar awaits us. Speak to me when you are ready to depart. I will escort you there myself.
english.completion: You have arrived just in time, $r. It is crucial we gain control of these shores before the Kirin Tor.$B$BThere is much to explain.
english.completed: Speak with Lor'themar Theron in the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 风雨欲来
text.objectives: 与温蕾萨·风行者一同前往雷神岛。
text.description: 没时间浪费了，$n。我们耽搁得越久，就等于让夺日者拥有对岛屿更加牢固的控制权。$b$b吉安娜·普罗德摩尔在等着我们。我们不该让她继续久候。$b$b等你准备好离开时就来与我交谈吧。我会亲自护送你过去。
text.completion: You have arrived just in time, $n. This land needs to be controlled by the Kirin Tor for everyone's safety. This will not be an easy task.
text.completed: Speak with Lady Jaina Proudmoore in the Isle of Thunder.

english.completion: You have arrived just in time, $n. This land needs to be controlled by the Kirin Tor for everyone's safety. This will not be an easy task.
english.completed: Speak with Lady Jaina Proudmoore in the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 继承土地
text.objectives: 和农夫老愚谈一谈。
text.description: 如你所知，$n，我年纪一天天大起来了。你知道，没人能永远做个活泼年轻的熊猫人。$B$B我正在找人接手我在阡陌客的工作，而最合适的人选莫过于农夫老愚了。$B$B尽管他还有许多东西要学，但在他肩膀上顶着一个聪明的大脑袋，而且更为重要的是，他还有一颗慷慨的心。$B$B你觉得他会感兴趣吗？
text.completion: Why I just knew you could convince him, $n. You've set my heart at ease, knowing the Tillers will be in good hands.
text.completed: Return to Nana Mudclaw at Halfhill in the Valley of the Four Winds.

english.title: Inherit the Earth
english.objectives: Speak to Farmer Yoon.
english.description: As you know, $n, I'm getting along in my years. One can't stay a spry young pandaren forever, you know.$B$BI'm looking for someone to take over my duties here at the Tillers Union, and I can't think of a better person than Farmer Yoon.$B$BHe's got a good deal to learn, but he's got a good head on his shoulders and most importantly, a generous heart.$B$BDo you think he'd be interested?
english.completion: Why I just knew you could convince him, $n. You've set my heart at ease, knowing the Tillers will be in good hands.
english.completed: Return to Nana Mudclaw at Halfhill in the Valley of the Four Winds.

objectiveDetails.description: 请农夫老愚加入阡陌客议会

text.title: 这么说，你想当铁匠……
text.objectives: 锻造技能达到500点后制作出一把幽冥万能钥匙。如果你想通过熊猫人材料进行训练，可以去找科伦·锤眉学习与你当前技能等级相适应的训练项目。
text.description: 尽管最佳的学习途径是借由了解简单金属的属性而逐步提升，但也可以通过掌握幽冥铁的各种应用方法，制作日常家用物品来成为一名优秀的铁匠。要是你希望以这种方式成为禅师级锻造大师，我可以教你如何开始。不论你选择哪种途径，如果你能制作出一把幽冥万能钥匙并拿给我看，你就会赢得我的尊重。
text.progress: How are your studies coming along?
text.completion: Well done. You are ready to become a zen master blacksmith.
text.completed: Create a Ghostly Skeleton Key.

english.title: So You Want to Be a Blacksmith...
english.objectives: Create a Ghostly Skeleton Key by attaining at least 500 skill in blacksmithing. If you wish to train through pandaren materials, a training project appropriate to your skill level can be learned from Cullen Hammerbrow.
english.description: While it is best to learn the properties of simpler metals and work your way up, it is possible to learn how to become a good blacksmith through mastering the various applications of ghost iron for common household objects. If you wish to take this path towards becoming a zen master blacksmith, I can teach you. Whichever way you choose, you will have my respect if you can show me that you can make a ghostly skeleton key.
english.progress: How are your studies coming along?
english.completion: Well done. You are ready to become a zen master blacksmith.
english.completed: Create a Ghostly Skeleton Key.

objectiveDetails.description: 制作一把幽冥万能钥匙

text.title: 你想钓鱼吗？
text.objectives: 与“大嗓门”班宏交谈。
text.description: 你是在找金色鲤鱼吗？还是其它熊猫人的鱼类呢？我自己并不是渔夫，不过在河边有个家伙，一直在教过往行人如何钓鱼。要是你去找他谈谈，他很有可能会给你几条鱼，并将捕鱼的技巧传授给你。
text.completion: Ah!  Have you come to learn how to fish? You're talking to the right person. First, here - have some fish!
text.completed: 与“大嗓门”班宏交谈。

english.title: You Want Fish?
english.objectives: Speak with Ben of the Booming Voice.
english.description: Are you looking for golden carp? or some other Pandaren fish? I'm no fisherman myself, but there is a fellow by the river who has been teaching the folks traveling through here. If you go speak with him, he will likely give you some fish, as well as teach you how to fish.
english.completion: Ah!  Have you come to learn how to fish? You're talking to the right person. First, here - have some fish!
english.completed: Speak with Ben of the Booming Voice.

text.title: 无需钓竿！
text.objectives: 捕捉5条金色鲤鱼。不用装备钓竿，试试看吧！$b$b要想钓鱼，只要在专业技能面板上点击钓鱼图标即可。注意浮标，当它跳动时用鼠标点击它，就能收获你钓到的鱼了！
text.description: 你在潘达利亚甚至不用装备钓竿！$b$b潘达利亚的水域里游满了各色鱼群。只要你集中精神，你几乎次次都能满载而归。试试看就知道了！
text.progress: Catch 5 Golden Carp. Try it without a fishing pole!
text.completion: Let me see...  Yes, these are nice. Good job! Here, have some more.
text.completed: Catch 5 Golden Carp. Try it without a fishing pole!

english.title: No Fishing Pole Necessary!
english.objectives: Catch 5 Golden Carp. Try it without a fishing pole!$b$bTo fish, simply click the Fishing icon on the Profession pane. Pay attention to the bobber, click on it when it bobs and you will have your fish!
english.description: You don't even need to equip a fishing pole in Pandaria!$b$bThe waters are TEEMING with fish. You'll catch one pretty much every time, as long as you are paying attention. Give it a go!
english.progress: Catch 5 Golden Carp. Try it without a fishing pole!
english.completion: Let me see...  Yes, these are nice. Good job! Here, have some more.
english.completed: Catch 5 Golden Carp. Try it without a fishing pole!

text.progress: Remove the clutter and put the artifact on display.
text.completion: This will aid lorewalkers and archaeologists in understanding the history of Pandaria.

text.title: 暗影中的盟友
text.objectives: 在阴冷洞窟与祝踏岚交谈。
text.description: 影踪派在我们之前就抵达这里了，而且他们已经在削弱雷电之王的军队了。$B$B我希望你去见见影踪派的首领祝踏岚，并代表肯瑞托贡献自己的力量。我觉得他恐怕不需要你帮忙，但做个姿态是非常必要的。
text.completion: Welcome, $n.

english.title: Allies in the Shadows
english.objectives: Speak to Taran Zhu in Bleak Hollow.
english.description: The Shado-Pan arrived here before we did, and they are already at work undermining the Thunder King's forces.$B$BI want you to meet with Taran Zhu, the leader of the Shado-Pan, and offer your services on behalf of the Kirin Tor. I doubt he is truly in need of the aid, but the gesture holds importance in itself.
english.completion: Welcome, $n.

text.title: 雷神岛的秘密
text.objectives: 找回3块山泽仪式石。这些石头极为稀少，且需要花费一定时间才能找齐。
text.description: 我确实有件事要请你帮忙，$c。$B$B我们已经拿到了一块强大的仪式石，山泽魔古就是用它来召唤同伴协同作战的，可我们需要不止一块仪式石来举行他们的仪式。$B$B要是你能找到3块这种石头，就把它们带回来交给我。我们可以集结军队，用这些石头把雷神最强大的仆从召唤出来，让他们直接落入我们的陷阱。
text.progress: Have you found the stones I spoke of?
text.completion: Perfect. I will show you how to use these stones, and then you can spring the ambush.
text.completed: Return to Taran Zhu in Bleak Hollow.

english.title: Secrets in the Isle of Thunder
english.objectives: Recover 3 Shan'ze Ritual Stones. These stones are very rare, and may take some time to gather.
english.description: I do have one thing I would ask of you, $c.$B$BWe've gotten our hands on a powerful ritual stone that the Shan'ze mogu use to beckon their allies into battle, but we need more than one to perform their rituals.$B$BIf you come upon three of these stones, bring them back to me. We can gather our forces and use these stones to beckon some of Lei Shen's most powerful servants directly into our traps.
english.progress: Have you found the stones I spoke of?
english.completion: Perfect. I will show you how to use these stones, and then you can spring the ambush.
english.completed: Return to Taran Zhu in Bleak Hollow.

text.title: 布设陷阱
text.objectives: 用3块山泽仪式石召唤雷电之王的勇士，然后将他消灭。
text.description: 把这3块仪式石带到我在你地图上标记的位置。你在那里会找到一样山泽仪式物品，可以用它来召唤出一位他们最强大的盟友。$B$B你需要找几位能干的伙伴帮你一同完成诱敌入瓮的任务。切勿只身前往，你要面对的是雷电之王最善战的仆从。$B$B等你的敌人现身时，千万不要手下留情。
text.completion: Very impressive.$B$BShould you find more stones, you should continue this ruse. It is sure to be quite some time before they catch on to our ploy.
text.completed: Return to Taran Zhu in Bleak Hollow.

english.title: Setting the Trap
english.objectives: Use 3 Shan'ze Ritual Stones to beckon a Champion of the Thunder King, and then kill him.
english.description: Take these 3 ritual stones to the location I have marked on your map. There, you will find a Shan'ze ritual object that you can use to beckon one of their powerful allies.$B$BYou will need capable friends at your side for this trap to work. Do not go alone, for these will be some of the Thunder King's most powerful servants.$B$BWhen your enemy shows itself, show no mercy.
english.completion: Very impressive.$B$BShould you find more stones, you should continue this ruse. It is sure to be quite some time before they catch on to our ploy.
english.completed: Return to Taran Zhu in Bleak Hollow.

text.title: 暗影中的盟友
text.objectives: 在阴冷洞窟与祝踏岚交谈。
text.description: 影踪派在我们之前就抵达这里了，而且他们已经在削弱雷电之王的军队了。$B$B我希望你去见见影踪派的首领祝踏岚，并代表夺日者贡献自己的力量。我觉得他恐怕不需要你帮忙，但做个姿态是非常必要的。
text.completion: Welcome, $n.

english.title: Allies in the Shadows
english.objectives: Speak to Taran Zhu in Bleak Hollow.
english.description: The Shado-Pan arrived here before we did, and they are already at work undermining the Thunder King's forces.$B$BI want you to meet with Taran Zhu, the leader of the Shado-Pan, and offer your services on behalf of the Sunreavers. I doubt he is truly in need of the aid, but the gesture holds importance in itself.
english.completion: Welcome, $n.

text.title: 酝酿中的腐化
text.objectives: 找到并消灭感染者弗赖什鲁克。
text.description: 你留意到有一股异常难闻的恶臭在头顶上方弥漫开来。随着这股浓郁的臭气钻入鼻孔，你感到五脏六腑都在翻腾。$b$b你熟悉这股气味，是从蜥蜴人身上发出来的。腐烂废弃的蜥蜴人肉块与下水道的肮脏秽物混在了一起。
text.completed: Flesh'rok's foul ooze drains into the stream of the sewer. He's either dead, or at least irreparably damaged as far as you can tell.
text.giverWindow: 弗赖什鲁克在远处怪笑并呻吟着。

english.title: Something Foul is Afoot
english.objectives: Seek and destroy Flesh'rok the Diseased.
english.description: You notice a stronger-than-usual smell permeating from ahead. Your stomach lurches as the thick smell fills your nostrils.$b $bYou recognize this smell, it's saurok. Rotting, discarded saurok flesh infused with the foul waste of the sewer.
english.completed: Flesh'rok's foul ooze drains into the stream of the sewer. He's either dead, or at least irreparably damaged as far as you can tell.
english.giverWindow: Flesh'rok gurgles and moans in the distance.

text.title: 痛苦与心能
text.objectives: 击败大祭师克拉达。
text.description: 你注意到在意志侧面用精准的笔法巧妙地刻着A和K这两个字母缩写。$b$b在你面前站着的是大祭师克拉达——意志的塑造者。克拉达听命于雷电之王，不知疲倦地制造着能够驾驭伟大心能力量的完美载体。他创造出的成品功能性极强，外形华丽，具有知觉，但最为重要的是……拥有致命的杀伤力。$b$b必须尽快将他消灭，决不能让雷电之王为他的下一个创意赋予生命。
text.giverWindow: 大祭师克拉达愤怒地凝视着你。

english.title: Agony and Anima
english.objectives: Slay Archritualist Kelada.
english.description: You notice the initials A.K. skillfully and with calligraphic precision engraved onto the side of the Animus.$b$bBefore you stands Archritualist Kelada, the shaper of the Animus. By command of the Thunder King, Kelada worked tirelessly to craft the perfect vessel to harness the great power of the anima. Something functional, magnificent, sentient, but most importantly... something deadly.$b$bHe must be stopped before his next imagination is brought to life by the Thunder King.
english.giverWindow: Archritualist Kelada glares at you indignantly.

text.title: 邪恶的曹卓
text.objectives: 击败曹卓。
text.description: 从远处传来电流的轰鸣声，撩拨你的听觉神经，神经冲动袭遍了你的整根脊椎。随着你越发靠近前方的那道门，你感到手指僵硬，心跳加快。$b$b曹卓傲慢地站在你面前的台阶上，指尖有闪电在涌动，神经质般地对着你假笑。
text.giverWindow: 径直凝视曹卓眼中的闪电，令你感到眼睛刺痛。

english.title: Zao'cho the Wicked
english.objectives: Slay Zao'cho.
english.description: Electricity hums in the distance, tickling your ears and sending impulses down your spine. Your fingers go numb, and  your heart races as you approach the door ahead.$b$bZao'cho stands arrogantly atop the steps ahead, weaving lightning between his fingers and smirking at you with demented glee.
english.giverWindow: Looking directly into the lightning in Zao'cho's eyes is painful.

text.title: 石落人亡
text.objectives: 击败岩石恐魔。
text.description: 出现在你面前的，是个由岩石、骨头和鲜血构成的恐怖巨怪，正在漫无目地盲目暴走，简直无法用语言加以形容。$b$b那怪物脚下的地面剧烈颤动，如空壳般破裂开来，所到之处一片狼藉。看来这只生物完全没有察觉到你的出现。
text.giverWindow: 在古代，也许有人会把这只生物当作低阶神祇来崇拜。

english.title: Rocks Fall, People Die
english.objectives: Slay the Rocky Horror.
english.description: Words fail to describe the massive horror of rock, bone, and blood that rumbles mindlessly and aimlessly ahead of you.$b $bMassive earthquakes crack the seemingly hollow shell of ground beneath the figure, leaving destruction in its wake. It appears that the creature is unaware of your presence.
english.giverWindow: In ancient times, one may have worshipped this creature as a lesser god.

text.title: 力压暴风雨
text.objectives: 击败颂风者诺库。
text.description: 你听见从远处传来一声凶猛刺耳的咆哮。劈啪作响的风暴在一个模糊阴暗的身影四周升腾盘旋。随着闪电划过，颂风者诺库现身了，他目空一切地径直凝视着你。
text.giverWindow: 当诺库穿过庭院时，闪电如卷须般在他脚下环绕。

english.title: Taming the Tempest
english.objectives: Slay No'ku Stormsayer.
english.description: You hear a fierce and militant voice roaring in the distance. A crackling storm swells and swirls around a clouded, shadowy figure. Lightning flashes and No'ku Stormsayer appears, his scornful gaze aimed directly at you.
english.giverWindow: Tendrils of lightning arc from No'ku's feet as he passes through the courtyard.

text.title: 皇后的安魂曲
text.objectives: 让莫纳拉安息。
text.description: 一阵冷风掠过你的身体，风中夹杂着挥之不去的哀伤。当你听到魔古末代皇后莫纳拉那带有旋律的低声哭喊时，你感到灵魂在往下沉。$b$b她那甜美嗓音唱出的安魂曲弥漫在空气里，歌声弯曲成形，竟变成了一只幽灵之手，攫住了你的心。随着这只手越抓越紧，你看见了莫纳拉临终前的片刻时光……是雷神残忍地亲手夺走了她的生命。$b$b曲调变得悲鸣，莫纳拉哀泣起来，在黑暗中越来越大声地恸哭着。
text.giverWindow: 莫纳拉——现知最后一位魔古皇后。

english.title: Requiem for a Queen
english.objectives: Put Monara to rest.
english.description: A chilling breeze sweeps across your body, bringing with it a haunting drape of sadness. Your soul sinks as you hear the faint, melodic cries of Monara, the last Queen of the Mogu.$b$bHer sweet requiem creeps through the air, bending and shaping itself into a spectral hand, reaching for your heart. As it grabs hold, you see a brief flash of Monara's last moments... her brutal murder by the hand of Lei Shen.$b$bSong turns to sadness and Monara weeps, wailing louder and louder into the darkness.
english.giverWindow: Monara, the last known Queen of the Mogu.

text.title: 雷电之王的眼目
text.objectives: 击败伏兵！
text.description: 随着阵亡哨兵身上的浓雾散去，你感觉到了突如其来的轰响。$b$b堵住下水道的岩石向前滚动，跌进了下方外流的水池里，从黑暗中钻出了四只腐烂的眼睛。
text.giverWindow: 坚定之眼扭动着。

english.title: Eyes of the Thunder King
english.objectives: Defeat the ambush!
english.description: As the fog dissipates from the fallen sentries, you feel a sudden rumbling.$b$bThe rocks blocking the sewer tunnels tumble forward and crash into the outflow tanks below, as four putrid eyes lunge from the darkness.
english.giverWindow: The Unblinking Eye twitches.

text.title: 魔古命运符石
text.objectives: 收集$1oa枚次级好运护符。
text.description: 欢迎你，$n。我有幸为你送上一个难得的好机会。经过几个世纪，我们找到了一种可以改变运势的方法。只要拥有魔古命运符石，雷电之王宫殿中的珍贵神器就会更加频繁地自动落入你的手中。
text.progress: May these charms bring you great luck, $N.
text.completion: May the stars smile upon you, $N.
text.completed: Return to Elder Liao in the Shrine of Two Moons in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

english.title: Mogu Runes of Fate
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Lesser Charms of Good Fortune.
english.description: Greetings, $n. I am privileged to offer you an excellent opportunity. Through the centuries, we've honed a method by which the very laws of chance themselves can be bent. With a Mogu Rune of Fate, valuable artifacts will find their way into your hands more frequently inside the palace of the Thunder King.
english.progress: May these charms bring you great luck, $N.
english.completion: May the stars smile upon you, $N.
english.completed: Return to Elder Liao in the Shrine of Two Moons in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.objectives: 在雷神岛上消灭锻造大师，然后从塑肌者霍古身上找到一块法典碎片。

还有其它事情要你去做。

text.title: 这么说，你想当铁匠……
text.objectives: 锻造技能达到500点后制作出一把幽冥万能钥匙。如果你想通过熊猫人材料进行训练，可以去找贾鲁高·石蹄学习与你当前技能等级相适应的训练项目。
text.description: 尽管最佳的学习途径是借由了解简单金属的属性而逐步提升，但也可以通过掌握幽冥铁的各种应用方法，制作日常家用物品来成为一名优秀的铁匠。要是你希望以这种方式成为禅师级锻造大师，我可以教你如何开始。不论你选择哪种途径，如果你能制作出一把幽冥万能钥匙并拿给我看，你就会赢得我的尊重。
text.progress: How are your studies coming along?
text.completion: Well done. You are ready to become a zen master blacksmith.
text.completed: Create a Ghostly Skeleton Key.

english.title: So You Want to Be a Blacksmith...
english.objectives: Create a Ghostly Skeleton Key by attaining at least 500 skill in blacksmithing. If you wish to train through pandaren materials, a training project appropriate to your skill level can be learned from Jorunga Stonehoof.
english.description: While it is best to learn the properties of simpler metals and work your way up, it is possible to learn how to become a good blacksmith through mastering the various applications of ghost iron for common household objects. If you wish to take this path towards becoming a zen master blacksmith, I can teach you. Whichever way you choose, you will have my respect if you can show me that you can make a ghostly skeleton key.
english.progress: How are your studies coming along?
english.completion: Well done. You are ready to become a zen master blacksmith.
english.completed: Create a Ghostly Skeleton Key.

text.title: 白骨庭院
text.objectives: 在白骨庭院外面找到大法师罗曼斯。
text.description: 附近白骨庭院中的魔古族一直威胁着我们在这座岛屿上的据点。我已经委派大法师罗曼斯去阻止他们的行动了，但我相信，有像你这么能干的$c帮忙，一定能起到事半功倍的效果。$B$B去找他吧。尽你所能提供帮助。
text.completion: Yes, good, come... there is work to be done.
text.completed: Find Scout Captain Elsia at the Beast Pens on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: The Court of Bones
english.objectives: Find Grand Magister Rommath outside the Court of Bones.
english.description: The mogu within the nearby Court of Bones pose a constant threat to our foothold on this island. Grand Magister Rommath has been entrusted with halting their efforts, but I am certain he could use a capable $c to see this task through.$B$BGo to him. Aid in whatever ways that you are able.
english.completion: Yes, good, come... there is work to be done.
english.completed: Find Scout Captain Elsia at the Beast Pens on the Isle of Thunder.

text.title: 赞图尔
text.objectives: 在赞图尔外面找到哈杜伦·明翼。
text.description: 自从我们登上这座岛屿，赞达拉巨魔就一直令我们如鲠在喉。我已经派哈杜伦·明翼去南边的赞图尔消灭他们。$B$B等你做好准备，就去向哈杜伦报告吧。他会为你安排任务。
text.completion: One more to join the Zandalari hunt?  Good.  Very good.
text.completed: Find Scout Captain Elsia at the Beast Pens on the Isle of Thunder.

english.title: Za'Tual
english.objectives: Find Halduron Brightwing outside of Za'Tual.
english.description: The Zandalari have been a constant nuisance since we arrived on this island. I've assigned Halduron Brightwing to take charge of dismantling their presence at Za'Tual, in the south.$B$BReport to Halduron when you are best able. He will have work for you.
english.completion: One more to join the Zandalari hunt?  Good.  Very good.
english.completed: Find Scout Captain Elsia at the Beast Pens on the Isle of Thunder.
