text.objectives: 在伊瓜鲁克峭壁外面找到大法师艾萨斯·夺日者。
text.description: 艾萨斯接管了东南边的伊瓜鲁克峭壁，继续努力让蜥蜴人与赞达拉和魔古族为敌。$B$B去找他吧，尽你所能提供帮助。
text.completion: You have good timing. I am quite in need of your assistance.
text.completed: Find Scout Captain Elsia at the Beast Pens on the Isle of Thunder.

english.description: Aethas has taken over at Ihgaluk Crag, to the southeast, continuing his effort to turn the Saurok against the Zandalari and mogu.$B$BGo to him, and help in any way that you can.
english.completion: You have good timing. I am quite in need of your assistance.
english.completed: Find Scout Captain Elsia at the Beast Pens on the Isle of Thunder.

text.description: 附近白骨庭院中的魔古族是我们在这座岛上面临的最大威胁之一。我已经委派纳莱丝·晨雪前去阻止他们的行动了，但我相信，有像你这么能干的$c帮忙，一定能起到事半功倍的效果。$B$B去找她吧。尽你所能提供帮助。
text.completion: Yes, good, come... there is work to be done.

text.title: 天神的祝福
text.objectives: 前往昆莱山的白虎寺、卡桑琅丛林的朱鹤寺、翡翠林的青龙寺、螳螂高原的砮皂寺，获得四位天神的祝福。完成他们四项挑战中的其中一项。
text.description: 我愿意将自己全部的巨龙之力都赋予你，但遗憾的是，那会使你的凡人之躯彻底瓦解。不过，希望仍在——我相信我能创造出一个强大的容器来供你使用。$b$b要想制作这个容器，我需要潘达利亚四位至尊天神的祝福。与我一同前往那四座神殿吧，让我们与诸位天神谈一谈。若要让自己配得上他们的馈赠，你必须赢得他们其中一项挑战。$b$b这些挑战可不简单——选择与你的装备和技能最相匹配的挑战吧！
text.completion: We have the four blessings of the celestials, and you have proven yourself by completing one of their challenges! I knew I saw great potential in you.

english.title: Celestial Blessings
english.objectives: Travel to the Temple of the White Tiger in Kun-Lai, the Temple of the Red Crane in Krasarang, the Temple of the Jade Serpent in the Jade Forest, and Niuzao Temple in Townlong Steppes to obtain four blessings of the celestials. Complete ONE of their four available challenges.
english.description: I would like to grant you my full array of draconic power, but sadly, it would tear your mortal frame apart. Still, it's not hopeless - I believe I can create a powerful vessel that you can use.$B$BTo craft it, I will need the blessings of the four August Celestials in Pandaria. Travel with me to the four temples and we will speak to each. To be worthy of their gifts, you must defeat one of their challenges.$B$BThey will not be easy - chose the one challenge best suited to your equipment and skills!
english.completion: We have the four blessings of the celestials, and you have proven yourself by completing one of their challenges! I knew I saw great potential in you.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成至尊天神的其中一项挑战

text.title: 国王与议会
text.objectives: 完成“雪山血战”场景战役。你可以通过地下城查找器加入队列或使用游学者周卓的洄梦仙酒。
text.description: 你在这里真是太好了，$n。我一直在用洄梦仙酒体验发生在世界各地的事件，可我了解得越多，就感到愈发困惑。$b$b比方说，乌瑞恩国王要求铁炉堡的矮人集结更多兵力，可他们并非全都是国王的支持者。$b$b我会与你分享更多的信息，但我也想听听你的亲身经历……
text.completion: So, King Wrynn and the Dark Iron dwarves saved the city, and the bitterly divided Council of Three Hammers gained a new unity under the Alliance banner. How interesting!$B$BBut what is happening within the Horde?
text.completed: Speak with Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

english.title: The King and the Council
english.objectives: Complete the "Blood in the Snow" scenario. You can queue from the Dungeon Finder or use Lorewalker Cho's Dream Brew.
english.description: I am glad you are here, $n. I have been using my dream brew to experience events around the world, but the more I learn, the more confused I become.$b$bFor instance, King Wrynn has asked the dwarves of Ironforge for more troops, but they do not all support him.$b$bI will tell you more, but I would also like to hear from your experience firsthand...
english.completion: So, King Wrynn and the Dark Iron dwarves saved the city, and the bitterly divided Council of Three Hammers gained a new unity under the Alliance banner. How interesting!$B$BBut what is happening within the Horde?
english.completed: Speak with Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成“雪山血战”场景战役

text.title: 酋长与黑暗
text.objectives: 完成“潘达利亚的黑暗之心”场景战役。你可以通过地下城查找器加入队列或使用游学者周卓的洄梦仙酒。
text.description: 我现在了解到联盟的国王是如何领导自己的人民了。可部落的酋长又有何打算？就在我们下方，一大群地精正在奉他的命令挖掘地道，试图进入神圣的山谷。他想在那里找到什么？我们必须查个水落石出！
text.completion: Whaaaat? The remains of an Old God are buried beneath Pandaria? No wonder the land is so haunted!$B$BThe warchief's pursuit of those dormant powers are fraying apart the very Horde he leads. His vision is narrow, but very, very dangerous. I must inform the Shado-Pan immediately.
text.completed: Speak with Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

english.title: The Warchief and the Darkness
english.objectives: Complete the "Dark Heart of Pandaria" scenario. You can queue from the Dungeon Finder or use Lorewalker Cho's Dream Brew.
english.description: I see now how the Alliance king leads his people. But what is the Horde warchief up to? Just below us, a swarm of goblins are burrowing into the sacred vale on his orders. What does he hope to find there? We must find out!
english.completion: Whaaaat? The remains of an Old God are buried beneath Pandaria? No wonder the land is so haunted!$B$BThe warchief's pursuit of those dormant powers are fraying apart the very Horde he leads. His vision is narrow, but very, very dangerous. I must inform the Shado-Pan immediately.
english.completed: Speak with Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: A Little Field Work
text.objectives: Secure passage to Kalimdor from Gleep Chatterswitch at the Shrine of Seven Stars. Then speak with Amber Kearnen, who is scouting Bladefist Bay near Skull Rock in Durotar.
text.description: My dream brew can only tell me so much. Its visions are scattered in time and space. But it is clear that a showdown is brewing at the Horde capital of Orgrimmar.$b$bYou should go there, and see these events for yourself!$b$bIn my dream brew I see two brave Alliance spies alone in Durotar. I see "Amber" and "Sully"...$b$bPerhaps you remember them? I think they need your help!$b$bYou'll find Amber and Sully in Kalimdor, near Skull Rock, at a place called the Dranosh'ar Blockade.
text.completion: $n! I cannot tell you how relieved I am to have some backup!$B$BKing Wrynn himself sent us to gather intel on Garrosh's activities and Orgrimmar's defenses, but... things are looking grim.$B$BWe need your help.
text.completed: Speak with Amber Kearnen near Skull Rock in Durotar.

text.title: Gathering Intelligence
text.objectives: Obtain the Kor'kron Supply Lines, Operation: Darkspear Destruction, Kor'kron Command Posts, and free the prisoner.
text.description: Garrosh continues building up his forces in Orgrimmar - this place is like a fortress!$b$bKing Wrynn won't want to risk an assault until we have as much information as possible.$b$bUse Project C4T to navigate through the Blockade. Try to gather as much information as you can. Look for any high priority documents and any weakness we can take advantage of. Keep your ears open and your head down!
text.progress: Did you find us anything useful?
text.completion: Let's see... the warchief is moving tons of supplies through the Barrens... And what's this about the Darkspear? The trolls are in open rebellion?! Garrosh certainly has his hands full.$B$BI think I know how we can use this intel. It's a crazy idea, but it just might work...
text.completed: Return to Amber Kearnen at the Dranosh'ar Blockade in Durotar.

text.title: The Darkspear Rebellion
text.objectives: Speak with Zen'tabra at Razor Hill in Durotar.
text.description: The trolls are in open rebellion. This could work to our advantage! If they open up a second front, Garrosh cannot possibly defend the city from us both.$b$bI have a very risky assignment for you. I need you to be the Alliance representative, and open up talks with Vol'jin of the Darkspear tribe.$b$bTry finding the troll prisoner that we freed from Kor'kron clutches. Zen'tabra, wasn't it?$B$BIt may be our only chance to bring Garrosh to his knees...
text.completion: <Zen'tabra narrows her eyes at you.>$B$BWhy de Alliance seek de Darkspear? We fightin' de "Warchief," sure, but dat don't mean we friends. I never trust de Alliance, an' I ain't 'bout ta start now.$B$BStill, dat funny mechanical cat ya have saved me life... so I give you dis. I let ya speak wit' Vol'jin.$B$BLet him decide if ya words be venom or honey.$B$BDon't be tryin' nothin', $c. Ya lift a finger against Vol'jin, ya life be forfeit.

english.objectives: Speak with Zen'tabra at Razor Hill in Durotar.
english.description: The trolls are in open rebellion. This could work to our advantage! If they open up a second front, Garrosh cannot possibly defend the city from us both.$b$bI have a very risky assignment for you. I need you to be the Alliance representative, and open up talks with Vol'jin of the Darkspear tribe.$b$bTry finding the troll prisoner that we freed from Kor'kron clutches. Zen'tabra, wasn't it?$B$BIt may be our only chance to bring Garrosh to his knees...

text.objectives: Collect $1oa Kor'kron Lumber, $2oa Kor'kron Oil, $3oa Kor'kron Meat, and $4oa Kor'kron Stone.
text.description: Ya want we work together on dis, ya gotta earn me trust.$b$bIn Northern Barrens, de Kor'kron be massin' for war. Hellscream's goons be stockpilin' lumber, oil, stone, an' meat. Supplies de Darkspear want ta use against' 'im.$b$bGo to de Barrens. Kill de Kor'kron. Bring me dem supplies! Fight dem wherever dey spring up, escort supply caravans, group up ta take down de dangerous ones. Whatever ya gotta do.$b$bProve ta me da Alliance wants dis! I be watchin'.
text.progress: I need dem Kor'kron supplies ta fuel de Darkspear Rebellion.
text.completion: <Vol'jin motions to his guards to allow you to come forward and speak.>$B$BDe Barrens be splattered wit' blood, $r. Ya done right by me.$B$BTell de Alliance ta rally its fleet. When de time comes, de Darkspear an' de other rebels will try ta hold de harbor for ya. Hellscream made too many enemies ta fight 'em all off at once, hah!$B$B$B$BYa have me thanks, $r. Dis rebellion only gonna get so far wit'out ya.
text.completed: Return to Vol'jin at Razor Hill in Durotar.

text.title: 暗矛反抗軍
text.objectives: 到杜洛塔的森金村找奇塔·箭牙。
text.description: 我的夢幻之釀能透露的就只有這些了。它透露的景象分散在時空之中。可是部落內部顯然醞釀著一場風暴。$b$b我在夢幻之釀裡看到了暗矛氏族的食人妖沃金已經前往杜洛塔保衛他的族人。漂流島的釀酒大師老陳·風暴烈酒與他同行。$b$b依我對老陳的了解，那就是他很快就會惹出麻煩來...你得加緊腳步!
text.completion: <Ki'ta Arrowtusk beckons you over.>$B$BI been waiting for ya, hero. Dis be a time of reckoning.

english.title: The Darkspear Rebellion
english.objectives: Travel to Durotar and speak with Ki'ta Arrowtusk in Sen'jin Village.
english.description: My dream brew can only tell me so much. Its visions are scattered in time and space. But it is clear that a showdown is brewing amongst the Horde.$b$bIn my dream brew I see that the troll Vol'jin of the Darkspear has already travelled to Durotar to defend his people. He is accompanied by Chen Stormstout, the brewmaster from the Wandering Isle.$b$bIf I have learned anything about Chen, it won't be long before he brews up some trouble... You should hurry!
english.completion: <Ki'ta Arrowtusk beckons you over.>$B$BI been waiting for ya, hero. Dis be a time of reckoning.

text.title: Battle of Sen'jin Village
text.objectives: Defend Sen'jin Village from the Kor'kron assault.
text.description: <Distant war drums sound.>$b$b$C, you always be in de right place at de right time. Hellscream be makin' a move against his own people.$b$bHe gonna find out what happens when you cross de Darkspear. Come! Fight wit' us! Show him de spirit of de real Horde!
text.completion: De "Warchief" thought we'd scatter once he sent in de Kor'kron. Hah. He shoulda sent ev'ryting he got.$B$BTime ta make 'im pay!
text.completed: Return to Vol'jin at Sen'jin Village in Durotar.

text.title: Battle of Razor Hill
text.objectives: Free 6 Captives and defeat Kor'kron leaders to capture Razor Hill for the Darkspear revolutionaries.
text.description: Now, we hit back! We don't give Hellscream no time to regroup. We ride north. We slit every Kor'kron throat we see.$b$bIf we take Razor Hill, we control all de roads in Durotar.$b$bCome! Ride wit' me!
text.completion: Razor Hill. We did it, $n! Look to de north - you can almost see Orgrimmar from here.$B$BHellscream gonna figure out who did dis. Hah hah. He gonna be one angry orc.$B$BNext stop is de capital. We gonna need a lot more help. An' more supplies...
text.completed: Speak with Vol'jin beneath the tower overlooking Razor Hill in Durotar.

text.title: 年老的先知
text.objectives: 在昆莱山中不息山的山坡上找到先知昊梵舟。
text.description: 我可以帮你收集故事的片段，但你得靠你自己将它们拼合起来。而我或许恰巧知道你该到哪里完成这件事。$b$b我听说过先知昊梵舟的传说，他是一位年老的学者。他可以说是……潘达利亚历史方面的专家，也许会对潘达利亚当前的混乱局势有独到的见解。$B$B去找他吧，$n。我最后听到的消息是，他正打算追溯皇帝的脚步，攀登昆莱的不息山。
text.completion: <Huff> Oh, hello- <puff> hello there, young man.$B$BQuite the squall we're having up here today, isn't it?
text.completed: 在昆莱山中不息山的山坡上找到先知昊梵舟。

english.title: The Old Seer
english.objectives: Locate Seer Hao Pham Roo on the slopes of Mount Neverest in Kun-Lai Summit.
english.description: I can help you collect the pieces a story, but it is up to you tie them together. And I may know just where you could do such a thing.$b$bI have heard tales of an elderly scholar named Seer Hao Pham Roo. He is something of an... expert on Pandaria's history, and may be able to shed light on Pandaria's current turmoil.$B$BSeek him out, $n. Last I heard, he was planning to retrace the emperor's steps by scaling Mount Neverest, in Kun-Lai.
english.completion: <Huff> Oh, hello- <puff> hello there, young man.$B$BQuite the squall we're having up here today, isn't it?
english.completed: Locate Seer Hao Pham Roo on the slopes of Mount Neverest in Kun-Lai Summit.

text.title: 末代皇帝之路
text.objectives: 将爬绳固定在沿途的每个绳锚处，帮助先知昊梵舟抵达探索者营地。
text.description: 在他感到彷徨疑惑的时候，末代皇帝独自一人爬上了这座山，直到终于找到了自己要找的答案。$B$B我来这里是为了重走他走过的路，而你似乎也有问题等待解答。也许你应该加入我，这样我们两个就都能称心如愿了吧？$B$B噢，可是我年纪大了，这场暴风雪快把我这把老骨头折腾散了。你能不能在我前面爬，沿途把这根绳子固定住？那样我就能自己拉着绳子往上爬了。$B$B我们将一同行走在末代皇帝走过的山路上。
text.completion: We made it, $c! Thank you so much. Please, help yourself to some of my old knick-knacks.$B$BBut... I am afraid I have not been completely honest with you...
text.end: We made it! Thank you so much. Please, help yourself to some of my old knick-knacks.
text.completed: Attach the climbing rope to each Rope Anchor along the path to help Seer Hao Pham Roo reach Seeker's Point.

english.title: Path of the Last Emperor
english.objectives: Attach the climbing rope to each Rope Anchor along the path to help Seer Hao Pham Roo reach Seeker's Point.
english.description: In his time of uncertainty, the last emperor walked a lonely path up this mountain, until he had at last found his answers.I am here to walk the same path, and it seems you have questions of your own to be answered. Perhaps you will join me, and we can both be satisfied? Together we shall walk the path of the last emperor.
english.completion: We made it, $c! Thank you so much. Please, help yourself to some of my old knick-knacks.$B$BBut... I am afraid I have not been completely honest with you...
english.end: We made it! Thank you so much. Please, help yourself to some of my old knick-knacks.
english.completed: Attach the climbing rope to each Rope Anchor along the path to help Seer Hao Pham Roo reach Seeker's Point.

text.progress: What's that you have there, $c?
text.completion: Ah, you've found one of my treasures. Well done, adventurer.$B$BIn return, I will allow you to purchase one of my rare challenge cards.

text.progress: My, my. What's this you've brought me?

english.title: Teeth Like Swords
english.objectives: Return the Impeccably Sharp Tooth to someone within your faction's Brawler's Guild.
english.description: The tooth comes to a singular edge, almost as if it were sharpened by stone. It clearly belonged to a ferocious beast.$b$bHandling it gingerly, you notice a few tiny words, expertly carved into the enamel:$b$bRETURN TO BRAWLER'S GUILD
english.progress: You have something for me - I can see it in your eyes. What is it, $c?
english.completion: Ah, you've found one of my treasures. Well done, adventurer.$B$BIn return, I will allow you to purchase one of my rare challenge cards.

text.title: 锋齿
text.objectives: 购买锋齿的挑战卡牌，并在搏击俱乐部里向他发起挑战。
text.description: 你今天赢得的挑战卡牌属于南海最危险的生物之一：锋齿。只要被他的利齿咬到一口，你就会变得血肉模糊、内脏横流。$b$b祝你玩得开心！
text.completion: Congratulations!$B$BAlso, how embarrassing would it have been if you got eaten by a beached shark?
text.completed: Return to the Card Trader in your faction's Brawler's Guild.

english.title: Razorgrin
english.objectives: Defeat Razorgrin by purchasing his challenge card and challenging him in the Brawler's Guild.
english.description: The challenge card you've earned today belongs to one of the most deadly creatures in the South Seas: Razorgrin. One bite from those teeth of his, and you're nothing but an unrecognizable pile of skin, blood, and entrails.$b$bHave fun!
english.completion: Congratulations!$B$BAlso, how embarrassing would it have been if you got eaten by a beached shark?
english.completed: Return to the Card Trader in your faction's Brawler's Guild.

text.title: 软泥的秘密
text.objectives: 前往你所在阵营的搏击俱乐部，把一瓶红色软泥交给那里的某个人。
text.description: 瓶中液体剧烈地旋转起泡，引得瓶子在你手中颤动起来。当你望向容器深处时，你觉得自己在一瞬间看见了一张活灵活现的愤怒面孔。$b$b瓶塞紧紧嵌在瓶口，在瓶塞边缘，有某位行家刻下的一行小字：$b$b归还搏击俱乐部
text.progress: Greetings, $c.
text.completion: Ah, you've found one of my treasures. Well done, adventurer.$B$BIn return, I will allow you to purchase one of my rare challenge cards.

english.title: Secret of the Ooze
english.objectives: Return the Vial of Reddish Ooze to someone within your faction's Brawler's Guild.
english.description: The contents of the vial swirl and froth violently, causing the vessel to tremble in your hand. As you look into the container, you think you catch a fleeting image of a living, angry face.$b$bThe vial's stopper fits snugly. Around its edge, some small words have been carved with an expert hand:$b$bRETURN TO BRAWLER'S GUILD
english.progress: Greetings, $c.
english.completion: Ah, you've found one of my treasures. Well done, adventurer.$B$BIn return, I will allow you to purchase one of my rare challenge cards.

text.title: 斯普拉特
text.objectives: 购买斯普拉特的挑战卡牌，并在搏击俱乐部里向她发起挑战。
text.description: 你也许已经对布拉特感到很熟悉了，它是搏击俱乐部中的一位2级挑战者。你赢得的这张挑战卡牌属于斯普拉特，她是布拉特的姐姐，比布拉特更难对付。$b$b别把自己的小命弄丢了，$n。不过就算你不幸惨死，至少也要让我们这些观众看得高兴！
text.completion: You left quite a mess behind you, but you did it. Well done, $r!
text.completed: Return to the Card Trader in your faction's Brawler's Guild.

english.title: Splat
english.objectives: Defeat Splat by purchasing her challenge card and challenging her in the Brawler's Guild.
english.description: You may already be familiar with Blat, one of our Rank 2 challengers here in the Brawler's Guild. The challenge card you've earned belongs to Splat, its older, nastier sister.$b$bTry not to get yourself killed, $n. And if you do, at least make it entertaining for the rest of us!
english.completion: You left quite a mess behind you, but you did it. Well done, $r!
english.completed: Return to the Card Trader in your faction's Brawler's Guild.

text.title: Modified Chomping Apparatus
text.objectives: Return the Modified Chomping Apparatus to someone within your faction's Brawler's Guild.
text.description: You might not have recognized this as a modified chomping apparatus if it didn't have the words "MODIFIED CHOMPING APPARATUS" messily painted onto it.$b$bRight beneath the sloppy label, you see a smaller message, written much more neatly in bright red ink:$b$bRETURN TO BRAWLER'S GUILD
text.progress: Can I help you with something?
text.completion: Ah, you've found one of my treasures. Well done, adventurer.$B$BIn return, I will allow you to purchase one of my rare challenge cards.

english.title: Modified Chomping Apparatus
english.objectives: Return the Modified Chomping Apparatus to someone within your faction's Brawler's Guild.
english.description: You might not have recognized this as a modified chomping apparatus if it didn't have the words "MODIFIED CHOMPING APPARATUS" messily painted onto it.$b$bRight beneath the sloppy label, you see a smaller message, written much more neatly in bright red ink:$b$bRETURN TO BRAWLER'S GUILD
english.progress: Can I help you with something?
english.completion: Ah, you've found one of my treasures. Well done, adventurer.$B$BIn return, I will allow you to purchase one of my rare challenge cards.

text.title: 機械布魯斯
text.objectives: 購買機械布魯斯的挑戰卡然後在鬥陣俱樂部向他挑戰並且擊敗他。
text.description: 大家都認識布魯斯，大家也愛布魯斯!而且到頭來，大家都會殺掉布魯斯。$b$b有個熟悉工程學的獸人獵人覺得這很可惜，所以他就把自己的鱷魚加裝了些武器。$b$b你贏得的挑戰卡讓你有資格和機械布魯斯一搏。這一定是場血戰。問題是...究竟是你咬牠，還是牠咬你?
text.completion: Aww... poor Mecha-Bruce.$B$BI'll give you your reward. But I don't have to be happy about it.
text.completed: Return to the Card Trader in your faction's Brawler's Guild.

english.title: Mecha-Bruce
english.objectives: Defeat Mecha-Bruce by purchasing his challenge card and challenging him in the Brawler's Guild.
english.description: Everybody knows Bruce. Everybody loves Bruce! And eventually, everybody kills Bruce.$b$bAn orcish hunter with a knack for engineering thought that this was a shame, so he's found his own crocolisk and geared him up a bit.$b$bThe challenge card you've earned grants you the right to fight Mecha-Bruce. It's bound to be a bloodbath. The question is... will you be the chomper, or the chompee?
english.completion: Aww... poor Mecha-Bruce.$B$BI'll give you your reward. But I don't have to be happy about it.
english.completed: Return to the Card Trader in your faction's Brawler's Guild.

text.title: Frost-Tipped Eggshell
text.objectives: Return the Frost-Tipped Eggshell to someone within your faction's Brawler's Guild.
text.description: A piece of an eggshell, presumably penguin. Its edges are covered with rime, and based on its curvature, this egg was quite large when it was intact.$b$bStrangely, the inside of the eggshell has a message written on it, in jade-green ink:$b$bRETURN TO BRAWLER'S GUILD
text.progress: You have the look of a messenger about you. What do you have for me, $r?
text.completion: Ah, you've found one of my treasures. Well done, adventurer.$B$BIn return, I will allow you to purchase one of my rare challenge cards.

english.title: Frost-Tipped Eggshell
english.objectives: Return the Frost-Tipped Eggshell to someone within your faction's Brawler's Guild.
english.description: A piece of an eggshell, presumably penguin. Its edges are covered with rime, and based on its curvature, this egg was quite large when it was intact.$b$bStrangely, the inside of the eggshell has a message written on it, in jade-green ink:$b$bRETURN TO BRAWLER'S GUILD
english.progress: You have the look of a messenger about you. What do you have for me, $r?
english.completion: Ah, you've found one of my treasures. Well done, adventurer.$B$BIn return, I will allow you to purchase one of my rare challenge cards.

text.title: Dippy and Doopy
text.objectives: Defeat Dippy & Doopy by purchasing their challenge card and challenging them in the Brawler's Guild.
text.description: Brawler's Guild vets will remember Dippy, the penguin. Dippy's not the most accomplished challenger in the Brawler's Guild, but he's no pushover, either!$b$bActually, come to think of it, he IS kind of a pushover...$b$bAnyway! The card you've earned gives you the right to challenge Dippy alongside his older, huger brother, Doopy. They may both be pushovers, but that doesn't mean that one or both of them won't eventually murder you.
text.completion: I never thought I'd say this, but successfully beating up a couple penguins is the sign of a true, tried-and-tested brawler. You've earned your reward.
text.completed: Return to the Card Trader in your faction's Brawler's Guild.

english.title: Dippy and Doopy
english.objectives: Defeat Dippy & Doopy by purchasing their challenge card and challenging them in the Brawler's Guild.
english.description: Brawler's Guild vets will remember Dippy, the penguin. Dippy's not the most accomplished challenger in the Brawler's Guild, but he's no pushover, either!$b$bActually, come to think of it, he IS kind of a pushover...$b$bAnyway! The card you've earned gives you the right to challenge Dippy alongside his older, huger brother, Doopy. They may both be pushovers, but that doesn't mean that one or both of them won't eventually murder you.
english.completion: I never thought I'd say this, but successfully beating up a couple penguins is the sign of a true, tried-and-tested brawler. You've earned your reward.
english.completed: Return to the Card Trader in your faction's Brawler's Guild.

text.title: 去年旧款
text.objectives: 前往你所在阵营的搏击俱乐部，把尘封的旧机器人交给那里的某个人。
text.description: 机器人显得破损不堪。和布林顿4000一样，在它身上有几个插孔，以前可能镶有宝石，但现在早已不见踪影。$b$b在机器人遍布尘埃的身体后部有一块闪闪发亮的金属小牌，上面印有如下字样：$b$b归还搏击俱乐部
text.progress: What's that you have there, $c?
text.completion: Ah, you've found one of my treasures. Well done, adventurer.$B$BIn return, I will allow you to purchase one of my rare challenge cards.

english.title: Last Year's Model
english.objectives: Return the Dusty Old Robot to someone within your faction's Brawler's Guild.
english.description: The robot is in bad shape. It was built with several sockets which, like the Blingtron 4000, presumably once carried gems, but are now empty.$b$bThe robot's otherwise dust-covered posterior region contains a small, shiny metal plaque, embossed with the words:$b$bRETURN TO BRAWLER'S GUILD
english.progress: What's that you have there, $c?
english.completion: Ah, you've found one of my treasures. Well done, adventurer.$B$BIn return, I will allow you to purchase one of my rare challenge cards.

text.title: 布林顿3000
text.objectives: 购买布林顿3000的挑战卡牌，并在搏击俱乐部里向他发起挑战。
text.description: 布林顿系列一直销路不畅，直到4000型系列上市才得以改观。很少有人记得布林顿3000，可它确实凭借自身实力创造了真正的工程学奇迹！$b$b你解锁的这张挑战卡牌使你能够在搏击俱乐部中与布林顿3000对决。$b$b祝你好运！
text.completion: You've got a real knack for beating up robots, $n.
text.completed: Return to the Card Trader in your faction's Brawler's Guild.

english.title: Blingtron 3000
english.objectives: Defeat Blingtron 3000 by purchasing his challenge card and challenging him in the Brawler's Guild.
english.description: The Blingtron line didn't really pick up until the 4000 series hit the vendor shelves. Few remember the Blingtron 3000, but it was a real engineering marvel in its own right!$b$bThe challenge card you've unlocked gives you the ability to fight Blingtron 3000 right here, in the Brawler's Guild.$b$bLucky you!
english.completion: You've got a real knack for beating up robots, $n.
english.completed: Return to the Card Trader in your faction's Brawler's Guild.

text.title: 挖掘专家的铲地刀
text.objectives: 前往你所在阵营的搏击俱乐部，把挖掘专家的铲地刀交给那里的某个人。
text.description: 一把普普通通的铲子。把手上刻有华丽的文字：“挖掘专家的铲地刀”。$b$b在把手的另一面则有个更小的标签，简明地写道：$b$b归还搏击俱乐部
text.progress: What are you carrying, $c? Something of mine?
text.completion: Ah, you've found one of my treasures. Well done, adventurer.$B$BIn return, I will allow you to purchase one of my rare challenge cards.

english.title: The Digmaster's Earthblade
english.objectives: Return the Digmaster's Earthblade to someone within your faction's Brawler's Guild.
english.description: An entirely ordinary-looking shovel. The handle is carved with an ornate script: "The Digmaster's Earthblade".$b$bOn the flipside of the handle, however, is a smaller label, written in simpler text:$b$bRETURN TO BRAWLER'S GUILD
english.progress: What are you carrying, $c? Something of mine?
english.completion: Ah, you've found one of my treasures. Well done, adventurer.$B$BIn return, I will allow you to purchase one of my rare challenge cards.

text.title: 明格斯·迪格斯
text.objectives: 购买明格斯·迪格斯的挑战卡牌，并在搏击俱乐部里向他发起挑战。
text.description: 你赢得了挑战考古学家明格斯·迪格斯的权力！$b$b据我所知，明格斯并不是那么能打……可负责人让他把一些出土文物带进了竞技场。你可要小心那些玩意儿。$b$b等你准备好，就来购买他的卡牌吧！
text.completion: You ran around that arena so quickly, I got dizzy for a moment.$B$BWell done!
text.completed: Return to the Card Trader in your faction's Brawler's Guild.

english.title: Mingus Diggs
english.objectives: Defeat Mingus Diggs by purchasing his challenge card and challenging him in the Brawler's Guild.
english.description: You've earned the right to challenge Mingus Diggs, the archaeologist!$b$bMingus isn't that tough, from what I hear... but the people in charge let him bring some of his excavated treasures with him into the brawling ring. Those are what you want to watch out for.$b$bCome buy his card when you're ready!
english.completion: You ran around that arena so quickly, I got dizzy for a moment.$B$BWell done!
english.completed: Return to the Card Trader in your faction's Brawler's Guild.

text.title: 陈旧的眼罩
text.objectives: 前往你所在阵营的搏击俱乐部，把陈旧的眼罩交给那里的某个人。
text.description: 一块依据人类头型剪裁的布。这块布显得朴素简洁，只在最下边有个小标签，上面写着：$b$b归还搏击俱乐部
text.progress: You carry something of mine, I believe.
text.completion: Ah, you've found one of my treasures. Well done, adventurer.$B$BIn return, I will allow you to purchase one of my rare challenge cards.

english.title: Well-Worn Blindfold
english.objectives: Return the Well-Worn Blindfold to someone within your faction's Brawler's Guild.
english.description: A piece of cloth, shaped for a human-sized head. The cloth is unadorned and simple, except for a small tag on the end, which reads:$b$bRETURN TO BRAWLER'S GUILD
english.progress: You carry something of mine, I believe.
english.completion: Ah, you've found one of my treasures. Well done, adventurer.$B$BIn return, I will allow you to purchase one of my rare challenge cards.

text.title: 盲眼英雄
text.objectives: 购买盲眼英雄的挑战卡牌，并在搏击俱乐部里向他发起挑战。
text.description: 你赢得的这张挑战卡牌，使你可以与盲眼英雄对决，他是昔日的神秘战士。没人能超越他对利刃的驾驭力。任何人都做不到。$b$b幸运的是，他什么都看不见。祝你玩得愉快！
text.completion: I would normally shame someone for fighting a blind person, but in this case, I have to commend you.$B$BBrilliant brawling, $n!
text.completed: Return to the Card Trader in your faction's Brawler's Guild.

english.title: The Blind Hero
english.objectives: Defeat the Blind Hero by purchasing his challenge card and challenging him in the Brawler's Guild.
english.description: The challenge card you've earned allows you to fight the Blind Hero, a mysterious warrior from a bygone age. Nobody surpasses his skill with a blade. Nobody.$b$bLuckily, he can't see anything. Have fun!
english.completion: I would normally shame someone for fighting a blind person, but in this case, I have to commend you.$B$BBrilliant brawling, $n!
english.completed: Return to the Card Trader in your faction's Brawler's Guild.

text.title: 被布包住的石头
text.objectives: 前往你所在阵营的搏击俱乐部，把被布包住的石头交给那里的某个人。
text.description: 这两样东西真是奇怪的组合。布把石块完全包住，如同把木浆裹在毯子里点燃，多此一举。与布相比，石头则只是一块普通的鹅卵石。$b$b当你对着光看时，布上现出了清晰的水印，有这样一行字：$b$b归还搏击俱乐部
text.progress: Good day, $r. Have you brought something for me?
text.completion: Ah, you've found one of my treasures. Well done, adventurer.$B$BIn return, I will allow you to purchase one of my rare challenge cards.

english.title: Paper-Covered Rock
english.objectives: Return the Paper-Covered Rock to someone within your faction's Brawler's Guild.
english.description: It's a strange combination of items. The paper envelops the rock completely, dwarfing it like a smothering blanket of wood pulp. Compared to the paper, the rock is barely a pebble.$b$bWhen held up to the light, the paper reveals a distinct watermark, along with the text:$b$bRETURN TO BRAWLER'S GUILD
english.progress: Good day, $r. Have you brought something for me?
english.completion: Ah, you've found one of my treasures. Well done, adventurer.$B$BIn return, I will allow you to purchase one of my rare challenge cards.

text.title: 猜拳手
text.objectives: 购买猜拳手的挑战卡牌，并在搏击俱乐部里向它发起挑战。
text.description: 你解锁的这张挑战卡牌，使你能够与猜拳手对决，它是来自未知区域的神秘生物。$b$b千万要多加小心。我听说它可有两下子。
text.completion: You did well! Even if you did get a little lucky...
text.completed: Return to the Card Trader in your faction's Brawler's Guild.

english.title: Ro-Shambo
english.objectives: Defeat Ro-Shambo by purchasing her challenge card and challenging her in the Brawler's Guild.
english.description: The challenge card you have unlocked will allow you to fight Ro-Shambo, an esoteric creature from parts unknown.$b$bWatch out. I hear it's got a few tricks up its sleeve.
english.completion: You did well! Even if you did get a little lucky...
english.completed: Return to the Card Trader in your faction's Brawler's Guild.

text.title: 迅猛龙皮拳击手套
text.objectives: 前往你所在阵营的搏击俱乐部，把迅猛龙皮拳击手套交给那里的某个人。
text.description: 这副手套针脚粗糙，而且从气味判断，应该沾有爬行者的粘液。尽管如此，看上去仍然坚固耐用。$b$b令人不大出乎意料的是，在内侧边缝处有这样一行字：$b$b归还搏击俱乐部
text.progress: What's that you have there, $c?
text.completion: Ah, you've found one of my treasures. Well done, adventurer.$B$BIn return, I will allow you to purchase one of my rare challenge cards.

english.title: Raptorhide Boxing Gloves
english.objectives: Return the Raptorhide Boxing Gloves to someone within your faction's Brawler's Guild.
english.description: The gloves are stitched together roughly, and by the smell of it, they've been treated with crawler mucus. Nevertheless, they appear sturdy and functional.$b$bSomewhat unsurprisingly, the inner seam bears the following words:$b$bRETURN TO BRAWLER'S GUILD
english.progress: What's that you have there, $c?
english.completion: Ah, you've found one of my treasures. Well done, adventurer.$B$BIn return, I will allow you to purchase one of my rare challenge cards.

text.title: 泰塔尔
text.objectives: 购买泰塔尔的挑战卡牌，并在搏击俱乐部里向他发起挑战。
text.description: 你赢得了购买一张挑战卡牌的权力，这张卡牌属于一位名叫泰塔尔的巨魔。$b$b泰塔尔的战斗风格极为独特，且作为他与搏击俱乐部协议的一部分，你必须遵循他的规则：$b$b面对面徒手拳击。不得四处乱跑。$b$b三次击倒对手者获胜。$b$b祝你好运！
text.completion: Look at you! You went into that arena and beat Ty'thar at his own game.$B$BHere. You deserve this.
text.completed: Return to the Card Trader in your faction's Brawler's Guild.

english.title: Ty'thar
english.objectives: Defeat Ty'thar by purchasing his challenge card and challenging him in the Brawler's Guild.
english.description: You've earned the right to purchase a challenge card, and that card belongs to a troll named Ty'thar.$b$bTy'thar has a very distinct fighting style, and as part of his agreement with the Brawler's Guild, you have to follow his rules:$b$b - Face-to-face fist fighting. No running around.$b$b - Three knockdowns wins the fight.$b$bGood luck!
english.completion: Look at you! You went into that arena and beat Ty'thar at his own game.$B$BHere. You deserve this.
english.completed: Return to the Card Trader in your faction's Brawler's Guild.

text.title: Battle of Razor Hill Tracking Quest

english.title: Battle of Razor Hill Tracking Quest

text.title: 善行披风
text.objectives: 前往雾纱栈道的石匠之愚，与拉希奥交谈。
text.description: 我们有了需要的东西。我能创造出驾驭天神之力的物品，而且只要略作努力，也许还能把我自己的部分力量收入其中。$b$b到石匠之愚上方与我会面吧，就在雾纱栈道迷雾酒肆的东边，我们曾经在那里见过面。结果会让你喜出望外的！
text.completion: I can custom-tailor the cloak to your preferred abilities. Choose wisely!$B$BThe cloak contains only a fraction of its potential power. I'm already hatching a plan to augment it...
text.completed: Speak with Wrathion in the Veiled Stair.

english.title: Cloak of Virtue
english.objectives: Travel to Mason's Folly in the Veiled Stair and speak with Wrathion.
english.description: We have what we need. I can create an item that will harness the power of the celestials and, with a little work, may also be able to contain some of my own.$b$bMeet me atop Mason's Folly, east of the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair, where we've met before. You will be delighted with the results!
english.completion: I can custom-tailor the cloak to your preferred abilities. Choose wisely!$B$BThe cloak contains only a fraction of its potential power. I'm already hatching a plan to augment it...
english.completed: Speak with Wrathion in the Veiled Stair.

text.title: 戰場:貧瘠之地
text.objectives: [每周任務]收集$1oa份柯爾克隆木材、$2oa份柯爾克隆之油、$3oa份柯爾克隆肉塊與$4oa份柯爾克隆石材。
text.description: $n，我們距離大功告成還遠得很呢。大火在燃燒，可是仍然可以撲滅的。$B$B帶更多的柯爾克隆補給回來給我，我會好好獎勵你。
text.progress: How go the Barrens, $c?
text.completion: <Ki'ta Arrowtusk chuckles to himself.> I see you made a whole lotta Kor'kron heads roll for dese supplies.$B$BWell mon, Vol'jin was right to commend you. Dese supplies will be lastin' us an entire week.

text.title: 我们受训的目的
text.objectives: 通过搜寻战斗的功能，率领一支由25级宠物组成的战队击败10名玩家。
text.description: 你准备好让自己的宠物经受考验了吗？战斗宠物竞技场可不欢迎低等级的菜鸟，你最好拿出点真本事来，做好打硬仗的准备。如果你有三只训练有素的宠物，那就找有相似技能的训练师较量一下，向这个世界证明你的实力吧！你可以在宠物手册中查阅说明事项。
text.completion: I've heard stories about some of your matches circulating around, apparently they were quite a sight to behold! I think you've earned this reward. Congratulations, trainer, and keep up the good work.
text.completed: Return to the Vale of Eternal Blossoms, Orgrimmar, or Stormwind.

english.title: What We've Been Training For
english.objectives: Defeat 10 players through Find Battle with a team of level 25 pets.
english.description: Are you ready to put your pets to the test? The battle pet arena is no place for low-level rabbits, you'd better have a rocketbot in your pocket and be ready for action. If you've got three fully-experienced pets, find battles against trainers of similar skill and show the world what you've got. You can find the instructions in your Pet Journal.
english.completion: I've heard stories about some of your matches circulating around, apparently they were quite a sight to behold! I think you've earned this reward. Congratulations, trainer, and keep up the good work.

text.completion: <Vol'jin nods at you.>$B$B$c. Looks like ya just chose a side.$B$BI hope ya ready ta fight.

text.title: 准备出击
text.objectives: 回雾纱栈道的迷雾酒肆找拉希奥。
text.description: 一切都在有条不紊地进行着，$n。在实施我计划的收尾行动之前，我们还有最后一项任务需要完成。$b$b我的密探们告诉我，乌瑞恩国王在塞拉摩惨败之后，集结了一支海军舰队；而沃金正在挥军北上，横跨杜隆塔尔，发起了推翻酋长统治的公开起义。$b$b一旦他们做好在大门处会师的准备时，就立刻回来与我交谈。我们要为这场战争画下辉煌的句点！
text.completion: Are you ready for your next adventure, $c?$B$BOur campaign is nearing its conclusion...
text.completed: 回雾纱栈道的迷雾酒肆找拉希奥。

english.title: Preparing to Strike
english.objectives: Return to Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.
english.description: Events are in motion, $n. We have one final task to complete before we are ready to move into the final act of my plan.$b$bMy agents tell me that King Wrynn has reassembled a naval fleet after his losses at Theramore, and Vol'jin is marching north across Durotar in open rebellion against the warchief.$b$bSpeak with me again as soon as they are ready to converge on the gates. We will bring this war to a glorious conclusion!
english.completion: Are you ready for your next adventure, $c?$B$BOur campaign is nearing its conclusion...
english.completed: Return to Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

Maybe we can work together dis once. You want to strangle de Warchief, hm? Shut 'im out?$B$B<Vol'jin smiles disarmingly, his grin slow and savage.>

text.title: 大战在即
text.objectives: 与游学者周卓交谈。
text.description: 当你进入山谷后，你看见一位圆滚滚的熊猫人在魔古山宫殿上方的平台上朝你打着手势。似乎是游学者周卓在试图引起你的注意。你应该弄清楚是怎么回事！
text.completion: Ah! Welcome my friend. I am very glad that I was able to get your attention. Great deeds are at work that require a hero such as yourself.
text.completed: 在锦绣谷的闻道之座与游学者周卓谈一谈。

text.title: 战争之路
text.objectives: 在杜隆塔尔的剃刀岭与基塔·箭牙交谈。
text.description: 嘿！我刚刚收到我们远在杜隆塔尔的密探发回的情报。$B$B暗矛起义军需要你的帮助。$B$B我听说你本来就跟巨魔有点交情。那为什么不亲自去杜隆塔尔走一趟，看看那里到底发生了什么事情？
text.completion: It be good to see dat some Alliance have a sense of loyalty.

english.objectives: Speak to Ki'ta Arrowtusk at Razor Hill in Durotar.
english.description: Hey! I just received word from our agents in Durotar.$B$BThe Darkspear Rebellion needs your help.$B$BI hear you've already got an in with the trolls. Why don't you zip over to Durotar and see what's happening?
english.completion: It be good to see dat some Alliance have a sense of loyalty.

text.objectives: 完成英雄难度的任意场景战役。
text.description: 我简直要无聊到发疯了——我一步都没离开过这地方！$b$b你看起来像是个见过点世面的冒险者。要是你能给我带来一个真正的英雄故事，我这肯定有你感兴趣的好东西。
text.completion: Congratulations, $n, you did it!  Before I forget, here's the special surprise I promised -- I hope you like it.$B$BNow tell me all about the adventure.  Did you face certain death?  Meet any friends?  I wish I had more friends like you.

Prove yourself by bringing back spoils from these dungeons.

Standard inks will not do.$b$bThere are beasts here in the Vale... beasts of legend which carry the colors I need. I can show you where to find them.

text.objectives: [TEMP TEXT] Complete a [PROVING GROUNDS TRIAL].
text.description: [TEMP TEXT] Gauros may have tested you, but I think you're capable of more, $n. I know what warriors like you have been through, and a few missions out in the field are really all in a day's work.$b$bYour true trial will take place in [PROVING GROUNDS TOWN]. Speak with [PROVING GROUNDS JIM] at [PROVING GROUNDS TOWN], and defeat one of his trials.

text.title: Into the Vale
text.objectives: Speak to Madam Vee Luo at the Shrine of Two Moons in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
text.description: Ah, I have been waiting for your arrival, traveler.$B$BI wish we could meet in better times, but alas, I fear the situation in the Vale is quite dire.$B$BBut let us not speak of that now. Go visit Madam Vee Luo at the Shrine of Two Moons.$B$BShe should be able to settle you in.

english.title: Into the Vale
english.objectives: Speak to Madam Vee Luo at the Shrine of Two Moons in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
english.description: Ah, I have been waiting for your arrival, traveler.$B$BI wish we could meet in better times, but alas, I fear the situation in the Vale is quite dire.$B$BBut let us not speak of that now. Go visit Madam Vee Luo at the Shrine of Two Moons.$B$BShe should be able to settle you in.

text.title: 失传已久的汤面秘诀
text.objectives: 在永恒岛的老酒湾里寻找古老铭牌的主人。
text.description: 你在碎石中找到了一块古老的铭牌碎片。你拭去上面的尘埃，勉强辨认出了几个因风化而变得模糊难识的熊猫人文字，分别是“汤面”和“林”。$B$B抬眼望去，有座小桥被埋在你身边的乱石堆里，这块铭牌应该是从当年位于桥上的某个设施上掉下来的。在桥上摆摊开设小吃店，听起来像是临时生意，所以店主可能就住在附近。$B$B也许能在岛上的村子里找到线索？
text.completion: Well, hello there. I am Lin Chao-Wei.$B$BHave you come here to try my family's famous noodle soup?

english.title: Noodle Secrets Long Forgotten
english.objectives: Search the village, Old Pi'jiu, on the Timeless Isle, for the owner of the old sign fragment.
english.description: Searching amidst the rubble, you find the fragment of an old sign. Wiping away the dust, you can make out the well-weathered pandaren characters for "Noodles" and "Lin."$B$BLooking above, you suspect that the establishment this sign belonged to was situated on the bridge, which now lies in rubble about you. An eatery placed on a bridge sounds very temporary, so its owner would likely live nearby.$B$BPerhaps there is a clue to be found in the village here on the island?
english.completion: Well, hello there. I am Lin Chao-Wei.$B$BHave you come here to try my family's famous noodle soup?

text.title: NC S1 Q2
text.description: Well hello there. I am Lin, Chao-Wei. Have you come here to try my family's famous noodle soup? I'm afraid you're all out of luck. My father passed away before he could teach me the secret ingredient to his secret ingredient noodle soup. He did mention writing down the recipe for a friend of his that went to the Temple of the Jade Serpent. Perhaps you can find it there?

english.title: NC S1 Q2
english.description: Well hello there. I am Lin, Chao-Wei. Have you come here to try my family's famous noodle soup? I'm afraid you're all out of luck. My father passed away before he could teach me the secret ingredient to his secret ingredient noodle soup. He did mention writing down the recipe for a friend of his that went to the Temple of the Jade Serpent. Perhaps you can find it there?

text.title: 秘密配方流失之谜
text.objectives: 击败疑之煞。
text.description: 如果你来这里是为了品尝我们家族最出名的汤面，那你恐怕得败兴而归了。$B$B我父亲还没来得及把他的秘密配方传授给我就过世了。不过我倒是听他说起过，他把配方写下来交给了一位在青龙寺学习的朋友。$B$B也许你可以去那找找？
text.completion: You recognize the name, Lin, on the scroll. A few characters down you see the character for "Recipe."$B$BThis must be it!$B$BYour only worry is that the sha energies that manifested themselves in the tales of the pandaren may have corrupted the scroll as well.$B$BThere is only one way to find out....
text.completed: Search for the Lin Famiy Scroll in the Temple of the Jade Serpent's Heart of Jade.

english.title: The Lost Secret of the Secret Ingredient
english.objectives: Defeat the Sha of Doubt.
english.description: If you've come here to try my family's famous noodle soup, I'm afraid you're out of luck.$B$BMy father passed away before he could teach me the secret ingredient. He did mention writing down the recipe for a friend of his that studied at the Temple of the Jade Serpent.$B$BPerhaps you can find it there?
english.completion: You recognize the name, Lin, on the scroll. A few characters down you see the character for "Recipe."$B$BThis must be it!$B$BYour only worry is that the sha energies that manifested themselves in the tales of the pandaren may have corrupted the scroll as well.$B$BThere is only one way to find out....
english.completed: Search for the Lin Famiy Scroll in the Temple of the Jade Serpent's Heart of Jade.

text.title: 就此失传？
text.objectives: 在四风谷的半山市集与孙行·铁掌谈一谈。
text.description: <既然已经拿到了林家古老的汤面配方，你决定出发前往半山市集。>$B$B<如果说在潘达利亚有人知道如何破译这个卷轴的话，那一定非孙行·铁掌莫属。>
text.completion: Hello, $n. What is it you have there?

english.title: Secrets Lost, Forever?
english.objectives: Speak with Sungshin Ironpaw at the Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.
english.description: <With the ancient Lin family noodle soup recipe in hand, you decide to set out for the Halfhill Market.>$B$B<If anyone in Pandaria knows how to decipher this scroll, it's Sungshin Ironpaw.>
english.completion: Hello, $n. What is it you have there?

text.title: 接与运
text.objectives: 在帝皇粮仓使用粮食袋接住20袋被谷仓破坏者扔下来的谷物。$B$B如果你骑上坐骑或受到伤害，你手中的谷物都会洒落在地。
text.description: 天哪！爷爷曾经给我讲过大名鼎鼎的林家汤面馆的故事。$B$B据说这个卷轴已经被扭曲了，但我想我们一定能合力解开这谜题！$B$B首先，我们需要用到大量谷物来制作面条。$B$B前往粮仓，用这个袋子接住一些谷物。等你接好以后，把它丢到我停放在粮仓的货车上。
text.completion: Excellent work, $n! With all this grain I think we're ready to start.$B$BFor now I think you should try making noodle soup. Try using this recipe I've written down for you. It'll make for excellent practice.
text.completed: Return to Sungshin Ironpaw at the Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

english.title: Catch and Carry
english.objectives: Use the Grain Catching Sack to catch 20 Sacks of Grain being thrown down by the Granary Vandals at the Imperial Granary.$B$BYou will drop all your carried grain if you mount or get hurt.
english.description: Oh my! Grandpa used to tell me stories of the famous Lin family noodle shop.$B$BIt is sad that the scroll has been warped, but I think we can work together to solve the riddle!$B$BTo start, we're going to need lots of grain to make noodles.$B$BHead down to the granary and catch some grain with this sack. After you've caught some, drop it off at the wagon I've placed at the granary.
english.completion: Excellent work, $n! With all this grain I think we're ready to start.$B$BFor now I think you should try making noodle soup. Try using this recipe I've written down for you. It'll make for excellent practice.
english.completed: Return to Sungshin Ironpaw at the Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 那是真正的计量单位吗？
text.objectives: 制造汤面餐车并在风暴烈酒酿造厂里从被杀死的酒灵身上收集20捧酒。
text.description: 干得好，$n。看来你已经准备好继续探索林家秘制汤面的秘密了。$B$B据我所知，林总是用风暴烈酒来制作汤底。$B$B我想你接下来应该制造属于你自己的汤面餐车，然后前往风暴烈酒酿造厂收集几捧酒回来。
text.progress: I'm glad it's you and not me. I'm not much of a drinker, myself.
text.completion: Well done, $n. With this we can make a truly unique soup broth.$B$BI've managed to get some updated schematics for your noodle cart. With this broth, you're definitely going to want to upgrade your operation.$B$BNext up: finding the secret ingredient of the Lin secret ingredient noodle soup!
text.completed: Return to Sungshin Ironpaw at the Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

english.title: Is That A Real Measurement?
english.objectives: Create a Noodle Cart Kit and collect 20 Sloshes of Brew from slain alementals in the Stormstout Brewery.
english.description: Well done, $n. I can see you're ready to continue exploring the mysteries of Lin's secret ingredient soup.$B$BFrom what I can tell, Lin used Stormstout brew for his soup broth.$B$BI think the next steps for you are to create a Noodle Cart of your own and to head to the Stormstout Brewery to collect some sloshes of brew.
english.progress: I'm glad it's you and not me. I'm not much of a drinker, myself.
english.completion: Well done, $n. With this we can make a truly unique soup broth.$B$BI've managed to get some updated schematics for your noodle cart. With this broth, you're definitely going to want to upgrade your operation.$B$BNext up: finding the secret ingredient of the Lin secret ingredient noodle soup!
english.completed: Return to Sungshin Ironpaw at the Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 这些可不是肥美的山羊肉排
text.objectives: 制造什锦汤面餐车并收集50块肥美的龟肉排。
text.description: 我真是太激动了，$n。我们几乎已经掌握汤面的所有成分了！$B$B我们这儿有许许多多的蔬菜和调料，但当年在林家手里还有某些外来肉品，已经在潘达利亚消失一段时间了。我们需要一些优质肥美的鲜肉。$B$B爷爷曾经告诉过我，在永恒岛的海岸边生活着古老的海龟。寿命那么长的动物，骨头上一定会长着些肥美的肉吧。$B$B制造什锦汤面餐车，再收集一些肥美的龟肉排，然后我们再继续。
text.progress: I can just taste the soup now!
text.completion: Ooh, these will do nicely, $n.$B$BNow for the final step: the Lin secret ingredient soup's secret ingredient.$B$BThat's a mouthful!
text.completed: Return to Sungshin Ironpaw at the Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

english.title: These Aren't Your Fatty Goatsteaks
english.objectives: Create a Deluxe Noodle Cart Kit and collect 50 Fatty Turtle Steaks.
english.description: I'm so excited, $n. We've nearly mastered all the ingredients for noodle soup!$B$BWe have plenty of vegetables and spices here, but the Lin family had access to exotic meats not seen in Pandaria for some time. We need some nice, fatty meats.$B$BGrandpa used to tell me of ancient turtles living off the shores of the Timeless Isle. Something that lives that long has to have some nice fatty meat on its bones.$B$BCreate a deluxe noodle cart and gather some fatty turtle steaks and we'll continue.
english.progress: I can just taste the soup now!
english.completion: Ooh, these will do nicely, $n.$B$BNow for the final step: the Lin secret ingredient soup's secret ingredient.$B$BThat's a mouthful!
english.completed: Return to Sungshin Ironpaw at the Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 秘密配方就是……
text.objectives: 排队并完成寻找秘密配方场景战役。
text.description: 要想做好这个，最好的办法就是亲自动手实验。$B$B我已经安排潘达利亚各处的商人、学者和农民前来试吃你的汤面。要是你能为他们每个人奉上对他们胃口的汤面，那我们一定能取得最好的结果！$B$B是时候找到秘密配方了！
text.completion: Well done, $n. All those people came by to taste your noodle soup and YOU made them so happy!$B$BDon't you see? The secret ingredient is in you!$B$BNow go out there and make the world happy with this latest noodle cart!
text.completed: Return to Sungshin Ironpaw at the Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

english.title: The Secret Ingredient Is...
english.objectives: Queue for and complete the Finding the Secret Ingredient scenario.
english.description: The best way to go about doing this is through hands-on experience.$B$BI've arranged for merchants, scholars, and farmers from all over Pandaria to come for a taste test of your soups. We'll get the best results if you can match them to the soups they prefer.$B$BIt's time to find the secret ingredient!
english.completion: Well done, $n. All those people came by to taste your noodle soup and YOU made them so happy!$B$BDon't you see? The secret ingredient is in you!$B$BNow go out there and make the world happy with this latest noodle cart!
english.completed: Return to Sungshin Ironpaw at the Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 回旅店与我会面
text.objectives: 到雾纱栈道迷雾酒肆的楼上与拉希奥会面。
text.description: 我敢肯定，你此刻已经迫不及待地想要试试自己的新披风了。那就让它发挥作用吧。$b$b回旅馆里与我碰面！一项新发现引起了我的注意，我们可以对其善加利用。
text.completion: Are you ready for your next adventure?

english.title: Meet Me Back at the Inn
english.objectives: Meet Wrathion upstairs at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.
english.description: I'm certain you're eager to test out your new cloak. Let's put it to use.$b$bMeet me back inside the inn! A new development has come to my attention that we'll want to take advantage of.
english.completion: Are you ready for your next adventure?

text.title: 永恒的发现
text.objectives: 前往位于翡翠林东南部的永恒岛，并与拉希奥交谈。
text.description: 潘达利亚。正当我以为自己已经洞悉了这片大陆上的一切神秘时，我却有了新的发现。$b$b那地方叫做“永恒岛”。它曾经深藏在迷雾之中，仿佛听凭自己的意志忽而出现，忽而消失。我听说时间在那里毫无意义，既无日出，也无日落。$b$b我们正好可以利用这一怪象，$n！如果我能用时间锁住你的斗篷，它所蕴含的力量将会是……无边无际的。$b$b我们的前路非常清晰。飞去翡翠林的东南部，到永恒岛上与我会面！
text.completion: You're here! How long have I been waiting for you?$B$B<Wrathion appears momentarily confused.>$B$BI feel like I just arrived... but maybe I've been here for weeks... This island plays with one's head.$B$BKairoz has been trying to explain it to me, but sometimes I think bronze dragons speak in riddles.

english.title: A Timeless Discovery
english.objectives: Travel to the Timeless Isle southeast of the Jade Forest and speak with Wrathion.
english.description: Pandaria. Just when I think I've gotten its mysteries figured out, I discover something new.$b$bIt's called "The Timeless Isle." Once hidden in the mists, it appears and disappears seemingly of its own will. I've heard that time has no meaning there, that the sun neither rises nor sets.$b$bWe can take advantage of this anomaly, $n! If I could time-lock your cloak, the power it could contain would be... immense.$b$bOur path is clear. Fly southeast of the Jade Forest and meet me at the Timeless Isle!
english.completion: You're here! How long have I been waiting for you?$B$B<Wrathion appears momentarily confused.>$B$BI feel like I just arrived... but maybe I've been here for weeks... This island plays with one's head.$B$BKairoz has been trying to explain it to me, but sometimes I think bronze dragons speak in riddles.

text.title: 永恒岛的秘密
text.objectives: 从永恒岛的怪物身上和事件中收集$1oa枚永恒铸币。
text.description: 在这座岛屿上铸有一种独特的货币，叫做“永恒铸币”。它们可以免疫岛上的时间扭曲之力……我想要查明原因。$b$b替我找些铸币来！深入这片被遗忘天堂的丛林间吧。不惜一切代价消灭那些潜伏在这片永恒之地的神秘敌人，探索隐藏的宝藏，找寻被遗忘的财宝。我等着你回来！
text.progress: <Wrathion tents his fingers together.>$B$BMy coins...?
text.completion: Wonderful, these are exactly what I need.$B$B<Wrathion holds one of the coins up, admiring it in the glow of the unmoving sun.>$B$BI will deconstruct their mysterious power, and use their timelessness to enhance your cloak. You will be most pleased with the result.
text.completed: Bring the coins to Wrathion on the Timeless Isle near the Jade Forest.

english.title: Secrets of the Timeless Isle
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Timeless Coins from creatures and events on the Timeless Isle.
english.description: There is a currency minted only on this island - "timeless coins." They are immune to the island's temporal distortions... I would like to figure out why.$b$bGather some for me! Venture into the jungles of this forgotten paradise. Destroy the mysterious foes who lurk in this timeless place, discover hidden caches of treasure, and explore forgotten treasure hoards - whatever it takes. I will be waiting!
english.progress: <Wrathion tents his fingers together.>$B$BMy coins...?
english.completion: Wonderful, these are exactly what I need.$B$B<Wrathion holds one of the coins up, admiring it in the glow of the unmoving sun.>$B$BI will deconstruct their mysterious power, and use their timelessness to enhance your cloak. You will be most pleased with the result.
english.completed: Bring the coins to Wrathion on the Timeless Isle near the Jade Forest.

text.title: 帝王之道
text.objectives: 击败玉珑、赤精、雪怒和砮皂这四位潘达利亚的至尊天神。
text.description: 不久前，潘达利亚的至尊天神给予了你一项挑战——而你取得了胜利。$b$b但你能在战斗中打败他们吗？他们在考验潘达利亚所有英雄的胆魄。$b$b这项挑战并非不可能完成，可你需要听取熊猫人末代皇帝的建议，并凭借坚定的内在力量应对这项挑战。你还需要集结一小支军队，去找些你信任的朋友来吧。$b$b在天神庭院击败四位天神，我们的旅途就差不多要结束了……
text.completion: An impressive display of martial skill, $c! You have truly walked the path of the emperor, and demonstrated the very traits pandaren value most.
text.completed: Return to Wrathion on the Timeless Isle near the Jade Forest.

english.title: The Emperor's Way
english.objectives: Defeat Yu'lon, Chi-Ji, Xuen and Niuzao, the four August Celestials of Pandaria.
english.description: Recently, the August Celestials of Pandaria presented you with a challenge - and you triumphed.$b$bBut can you defeat them in combat? They are testing the mettle of all of Pandaria's heroes.$b$bThis challenge is not impossible, but you'll need to follow the advice of the last Pandaren Emperor and tackle it with unwavering inner strength. You'll also need a small army, so find a group of people you trust.$b$bDefeat the four celestials here in the Celestial Court, and our journey is almost complete...
english.completion: An impressive display of martial skill, $c! You have truly walked the path of the emperor, and demonstrated the very traits pandaren value most.
english.completed: Return to Wrathion on the Timeless Isle near the Jade Forest.

text.title: 熊猫人的传说
text.objectives: 到锦绣谷的闻道之座与拉希奥会面。
text.description: 我在这个永恒之地增长了许多见识，朋友。在天神的智慧与这些永恒神器的神秘力量之间，我现在知道该如何安全地用我自己强大的力量来强化你的斗篷。$b$b我需要到一个神圣的地方来施展最后的法术。动作快！到锦绣谷魔古山宫殿上方的闻道之座与我会面吧。$b$b今天，你的传说即将开始！
text.completion: Step forward, my champion.$B$BThis is your hour.
text.completed: Meet Wrathion within the Seat of Knowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

english.title: A Pandaren Legend
english.objectives: Meet Wrathion within the Seat of Knowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
english.description: I have learned so much in this timeless place, friend. Between the wisdom of the celestials and the curious power of these timeless artifacts, I know now how to safely augment your cloak with my own considerable power.$b$bI need a sacred place to complete my final incantations. Quickly! Meet me in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms, within the Seat of Knowledge above the Mogu'shan Palace.$b$bToday, your legend begins!
english.completion: Step forward, my champion.$B$BThis is your hour.
english.completed: Meet Wrathion within the Seat of Knowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: 黑王子的审判
text.objectives: 完成决战奥格瑞玛并击败加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮。
text.description: 现在，该实行我计划的最后一步了。是时候完成你的伟大使命了。$b$b利用你新获得的力量，为这场战争画上句号吧。去消灭加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮。你的人民在迫切渴望着，你的后世子孙也将歌颂你的功绩，我们将共同建造一个光辉的新世界，而你，将成为先驱者！$b$b我没有奖励可以给你。我已经竭尽所能来确保你能取得成功。现在要靠你自己了。$b$b终结地狱咆哮的暴政。
text.completion: <Wrathion is FURIOUS. News of Hellscream's defeat and King Wrynn's gesture of peace must've already reached the black dragon's ears.>
text.completed: Return to Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

english.title: Judgment of the Black Prince
english.objectives: Complete the Siege of Orgrimmar and defeat Garrosh Hellscream.
english.description: Now. To the final stage of my plan. Time to fulfil your grand purpose.$b$bUsing your newfound powers, it is time to bring this war to its conclusion. Destroy Garrosh Hellscream. Your people demand it, and future generations will sing your praises as the harbinger for the glorious new world we shall build together.$b$bI have no reward to offer you. I have already done everything in my power to ensure that you succeed. You are on your own.$b$bEnd Hellscream's reign.
english.completion: <Wrathion is FURIOUS. News of Hellscream's defeat and King Wrynn's gesture of peace must've already reached the black dragon's ears.>
english.completed: Return to Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

text.title: 战火为何而燃？
text.objectives: 游学者周卓想与你在锦绣谷谈一谈。
text.description: 噢，我的朋友，今天你和你的同伴终结了自有史以来就始终困扰潘达利亚的邪煞。你们的壮举，甚至令泰坦和他们的魔古仆从都望尘莫及——你们竟然摧毁了亚煞极最后的气息。$b$b来吧，你愿意到锦绣谷与我会合吗？有些事情我希望你能亲眼见证。
text.completion: Our precious Vale of Eternal Blossoms. So much destruction and violence. But... I sense a glimmer of hope.

english.description: Oh my friend, today you and your companions have put an end to the sha that has plagued Pandaria since before time was recorded. You have accomplished that which even the titans and their mogu servants could not: destroying the last breaths of Y'Shaarj.$b$bCome, will you join me in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms? There is something I would like you to bear witness to.

text.title: 永恒之疑
text.objectives: 正确回答一个由伊夫琳娜提出的有关艾泽拉斯历史的问题。
text.description: 命运、定数、因果循环。这样的词汇暗示着时间之流的无懈可击。$B$B但愿真是这样。直到今天，艾泽拉斯的许多住民仍然渴望改变过去。然而正如我们的经历可以塑造我们一样，它们也能塑造我们身边的世界。$B$B想想这些千丝万缕的线是如何织成了我们今天的现实世界。一旦割断足够多的线，因果必将化为虚无，我们的世界也会分崩瓦解。事实上，哪怕只将一根线剪短，都会引发灾难性的结局，前提是线要剪对。
text.completion: This is the great burden of the Historian - should Azeroth's timeways come under attack, we must reconstruct history exactly as it happened, or the consequences could be dire. As we spread our stories and knowledge, so do we create a stronger future for us all.
text.completed: Return to Senior Historian Evelyna on the Timeless Isle.

english.title: A Timeless Question
english.objectives: Correctly answer one of Evelyna's questions about the history of Azeroth.
english.description: Destiny. Fate. Karma. Words like these imply that the timeways are unassailable.$B$BWould that were the case. To this day, many of Azeroth's inhabitants yearn to change the past. Yet just as our experiences shape us, they also shape the world around us.$B$BConsider how those threads have woven the fabric of today's reality. Cut enough threads, and causation inevitably fails, unraveling that fabric. Indeed, cutting even a single thread short can result in disaster, provided it is the right thread.
english.completion: This is the great burden of the Historian - should Azeroth's timeways come under attack, we must reconstruct history exactly as it happened, or the consequences could be dire. As we spread our stories and knowledge, so do we create a stronger future for us all.
english.completed: Return to Senior Historian Evelyna on the Timeless Isle.

text.title: 时间在你手中
text.objectives: 收集$1oa个永恒铸币，并向织雾者艾莉和织雾者顾严介绍你自己。
text.description: 在这座诡异岛屿的住民间流通着一种特殊的货币，这种货币可以免受变幻无常的时间流影响。$b$b你最好能尽可能多地去收集这种“永恒铸币”！你可以在小型宝箱里或是岛上各种生物的身上找到它们。体型越大、越稀有的生物，往往会携带越多的铸币——所以你要是能和其他同伴组队的话，收入就会更为可观。$b$b到天神庭院与织雾者艾莉和织雾者顾严见个面，并为我搜集这种铸币吧。
text.progress: You're back already? It feels like we spoke only moments ago.
text.completion: I believe you are getting the feel for this place! Yes, opportunities abound to gather up timeless treasures. text.objectives: 到位于翡翠林沿海的永恒岛上与观察者劳拉交谈。
text.description: 青铜龙军团发现了一个极不寻常的熊猫人现象，$c。在远离翡翠林海岸线的地方，一座迷失在时光中的岛屿冲破了迷雾！$b$b那里危险得很，也许是整个潘达利亚最为危机四伏的地方。可我们决心解开这座岛屿的谜团。$b$b来，拿着这个计时器。只需轻轻一按，你就将飞驰到岛上。站稳脚跟后就去和观察者劳拉谈谈吧。她会带你去找我们的首席侦察员。
text.completion: I see Chronormu has made good on her promise! You are right on time.
text.completed: 到翡翠林沿岸的永恒岛与观察者劳拉交谈。

text.objectives: 到白虎寺与试炼教头罗敦交谈，然后进入试炼场。
text.description: 喂！你叫$n是吧？你好啊。我是泰晶。$b$b<泰晶上下打量了你一番。>$b$b你看起来很强壮。我在山谷里见过你几面，但还从来没看到过你战斗的样子。我在想……你会不会是个绣花枕头？$b$b要是你愿意证明自己的话，就去昆莱山的白虎寺与试炼教头罗敦谈一谈吧。他会考验你的实力。
text.completion: Welcome to the Proving Grounds, $c. I am Trial Master Rotun.$B$BHere, you may test your skill at performing several different combat roles: dealing damage, absorbing damage, and healing. I shall administer and judge these trials.$B$B$B$BAre you ready to begin?
